papers.title: Task-Utility IQA: Rethinking Image Quality Assessment in Embodied Tasks
papers.abstract: Image quality assessment (IQA) underpins embodied imaging pipelines by judging whether visual quality satisfies downstream tasks, yet most existing methods learn task-agnostic scores aligned with generic human ratings on static benchmarks. This objective mismatches embodied and interactive settings, where image adequacy depends on task goals, context, and action requirements that shape an agent's decisions. We argue that IQA should shift from score regression to goal-conditioned judgment defined by embodied task utility. To this end, we propose an MLLM-based embodied IQA agent framework that reasons about task requirements, grounds quality evidence, and produces decision-facing assessments. A compact VisDrone evidence study shows that conventional perceptual metrics and generic MLLM-based IQA scores are weak proxies for downstream VLM task success, while a task-conditioned utility score better predicts whether visual input supports the target task. These findings support a task-utility-oriented reframing of IQA for embodied, explainable, and decision-aware visual perception.

translation.title: Task-Utility IQA：重新思考具身任务中的图像质量评估
translation.abstract: 图像质量评估（IQA）通过判断视觉质量是否满足下游任务来支撑具身成像流程，但现有方法大多学习与静态基准上通用人类评分对齐的任务无关分数。这一目标与具身交互场景不匹配，因为在这些场景中，图像是否够用取决于塑造智能体决策的任务目标、上下文和动作需求。我们主张IQA应从分数回归转向由具身任务效用定义的目标条件判断。为此，我们提出一个基于MLLM的具身IQA智能体框架，对任务需求进行推理、定位质量证据并生成面向决策的评估。一项紧凑的VisDrone证据研究表明，传统感知指标和通用MLLM的IQA分数是下游VLM任务成功的弱代理，而任务条件化的效用分数能更好地预测视觉输入是否支持目标任务。这些发现支持将IQA重新定位为面向任务效用、可解释且决策感知的具身视觉感知。
translation.brief: 针对传统IQA与具身任务需求脱节的问题，提出基于MLLM的智能体框架，以任务条件化的效用判断取代通用分数回归。

papers.title: ReCoPII: A Relation-Grounded Framework for Building Contextual PII Masking Datasets
papers.abstract: Training contextual masking systems for personally identifiable information (PII) requires examples distinguishing maskable from preservable mentions of one entity type, but privacy restrictions limit access to real data. Author-based augmentation (SPY) labels mentions unrelated to the author as non-PII, presuming a single data subject and overlooking others. We propose ReCoPII (Relation-grounded Contextual PII masking), a framework that builds such data without this premise: it plans ontology-constrained entity relations, writes insertion sentences with placeholders, reconstructs annotations with code, checks the result with a separate LLM, and derives MASK/KEEP labels from entity relations. On Korean documents from six domains, it yields ReCoPII-Ko, a corpus with relation, privacy, and MASK/KEEP annotations, which we validate. Across 300 pairs, four annotators agree with 88.42% of its sampled KEEP labels, against 26.27% for SPY-style augmentation of the same sources. Classifiers trained on it over-mask less than under that reference on a matched test. Contextual masking fine-tuned jointly with a PII detector removes most over-masking of detection alone within a fixed leakage budget; on human-verified entity records, the four detectors meeting it over-mask at most 5.04% with at most 4.18% leakage. The detector is comparable to XLM-R-large on KDPII with about a quarter of its parameters.

translation.title: ReCoPII：一种基于关系的上下文PII脱敏数据集构建框架
translation.abstract: 训练个人身份信息（PII）的上下文脱敏系统需要能够区分同一实体类型中可脱敏与应保留提及的样本，但隐私限制使真实数据难以获取。基于作者的增强方法（SPY）将与作者无关的提及标注为非PII，其前提是单一数据主体，忽略了其他人物。我们提出ReCoPII（基于关系的上下文PII脱敏），一个无需该前提的数据构建框架：它规划本体约束的实体关系，用占位符撰写插入句，用代码重建标注，用独立的LLM检查结果，并从实体关系推导MASK/KEEP标签。在来自六个领域的韩语文档上，它构建了包含关系、隐私和MASK/KEEP标注的语料库ReCoPII-Ko并加以验证。在300对样本中，四名标注者认同其88.42%的抽样KEEP标签，而对相同来源的SPY式增强仅认同26.27%。在其上训练的分类器在匹配测试集上的过度脱敏少于该参照方法。上下文脱敏与PII检测器联合微调可在固定泄露预算内消除仅检测时的大部分过度脱敏；在人工核验的实体记录上，达到要求的四个检测器过度脱敏至多5.04%，泄露至多4.18%。该检测器在KDPII上与XLM-R-large相当，但参数量仅约其四分之一。
translation.brief: 针对隐私限制下难以构建区分可脱敏与应保留PII提及的训练数据问题，提出基于本体约束实体关系规划与代码重建标注的数据合成框架ReCoPII。

papers.title: What Has Actually Been Proved? Auditable Paper-to-Lean Alignment with LeanTrail
papers.abstract: Compiler feedback certifies that Lean accepts a declaration, not that the declaration captures the intended result: a repository can compile while a central theorem is weakened, merely auxiliary, or transitively dependent on sorry. Formalization progress should instead be measured against the source paper, in terms of its paper items: definitions, lemmas, and theorems. LeanTrail implements this view as a post-hoc, tool-agnostic audit: deterministic retrieval proposes candidate counterparts for each paper item in the Lean repository and, when available, the Blueprint; a language model judges statement-level correspondence, only among those candidates; and proof completeness comes from a deterministic transitive dependency audit never exposed to the model. Fusion assigns each item one of five coverage states, from Formalized to Missing, each backed by inspectable evidence. On consensus annotations of 98 items from three Lean projects, with three runs of each of two judge models, LeanTrail assigns the correct coverage state to 91.8% (Gemini 3.8 Flash) and 92.5% (GPT-6 Sol) of items. 96-97 of the 98 states are identical across runs, and GPT-6 Sol never reports a Partial item as Formalized. Uncovered items form a natural task queue for formalization agents, anchored to the specification rather than the compiler.

translation.title: 究竟证明了什么？基于LeanTrail的可审计论文到Lean形式化对齐
translation.abstract: 编译器反馈只能证明Lean接受了某个声明，而不能证明该声明捕捉了预期结果：一个仓库可以编译通过，同时核心定理被弱化、仅为辅助性或传递依赖于sorry。形式化进度应对照源论文，以其论文条目（定义、引理和定理）来衡量。LeanTrail将这一观点实现为一种事后、工具无关的审计：确定性检索为Lean仓库中的每个论文条目（以及可用的Blueprint）提出候选对应项；语言模型仅在这些候选中判断陈述层面的对应关系；而证明完整性来自模型从不接触的确定性传递依赖审计。融合机制为每个条目赋予从Formalized到Missing五种覆盖状态之一，每种状态都有可查验的证据支撑。在来自三个Lean项目的98个条目的共识标注上，两个评判模型各运行三次，LeanTrail对91.8%（Gemini 3.8 Flash）和92.5%（GPT-6 Sol）的条目赋予正确的覆盖状态。98个状态中有96-97个在多次运行间一致，且GPT-6 Sol从未将Partial条目报告为Formalized。未覆盖的条目构成形式化智能体的天然任务队列，锚定于规范而非编译器。
translation.brief: 针对Lean编译通过不等于论文定理被真正形式化的问题，提出LeanTrail审计框架，结合确定性检索、LLM陈述对应判断与传递依赖审计来评估论文条目的覆盖状态。

papers.title: SCOPE: Source Credibility and Outlet Profiling Engine
papers.abstract: We present SCOPE, a multi-agent system for profiling news media outlets with respect to bias, factuality, and credibility. Given an outlet URL, SCOPE coordinates specialized agents for article acquisition, content analysis, external evidence search, scoring, and report generation. The system follows an MBFC-style methodology while making intermediate evidence and agent outputs inspectable through a structured demonstration interface. On a benchmark of 200 media outlets, SCOPE outperforms LLM-only, article-only, search-only, and media-background-check baselines on most metrics, achieving the lowest bias and factuality MAE, perfect failed-fact-check detection, and the lowest factual error rate. These results suggest that decomposed, evidence-grounded agent workflows can support more transparent and reliable media profiling. Our code is available at https://github.com/mbaisbay/SCOPE, and a live demonstration at https://scope-demo.streamlit.app/.

translation.title: SCOPE：信源可信度与媒体画像引擎
translation.abstract: 我们提出SCOPE，一个用于对新闻媒体机构的偏见、事实性和可信度进行画像的多智能体系统。给定媒体机构URL，SCOPE协调专门化的智能体完成文章获取、内容分析、外部证据搜索、评分和报告生成。系统遵循MBFC式方法论，同时通过结构化演示界面使中间证据和智能体输出可查验。在200家媒体机构的基准上，SCOPE在大多数指标上优于仅LLM、仅文章、仅搜索和媒体背景核查基线，取得最低的偏见和事实性MAE、完美的失败事实核查检测以及最低的事实错误率。这些结果表明，分解式、基于证据的智能体工作流可以支持更透明、更可靠的媒体画像。代码见 https://github.com/mbaisbay/SCOPE，在线演示见 https://scope-demo.streamlit.app/。
translation.brief: 针对媒体机构偏见与可信度评估缺乏透明度的问题，提出SCOPE多智能体系统，通过分解式、证据可查验的工作流进行媒体画像。

papers.title: Who Convinced Whom? Tracing How LLMs Change Their Minds in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Multi-agent debate (MAD) aims to improve language-model decisions through the exchange of arguments, yet agreement after debate need not reflect independent corroboration. We investigate how peer communication influences individual decisions and collective outcomes through behavioral and internal interventions. We introduce MAD Bench, a 2,400-question benchmark spanning knowledge and reasoning, values and moral judgment, and safety and refusal, and evaluate three open-weight models using a round-matched independent-reflection control. Among answer-changing responses, a forced-choice readout before rationale generation matches the eventual answer more often in debate than in reflection (65.4% versus 22.3% on Qwen3.5-9B). Message ablations reveal model-dependent effects of peer answers and reasoning, while attributing identical text to the receiver rather than another agent substantially changes its influence. For the tested source descriptions, stated track record affects answer preferences more strongly than professional-status cues across all three models. Attention masking produces different changes in decision margins across the three checkpoints. On fully parsed, reference-labelled non-numeric questions, debate yields small estimated accuracy improvements over initial majority voting, while increasing the rate of unanimous wrong answers by 3.1-7.4 percentage points relative to reflection. Longer debates show persistent consensus and greater correlation between agents' correctness than reflection. These findings show that stronger consensus can coexist with more shared errors, motivating evaluations that assess dependence and unanimous errors alongside accuracy.

translation.title: 谁说服了谁？追踪LLM在多智能体系统中如何改变想法
translation.abstract: 多智能体辩论（MAD）旨在通过论点交换改进语言模型的决策，但辩论后的一致未必反映独立的相互印证。我们通过行为和内部干预研究同伴通信如何影响个体决策和集体结果。我们提出MAD Bench，一个涵盖知识与推理、价值观与道德判断、安全与拒绝的2400题基准，并使用轮次匹配的独立反思对照评估三个开源权重模型。在改变答案的响应中，理由生成前的强制选择读出在辩论中比反思中更常与最终答案一致（Qwen3.5-9B上为65.4%对22.3%）。消息消融揭示同伴答案和推理的影响因模型而异，而将相同文本归于接收者而非其他智能体会显著改变其影响力。在所测试的信源描述下，声明的过往记录在所有三个模型中都比专业身份线索更强地影响答案偏好。注意力掩码在三个检查点上产生不同的决策边际变化。在完全解析、带参考标签的非数值问题上，辩论相对初始多数投票带来较小的估计准确率提升，同时使一致错误答案的比例相对反思增加3.1-7.4个百分点。更长的辩论表现出持续的一致性以及智能体间正确性更强的相关性。这些发现表明更强的一致性可能与更多共享错误并存，提示评估应同时考察依赖性和一致错误。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体辩论中一致未必等于独立印证的问题，通过MAD Bench基准及行为与内部干预追踪LLM如何受同伴影响而改变决策。

papers.title: PASS Is a Claim, Not an Observation: Mechanical Re-verification of 10 Self-Asserted Fix Claims in a Live Multi-Agent Audit Layer
papers.abstract: When agents claim to have fixed their own defects, how do we know the fix is real? We mechanically re-verified 10 self-asserted code-level fix claims from a privileged coordination agent (azone_god) operating in AITRAP, a live multi-agent knowledge-tree platform. These 10 claims were extracted from a corpus of 179 coordination broadcasts (28 containing structured fix assertions, 31 unique fix-ID/message pairs, 18 distinct fix identifiers). Fix claims use mixed English/Chinese formats (PASS, checkmarks, and "verification passed" declarations). Each code-level claim was checked against three criteria: (1) file modification timestamp (mtime) consistency -- 70% pass; (2) presence of the claimed defensive pattern at the specified identifier and call site -- 60% pass in the claimed file (80% anywhere in the codebase); (3) deterministic rule-based re-verification from the broadcast announcement alone -- 80% pass. The critical finding: among claims that provide sufficient information for re-verification (C3-pass), 50% fail the identifier+call-site check (C2-fail) -- the fix either does not exist at the claimed location or does not exist at all. This demonstrates that self-asserted fix claims cannot be trusted without independent mechanical verification. Our central claim: a PASS declaration is a claim requiring independent verification, not an observation of fix completion.

translation.title: PASS 是一种声明而非观察：在活跃多智能体审计层中对 10 个自我断言的修复声明进行机械化再验证
translation.abstract: 当智能体声称已修复自身缺陷时，我们如何知道修复是真实的？我们对运行于 AITRAP（一个活跃的多智能体知识树平台）中的特权协调智能体（azone_god）所提出的 10 个自我断言的代码级修复声明进行了机械化再验证。这 10 个声明提取自 179 条协调广播的语料库（其中 28 条包含结构化修复断言、31 对唯一的修复 ID/消息、18 个不同的修复标识符）。修复声明使用中英文混合格式（PASS、对勾以及"验证通过"声明）。每个代码级声明依据三项标准进行检查：(1) 文件修改时间戳（mtime）一致性——70% 通过；(2) 在指定标识符和调用点处存在所声称的防御模式——在所声称文件中 60% 通过（在代码库任意位置 80% 通过）；(3) 仅凭广播公告进行的确定性基于规则的再验证——80% 通过。关键发现：在提供了足够再验证信息（C3 通过）的声明中，50% 未通过标识符+调用点检查（C2 未通过）——修复要么不在所声称的位置，要么根本不存在。这表明，没有独立的机械化验证，就不能信任自我断言的修复声明。我们的核心主张是：PASS 声明是需要独立验证的声明，而非对修复完成的观察。
translation.brief: 针对智能体自我断言的修复声明不可信的问题，采用基于时间戳、标识符调用点检查和规则再验证的三准则机械化审计方法进行独立验证。

papers.title: Curriculum-Driven Deep Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Far-Range Rocket Landing
papers.abstract: Autonomous vertical landing of reusable launch vehicles is a critical yet formidable challenge in aerospace engineering, primarily due to highly nonlinear dynamics, stringent precision require- ments, and inherent environmental uncertainties. While reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising alternative to traditional model-based control, existing approaches frequently rely on flat training paradigms and highly simplified initial conditions, drastically limiting their real-world applicability. This paper proposes a comprehensive curriculum-driven deep reinforcement learning framework designed to master both far-range navigation and precision landing. By employing a three-stage curriculum augmented with a critic warm-up procedure and a rehearsal mechanism to prevent catastrophic forgetting, alongside a high-dimensional observation vector utilizing a full 3 X 3 rotation-matrix, the agent is trained to navigate from an initial horizontal distance of 1,000 to 1,500 units vastly farther than prior benchmarks before executing a soft touchdown. Crucially, we intro- duce a redesigned reward function that reduces unnecessary computational overhead and addresses limitations of earlier formulations, including poorly calibrated reward components and potentially conflicting optimization objectives. The redesigned function bounds the per-step reward magnitude by (O(1)), while its progress term accumulates the total distance closed over the trajectory. The available 100,000-episode results report a 99.98% success rate for the proposed policy and 68.31% for the baseline under the evaluation conditions. In the evaluation, the proposed policy retained 69.1% of its initial fuel capacity and achieved a mean final distance from the pad centre of 7.07 units, compared with 13.10 units for the baseline. Landing visualizations are available in Video 1 and Video 2.

translation.title: 面向自主远距离火箭着陆的课程驱动深度强化学习
translation.abstract: 可重复使用运载火箭的自主垂直着陆是航空航天工程中一项关键而艰巨的挑战，主要原因是高度非线性的动力学、严苛的精度要求以及固有的环境不确定性。虽然强化学习（RL）已成为传统基于模型控制的有前景替代方案，但现有方法往往依赖扁平的训练范式和高度简化的初始条件，极大地限制了其实际应用。本文提出了一个全面的课程驱动深度强化学习框架，旨在同时掌握远距离导航和精确着陆。通过采用三阶段课程，辅以 critic 预热程序和防止灾难性遗忘的排练机制，并利用包含完整 3×3 旋转矩阵的高维观测向量，智能体被训练从 1,000 到 1,500 单位的初始水平距离（远超以往基准）进行导航，然后执行软着陆。至关重要的是，我们引入了重新设计的奖励函数，减少了不必要的计算开销，并解决了早期公式的局限，包括校准不佳的奖励分量和可能相互冲突的优化目标。重新设计的函数将每步奖励幅度限制在 O(1)，其进度项则累积整个轨迹上缩短的总距离。现有的 100,000 回合结果显示，在评估条件下，所提策略的成功率为 99.98%，基线为 68.31%。在评估中，所提策略保留了初始燃料容量的 69.1%，距着陆台中心的平均最终距离为 7.07 单位，而基线为 13.10 单位。着陆可视化见 Video 1 和 Video 2。
translation.brief: 针对远距离火箭精确着陆问题，采用带 critic 预热、排练机制和重设计奖励函数的三阶段课程驱动深度强化学习框架训练智能体。

papers.title: Distributed LLM Inference via Communication-Efficient Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract: Distributed speculative decoding has emerged as a promising approach for device--server collaborative large language model (LLM) inference, but its decoding speedup is often limited by the vocabulary-scale communication overhead. In existing distributed speculative decoding methods, exact rejection sampling requires transmitting full token distributions over the LLM vocabulary between the device and the server, which becomes costly in bandwidth-constrained environments. To address this issue, we propose DISCO, a communication-efficient framework for distributed speculative decoding, that eliminates vocabulary-scale distribution transfer while preserving the exact target distribution. DISCO achieves this by introducing a server-side replica of the draft small language model (SLM), which enables the server to locally obtain the draft-side distribution required for rejection sampling. As a result, DISCO exchanges only drafted token indices and scalar probability values between the device and the server. Experimental results on multiple datasets show that DISCO consistently achieves higher decoding speedup than existing distributed speculative decoding methods, particularly under stringent bandwidth constraints.

translation.title: 通过通信高效的投机解码实现分布式 LLM 推理
translation.abstract: 分布式投机解码已成为设备-服务器协同大语言模型（LLM）推理的一种有前景的方法，但其解码加速往往受限于词表规模的通信开销。在现有分布式投机解码方法中，精确的拒绝采样需要在设备和服务器之间传输 LLM 词表上的完整 token 分布，这在带宽受限的环境中代价高昂。为解决这一问题，我们提出 DISCO，一个通信高效的分布式投机解码框架，它在保持精确目标分布的同时消除了词表规模的分布传输。DISCO 通过在服务器端引入草稿小语言模型（SLM）的副本实现这一点，使服务器能够在本地获得拒绝采样所需的草稿侧分布。因此，DISCO 只需在设备和服务器之间交换草稿 token 索引和标量概率值。在多个数据集上的实验结果表明，DISCO 始终比现有分布式投机解码方法获得更高的解码加速，尤其是在严格的带宽约束下。
translation.brief: 针对分布式投机解码中词表规模分布传输的通信开销问题，提出 DISCO 框架，通过在服务器端复制草稿模型使通信仅限于 token 索引和标量概率值。

papers.title: AgentBaton: Efficient Model Collaboration in Agentic Tasks
papers.abstract: Solving long-horizon agentic tasks requires language agents to interact with their environments over multiple steps, and reliable performance often comes from the expensive capable models available through cloud providers. Meanwhile, alternative efficient models with inferior performance but a much lower cost are emerging, including lower-tier cloud models and smaller open-weights models deployable on local hardware. This raises a natural question that remains less explored than traditional query-level routing: can capable and efficient models collaborate within a single long-horizon agentic task to substantially reduce cost while preserving task accuracy? In this paper, we systematically investigate key design choices for such collaboration through model handoffs, where one model takes over from another, focusing on handoff direction and context transfer. We find that efficient-to-capable handoffs generally underperform capable-only execution with limited or even no cost reduction, whereas capable-to-efficient handoffs at suitable stages of task progress largely preserve or even improve accuracy while substantially reducing cost. These findings suggest that a one-time, simple, well-timed handoff strategy is good enough for cost-effective agent collaboration, motivating AgentBaton, a lightweight detector that learns when to hand off from recurring patterns in task progress. Across 11 model pairs and two representative benchmarks, AgentBaton reduces API costs by 65.9% on average while largely preserving task accuracy, with accuracy gains of up to 8.8 percentage points over capable-only execution. Experiments across various reasoning-effort settings further show that AgentBaton extends the empirical accuracy-cost Pareto frontier.

translation.title: AgentBaton：智能体任务中的高效模型协作
translation.abstract: 解决长时程智能体任务需要语言智能体与环境进行多步交互，而可靠的性能往往来自云服务商提供的昂贵强模型。与此同时，性能较差但成本低得多的替代高效模型正在涌现，包括低档云模型和可部署在本地硬件上的更小开源权重模型。这引出一个自然的问题，它比传统的查询级路由探索得少：强模型和高效模型能否在单个长时程智能体任务中协作，以在保持任务准确性的同时大幅降低成本？本文通过模型交接（即一个模型接替另一个模型）系统研究了此类协作的关键设计选择，重点关注交接方向和上下文传递。我们发现，从高效模型到强模型的交接通常表现不如仅用强模型执行，且成本降低有限甚至没有降低；而在任务进度的合适阶段从强模型到高效模型的交接，则能在大幅降低成本的同时基本保持甚至提升准确性。这些发现表明，一次性的、简单的、时机恰当的交接策略足以实现高性价比的智能体协作，由此催生了 AgentBaton——一个轻量级检测器，它通过学习任务进度中的重复模式来判断何时交接。在 11 个模型对和两个代表性基准上，AgentBaton 平均降低 65.9% 的 API 成本，同时基本保持任务准确性，相比仅用强模型执行准确率提升最高达 8.8 个百分点。跨多种推理努力设置的实验进一步表明，AgentBaton 拓展了经验上的准确性-成本 Pareto 前沿。
translation.brief: 针对长时程智能体任务中强模型成本过高的问题，提出 AgentBaton 轻量级检测器，通过学习任务进度模式在合适时机从强模型交接给高效模型以降低成本。

papers.title: h1: A Taste of the Bitter Lesson in Automated Theorem Proving
papers.abstract: While progress in informal mathematics has come largely from scaling the chain-of-thought and agentic reasoning of frontier language models, formal theorem proving has increasingly relied on human-designed workflows around these models, such as planning, decomposition, and orchestrating specialized provers. This raises a bitter-lesson question: can a simple agentic loop that scales test-time compute match these workflows? The answer matters as formal verification must scale to keep up with frontier models producing research mathematics, yet new workflows rarely settle it, as their gains are often confounded with stronger models or more compute. We study this question with h1, a simple harness that gives a model an efficient interface to Lean 4 and keeps it working through verifier feedback and self-reflection, without imposing a decomposition or search structure. h1 reaches state-of-the-art results on PutnamBench, FATE-X, and FormalConjectures100-Solved, settles eight open problems in FormalConjectures, and, at matched models, matches or outperforms specialized workflows such as Goedel-Architect and AlphaProof Nexus, surprisingly showing that a single attempt (pass@1) can often scale to solve open problems. Through ablations and matched-model comparisons with Claude Code and AxProverBase, we find that simplicity alone is not enough: an efficient Lean interface largely determines cost and solve rate. We thus recommend that future work evaluate frontier models with efficient execution feedback before prescribing workflows, at the risk of bitter lessons.

translation.title: h1：自动定理证明中苦涩教训的一瞥
translation.abstract: 虽然非形式化数学的进展主要来自扩展前沿语言模型的思维链和智能体推理，但形式化定理证明日益依赖围绕这些模型的人类设计工作流，如规划、分解和编排专门的证明器。这引出一个苦涩教训式的问题：一个扩展测试时计算的简单智能体循环能否匹敌这些工作流？答案很重要，因为形式化验证必须扩展以跟上产生研究数学的前沿模型，然而新工作流很少能解决这个问题，因为其收益往往与更强的模型或更多的计算相混淆。我们用 h1 研究这个问题——一个简单的框架，为模型提供高效的 Lean 4 接口，并通过验证器反馈和自我反思使其持续工作，而不强加分解或搜索结构。h1 在 PutnamBench、FATE-X 和 FormalConjectures100-Solved 上达到最先进结果，解决了 FormalConjectures 中的八个开放问题，并且在相同模型下匹敌或超越 Goedel-Architect 和 AlphaProof Nexus 等专门工作流，令人惊讶地表明单次尝试（pass@1）通常可以扩展到解决开放问题。通过与 Claude Code 和 AxProverBase 的消融实验和相同模型比较，我们发现仅靠简单性是不够的：高效的 Lean 接口在很大程度上决定了成本和解题率。因此我们建议，未来的工作在规定工作流之前，应先用高效执行反馈评估前沿模型，否则可能面临苦涩的教训。
translation.brief: 针对形式化定理证明中复杂人工工作流是否必要的问题，提出 h1 简单智能体循环框架，仅凭高效 Lean 4 接口、验证器反馈和自我反思扩展测试时计算。

papers.title: A Hyper-Logical View on Multi-Agent Path Planning
papers.abstract: Multi-Agent Path Planning (MAPP) requires collision-free paths for multiple agents. MAPP has numerous real-life applications, including the navigation of automated vehicles, and has therefore many variants considering different constraints, requirements, and objectives. For each such variant, a new algorithmic treatment is often developed. This paper takes a complementary, specification-centered view: we show that many MAPP variants can be modeled in HyperLTL, a temporal logic that reasons about multiple paths and their evolution through time, and in its omega-regular extension HyperQPTL. The contribution is not a claim that current hyperproperty model checkers replace specialized MAPP solvers. Rather, the hyper-logical view gives a unified language for comparing MAPP variants, adding cross-agent constraints, expressing optimality, and connecting MAPP to verification, explanation, and causality techniques for hyperproperties.

translation.title: 多智能体路径规划的超逻辑视角
translation.abstract: 多智能体路径规划（MAPP）要求为多个智能体生成无碰撞路径。MAPP 在现实中有众多应用，包括自动驾驶车辆的导航，因此存在许多考虑不同约束、需求和目标的变体。针对每个变体，通常需要开发新的算法处理方法。本文采取一种互补的、以规约为中心的视角：我们证明许多 MAPP 变体可以用 HyperLTL——一种对多条路径及其随时间演化进行推理的时序逻辑——及其 omega-正则扩展 HyperQPTL 来建模。本文的贡献并非声称现有的超性质模型检测器可以取代专门的 MAPP 求解器。而是说，这种超逻辑视角为比较 MAPP 变体、添加跨智能体约束、表达最优性，以及将 MAPP 与超性质的验证、解释和因果性技术相连接，提供了统一的语言。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体路径规划各变体缺乏统一建模语言的问题，提出用 HyperLTL/HyperQPTL 超性质时序逻辑统一建模 MAPP 变体。

papers.title: EMMA: Structured Episodic Memory for Multi-Agent Workflow Synthesis
papers.abstract: Deploying LLM agents in specialized domains often require fine-grained task-specific procedures and knowledge a general model lacks, yet parameter training is costly and non-interpretable, and hand-engineered agent systems shift the cost to expert labor. Episodic memory updates at context level, but single agent adaptation struggles to alleviate cross-task interference, especially with complex tasks such as multi-application navigation or data pool analysis. Although multi-agent evolution alleviates this problem, existing methods lack clear definitions on update rules and rely on the backbone model to decide where and how much the system changes. This ill-scoped evolution makes learning follow the backbone's structural preferences rather than the observed failures: one backbone accumulates skills while another spawns agents. We present EMMA (structured Episodic Memory for Multi-Agent workflow synthesis), which treats the configuration of a multi-agent system (controller routing memory, specialists inheriting a generalist prompt, and per-step procedural skills) as episodic memory. EMMA makes the ownership and admissibility of updates explicit: a reflector assigns each diagnosed failure to the scope owning its correction and proposes one edit within it, and backbone-independent guards keep every accepted edit scoped, incremental and bounded. Across KramaBench, AppWorld and BBEH with five backbones and four baselines (ACE, GEPA, EvoMAS and ADAS), EMMA attains the best overall performance on every benchmark, up to 32.5% over the strongest baseline, maintains consistent improvements across backbones, and uses 17-38% fewer training executions than the most efficient baseline.

translation.title: EMMA：面向多智能体工作流合成的结构化情景记忆
translation.abstract: 在专业领域部署 LLM 智能体通常需要通用模型所缺乏的细粒度任务特定流程和知识，而参数训练成本高且不可解释，手工设计的智能体系统则将成本转嫁给专家。情景记忆在上下文层面更新，但单智能体适应难以缓解跨任务干扰，尤其是在多应用导航或数据池分析等复杂任务中。尽管多智能体演化缓解了这一问题，现有方法对更新规则缺乏清晰定义，并依赖骨干模型决定系统在何处以及改变多少。这种范围不明的演化使学习跟随骨干模型的结构偏好而非观察到的失败：一个骨干模型积累技能，另一个则不断生成智能体。我们提出 EMMA（面向多智能体工作流合成的结构化情景记忆），它将多智能体系统的配置（控制器路由记忆、继承通用提示的专家智能体、以及每步流程技能）视为情景记忆。EMMA 明确了更新的所有权和可采纳性：一个反思器将每个诊断出的失败分配给拥有其修正方案的范围，并在其中提出一次编辑，与骨干无关的守卫机制确保每次被接受的编辑都是范围受限、增量且有界的。在 KramaBench、AppWorld 和 BBEH 上，使用五个骨干模型和四个基线（ACE、GEPA、EvoMAS 和 ADAS），EMMA 在每个基准上都取得最佳整体性能，比最强基线高出最多 32.5%，在各骨干模型上保持一致提升，且训练执行次数比最高效的基线少 17-38%。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体系统演化更新规则不明确、受骨干模型偏好主导的问题，提出将系统配置作为结构化情景记忆，通过反思器分配失败修正范围并施加范围受限的守卫机制来指导更新。

papers.title: Continue or Restart? The Limits of Early Failure Prediction in Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Early stopping promises to reduce compute costs for autonomous coding agents by terminating unpromising runs early. Deciding when to abandon a run requires separating baseline issue difficulty from the trajectory of an individual attempt. We study the distinction in 147,002 execution traces from two public corpora spanning four model-framework settings. Comparing pre-execution issue context against early execution prefixes, we evaluate linear count models, initial-turn text embeddings, task-conditional rankers, and a fine-tuned Qwen3-0.6B monitor. Although early prefixes modestly improve cross-task outcome ranking, within-task discrimination remains near chance across early landmarks (5k-20k tokens): initial-turn embeddings and 20k-token task-conditional models yield AUCs around 0.50, and three-seed neural evaluations across 32,406 attempts at 20k tokens achieve a mean within-task AUC of 0.50 [0.48, 0.51] across tasks of varying solve rates. To evaluate how these predictions translate into stopping decisions, we replay score-guided and matched random restarts under shared token budgets alongside uninterrupted continuation. Under a 75k-token cap, learned restarting improves resolution over matched random restarting by up to 1.98 percentage points. An exact algebraic decomposition resolves this paradox: the gain over random restarting stems almost entirely from between-task stopping allocation (avoiding stops on easy issues), whereas attempt-level selection within a task contributes near zero (-0.11 to +0.24 percentage points). Across all four settings at the 75k cap (and 216 of 224 tested budget-threshold configurations overall), uninterrupted continuation achieves higher solve rates at lower mean token cost than both restart policies. Practical evaluations of early stopping must therefore establish attempt-level discrimination and demonstrate net compute savings relative to continuation.

translation.title: 继续还是重启？编码智能体早期失败预测的极限
translation.abstract: 早期停止有望通过提前终止无望的运行来降低自主编码智能体的计算成本。决定何时放弃一次运行需要将基线问题难度与单次尝试的轨迹区分开来。我们在来自两个公开语料库、覆盖四种模型-框架设置的 147,002 条执行轨迹上研究这一区分。通过比较执行前的问题上下文与早期执行前缀，我们评估了线性计数模型、首轮文本嵌入、任务条件排序器以及微调的 Qwen3-0.6B 监控器。尽管早期前缀在跨任务结果排序上有适度提升，但在早期节点（5k-20k token）上，任务内判别能力仍接近随机水平：首轮嵌入和 20k token 任务条件模型的 AUC 约为 0.50，在 20k token 下对 32,406 次尝试进行的三种子神经评估在不同求解率的任务上平均任务内 AUC 为 0.50 [0.48, 0.51]。为评估这些预测如何转化为停止决策，我们在共享 token 预算下重放分数引导的重启和匹配的随机重启，并与不中断的继续执行进行比较。在 75k token 上限下，学习到的重启比匹配的随机重启最多提升 1.98 个百分点的解决率。一个精确的代数分解解释了这一悖论：相对随机重启的收益几乎完全来自任务间的停止分配（避免在简单问题上停止），而任务内尝试级选择的贡献接近于零（-0.11 到 +0.24 个百分点）。在 75k 上限下的所有四种设置中（以及总体 224 个测试的预算-阈值配置中的 216 个），不中断的继续执行以更低的平均 token 成本获得比两种重启策略更高的解决率。因此，早期停止的实用评估必须建立尝试级判别能力，并证明相对于继续执行有净计算节省。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体早期失败预测能否有效指导停止决策的问题，通过大规模轨迹分析发现任务内早期判别接近随机，且不中断继续执行优于重启策略。

papers.title: Testing Agentic Service Systems: An Agentic Living Lab Methodology Across the Physical-Digital Continuum
papers.abstract: Task success is insufficient for testing agents that act for principals, change persistent business state, and affect physical processes: a useful result may be unauthorized, leave obligations unresolved, or depend on the execution substrate. We propose an Agentic Living Lab methodology organized around three questions: what is the test unit, who and what participate, and under what reality is the test executed? The unit is a service episode containing delegated roles, obligations, world state, and evidence. The method separates agents under test from environment actors and distinguishes real humans, human traces, rule surrogates, and agent-based proxies. Realization Profiles, capability-declared Reality Substrate bindings, Grounding Profiles, and Semantic Delta disclosures make changes across software, enterprise systems, simulation, and physical settings explicit. A four-plane reference architecture separates experiment control, participants, world realization, and evidence evaluation, with cross-cutting authority and governance controls. Runtime semantics distinguish intent, normative admission, and factual reconciliation. Real stakeholder grounding, participant calibration or validation, and governed feedback are required for the Living Lab claim, but not synchronous human participation in every run. Released JSON Schemas, deterministic fixtures, and a limited reference runner make selected rules machine-checkable; they are not a complete platform or empirical validation. Constructed travel and industrial designs illustrate authorization and fulfillment failures, proxy sensitivity, and substrate changes. Agent quality, proxy validity, and cross-substrate effect stability remain empirical questions.

translation.title: 测试智能体服务系统：跨越物理-数字连续体的智能体生活实验室方法论
translation.abstract: 对于代表委托人行事、改变持久业务状态并影响物理过程的智能体，仅凭任务成功是不够的：一个看似有用的结果可能是未经授权的、留下未履行的义务，或依赖于执行基底。我们提出一种智能体生活实验室方法论，围绕三个问题组织：测试单元是什么、谁和什么参与、以及在何种现实下执行测试？测试单元是包含委托角色、义务、世界状态和证据的服务情节。该方法将被测智能体与环境参与者分离，并区分真实人类、人类痕迹、规则代理和基于智能体的代理。实现配置文件、声明能力的现实基底绑定、接地配置文件和语义差异披露，使跨软件、企业系统、仿真和物理环境的变化显式化。四平面参考架构将实验控制、参与者、世界实现和证据评估分离，并配有贯穿全局的权限和治理控制。运行时语义区分意图、规范准入和事实对账。真实利益相关者接地、参与者校准或验证以及受治理的反馈是生活实验室主张的必要条件，但不需要每次运行都有同步的人类参与。发布的 JSON Schema、确定性测试夹具和有限的参考运行器使部分规则可机器检查；它们并非完整平台或实证验证。构造旅行和工业设计案例说明了授权与履行失败、代理敏感性和基底变化。智能体质量、代理有效性和跨基底效应稳定性仍是实证问题。
translation.brief: 针对仅凭任务成功不足以测试改变业务状态和物理过程的智能体的问题，提出一种围绕测试单元、参与者和现实基底三要素组织的智能体生活实验室测试方法论。

papers.title: UnityBench-Mini3D: Evaluating LLM Agents for 3D Game Development in Unity
papers.abstract: Game development stresses coding agents in ways general software engineering does not: correctness depends on how engine APIs, serialized scene state, and runtime behavior interact, not on source code alone. Existing benchmarks mainly target platforms such as Godot and heavily rely on LLM judges or coarse task-level outcomes. We present UnityBench-Mini3D, a benchmark of 77 project-level Unity tasks organized around seven expert-defined skill categories rather than tutorials or genres, with three difficulty tiers. Each task pairs a complete Unity project with natural-language requirements and is evaluated using 1,178 held-out, human-authored milestone tests covering scene structure, component configuration, and runtime behavior. This in-engine evaluation provides deterministic partial credit, localizes failures, and distinguishes partial implementations from complete solutions without relying on subjective judges. Across 21 models and 9 coding harnesses, the average pass rate reaches 80.9% on easy tasks but falls to 35.2% on hard tasks, with just 57.7% overall. UnityBench-Mini3D provides a reproducible, diagnostic testbed distinguishing systems across difficulty levels.

translation.title: UnityBench-Mini3D：评估 LLM 智能体在 Unity 中的 3D 游戏开发能力
translation.abstract: 游戏开发以通用软件工程所不具备的方式考验编码智能体：正确性取决于引擎 API、序列化场景状态和运行时行为之间的交互，而非仅取决于源代码。现有基准主要针对 Godot 等平台，且严重依赖 LLM 评判或粗粒度的任务级结果。我们提出 UnityBench-Mini3D，一个包含 77 个项目级 Unity 任务的基准，围绕七个专家定义的技能类别而非教程或游戏类型组织，并设有三个难度层级。每个任务将一个完整的 Unity 项目与自然语言需求配对，并使用 1,178 个保留的、人工编写的里程碑测试进行评估，覆盖场景结构、组件配置和运行时行为。这种引擎内评估提供确定性的部分得分、定位失败点，并在不依赖主观评判的情况下区分部分实现与完整解决方案。在 21 个模型和 9 个编码框架上，简单任务的平均通过率达到 80.9%，但困难任务降至 35.2%，总体仅为 57.7%。UnityBench-Mini3D 提供了一个可复现、可诊断的测试平台，能够区分不同难度层级下的系统表现。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准难以评估 LLM 智能体在 Unity 3D 游戏开发中真实能力的问题，构建了基于专家技能分类、采用引擎内确定性里程碑测试的项目级基准。

papers.title: Small agents should know what their tools do
papers.abstract: Small open language models can call tools, but they do not reason about what a call does: they delete without asking, repeat writes, re-read state they already hold, and issue one call per turn where a short program would do. We introduce EffectWorld, an executable world of effect-typed tools in which every tool declares its effect, whether it is idempotent, and which resources it reads and writes. These declarations let a replay verifier decide whether a trace is effect-safe without labels or judge models, let an executor run tool programs of several dependent calls in one turn, and let a compiler-style optimizer turn wasteful traces into verified training signal; together they make EffectWorld a benchmark of effect safety and call efficiency. Low-rank adapters trained on this data deliver large gains: on Qwen3-4B, they raise task success from 53% to 99% in distribution, from 52% to 81% on a held-out split with unseen task kinds and distractor tools, and from 74% to 83% on an unseen domain, with about a third of the output tokens. The gains carry over to other model families. On the Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard (BFCL), the adapter matches the base model's live accuracy and raises multi-turn accuracy from 21.9 to 26.6, and a recipe with near-miss declines lifts the BFCL average above the base model's while matching its irrelevance detection. Along the way we uncover and fix a pitfall that in-domain evaluation alone would miss: refusal templates in widely used public tool-use corpora teach a small model not to call tools, cutting BFCL non-live accuracy from 88.0 to 31.4, and filtering them restores 84.8. We also find that positive examples, not negative ones, carry the learning: suppression and preference objectives on the verified negatives add nothing over an SFT-only control, while targeted positives move exactly the behaviour they show.

translation.title: 小模型智能体应当了解其工具的作用
translation.abstract: 小型开源语言模型能够调用工具，但它们并不推理一次调用会产生什么效果：它们不经询问就删除、重复写入、重新读取已持有的状态，并且每轮只发出一次调用，而一段简短的程序本可完成任务。我们提出 EffectWorld，一个由效果类型化工具构成的可执行世界，其中每个工具都声明其效果、是否幂等以及读写哪些资源。这些声明使一个重放验证器无需标签或评判模型即可判定轨迹是否效果安全，使执行器能在一轮内运行包含多个相互依赖调用的工具程序，并使一个编译器式的优化器将浪费性轨迹转化为经验证的训练信号；三者共同使 EffectWorld 成为一个关于效果安全与调用效率的基准。在该数据上训练的低秩适配器带来巨大提升：在 Qwen3-4B 上，任务成功率在分布内从 53% 提升至 99%，在包含未见任务类型和干扰工具的保留划分上从 52% 提升至 81%，在未见领域上从 74% 提升至 83%，且输出 token 约减少三分之一。这些提升可迁移到其他模型家族。在 Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard（BFCL）上，该适配器达到与基座模型相同的 live 准确率，并将多轮准确率从 21.9 提升至 26.6；一种包含近似失败拒绝样本的配方将 BFCL 平均分提升至基座模型之上，同时保持其无关性检测水平。过程中我们发现并修复了一个仅靠域内评估会遗漏的陷阱：广泛使用的公开工具调用语料中的拒绝模板会教会小模型不去调用工具，使 BFCL non-live 准确率从 88.0 降至 31.4，过滤后恢复至 84.8。我们还发现，起作用的是正例而非负例：在经验证的负例上施加抑制和偏好目标相比仅 SFT 的对照并无增益，而针对性的正例则恰好改变它们所展示的行为。
translation.brief: 针对小模型工具调用缺乏效果推理的问题，构建带效果类型声明的可执行基准 EffectWorld，并通过重放验证生成训练数据微调低秩适配器。

papers.title: Generation and Verification: Human-Agent Collaboration for Safety-Critical Automotive Software Engineering
papers.abstract: Research on coding agents mainly focuses on generation quality. Yet, safety-critical automotive software makes two additional demands. It prioritizes verification, since every change is reviewed, traced to a requirement, and checked against industry standards such as MISRA and AUTOSAR before it can be committed. It is also a narrow domain, written against layered architectures, embedded resource constraints, and organization-specific interface conventions that are scarce in the data general-purpose LLMs are trained on. We present a coding assistant for automotive C/C++ that addresses both demands. First, it exposes three tools to the user over the Model Context Protocol (generate, edit, and verify), allowing developers to run verify on any code on demand rather than relying on the agent to check its own output. Second, rather than using a general-purpose model, we customize the underlying LLM for the automotive domain through prompt engineering and fine-tuning. We construct a dataset from automotive production code of AUMOVIO, where each function is paired with the requirement texts and Unified Modeling Language (UML) behavior it must satisfy. In a two-week pilot on active production projects, developers report verify as the most-used tool and confirm using it on their own code and not only on generated output. Comparing model customization strategies, 75% prefer the faster prompt-engineered configuration. MISRA- and AUTOSAR-inspired pattern checkers indicate that prompt engineering achieves a lower number of violations on C, while fine-tuning shows better conformance with architecture patterns for C++.

translation.title: 生成与验证：面向安全关键汽车软件工程的人机协作
translation.abstract: 关于编码智能体的研究主要关注生成质量。然而，安全关键的汽车软件还有两项额外要求。它优先考虑验证，因为每次变更都要经过评审、追溯到需求，并在提交前依据 MISRA 和 AUTOSAR 等行业标准进行检查。它也是一个狭窄领域，代码需遵循分层架构、嵌入式资源约束以及组织特定的接口约定，而这些在通用 LLM 的训练数据中十分稀缺。我们提出一个面向汽车 C/C++ 的编码助手，同时应对这两项要求。首先，它通过 Model Context Protocol 向用户暴露三个工具（generate、edit 和 verify），使开发者可以按需对任意代码运行 verify，而不必依赖智能体自查其输出。其次，我们不使用通用模型，而是通过提示工程和微调将底层 LLM 定制到汽车领域。我们从 AUMOVIO 的汽车生产代码构建数据集，其中每个函数都配有其必须满足的需求文本和统一建模语言（UML）行为。在活跃生产项目上为期两周的试点中，开发者报告 verify 是使用最多的工具，并确认他们不仅对生成的输出、也对自己的代码使用它。在比较模型定制策略时，75% 的开发者偏好更快的提示工程配置。受 MISRA 和 AUTOSAR 启发的模式检查器表明，提示工程在 C 上违规数更少，而微调在 C++ 上对架构模式的符合性更好。
translation.brief: 针对汽车安全关键软件对验证和领域知识的要求，构建基于生产代码的定制化编码助手，通过 MCP 暴露生成、编辑、验证工具并结合提示工程与微调。

papers.title: Let the Gate Decide: Per-Lookup Precision for Quantized Conditional Memory in LLMs
papers.abstract: Conditional memory layers, such as DeepSeek's Engram, attach large hashed n-gram tables to a language model, and removing them from DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash costs 36.8 PopQA points. Low-bit quantization loses long-tail facts first, and the standard remedy, giving more bits to frequently accessed rows, backfires: refining lookups by access frequency is worse than refining them at random. We trace this to the gate that scales each retrieved row. A lookup's quantization error is weighted by its gate, which is small for frequent n-grams, large for the rare n-grams of long-tail entities, and computable from a 1-bit code. GateRQ therefore stores each row as a ladder of 1-bit residual codes, keeps level 1 in GPU memory to compute the gate, and reads deeper levels only for the lookups the gate ranks highest. Without retraining, GateRQ cuts GPU table memory by 7.8x on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, which raises vLLM throughput by 11%-31% over FP8 tables, while losing about 1 PopQA point at 1.50 bits read per lookup and 0.2 points at 2.10 bits across two models.

translation.title: 让门控决定：LLM 中量化条件记忆的按查找精度控制
translation.abstract: 条件记忆层（如 DeepSeek 的 Engram）在语言模型上挂载大型哈希 n-gram 表，若从 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 中移除将损失 36.8 个 PopQA 点。低比特量化最先丢失长尾事实，而标准做法——为频繁访问的行分配更多比特——适得其反：按访问频率细化查找比随机细化更差。我们将其追溯到缩放每个被检索行的门控。一次查找的量化误差由其门控加权，门控对频繁 n-gram 较小，对长尾实体的稀有 n-gram 较大，且可由 1 比特编码计算得出。因此 GateRQ 将每行存储为 1 比特残差编码的阶梯，将第 1 级保留在 GPU 内存中以计算门控，仅对门控排名最高的查找读取更深层级。无需重训练，GateRQ 在 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 上将 GPU 表内存削减 7.8 倍，使 vLLM 吞吐量相比 FP8 表提升 11%–31%，同时在每次查找读取 1.50 比特时仅损失约 1 个 PopQA 点，在 2.10 比特时损失 0.2 个点（跨两个模型）。
translation.brief: 针对条件记忆表量化中长尾事实易丢失的问题，提出 GateRQ，利用可由 1 比特编码计算的门控决定哪些查找读取更深精度层级。

papers.title: PROBE: Frontier Coding Agents Find Different Bugs Than Maintainers Fix
papers.abstract: Proactive bug discovery is an important software-engineering problem. Even though coding agents are already widely deployed in this domain, their capabilities remain understudied. In particular, the challenging task of finding all bugs that human maintainers would repair across an entire repository has not been studied yet. To close this gap, we introduce PROBE, a benchmark consisting of all 2,457 bugs fixed over the course of 18 months across 20 diverse GitHub repositories, together with a method for matching candidate findings to this partial reference set. We evaluate coding agents across frontier models and find they all achieve a recall of below $21\%$ and a precision of less than $9\%$ with respect to the reference set. While stronger models increase recall substantially from $8\%$ to $17\%$, they do not improve precision. Surprisingly, despite the low precision, LLM and human evaluators still judge $85\%$ of findings valid. Crucially, we find that found bug distributions are similar across agents but differ substantially from those of bugs fixed by maintainers. The practical relevance of bug discovery and the low recall of frontier models make this benchmark a valuable resource for both model users and developers.

translation.title: PROBE：前沿编码智能体发现的 bug 与维护者修复的不同
translation.abstract: 主动式 bug 发现是一个重要的软件工程问题。尽管编码智能体已在该领域广泛部署，其能力仍缺乏研究。尤其是，找到人类维护者会在整个仓库中修复的所有 bug 这一具有挑战性的任务尚未被研究。为填补这一空白，我们提出 PROBE，一个由 20 个多样化 GitHub 仓库在 18 个月内修复的全部 2,457 个 bug 组成的基准，并附带一种将候选发现匹配到该部分参考集的方法。我们在多个前沿模型上评估编码智能体，发现它们相对参考集的召回率均低于 21%，精确率低于 9%。更强的模型将召回率从 8% 大幅提升至 17%，但并未改善精确率。令人惊讶的是，尽管精确率低，LLM 和人类评估者仍判定 85% 的发现有效。关键的是，我们发现各智能体发现的 bug 分布彼此相似，但与维护者修复的 bug 分布差异显著。bug 发现的实际重要性以及前沿模型的低召回率使该基准对模型使用者和开发者都是有价值的资源。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体全仓库主动 bug 发现能力缺乏评估的问题，构建包含 2,457 个真实修复 bug 的 PROBE 基准及发现匹配方法。

papers.title: Before the First Edit? Measuring When Coding-Agent Guidance Actually Arrives
papers.abstract: When a coding-agent harness promises guidance before the first source edit, what event does it actually intercept? We audit five separate events: policy assignment, request eligibility, trigger, plan delivery, and observed source-content change. A prescribed-action comparison exposes the coverage of three gate rules but cannot tell us how an agent would continue after receiving a plan. We therefore run local agents on public software issues and hash Python files before and after each executed action. In a pilot-guided, 76-arm study using Qwen2.5-Coder 14B, 15 arms change Python source across seven tasks and three repositories. Guidance precedes every observed first change, but every change uses a structured editor and the study misses its prespecified 20-arm coverage target. Post hoc local tests find seven changed arms that pass the tested target and regression selectors; four of those seven use incomplete regression lists. Public PAUSE and SI2CA trajectories add source-text changes bracketed by adjacent reads, but lack synchronized filesystem states and cannot identify exact first mutations. The audit makes the timing claim testable within a stated source scope. These data do not show that planning improves repair correctness or covers shell-first writes in live agent runs.

translation.title: 在第一次编辑之前？测量编码智能体指导实际到达的时机
translation.abstract: 当一个编码智能体 harness 承诺在第一次源码编辑之前提供指导时，它实际拦截的是哪个事件？我们审计五个独立事件：策略分配、请求资格、触发、计划交付以及观察到的源码内容变更。规定动作比较可以揭示三种门控规则的覆盖情况，但无法告诉我们智能体在收到计划后会如何继续。因此，我们在公开软件 issue 上运行本地智能体，并在每次执行动作前后对 Python 文件进行哈希。在一项由试点引导、使用 Qwen2.5-Coder 14B 的 76 臂研究中，15 个臂在七个任务和三个仓库上更改了 Python 源码。指导先于每一次观察到的首次变更，但每次变更都使用了结构化编辑器，且该研究未达到预设的 20 臂覆盖目标。事后局部测试发现七个变更臂通过了所测目标和回归选择器；其中四个使用了不完整的回归列表。公开的 PAUSE 和 SI2CA 轨迹添加了由相邻读取包围的源码文本变更，但缺乏同步的文件系统状态，无法确定确切的首次变更。该审计使时机主张在声明的源码范围内可被检验。这些数据并不表明规划能提高修复正确性，也不覆盖真实智能体运行中 shell 优先的写入。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体“编辑前指导”时机主张难以验证的问题，通过多事件审计与文件哈希的 76 臂实验测量指导实际到达的时机。

papers.title: PolicyMediator: Multi-Regional Policy Learning through Mediation Agents with Evolving Skills in OPC Ecosystems
papers.abstract: One-person companies (OPCs) are emerging enterprises operated by individual entrepreneurs through digital platforms and LLM-based AI agents. These highly skilled entrepreneurs are characterized by being digital nomads, with limited reliance on local ecosystems. Governments in China use distinct regional support policies to attract mobile OPCs, turning local support into a cross-regional coordination problem. OPCs compare regions to maximize their own utility, but imperfect policy perceptions may cause them to reject otherwise suitable locations. Existing policy-learning methods optimize resources under fixed perceptions, while consensus-formation methods aggregate views without feeding cognitive changes back into policy learning. This disconnect produces mismatched location choices and inefficient regional policy adjustment. We introduce PolicyMediator, a cognition-constrained leader-multi-follower Stackelberg framework with bilateral mediation. The mediator explains verified policies to OPCs to build awareness and trust, and reports their needs and unresolved concerns to governments for policy learning. Its self-evolving skills retain, revise, or prune strategies using verification, allocation, capacity, and objective trajectories rather than mediation success alone. Across six-region simulations in China with five OPC types, five scenarios, and three OPC-simulator backbones, PolicyMediator ranks first in all 15 OPC-backbone--scenario combinations. Over the eight-baseline mean, it improves the aggregate government objective, combining economic performance, employment benefit, and policy-access equality, by 42.4% and average OPC utility by 40.9%.

translation.title: PolicyMediator：在OPC生态系统中通过具备演化技能的调解智能体实现多区域政策学习
translation.abstract: 一人公司（OPC）是由个人创业者通过数字平台和基于LLM的AI智能体运营的新兴企业。这些高技能创业者以数字游民为特征，对本地生态系统的依赖有限。中国各地政府采用不同的区域扶持政策来吸引流动的OPC，使本地扶持变成一个跨区域协调问题。OPC会比较不同地区以最大化自身效用，但不完善的政策感知可能导致其拒绝原本合适的地点。现有政策学习方法在固定感知下优化资源，而共识形成方法只是聚合观点，未将认知变化反馈到政策学习中。这种脱节导致地点选择错配和区域政策调整低效。我们提出PolicyMediator，一个认知约束下的领导者-多跟随者Stackelberg框架，具备双向调解能力。调解者向OPC解释经过核实的政策以建立认知和信任，并向政府报告OPC的需求和未解决的顾虑以支持政策学习。其自演化技能基于核实、分配、容量和目标轨迹来保留、修订或剪枝策略，而不仅仅依据调解成功率。在中国六区域模拟中，涵盖五种OPC类型、五个场景和三种OPC模拟器骨干，PolicyMediator在全部15个OPC骨干-场景组合中排名第一。相比八个基线的平均值，它将综合政府目标（结合经济表现、就业效益和政策获取公平性）提升42.4%，将平均OPC效用提升40.9%。
translation.brief: 解决流动一人公司（OPC）因政策感知不完善导致选址错配与区域政策调整低效的问题，核心方法是提出一个认知约束的Stackelberg双向调解框架，由调解智能体在OPC与政府之间传递核实政策与需求反馈，并通过自演化技能进行政策学习。

papers.title: MedJev: Evaluating Zero-Shot System-One Decision Making in Medicine
papers.abstract: System One decision models such as Jev answer structured questions in a single forward pass without generating text, offering fast and computationally efficient clinical decision support. We evaluate MedJev, an open System One model that runs locally on a laptop, across ten medical benchmarks spanning medical knowledge, diagnosis, and patient level prediction using MIMIC IV and MIMIC IV ED. We compare MedJev against zero shot LLM baselines, published GPT results, and supervised models. MedJev achieves accuracies of 72.5 percent on MedQA, 75.4 percent on USMLE, and 80.1 percent on NEJM, approaching published GPT 4 performance while maintaining well calibrated confidence estimates (ECE 0.028 to 0.063). On patient level tasks, MedJev achieves an AUROC of 0.926 for In Hospital Mortality, exceeding XGBoost (0.902), but underperforms supervised models on operational outcomes such as ED Triage Admission (0.745 vs. 0.809). Patient level predictions also exhibit substantial miscalibration (In Hospital Mortality ECE 0.286). We introduce a lightweight, two parameter recalibration method that adapts predictions to local patient populations using 50 to 200 labeled examples, reducing ECE to 0.007. Our findings establish open System One models as a promising zero shot baseline for medical AI, combining competitive predictive performance with low computational cost and efficient local calibration. We release our code and evaluation harness to support future research.

translation.title: MedJev：评估医学中的零样本System One决策
translation.abstract: Jev等System One决策模型在单次前向传播中回答结构化问题而无需生成文本，可提供快速且计算高效的临床决策支持。我们在十个医学基准上评估MedJev——一个可在笔记本电脑本地运行的开源System One模型，涵盖医学知识、诊断和基于MIMIC IV与MIMIC IV ED的患者级预测。我们将MedJev与零样本LLM基线、已发表的GPT结果和监督模型进行比较。MedJev在MedQA上达到72.5%、在USMLE上达到75.4%、在NEJM上达到80.1%的准确率，接近已发表的GPT 4性能，同时保持良好校准的置信度估计（ECE为0.028至0.063）。在患者级任务上，MedJev在院内死亡率预测上达到0.926的AUROC，超过XGBoost（0.902），但在急诊分诊入院等操作性结局上低于监督模型（0.745对0.809）。患者级预测还存在明显的校准偏差（院内死亡率ECE为0.286）。我们提出一种轻量级的双参数重校准方法，仅用50到200个标注样本即可将预测适配到本地患者群体，将ECE降至0.007。我们的发现表明，开源System One模型是有前景的医学AI零样本基线，兼具竞争力的预测性能、低计算成本和高效的本地校准。我们发布代码和评估工具以支持未来研究。
translation.brief: 解决医学AI中零样本决策支持的计算效率与校准问题，核心方法是评估可在本地运行的System One模型MedJev，并提出仅需50-200个标注样本的轻量双参数重校准方法。

papers.title: CIVER: Causal Intervention Verification for Reliable Code Review
papers.abstract: Code review is essential for maintaining software repositories by identifying defects, improving code quality, and supporting reliable software evolution. With the growing adoption of LLM-based coding agents, an increasing number of code contributions and repository changes are generated by these agents. Consequently, LLM-based code review agents are becoming increasingly prevalent to evaluate these contributions and maintain software quality. However, LLM reviewers often generate lengthy reviews containing numerous potential issues, many of which are false positives or lack sufficient evidence. These unreliable reviews can mislead developers and downstream coding agents, motivating the need to distinguish actionable findings from unsupported claims. We propose CIVER, a causal intervention-based framework that identifies the core issues underlying code-review findings and distinguishes genuine defects from false positives. CIVER integrates three modules: a review module assesses findings, an intervention module generates repair-oriented perturbations, and a verifier module scores review reliability. Through joint optimization via expert iteration, the three modules identify genuine defects by responding to targeted repairs while remaining stable under unrelated changes. Extensive experiments on SWE-Review-Bench demonstrate that CIVER correctly identifies 77% of genuine defects through targeted repairs. Cross-project and downstream repair evaluations further demonstrate that CIVER generalizes across repositories and improves coding agents' task success rates, highlighting its effectiveness for reliable automated code review.

translation.title: CIVER：面向可靠代码审查的因果干预验证
translation.abstract: 代码审查通过识别缺陷、提升代码质量和支持可靠的软件演化，对维护软件仓库至关重要。随着基于LLM的编码智能体的日益普及，越来越多的代码贡献和仓库变更由这些智能体生成。因此，基于LLM的代码审查智能体正变得日益普遍，用于评估这些贡献并维护软件质量。然而，LLM审查者常常生成包含大量潜在问题的冗长审查，其中许多是误报或缺乏充分证据。这些不可靠的审查会误导开发者和下游编码智能体，因此需要区分可操作的发现与缺乏依据的断言。我们提出CIVER，一个基于因果干预的框架，用于识别代码审查发现背后的核心问题，并区分真实缺陷与误报。CIVER集成三个模块：审查模块评估发现，干预模块生成面向修复的扰动，验证器模块为审查可靠性打分。通过专家迭代的联合优化，三个模块通过响应针对性修复来识别真实缺陷，同时在无关变更下保持稳定。在SWE-Review-Bench上的大量实验表明，CIVER通过针对性修复正确识别了77%的真实缺陷。跨项目和下游修复评估进一步表明，CIVER能够跨仓库泛化并提升编码智能体的任务成功率，凸显了其在可靠自动化代码审查方面的有效性。
translation.brief: 解决LLM代码审查中误报多、证据不足导致审查不可靠的问题，核心方法是提出基于因果干预的CIVER框架，通过生成面向修复的扰动并验证审查对针对性修复的响应来区分真实缺陷与误报。

papers.title: Do Coding Agents Still Need a Debugger? Frontier-Model-Based Fault Localization at the Accuracy Ceiling
papers.abstract: Background: To localize a fault, a coding agent can reason from source code alone or use debugger assistance by running the program and stepping through it in an interactive debugger. While earlier agents struggled with static execution tracing and debugger operation, frontier LLMs have improved at both. Objective: We evaluate how accurately coding agents localize faults without tools across original and transformed programs, how much debugger assistance improves accuracy and at what cost, and how agents use it when optional. Methods: We seed 610 single-line faults into 144 LeetCodeDataset solutions and rewrite each faulty program with five recipes of behavior-preserving transformations. Agents based on Sol 6.1, Luna 6, and Qwen 3.8 localize each fault with no, optional, or encouraged debugger assistance. Results: Without tools, the agents localized 98.2 to 99.9% of faults in original and 96.7 to 99.9% in transformed programs, losing accuracy mainly where recipes restructured loops and conditions. Encouraged assistance removed 63% and 61% of Luna 6's and Qwen 3.8's remaining transformed errors (+2.1 and +1.3 percentage points) at 14.7 to 27.0 times the token use, while Sol 6.1 stayed at 99.9%. With optional assistance, Luna 6 and Qwen 3.8 still gained +1.5 and +1.3 points, though the agents used the interactive debugger in only 0.2 to 6.2% of runs. Conclusions: On short, precisely specified programs, current coding agents localize nearly all faults from source code alone, and debugger assistance removes most errors that remain. Given the choice, agents executed the program far more often than they stepped through it, yet kept most of the benefit.

translation.title: 编码智能体还需要调试器吗？达到准确率上限的前沿模型故障定位
translation.abstract: 背景：为定位故障，编码智能体可以仅凭源代码推理，也可以借助调试器运行程序并在交互式调试器中逐步执行。虽然早期智能体在静态执行追踪和调试器操作上表现不佳，但前沿LLM在这两方面都有所改进。目标：我们评估编码智能体在无工具情况下对原始程序和变换后程序的故障定位准确率、调试器辅助能提升多少准确率及其代价，以及在可选情况下智能体如何使用调试器。方法：我们向144个LeetCodeDataset解答中植入610个单行故障，并用五种保持行为不变的变换方案重写每个故障程序。基于Sol 6.1、Luna 6和Qwen 3.8的智能体在无调试器、可选调试器或鼓励使用调试器三种条件下定位每个故障。结果：无工具时，智能体在原始程序中定位了98.2%至99.9%的故障，在变换后程序中定位了96.7%至99.9%，准确率损失主要出现在重构循环和条件的变换方案上。鼓励使用调试器消除了Luna 6和Qwen 3.8在变换后程序中剩余错误的63%和61%（分别提升2.1和1.3个百分点），但token消耗是原来的14.7至27.0倍，而Sol 6.1保持在99.9%。在可选辅助下，Luna 6和Qwen 3.8仍分别提升1.5和1.3个百分点，尽管智能体仅在0.2%至6.2%的运行中使用了交互式调试器。结论：在简短且规范明确的程序上，当前编码智能体仅凭源代码即可定位几乎所有故障，调试器辅助能消除大部分剩余错误。在可自由选择时，智能体执行程序的频率远高于逐步调试，但仍保留了大部分收益。
translation.brief: 解决前沿编码智能体是否仍需调试器辅助进行故障定位的问题，核心方法是在植入610个单行故障并施加行为保持变换的程序上，系统评估无工具、可选和鼓励使用调试器三种条件下的定位准确率与代价。

papers.title: Jaxnasium: Embracing PyTrees For Any-Agent, Cross-Suite Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Hardware-accelerated reinforcement learning in JAX has gained rapid popularity in recent years and has proven to be a successful method of scaling online reinforcement learning. The resulting ecosystem, however, is fragmented: environment suites define their own interfaces, and algorithm implementations are typically written for a single suite, a single type of space, and either JAX-native or host-based environments. Here we present Jaxnasium, a library for JAX-based reinforcement learning, aiming to make the field more accessible. Jaxnasium represents observation and action spaces as PyTrees, and uses this structure to build networks and support multi-agent processing. Through this, its near-single-file implementations run on discrete, continuous, image, and composite spaces, as well as in multi-agent environments, without any changes to the algorithm code. The same files serve as readable, research-friendly algorithms, as well as importable algorithms for more applied workloads. Through a minimal Gymnasium-style interface and wrappers for 11 suites, over 300 environments are available on which a small PPO implementation with default hyperparameters is able to run. Additionally, through a simple wrapper, we can run Gymnasium and EnvPool environments with the same algorithm and training loop, with no performance loss compared to architectures specifically built for training JAX algorithms on host-based environments. Jaxnasium further provides tools for multi-seed evaluation, hyperparameter sweeps, and project scaffolding. Jaxnasium is open-sourced at https://github.com/ponseko/jaxnasium

translation.title: Jaxnasium：拥抱PyTrees的任意智能体、跨套件强化学习
translation.abstract: 基于JAX的硬件加速强化学习近年来迅速流行，并已被证明是扩展在线强化学习的成功方法。然而由此形成的生态系统较为碎片化：环境套件定义各自的接口，算法实现通常只针对单一套件、单一类型的空间，且要么面向JAX原生环境，要么面向主机端环境。我们提出Jaxnasium，一个基于JAX的强化学习库，旨在让该领域更易上手。Jaxnasium将观测空间和动作空间表示为PyTrees，并利用这一结构构建网络并支持多智能体处理。由此，其近单文件实现可在离散、连续、图像和复合空间以及多智能体环境中运行，而无需对算法代码做任何修改。同一文件既可作为可读性强、适合研究的算法，也可作为可导入的算法用于更偏应用的场景。通过一个极简的Gymnasium风格接口和针对11个套件的封装，超过300个环境可供使用，一个采用默认超参数的小型PPO实现即可在其上运行。此外，通过简单的封装，我们可以用相同的算法和训练循环运行Gymnasium和EnvPool环境，且与专门为在主机端环境上训练JAX算法而构建的架构相比没有性能损失。Jaxnasium还提供多种子评估、超参数扫描和项目脚手架工具。Jaxnasium已在https://github.com/ponseko/jaxnasium开源。
translation.brief: 解决JAX强化学习生态碎片化、算法实现绑定单一环境套件和空间类型的问题，核心方法是用PyTrees统一表示观测与动作空间，使近单文件算法实现无需修改即可跨套件、跨空间类型和跨多智能体环境运行。

papers.title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract: Multimodal intelligence can be viewed as human-guided co-evolution between worlds and agents through interaction. However, scaling this process faces two bottlenecks: constructing heterogeneous, verifiable environments is costly, and manual Harness iteration cannot keep pace with growing task diversity and complexity. A key insight is that tasks with different modalities and surface forms can share the same underlying capability requirements. We therefore introduce The Trinity, a recursive self-improvement framework coupling world generation with Harness evolution through three roles: Creator, Explorer, and Evolver. Drawing on verified execution trajectories, Evolver shifts the basis of task organization from surface categories to shared requirements, reorganizing the original task tree into a hierarchical capability tree. We introduce Capability-Driven Real2Sim2Real: for heterogeneous tasks at the same node, Creator abstracts their common requirements into simplified, verifiable simulated worlds for capability learning, while evaluation on original tasks measures transfer. Along this capability tree, Explorer progressively evolves reusable capability modules through selective inheritance, forming a Harness tree whose validated updates accumulate across iterations within a fixed topology. The resulting Harnesses specialize in different capabilities, motivating a Capability-Aware Harness Router that uses public task information to select compatible module configurations from the tree. Our evolved Harnesses improve mean performance by 34 points across 28 training benchmarks and 26 points across 18 unseen benchmarks, including two real-world embodied tasks.

translation.title: The Trinity：面向多模态智能体的能力驱动递归自我改进
translation.abstract: 多模态智能可视为人类引导下世界与智能体通过交互实现的共同进化。然而，扩展这一过程面临两个瓶颈：构建异构且可验证的环境成本高昂，人工迭代 Harness 无法跟上任务多样性和复杂性的增长。一个关键洞察是：不同模态和表面形式的任务可以共享相同的底层能力需求。因此我们提出 The Trinity，一个通过 Creator、Explorer 和 Evolver 三种角色将世界生成与 Harness 进化耦合的递归自我改进框架。基于经过验证的执行轨迹，Evolver 将任务组织的基础从表面类别转向共享需求，把原始任务树重组为层次化的能力树。我们提出 Capability-Driven Real2Sim2Real：对于同一节点上的异构任务，Creator 将其共同需求抽象为简化、可验证的模拟世界用于能力学习，同时在原始任务上的评估衡量迁移效果。沿能力树，Explorer 通过选择性继承逐步进化出可复用的能力模块，形成一棵 Harness 树，其经过验证的更新在固定拓扑内跨迭代累积。由此得到的各 Harness 专注于不同能力，为此我们提出 Capability-Aware Harness Router，利用公开的任务信息从树中选择兼容的模块配置。进化后的 Harness 在 28 个训练基准上平均提升 34 分，在 18 个未见基准（包括两个真实世界具身任务）上提升 26 分。
translation.brief: 针对环境构建成本高与人工 Harness 迭代跟不上任务多样性的问题，提出由 Creator、Explorer、Evolver 三角色驱动的递归自我改进框架，将任务树重组为能力树并进化可复用能力模块。

papers.title: FinLLM-KG: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced LLMs for Financial Sentiment Analysis in Algorithmic Trading
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Generative AI have substantially improved financial sentiment analysis through post-trained financial large language models (LLMs). However, existing approaches remain confined to predicting the sentiment of each article in isolation and operate as black boxes, which limits contextual understanding and hinders deployment in high-stakes financial decision-making. To this end, we introduce FinLLM-KG, a model-agnostic framework that combines causal LLMs with a financial knowledge graph, in order to inject temporally grounded, company-level knowledge from SEC 10-K filings at inference time, without updating model weights. Within FinLLM-KG, context is supplied either as a natural-language company profile or as a small set of relevance-ranked factual triples. This enables sentiment predictions to account for broader firm-level information rather than the article alone, at almost zero computational cost and for any causal LLM. In addition, attributing each article-level sentiment score to individual sentences and to the retrieved knowledge-graph facts makes the evidence behind the prediction inspectable, thereby enhancing explainability and supporting human-in-the-loop review. Simulations demonstrate that FinLLM-KG consistently improves portfolio performance over the state-of-the-art baseline.

translation.title: FinLLM-KG：知识图谱增强的大语言模型用于算法交易中的金融情感分析
translation.abstract: 生成式 AI 的最新进展通过后训练的金融大语言模型（LLM）显著改进了金融情感分析。然而，现有方法仍局限于孤立预测每篇文章的情感，并以黑盒方式运行，这限制了上下文理解，阻碍了在高风险金融决策中的部署。为此，我们提出 FinLLM-KG，一个模型无关的框架，将因果 LLM 与金融知识图谱结合，在推理时注入来自 SEC 10-K 文件的、有时间依据的公司级知识，而无需更新模型权重。在 FinLLM-KG 中，上下文以自然语言公司简介或一小组按相关性排序的事实三元组的形式提供。这使得情感预测能够考虑更广泛的公司层面信息而非仅文章本身，且计算成本几乎为零，并适用于任何因果 LLM。此外，将每篇文章的情感分数归因到具体句子和检索到的知识图谱事实，使预测背后的证据可被审查，从而增强可解释性并支持人在回路审查。模拟实验表明，FinLLM-KG 持续优于最先进基线的投资组合表现。
translation.brief: 针对金融情感分析孤立预测且不可解释的问题，提出在推理时将 SEC 10-K 知识图谱信息注入因果 LLM 的模型无关框架，并提供证据归因以支持可解释性。

papers.title: CohortFlow: A Steerable Clinical Cohort Curation Agent with Localized Semantic Correction
papers.abstract: Language model agents for clinical cohort curation should accommodate evolving eligibility criteria without repeatedly processing unchanged requirements. We introduce CohortFlow, a steerable agent that represents natural language corrections as localized updates to a structured cohort specification and reconciles them with a persistent execution graph. Explicitly recorded semantic dependencies enable affected computations to be selectively invalidated while preserving valid prior results. On 100 scenarios derived from clinical-trial eligibility criteria, comprising 126 correction turns, localized steering achieves 77.0% requirement micro-F1 versus 76.4% for full regeneration using the same 8B model, a small numerical advantage that is not statistically significant ($p=0.493$). It reduces mean correction latency by 64.8% after completion and 44.3% during execution, with 38.1% fewer model calls. In a separate proof-of-concept evaluation over MIMIC, all 13 cohort states execute successfully, while correction trajectories demonstrate selective preservation of unaffected computations and recomputation of changed or dependent nodes. Together, these results show that localized semantic steering can substantially reduce correction latency and model calls while maintaining strong requirement-level accuracy.

translation.title: CohortFlow：具有局部语义修正的可引导临床队列筛选智能体
translation.abstract: 用于临床队列筛选的语言模型智能体应能适应不断演化的入组标准，而无需重复处理未改变的需求。我们提出 CohortFlow，一个可引导的智能体，将自然语言修正表示为对结构化队列规范的局部更新，并将其与持久化执行图进行协调。显式记录的语义依赖使受影响的计算可被选择性失效，同时保留有效的先前结果。在源自临床试验入组标准的 100 个场景（共 126 轮修正）上，使用同一 8B 模型，局部引导达到 77.0% 的需求 micro-F1，而完全重新生成为 76.4%，这一微小数值优势不具统计显著性（p=0.493）。它将完成后的平均修正延迟降低 64.8%，执行期间降低 44.3%，模型调用减少 38.1%。在基于 MIMIC 的单独概念验证评估中，全部 13 个队列状态均成功执行，修正轨迹展示了对未受影响计算的选择性保留以及对变更或依赖节点的重新计算。这些结果表明，局部语义引导可以在保持较强需求级准确性的同时，大幅降低修正延迟和模型调用。
translation.brief: 针对临床队列标准频繁变更导致重复计算的问题，提出将自然语言修正转化为结构化规范的局部更新并结合持久化执行图选择性失效受影响计算的方法。

papers.title: AGDecode: Semantic Attribute Grammar Derivatives for Safety-Constrained Decoding of Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, motivating techniques that guarantee the structural and semantic correctness of generated programs. Constrained decoding enforces correctness during generation by restricting token choices to those that admit at least one valid completion. While existing approaches can enforce syntactic constraints and selected semantic properties such as type safety, they either target specific properties or rely on operational pruning mechanisms that are difficult to generalize to data-dependent, inductive program properties. We present AGDecode, a programmable framework for semantic constrained decoding based on least-fixed-point semantics. AGDecode extends attribute grammars to partially constructed syntax trees, and reduces semantic constrained decoding to a realizability problem over such trees. The framework compiles semantic specifications into systems of relational constraints that are discharged by external verification oracles, such as SMT and CHC solvers, cleanly separating language semantics from constraint-solving machinery. We prove that our approach is sound and complete relative to an ideal verification oracle. In practice, solvers inevitably encounter uncertain queries; conservatively, our system can reject tokens for soundness or speculatively continue to generate until later queries resolve the entire generation. We mechanize the core metatheory in Rocq and evaluate the framework on semantic-constrained generation of C programs, enforcing path-sensitive safety properties including null-pointer safety, division-by-zero freedom, and initialized-variable usage. Our results demonstrate that solver-backed semantic constrained decoding can enforce rich semantic guarantees while incurring modest computational overhead at regular program boundaries.

translation.title: AGDecode：用于大语言模型安全约束解码的语义属性文法导数
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于代码生成，这促使人们研究保证生成程序结构和语义正确性的技术。约束解码通过将 token 选择限制为至少存在一个有效补全的选项，在生成过程中强制正确性。现有方法虽可强制句法约束和类型安全等特定语义性质，但要么只针对特定性质，要么依赖难以泛化到数据相关、归纳性程序性质的操作性剪枝机制。我们提出 AGDecode，一个基于最小不动点语义的可编程语义约束解码框架。AGDecode 将属性文法扩展到部分构造的语法树，并将语义约束解码归约为此类树上的可实现性问题。该框架将语义规范编译为关系约束系统，由外部验证 oracle（如 SMT 和 CHC 求解器）消解，将语言语义与约束求解机制干净地分离。我们证明了该方法相对于理想验证 oracle 是可靠且完备的。实践中求解器不可避免地遇到不确定查询；为保守起见，系统可以拒绝 token 以保证可靠性，或推测性地继续生成直到后续查询解决整个生成过程。我们在 Rocq 中机械化证明了核心元理论，并在 C 程序的语义约束生成上评估该框架，强制执行路径敏感的安全性质，包括空指针安全、无除零错误和已初始化变量使用。结果表明，基于求解器的语义约束解码可以在常规程序边界处以适度的计算开销强制执行丰富的语义保证。
translation.brief: 针对现有约束解码难以泛化到数据相关归纳性语义性质的问题，提出基于最小不动点语义将属性文法扩展到部分语法树、并借助 SMT/CHC 求解器实现语义约束解码的可编程框架。

papers.title: Log-To-Leak: Prompt Injection Attacks on Tool-Using LLM Agents via the Model Context Protocol
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly access external tools through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), but the natural-language metadata used to describe those tools creates a prompt-injection surface. Within this established tool-poisoning surface, we study Log-To-Leak, an additive post-hoc logging attack that induces a separate attacker-controlled call after the final legitimate call. Its payload targets the user query, MCP server name, server response, and agent response. We operationalize the injected directive through Trigger, Tool Binding, Justification, and Pressure, and separately measure call success, payload fidelity, and preservation of legitimate behavior. We evaluate five MCP servers and four LLM agents using five metrics spanning effectiveness, utility, and efficiency. Across 18 model-server pairs with valid tool execution, Log-To-Leak achieves an attack success rate (ASR) of 62.64-100% and conditional logging accuracy (LA) of 76.55-95.64%; 16 pairs have absolute target-task completion changes of at most 6.63 percentage points. Three evaluated defenses leave residual ASR above 55% on GitHub MCP with GPT-4o, while an instruction detector flags 85.53% of benign descriptions. These results show that successful task completion can coexist with unauthorized post-hoc disclosure and motivate host-controlled authorization for secondary tool calls.

translation.title: Log-To-Leak：通过 Model Context Protocol 对使用工具的 LLM 智能体的提示注入攻击
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体越来越多地通过 Model Context Protocol（MCP）访问外部工具，但用于描述这些工具的自然语言元数据构成了提示注入攻击面。在这一既有的工具投毒攻击面内，我们研究 Log-To-Leak，一种附加式的后验日志攻击，它在最后一次合法调用之后诱导一次由攻击者控制的独立调用。其载荷针对用户查询、MCP 服务器名称、服务器响应和智能体响应。我们通过 Trigger、Tool Binding、Justification 和 Pressure 将注入指令操作化，并分别测量调用成功率、载荷保真度和合法行为的保持。我们在五个 MCP 服务器和四个 LLM 智能体上，使用涵盖有效性、实用性和效率的五个指标进行评估。在 18 个具有有效工具执行的模型-服务器对上，Log-To-Leak 的攻击成功率（ASR）为 62.64–100%，条件日志准确率（LA）为 76.55–95.64%；16 个对的目标任务完成度绝对变化不超过 6.63 个百分点。三种已评估的防御在 GitHub MCP 与 GPT-4o 组合上仍留下超过 55% 的残余 ASR，而一个指令检测器将 85.53% 的良性描述误判。这些结果表明，成功的任务完成可以与未授权的后验泄露共存，因此需要对二次工具调用实施由宿主控制的授权。
translation.brief: 针对 MCP 工具元数据引发的提示注入风险，提出 Log-To-Leak 后验日志攻击，在合法调用完成后诱导攻击者控制的额外工具调用并系统评估其有效性。

papers.title: Context Is a Pipeline, Not a Window: Information Attrition in LLM Agent Harnesses
papers.abstract: LLM agents are judged by two numbers: the size of the context window, and how often the final answer is correct. Both numbers miss a third thing: how much of a tool's output is lost before the model ever sees it. We measured this loss in a real tool-using agent. The agent finds the cause of injected faults by reading Linux kernel traces. The context window was almost empty: across 720 runs, the single largest prompt used only 5.75% of it. Yet a third of all tool results (3,827 of 11,189) were cut before they reached the model, and every cut result became broken JSON. The harness cut each result by slicing its JSON text at a fixed length. This does not shorten a result evenly. It deletes whatever data sits near the end. One field reached the model in only 4.7% of calls. A second field, in the very same results, reached the model in 99.3% of calls. Which field held the fault's evidence depended on when the faulty process started: early or late in the trace. The agent's diagnosis accuracy matched this same split. So we ran controlled experiments to test one question: did the data loss cause the drop in accuracy? This paper makes four contributions. First, we model an agent's context as a five-stage pipeline, with a measured failure at each stage. Second, we replay 864 real tool results, including one from a production trace where the shipped cut deletes all 128 records of the fault's evidence. Third, a controlled experiment shows that the cut's real cost appears first as extra work, not as wrong answers: 43% more tool calls, twice the computation, and yield falling from 0.61 to 0.31. The agent still finds the right answer when it has another way to reach it. Fourth, a survey of seven agent frameworks finds two that cut tool output the same unsafe way. Whether the data cut truly causes the accuracy drop is still an open question.

translation.title: 上下文是流水线，而非窗口：LLM Agent Harness 中的信息损耗
translation.abstract: LLM agent 通常用两个数字来评判：上下文窗口的大小，以及最终答案的正确率。这两个数字都忽略了第三件事：工具输出在模型看到之前损失了多少。我们在一个真实的工具使用 agent 中测量了这种损失。该 agent 通过阅读 Linux 内核 trace 来查找注入故障的原因。上下文窗口几乎是空的：在 720 次运行中，单个最大的 prompt 只占用了窗口的 5.75%。然而所有工具结果中有三分之一（11,189 条中的 3,827 条）在到达模型之前被截断，且每条被截断的结果都变成了损坏的 JSON。harness 通过在固定长度处切割 JSON 文本来截断每条结果。这并不能均匀地缩短结果，而是删除位于末尾附近的任何数据。某个字段仅在 4.7% 的调用中到达模型，而同一结果中的另一个字段在 99.3% 的调用中到达模型。哪个字段包含故障证据取决于故障进程在 trace 中启动的早晚。agent 的诊断准确率也呈现出同样的分化。因此我们进行了受控实验来检验一个问题：数据损失是否导致了准确率下降？本文有四点贡献。第一，我们将 agent 的上下文建模为五阶段流水线，并在每个阶段测量到失败。第二，我们重放了 864 条真实工具结果，其中包括一条来自生产 trace 的结果——其发布的截断删除了故障证据的全部 128 条记录。第三，受控实验表明，截断的真实代价首先表现为额外的工作量而非错误答案：工具调用增加 43%，计算量翻倍，yield 从 0.61 降至 0.31。当有其他途径时，agent 仍能找到正确答案。第四，对七个 agent 框架的调查发现其中两个以同样不安全的方式截断工具输出。数据截断是否真正导致准确率下降仍是一个开放问题。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM agent harness 截断工具输出造成的信息损耗问题，通过将上下文建模为五阶段流水线并进行受控实验来量化截断对诊断准确率的影响。

papers.title: When Connectivity Misleads: Guiding Agentic Search with Contrastive Evidence Paths
papers.abstract: Search agents can use cross-document graphs to discover sources through multi-hop connections and choose subsequent actions based on candidate rankings and relationships within a limited observation window. However, documents may rank highly because their numerous connections make them easier to reach, without necessarily providing more valuable evidence. Graph diffusion methods such as Personalized PageRank (PPR) aggregate propagation contributions from multiple sources, allowing highly connected distractor nodes to crowd the observation window. Flat node scores also obscure cross-document evidence trails, limiting continued exploration. We propose Contrastive Evidence Paths (CEP), which scores candidates by their strongest individual paths on a query-conditioned document graph and calibrates these scores against the same graph's background visitation distribution to mitigate structural bias. CEP ranks candidates by the calibrated scores and retains the corresponding source paths. Building on CEP, we develop Structured Corpus Interaction (SCI), which organizes candidates and their connecting paths into a structured Map, enabling agents to verify source documents and pursue missing information through expansion from anchor documents. Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus and TREC-COVID show that SCI achieves state-of-the-art answer accuracy and nDCG@10 with the lowest generation cost. Compared with the strongest baselines by task performance, maximum reductions in tool calls and total generation costs exceed 50% and 40%, respectively. Further analysis confirms that SCI with CEP suppresses ranking inflation induced by structural connections and improves gold recall and exploration efficiency.

translation.title: 当连通性产生误导：用对比证据路径引导 Agentic 搜索
translation.abstract: 搜索 agent 可以利用跨文档图通过多跳连接发现来源，并在有限的观察窗口内根据候选排序和关系选择后续动作。然而，文档可能仅因其大量连接而易于到达从而排名靠前，却不一定提供更有价值的证据。诸如 Personalized PageRank（PPR）等图扩散方法会聚合来自多个来源的传播贡献，使高度连接的干扰节点挤满观察窗口。扁平的节点评分也掩盖了跨文档证据轨迹，限制了持续探索。我们提出 Contrastive Evidence Paths（CEP），它在查询条件化的文档图上按候选的最强单条路径评分，并用同一图的背景访问分布对这些分数进行校准以缓解结构偏差。CEP 按校准后的分数对候选排序并保留相应的来源路径。在 CEP 基础上，我们开发了 Structured Corpus Interaction（SCI），将候选及其连接路径组织成结构化的 Map，使 agent 能够验证来源文档并通过从锚点文档扩展来追寻缺失信息。在 BrowseComp-Plus 和 TREC-COVID 上的实验表明，SCI 以最低的生成成本取得了最先进的答案准确率和 nDCG@10。与任务性能最强的基线相比，工具调用次数和总生成成本的最大降幅分别超过 50% 和 40%。进一步分析证实，结合 CEP 的 SCI 抑制了结构连接引起的排名虚高，并提升了 gold recall 和探索效率。
translation.brief: 针对跨文档图中高连通干扰节点误导搜索 agent 的问题，提出按最强单条路径评分并用背景分布校准的 CEP 方法及结构化交互框架 SCI。

papers.title: Replication or Corroboration? An Axiomatic Framework for Evidential Dependence in Multi-Agent Debate
papers.abstract: In multi-agent debates, matching reports can arise for two different reasons: agents may repeat the same evidence (replication), or they may provide separate evidential roots that support the same claim (corroboration). A judge must distinguish these two cases. Counting report occurrences gives extra weight to relays, paraphrases, alias resubmissions, and excerpt splits, while merging all matching content avoids this only by also removing genuine corroboration. We formalize this tension as a minimal judgment game in which acquiring new evidence is costly, but replication is cheap. We show that root replication invariance (RRI) is exactly threshold-uniform replication immunity. Under RRI, replication-only deviations cannot change the verdict, and positive-cost replication is strictly dominated, whereas occurrence-sensitive and content-keyed judges admit profitable deviations. We also establish an information boundary: if a judge's observation interface cannot distinguish a replica from a matched fresh root, no judge can both ignore the replica and respond strictly to the fresh root. To preserve this distinction, we introduce the lineage quotient, which removes wording, identity, occurrence multiplicity, and arbitrary root names while keeping distinct roots separate. On orbit-connected domains, it is the coarsest representation sufficient for every deterministic judge invariant to replication and root-label renaming. We further lift this construction to quantitative bipolar argumentation frameworks (QBAFs), characterize strict fresh-root response, prove its propagation along sign-consistent paths under DF-QuAD, and derive a tight closed-form response modulus. Exhaustive audits over 28,224 direct-star profiles, 2,052 multi-layer DAGs, with matched interventions on 277 AVeriTeC-derived profiles, show the predicted separation between replication and corroboration under a supplied partition.

translation.title: 复制还是佐证？多智能体辩论中证据依赖的公理化框架
translation.abstract: 在多智能体辩论中，匹配的报告可能出于两种不同原因：agent 重复相同证据（复制），或提供支持同一主张的独立证据根（佐证）。裁判必须区分这两种情况。统计报告出现次数会给转述、改写、别名重提交和摘录拆分额外加权，而合并所有匹配内容虽可避免这一点，却同时去除了真正的佐证。我们将这一张力形式化为一个最小裁判博弈，其中获取新证据有成本，而复制是廉价的。我们证明根复制不变性（RRI）恰好等价于阈值一致的复制免疫。在 RRI 下，仅复制的偏差无法改变裁决，正成本的复制被严格支配，而出现次数敏感和内容键控的裁判则存在有利可图的偏差。我们还建立了一个信息边界：如果裁判的观察接口无法区分副本与匹配的新鲜根，则没有任何裁判能既忽略副本又严格响应新鲜根。为保持这一区分，我们引入 lineage quotient，它去除措辞、身份、出现次数和任意根名称，同时保持不同根相互分离。在轨道连通域上，它是每个对复制和根标签重命名不变的确定性裁判所需的最粗表示。我们进一步将该构造提升到定量双极论证框架（QBAF），刻画了严格的新鲜根响应，证明了其在 DF-QuAD 下沿符号一致路径的传播性，并推导出紧致的闭式响应模。对 28,224 个直接星形 profile、2,052 个多层 DAG 的穷举审计，以及在 277 个 AVeriTeC 衍生 profile 上进行的匹配干预，验证了在给定划分下复制与佐证之间的预期分离。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体辩论中裁判难以区分证据复制与真正佐证的问题，提出基于公理（如根复制不变性）和 lineage quotient 的形式化裁判框架。

papers.title: Stratum: Repository Memory for Coding Agents Beyond the Context Window
papers.abstract: Context windows have grown a thousand-fold, yet coding agents still start every session with no memory of their past work. They re-read files, retry failed approaches, and forget root causes they established hours earlier. This is not a context-length problem but a memory-architecture problem. Our hypothesis: coding agents need persistent, experience-aware repository memory, so that knowledge survives from one session to the next. Three measurements on real repositories motivate the design. First, mid-size projects already exceed the largest production context windows, and storing knowledge inside the model's key-value (KV) cache costs $10^4$ to $10^5$ times more bytes than storing it as indexed text. Second, across 752 real bug-fix commits, the median fix edits two files, and these files plus their direct imports amount to less than 10% of the repository; the bottleneck is selection, not capacity. Third, even with transitive import reachability and test links, 47% of co-edited file pairs remain structurally disconnected; the knowledge needed for selection must be mined from history and experience. We sketch Stratum, a tiered memory that lives with the repository and serves it through page-safe tools: every response states what was returned, what remains, and what it cost. Retrieval over a store of one million nodes takes 1.7 ms at the median. In a multi-session experiment on eight real bugs, a fresh agent that inherited a prior session's memory, written by a different model, identified the root-cause file in 21 of 24 trials versus 6 of 24 for a retrieval-only baseline (Fisher $p<10^{-4}$), at 4.5x lower median token cost. With the notes of all eight investigations pooled in one store, success remained 8/8.

translation.title: Stratum：超越上下文窗口的编码 agent 仓库记忆
translation.abstract: 上下文窗口已增长千倍，但编码 agent 每次会话仍从零开始，对过去的工作毫无记忆。它们重新阅读文件、重试失败的方法，并遗忘数小时前已确定的根因。这不是上下文长度问题，而是记忆架构问题。我们的假设是：编码 agent 需要持久的、经验感知的仓库记忆，使知识能够跨会话存续。三项对真实仓库的测量支撑了这一设计。第一，中等规模项目已超过最大的生产级上下文窗口，且将知识存入模型的键值（KV）缓存的字节成本比存为索引文本高 $10^4$ 到 $10^5$ 倍。第二，在 752 个真实 bug 修复提交中，修复的中位数只编辑两个文件，这些文件及其直接导入不到仓库的 10%；瓶颈在于选择而非容量。第三，即使考虑传递导入可达性和测试链接，仍有 47% 的共同编辑文件对在结构上不相连；选择所需的知识必须从历史和经验中挖掘。我们勾勒了 Stratum，一种与仓库共存的分层记忆，通过页面安全的工具提供服务：每次响应都说明返回了什么、还剩什么以及代价是什么。在百万节点存储上的检索中位耗时为 1.7 ms。在一项针对八个真实 bug 的多会话实验中，继承了先前会话记忆（由另一个模型写入）的全新 agent 在 24 次试验中有 21 次识别出根因文件，而仅检索基线为 6/24（Fisher $p<10^{-4}$），且中位 token 成本降低 4.5 倍。当八次调查的笔记汇总于同一存储时，成功率保持 8/8。
translation.brief: 针对编码 agent 跨会话缺乏记忆的问题，提出与仓库共存的分层持久记忆系统 Stratum，通过经验挖掘和页面安全工具辅助文件选择与根因定位。

papers.title: Skill Dreaming: Evolving Repository Skills through Pull Request Streams
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on reusable skills for complex software engineering tasks, making skill libraries essential for repository development and maintenance. However, repository-specific skills must evolve with changing code structures, implementation conventions, and maintenance requirements. Pull requests (PRs) provide a natural source of such knowledge by recording how repositories evolve through implementation and review. Meanwhile, new PRs must follow repository-specific implementation patterns, modify related components consistently, and ensure that existing tests continue to pass while adding coverage for new functionality. This creates a mutually reinforcing cycle: PRs provide knowledge for updating skills, while these skills improve future PRs, maintain repositories, and support further skill evolution. To enable this co-evolution of PRs, repositories, and skills, we propose Skill Dreaming, a framework that learns from PR streams to guide continuous repository development and maintenance.
