Given a repository and its PR history, Skill Dreaming builds a repository-specific skill library by extracting executable knowledge from validated PRs and continuously refines the skills as new PR information becomes available. These skills guide coding agents not only in implementing requested features but also in maintaining associated tests, documentation, compatibility, and repository conventions. By integrating PR analysis, skill management, code execution, and continuous integration, Skill Dreaming provides an end-to-end workflow for applying learned skills to repository changes and incorporating subsequent PR outcomes into future skill updates.

translation.title: Skill Dreaming：通过 Pull Request 流演化仓库技能
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）agent 在复杂软件工程任务中日益依赖可复用技能，使技能库对仓库开发与维护至关重要。然而，仓库特定技能必须随代码结构、实现约定和维护需求的变化而演化。Pull request（PR）通过记录仓库如何通过实现和评审而演化，为此类知识提供了天然来源。同时，新 PR 必须遵循仓库特定的实现模式、一致地修改相关组件，并确保现有测试继续通过的同时为新功能增加覆盖。这形成了一个相互促进的循环：PR 为技能更新提供知识，而这些技能又改进未来的 PR、维护仓库并支持进一步的技能演化。为实现 PR、仓库与技能的共同演化，我们提出 Skill Dreaming，一个从 PR 流中学习以引导仓库持续开发与维护的框架。给定仓库及其 PR 历史，Skill Dreaming 通过从已验证的 PR 中提取可执行知识构建仓库特定的技能库，并随着新 PR 信息的出现持续精炼技能。这些技能不仅指导编码 agent 实现所请求的功能，还指导其维护相关测试、文档、兼容性和仓库约定。通过整合 PR 分析、技能管理、代码执行和持续集成，Skill Dreaming 提供了一个端到端工作流，将学到的技能应用于仓库变更，并将后续 PR 结果纳入未来的技能更新。
translation.brief: 针对仓库技能需随代码演化而更新的问题，提出 Skill Dreaming 框架，从 PR 流中提取并持续精炼可执行技能以指导 agent 的仓库开发与维护。

papers.title: LLM Hallucination Detection via Low-rank Multilinear Decomposition
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) frequently generate fluent yet factually incorrect responses, raising concerns about their reliability. Recent hallucination detectors increasingly exploit internal representations, but extracting informative signals from high-dimensional hidden states remains challenging. Existing approaches often rely on selected activations or pooling-based compression, potentially overlooking discriminative information distributed across Transformer layers, feature modes, and tokens. We propose LOTUS (Low-rank Order-statistic TUcker-based Subspace learning), a multilinear low-rank decomposition framework for hallucination detection that extracts compact representations from LLM hidden states while reducing dependence on labeled data. Our approach first summarizes variable-length token representations using complementary statistical descriptors that capture peak activations, activation distributions, and cross-layer changes. We then leverage low-rank multilinear decomposition to extract compact representations that capture the underlying structure of LLM hidden states, which are subsequently used to train a lightweight hallucination classifier. Experiments across multiple LLMs and question-answering benchmarks demonstrate improved hallucination detection performance over recent state-of-the-art baselines.

translation.title: 基于低秩多重线性分解的LLM幻觉检测
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）经常生成流畅但事实错误的回答，引发了对其可靠性的担忧。近来的幻觉检测器越来越多地利用内部表示，但从高维隐藏状态中提取有信息量的信号仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常依赖选定的激活值或基于池化的压缩，可能忽略分布在Transformer层、特征模式和token之间的判别信息。我们提出LOTUS（Low-rank Order-statistic TUcker-based Subspace learning），一个用于幻觉检测的多重线性低秩分解框架，能从LLM隐藏状态中提取紧凑表示，同时减少对标注数据的依赖。我们的方法首先使用互补的统计描述符（捕捉峰值激活、激活分布和跨层变化）来汇总变长的token表示。随后利用低秩多重线性分解提取捕捉LLM隐藏状态底层结构的紧凑表示，进而用于训练轻量级幻觉分类器。在多个LLM和问答基准上的实验表明，我们的方法在幻觉检测性能上优于近期的state-of-the-art基线。
translation.brief: 针对从LLM高维隐藏状态中提取幻觉检测信号困难的问题，提出LOTUS框架，通过统计描述符汇总token表示并进行低秩多重线性分解以获得紧凑判别表示。

papers.title: EREBOTS 4.0: A framework for conversational assistants with A2A agents and MCP tools
papers.abstract: In recent years, multi-agent systems have shifted from rule-based, symbolic agents to sub-symbolic agents built on language models. However, several limitations remain unresolved. The new frontier is neuro-symbolic agents, which pair language models with deterministic tools and explicit protocols. Without a common framework to standardize and compose them, each study rebuilds the same infrastructure, and results are hard to replicate. This paper presents EREBOTS 4.0, an open-source, hybrid-AI, multi-agent framework that fills this gap for conversational assistants. Language-model agents plan and route requests, while deterministic tools compute exact results over the Model Context Protocol (MCP). An orchestrator selects one or more specialist agents per turn and calls them over the Agent2Agent protocol (A2A). A new agent, local or remote, is added by listing its URL in a configuration file. The framework also manages identity, user context with consent flags, task states and traces. Its A2A server passed 97 tracked requirements in the official A2A Technology Compatibility Kit, with no failures.

translation.title: EREBOTS 4.0：基于A2A智能体与MCP工具的会话助手框架
translation.abstract: 近年来，多智能体系统已从基于规则的符号智能体转向建立在语言模型之上的亚符号智能体。然而，若干局限仍未解决。新的前沿是神经符号智能体，它将语言模型与确定性工具和显式协议配对。由于缺乏一个通用框架来标准化和组合它们，每项研究都要重建相同的基础设施，结果难以复现。本文提出EREBOTS 4.0，一个开源的、混合AI的多智能体框架，填补了会话助手领域的这一空白。语言模型智能体负责规划与请求路由，而确定性工具通过Model Context Protocol（MCP）计算精确结果。编排器（orchestrator）在每轮选择一个或多个专家智能体，并通过Agent2Agent协议（A2A）调用它们。新增本地或远程智能体只需在配置文件中列出其URL。该框架还管理身份、带同意标志的用户上下文、任务状态和追踪。其A2A服务器在官方A2A Technology Compatibility Kit中通过了97项受跟踪要求，无一失败。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体会话助手缺乏标准化可复用框架的问题，提出EREBOTS 4.0，用语言模型智能体做规划路由、确定性MCP工具做精确计算、A2A协议编排调用。

papers.title: Agent or Human? Detecting Commits by AI Coding Agents in the Absence of Authorship Signatures
papers.abstract: AI coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot coding agent, and Cursor now commit directly to open-source repositories. Empirical studies of these agents identify their commits through authorship signatures, such as bot accounts and Co-authored-by trailers. These signatures are optional, can be removed, and are often attached to pull requests rather than to individual commits. Hence, it is unclear whether Agent commits can be told apart from Human commits once the signatures are gone. We investigate the signals and limits of signature-free detection using 7,837,946 commits from 1,226 repositories, covering five coding agents and Human commits. After signatures are masked, detectors rank Agent commits above Human commits with a ROC AUC of up to 0.859, and most of this signal comes from message verbosity and change size rather than from the code itself. On the shared sample, gpt-6-sol without fine-tuning reaches AUCs similar to XGBoost and TF-IDF. At the observed Agent share, however, the best detector on the full test set reaches a precision of only 0.332. Detection transfers poorly to held-out Claude Code and Copilot, with TF-IDF reaching an AUC of only 0.524 for Claude Code. Temporal changes also depend on the agent, e.g., Copilot AUC drops and later recovers, while more training history helps Claude Code but not Copilot. These results indicate that signature-free detection can prioritize commits for review but cannot replace recorded attribution, and that studies relying on signature-based labels should treat them as a lower bound on agent activity.

translation.title: 智能体还是人类？在没有作者签名的情况下检测AI编程智能体的提交
translation.abstract: Claude Code、GitHub Copilot coding agent和Cursor等AI编程智能体现在可以直接向开源仓库提交代码。针对这些智能体的实证研究通常通过作者签名（如bot账号和Co-authored-by trailer）来识别其提交。这些签名是可选的、可被移除的，且往往附加在pull request而非单个commit上。因此，一旦签名消失，Agent提交能否与Human提交区分开来尚不清楚。我们使用来自1,226个仓库的7,837,946个commit，涵盖五种编程智能体和Human提交，研究了无签名检测的信号与局限。在签名被遮蔽后，检测器对Agent提交的排序高于Human提交，ROC AUC最高达0.859，且大部分信号来自提交信息的冗长度和变更规模，而非代码本身。在共享样本上，未经微调的gpt-6-sol达到与XGBoost和TF-IDF相近的AUC。然而，在观察到的Agent占比下，全测试集上最佳检测器的precision仅为0.332。检测对held-out的Claude Code和Copilot迁移性差，TF-IDF对Claude Code的AUC仅0.524。时间变化也依赖具体智能体，例如Copilot的AUC先降后升，而更多训练历史对Claude Code有帮助但对Copilot没有。这些结果表明，无签名检测可用于优先排序待审查的提交，但无法替代记录在案的归属信息，且依赖签名标签的研究应将其视为智能体活动的下界。
translation.brief: 研究在缺少作者签名时能否区分AI编程智能体与人类的代码提交，通过大规模仓库commit数据提取消息冗长度与变更规模等信号并评估检测能力与局限。

papers.title: MARQ: A Modular, LLM-Agnostic Requirement Quality Assessor Infused with Systems Engineering Knowledge
papers.abstract: Requirements engineering (RE) is foundational to systems engineering (SE), as requirement defects can propagate downstream and adversely affect development outcomes. Although large language models (LLMs) are promising for requirement quality assessment, prior work shows that off-the-shelf models miss a large share of expert-identified defects, perform unevenly across quality criteria, and vary across executions. This study investigates whether infusing expert-derived SE knowledge can improve LLM-based requirement quality evaluation beyond off-the-shelf capability. We present MARQ, a modular, LLM-agnostic prototype that supplements LLMs with a criterion-specific knowledge stack operationalizing INCOSE requirement quality criteria and evaluated against off-the-shelf baselines on an expert-labeled NASA requirement set using Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, and the open-weight Gemma 3 12B, with 100 executions per model. MARQ achieves median F1 scores of 0.80 for Claude Opus 5, 0.62 for GPT-5.6 Sol, and 0.53 for Gemma 3 12B, compared with off-the-shelf baselines of 0.55, 0.52, and 0.18, respectively. However, the nature of these gains is model-dependent. Claude Opus 5 improves defect detection and false-alarm control; GPT-5.6 Sol gains detection and better execution-level consistency at the cost of more false alarms; and Gemma 3 12B reaches the performance of off-the-shelf proprietary models, although it remains highly variable. Criterion-level analysis shows gains concentrated in Correctness and Conformance, trade-offs between misses and false alarms within individual criteria, and model-dependent responses across several criteria. These findings position SE knowledge infusion as a promising model-agnostic pathway for strengthening trustworthy LLM-based RE support while underscoring the need for criterion-specific interventions and human-in-the-loop review.

translation.title: MARQ：一个融合系统工程知识的模块化、LLM无关的需求质量评估器
translation.abstract: 需求工程（RE）是系统工程（SE）的基础，因为需求缺陷会向下游传播并对开发结果产生不利影响。尽管大语言模型（LLM）在需求质量评估方面前景可观，但先前工作表明，开箱即用的模型会遗漏大量专家识别的缺陷，在不同质量标准上表现不均，且多次执行结果不一致。本研究探讨注入专家-derived的SE知识能否使基于LLM的需求质量评估超越开箱即用能力。我们提出MARQ，一个模块化、LLM无关的原型，通过针对各质量标准的知识栈为LLM提供补充，该知识栈将INCOSE需求质量标准操作化。我们在一个专家标注的NASA需求集上，使用Claude Opus 5、GPT-5.6 Sol和开源权重的Gemma 3 12B，每个模型执行100次，与开箱即用基线进行对比评估。MARQ的中位F1分别为Claude Opus 5的0.80、GPT-5.6 Sol的0.62、Gemma 3 12B的0.53，而开箱即用基线分别为0.55、0.52和0.18。然而，这些提升的性质依赖于具体模型。Claude Opus 5改善了缺陷检测和误报控制；GPT-5.6 Sol提升了检测能力和执行级一致性，但代价是误报增多；Gemma 3 12B达到了开箱即用专有模型的水平，尽管仍高度不稳定。标准层面分析显示提升集中在Correctness和Conformance上，各标准内部存在漏检与误报之间的权衡，且不同模型在多个标准上的响应不同。这些发现将SE知识注入定位为增强可信的基于LLM的RE支持的一条有前景的模型无关路径，同时强调需要针对具体标准的干预和人在回路审查。
translation.brief: 针对开箱即用LLM在需求质量评估中漏检缺陷且表现不稳定的问题，提出MARQ，通过注入INCOSE专家系统工程知识的标准级知识栈增强多种LLM的评估能力。

papers.title: Freeze, Don't Clone: Fine-Tuning with Expressive Policies Without Retaining Offline Data
papers.abstract: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning uses offline pretraining to accelerate subsequent online learning. While many methods assume the offline dataset remains available throughout fine-tuning, there are many settings where this is not the case. Prior work attributes failures in this setting primarily to critic recalibration under distribution shift. We identify a complementary actor-side failure: once the offline data disappears, continued behavioral cloning (BC) no longer preserves the offline behavior distribution and instead refits the behavioral model to the agent's limited, and nonstationary, online experience. We demonstrate that stopping online behavioral fitting while preserving the pretrained expressive prior substantially improves no-retention fine-tuning across implicit flow Q-learning (IFQL), flow Q-learning (FQL), and action-chunked RL (QC) on seven OGBench domains. We trace this failure to a behavioral feedback loop: continuing online behavioral cloning rapidly erases the pretrained prior, inducing representational collapse and action diversity loss that starves the critic of useful exploration. Freezing the prior breaks this cycle, preserving offline coverage while allowing value learning to drive continuous improvement.

translation.title: 冻结而非克隆：在不保留离线数据的情况下用表达性策略进行微调
translation.abstract: 离线到在线强化学习利用离线预训练来加速后续在线学习。许多方法假设离线数据集在整个微调过程中保持可用，但在很多场景下并非如此。先前工作将这种设置下的失败主要归因于分布偏移下的critic重新校准。我们识别出一个互补的actor侧失败：一旦离线数据消失，持续的行为克隆（BC）不再保持离线行为分布，而是将行为模型重新拟合到智能体有限的、非平稳的在线经验上。我们证明，在保留预训练表达性先验的同时停止在线行为拟合，能显著改善无保留微调，涵盖implicit flow Q-learning（IFQL）、flow Q-learning（FQL）和action-chunked RL（QC）在七个OGBench领域上的表现。我们将这一失败归因于行为反馈循环：持续在线行为克隆会迅速抹除预训练先验，引发表示坍缩和动作多样性丧失，使critic缺乏有用的探索。冻结先验打破了这一循环，在保持离线覆盖的同时让价值学习驱动持续改进。
translation.brief: 针对离线数据不可用时在线微调失败的问题，发现持续行为克隆会抹除预训练先验导致表示坍缩，提出冻结预训练表达性先验以保留离线覆盖并改善微调。

papers.title: Instant Software Factories
papers.abstract: Coding agents can quickly build prototypes, but a long tail of fixes, optimizations, tests, and releases separates a prototype from a product. A software factory handles this ongoing work through a repeatable process. We ask whether this work needs dedicated orchestration and how such factories should be judged. Given a tested repository and a coding agent, an instant software factory uses only two coordination inputs, a swarm of cron-job agents with standing objectives and a shared communication board, such as GitHub, where agents coordinate through the traces they leave. We developed a bootstrap prompt designed to set up both inputs from one round of human input, with governance as a separable layer. We distilled it from two manually configured industrial factories, observed for 15 and 17 days, and have not yet evaluated it. In the GitHub-coordinated CLI factory, daily merges rose 15x during agent rollout, an observed association. Its agents also filed 95% of new issues and authored 40 of 58 PRs that changed CI workflows, and at least 5.6% of issues marked as fixed were later found to have incorrect fixes. Unlike an agent scored on a fixed benchmark, a factory thus changes its own workload, evaluator, and measured progress. We formulate factory development as multi-objective optimization under this endogenous feedback. Over five months, we plan to evolve both factories, test the bootstrap on new repositories, and test five falsifiable hypotheses.

translation.title: 即时软件工厂
translation.abstract: 编码代理可以快速构建原型，但从原型到产品之间还隔着大量的修复、优化、测试和发布工作。软件工厂通过可重复的流程处理这些持续性工作。我们探讨这类工作是否需要专门的编排，以及应如何评判软件工厂。给定一个已通过测试的代码仓库和一个编码代理，即时软件工厂仅使用两个协调输入：一群具有常设目标的 cron 定时代理，以及一个共享通信看板（如 GitHub），代理通过在其中留下的痕迹进行协调。我们开发了一个引导提示词（bootstrap prompt），旨在仅通过一轮人类输入就设置好这两个输入，并将治理作为可分离的一层。该提示词从两个人工配置、分别观察了15天和17天的工业工厂中提炼而来，尚未经过评估。在 GitHub 协调的 CLI 工厂中，代理部署期间每日合并次数上升了15倍（仅为观察到的关联）。其代理还提交了95%的新 issue，并在58个修改 CI 工作流的 PR 中撰写了40个，但被标记为已修复的 issue 中至少有5.6%后来被发现修复有误。与在固定基准上评分的代理不同，工厂会改变自身的工作负载、评估者和所测量的进度。我们将工厂开发表述为在这种内生反馈下的多目标优化问题。在接下来的五个月中，我们计划演化这两个工厂，在新仓库上测试引导提示词，并检验五个可证伪的假设。
translation.brief: 研究如何仅用极少量人工协调（常设目标的 cron 代理群加共享看板）建立自动化软件工厂，并通过引导提示词实现一键搭建，将工厂演化形式化为内生反馈下的多目标优化。

papers.title: The Inbox as a Coordination Primitive for LLM Agent Societies
papers.abstract: Language-model agents increasingly coordinate in large groups, and current agent protocols focus on delivering messages. For these agents, however, the scarce resource is not delivery but reading: every message costs tokens, and the context is finite. Current infrastructure works by push: the sender decides when a message enters the recipient's context, so the recipient reads in arrival order and drops the oldest messages once its context is full. We study the alternative, pull, in which messages wait in an inbox outside the context and the recipient's own rules decide what it reads and keeps. We argue that the inbox is a coordination primitive: each agent sets its rules privately, and those rules decide whether other agents' requests reach it. In simulated societies of up to 16,000 agents, with every decision an LLM judgment, we report three findings. First, push fails as an agent takes part in more coordination at once: an agent leading 20 negotiations with a full memory proposes options already rejected 97% of the time, because it has dropped the oldest replies. Second, an inbox is necessary under heavy, noisy traffic. Where first come, first read misses every request, an inbox that first reads messages carrying a refundable deposit still finds about 60% of the agents a request needs, at every size from 1,000 to 16,000. On a real email network, losses compound: when half the agents adopt such an inbox, forwarded search recovers only 5% of full adoption, against 42% for one-hop search. Third, an inbox comprises four decisions (what to read, what to keep, what a sender pays, and what a reply may say), and the best rule for each depends on the traffic and the agent's role. Multi-agent coordination under load requires an inbox layer designed for the traffic each agent receives.

translation.title: 作为 LLM 代理社会协调原语的收件箱
translation.abstract: 语言模型代理越来越多地在大型群体中协调，而当前的代理协议侧重于消息投递。然而对这些代理而言，稀缺资源不是投递而是阅读：每条消息都消耗 token，而上下文是有限的。当前基础设施采用推送（push）模式：由发送方决定消息何时进入接收方的上下文，因此接收方按到达顺序阅读，并在上下文满时丢弃最旧的消息。我们研究另一种模式——拉取（pull），即消息在上下文之外的收件箱中等待，由接收方自己的规则决定读取和保留什么。我们主张收件箱是一种协调原语：每个代理私下设置自己的规则，而这些规则决定其他代理的请求能否到达它。在最多16,000个代理的模拟社会中（每个决策都是一次 LLM 判断），我们报告了三个发现。第一，当代理同时参与更多协调时，推送模式会失效：一个领导20场谈判且记忆已满的代理，有97%的概率提出已被拒绝的选项，因为它丢弃了最旧的回复。第二，在高负载、高噪声的流量下，收件箱是必要的。在先到先读的模式下所有请求都会被错过，而优先读取带有可退还押金消息的收件箱，在1,000到16,000的所有规模下仍能找到请求所需的约60%的代理。在真实邮件网络上，损失会叠加：当一半代理采用此类收件箱时，转发式搜索只能恢复全量采用时5%的效果，而单跳搜索为42%。第三，收件箱包含四个决策（读什么、留什么、发送方付什么、回复可以写什么），每个决策的最优规则取决于流量和代理角色。高负载下的多代理协调需要为每个代理接收的流量设计的收件箱层。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 多代理协调中上下文有限导致消息被丢弃的问题，提出将收件箱作为拉取式协调原语，由代理私有规则决定读取和保留哪些消息。

papers.title: BUSTA: Teaching Small Language Models to Reason About Binary Execution
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLM) are increasingly applied to Reverse Engineering (RE) workflows. RE, however, differs from common LLM coding tasks as it requires models to reason about low-level program behavior. Furthermore, the deployment of tooling in resource-constrained sandboxed RE environments limits the ability to use frontier-scale solutions. We examine whether a targeted LLM training approach can transfer distinct RE skills to open models via inverse basic-block execution: given an x86-64 basic block and a desired output register state, the model predicts the input register values that produce it. Fine-tuning \texttt{Qwen3-1.7B} and \texttt{Nemotron-3-Nano} with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) raises knowable-register prediction accuracy from 73.2\% to 85.3\% and from 63.3\% to 95.2\%, respectively. Frontier models still score highest (up to 99.2\%), but our fine-tuned \texttt{Nemotron-3-Nano} comes within four points at a fraction of the parameter count. We release both fine-tuned models and the training dataset.

translation.title: BUSTA：教会小型语言模型对二进制执行进行推理
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地应用于逆向工程（RE）工作流。然而 RE 与常见的 LLM 编码任务不同，它要求模型对底层程序行为进行推理。此外，在资源受限的沙盒化 RE 环境中部署工具限制了前沿规模模型的使用。我们研究一种针对性的 LLM 训练方法能否通过反向基本块执行将特定的 RE 技能迁移到开源模型：给定一个 x86-64 基本块和期望的输出寄存器状态，模型预测能产生该状态的输入寄存器值。使用 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）微调 \texttt{Qwen3-1.7B} 和 \texttt{Nemotron-3-Nano} 后，可推知寄存器的预测准确率分别从73.2%提升到85.3%，以及从63.3%提升到95.2%。前沿模型仍然得分最高（最高99.2%），但我们微调后的 \texttt{Nemotron-3-Nano} 以极小的参数量将差距缩小到四个百分点以内。我们发布了两个微调模型和训练数据集。
translation.brief: 通过反向基本块执行任务和 GRPO 微调，使小型开源模型习得逆向工程所需的二进制执行推理能力。

papers.title: Compatibility and future-proof testing for multi-agent systems
papers.abstract: Independently developed autonomous agents, such as autonomous vehicles, must guarantee joint compatibility, such as safety and task-completion requirements, when they operate in a shared environment. Existing methods require a centrally designed specification, or interaction mechanism before any agent is deployed. However, such centralized design is unrealistic when agent designs are confidential to their developers, and it is not flexible enough to accommodate future agent designs. We study a bi-level structure in which a regulator coordinates developers by publishing seed agents, and each developer independently tests its agent to ensure that it is compatible with every seed-compatible agent, a property we call future-proofness. Under this structure, joint compatibility is guaranteed for any agents that are designed and tested independently, without any coordination with each other. In this work, we first formulate compatibility for general multi-agent systems and show why it is not trivially implied by seed-compatibility. We then characterize the future-proof agents as the closure of the seed and show that this closure is monotone in the seed. Finally, we study a class of executable tests that involve interaction with the seed alone, and we ask to what extent such tests can distinguish the future-proof agents.

translation.title: 多智能体系统的兼容性与面向未来的测试
translation.abstract: 独立开发的自主代理（如自动驾驶车辆）在共享环境中运行时，必须保证联合兼容性，例如安全和任务完成要求。现有方法要求在部署任何代理之前存在集中设计的规范或交互机制。然而，当代理设计对其开发者保密时，这种集中式设计并不现实，也不够灵活以适应未来的代理设计。我们研究一种双层结构：监管者通过发布种子代理来协调开发者，每个开发者独立测试其代理，以确保它与每一个种子兼容的代理都兼容，我们称这一性质为面向未来性（future-proofness）。在该结构下，任何被独立设计和测试的代理之间无需相互协调即可保证联合兼容性。在本工作中，我们首先为一般多智能体系统形式化兼容性，并说明为什么它不能由种子兼容性平凡地推出。然后我们将面向未来的代理刻画为种子的闭包，并证明该闭包对种子是单调的。最后，我们研究一类仅需与种子交互的可执行测试，并探讨这类测试能在多大程度上区分面向未来的代理。
translation.brief: 针对开发者各自保密的自主代理之间的联合兼容性问题，提出由监管者发布种子代理、开发者独立测试以达成面向未来兼容性的双层验证框架。

papers.title: Detecting and Mitigating Query-Based System Prompt Leakage Attacks
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on proprietary system prompts to enforce task directives, safety policies, and access controls. These prompts are vulnerable to query-based leakage attacks, where black-box adversaries extract confidential instructions through adaptive, multi-turn interactions. Existing defenses often assess queries independently, missing malicious behavior that emerges across interactions. We present AdvGuard, a model-agnostic framework for detecting and mitigating system prompt leakage. AdvGuard models cross-query relationships using a bounded semantic interaction graph, statistically filters candidate components, and converts them into line graphs for graph convolutional network (GCN) classification. This approach captures multi-hop patterns in query similarity that distinguish coordinated extraction from benign workflows. A lightweight prompt-level detector provides protection before sufficient interaction history accumulates, and the framework supports black-box LLM deployments. In mixed-query evaluations, AdvGuard improves recall by up to 36% over the strongest baseline while maintaining a false positive rate of at most 3.4%. In multi-turn workloads, it achieves 97.23%-99.1% F1 with 100% recall. Leave-one-attack-family-out tests yield 99.98% mean recall and 99.99% mean F1, with no observed false positives. Integrated into the adaptive PLeak and LeakAgent attack loops, AdvGuard limits exact-match leakage to 0.00-0.01 and substring-match leakage to 0.01-0.09 across evaluated victim models. These results demonstrate robust detection of unseen attack families and substantially reduced prompt reconstruction.

translation.title: 检测与缓解基于查询的系统提示词泄露攻击
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）依赖专有系统提示词来执行任务指令、安全策略和访问控制。这些提示词容易受到基于查询的泄露攻击，即黑盒对手通过自适应的多轮交互提取机密指令。现有防御通常独立评估每个查询，无法捕捉跨交互涌现的恶意行为。我们提出 AdvGuard，一个用于检测和缓解系统提示词泄露的模型无关框架。AdvGuard 使用有界语义交互图建模跨查询关系，统计过滤候选组件，并将其转换为线图（line graph）以供图卷积网络（GCN）分类。这一方法捕捉查询相似性中的多跳模式，从而区分协调式提取与良性工作流。一个轻量级提示词级检测器在足够的交互历史积累之前提供保护，且该框架支持黑盒 LLM 部署。在混合查询评估中，AdvGuard 相比最强基线将召回率提升最高36%，同时误报率不超过3.4%。在多轮工作负载中，它实现了97.23%–99.1%的 F1 和100%的召回率。留一攻击族测试的平均召回率为99.98%，平均 F1 为99.99%，且未观察到误报。集成到自适应的 PLeak 和 LeakAgent 攻击循环后，AdvGuard 在所评估的受害模型上将精确匹配泄露限制在0.00–0.01，子串匹配泄露限制在0.01–0.09。这些结果表明其对未见攻击族的鲁棒检测能力以及大幅降低的提示词重构成功率。
translation.brief: 针对多轮查询式系统提示词泄露攻击，提出 AdvGuard 框架，通过语义交互图和 GCN 建模跨查询协同提取模式进行检测与缓解。

papers.title: When Retrieval Is Not Enough: Obsolete Facts in Agent Memory
papers.abstract: Memory-agent benchmarks often collapse retrieval and answer generation into one score, making it hard to tell whether a failure comes from missing an update or from not using an update that was already retrieved. We examine this distinction on the single-hop FactConsolidation task of MemoryAgentBench. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on 6K-history BM25 accuracy drops from 45% to 32% when the retrieved evidence budget grows from 64 to 512 tokens, even though a gold-assisted post-hoc audit finds the newest statement in every retrieved set. Most of the errors occur on questions that also contain an obsolete statement version. Under a frozen prompt and equal four-statement evidence size, replacing one unrelated statement with the obsolete competing statement reduces accuracy from 100% to 44.6% for Qwen2.5 and from 100% to 87.8% for Qwen3-14B, with all 50 harmful paired flips classified as stale. A 32K-history replication likewise favors BM25-64 over BM25-512 (69% versus 58%). These results suggest that retrieving the correct fact is not enough. An obsolete competing statement can be more harmful than an unrelated piece of evidence of the same size.

translation.title: 当检索还不够：Agent 记忆中的过时事实
translation.abstract: 记忆型 Agent 的基准通常将检索与答案生成合并为一个分数，难以区分失败是由于遗漏更新，还是未能使用已检索到的更新。我们在 MemoryAgentBench 的单跳 FactConsolidation 任务上考察这一区分。使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，在 6K 历史下，当检索证据预算从 64 增至 512 token 时，BM25 准确率从 45% 降至 32%，尽管借助金标准的事后审计发现每个检索集合中都包含最新陈述。大部分错误出现在同时包含过时陈述版本的问题上。在冻结提示且证据规模均为四条陈述的条件下，将一条无关陈述替换为过时的竞争性陈述，使 Qwen2.5 的准确率从 100% 降至 44.6%，Qwen3-14B 从 100% 降至 87.8%，且全部 50 个有害配对翻转均被归类为陈旧问题。32K 历史的复现同样显示 BM25-64 优于 BM25-512（69% 对 58%）。这些结果表明检索到正确事实并不足够，一条过时的竞争性陈述可能比同等大小的无关证据更有害。
translation.brief: 针对记忆型 Agent 中检索成功但答案仍错误的问题，通过 MemoryAgentBench 上的受控实验揭示过时事实比无关证据更严重地损害答案生成。

papers.title: Ontology-guided multi-agent reasoning for explainable differential diagnosis
papers.abstract: Effective differential diagnosis depends on well structured and unambiguous patient case descriptions, since incomplete or ambiguous clinical information readily leads to diagnostic errors and inconsistent reasoning. Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown promising capabilities in medical question answering and clinical reasoning; however, even when achieving competitive performance on medical benchmarks, they often rely on pattern recognition learned from training data rather than grounded clinical evidence, and can generate plausible yet unsupported diagnostic conclusions. Their reasoning remains largely opaque, making it difficult for clinicians to assess the evidence and rationale behind a given recommendation. To address this gap, we propose an ontology-guided, multiagent differential diagnosis framework that replicates the iterative reasoning process of physicians. The framework grounds diagnostic inference in a structured, expert-curated medical knowledge base, enabling interpretation of symptoms, clinical findings, or disease relationships, while decomposing diagnosis into explicit, auditable reasoning steps. This ontology-based grounding constrains inference to evidence-backed associations, reducing hallucination and improving diagnostic transparency, traceability, and consistency. The system then identifies the most discriminative missing symptoms and generates targeted follow-up questions to reduce uncertainty through a process that mirrors to clinical inquiry. Together, these components improve the reliability, explainability, and diagnostic accuracy of AI-assisted differential diagnosis. The source code is publicly available.

translation.title: 基于本体的多智能体推理实现可解释的鉴别诊断
translation.abstract: 有效的鉴别诊断依赖于结构良好且无歧义的患者病例描述，因为不完整或含糊的临床信息容易导致诊断错误和推理不一致。大语言模型（LLM）近来在医学问答和临床推理方面展现出可观的能力；然而，即使其在医学基准上取得有竞争力的成绩，也往往依赖从训练数据中学到的模式识别而非有据可依的临床证据，可能生成看似合理却缺乏支持的诊断结论。其推理在很大程度上仍不透明，使临床医生难以评估某项建议背后的证据与理由。为弥补这一缺口，我们提出一个本体引导的多智能体鉴别诊断框架，复现医生的迭代推理过程。该框架将诊断推理锚定在结构化、由专家整理的医学知识库上，能够解释症状、临床发现或疾病之间的关系，同时将诊断分解为显式、可审计的推理步骤。这种基于本体的锚定将推理约束在有证据支持的关联上，减少幻觉并提升诊断的透明度、可追溯性和一致性。系统随后识别最具鉴别力的缺失症状，并生成针对性的随访问题，通过模拟临床问诊的过程来降低不确定性。这些组件共同提升了 AI 辅助鉴别诊断的可靠性、可解释性和诊断准确率。源代码已公开。
translation.brief: 为解决 LLM 诊断推理缺乏可解释性和证据支持的问题，提出基于医学本体知识库的多智能体框架，将诊断分解为可审计的推理步骤并生成针对性随访问题。

papers.title: How Stable Are LLM-Generated Proofs Under Program Refactoring? A Stress Test for Verifiable Code Generation
papers.abstract: Benchmarks for verifiable code generation usually test a proof against one fixed implementation. We ask whether the same proof remains valid after a program refactoring that preserves behavior. We introduce RefactorProof, which derives 458 Lean-certified variants from the 185 VERINA tasks that compile in our pinned environment while holding the specification and evaluated proof fixed byte-for-byte. VERINA supplies reference proofs for 46 tasks, all from its basic split; the primary model-versus-reference comparisons further match on 21-25 short, non-recursive tasks. Structural refactorings expose substantial brittleness across proof sources: task-normalized structural PSR is 4.3% for the supplied references and 13.3-26.8% for the specialized provers. On the matched tasks, specialized prover proofs nevertheless have higher overall unchanged-proof survival than the supplied reference artifacts: +15.6 points for DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B, +18.8 for Goedel-Prover-V2-32B, and +20.3 for Goedel-Prover-V2-8B; all three 95% CIs exclude zero. The ordering persists after excluding universally survived T1 variants, under family-balanced aggregation, and under alternative deployable valid-proof selection rules. However, unchanged-proof failure is not the same as high repair cost: predefined one-identifier edits repair 51/54 eligible reference structural failures and 58/85 eligible prover failures. RefactorProof therefore measures unchanged-proof stability under program refactoring, not the cost of maintaining a proof after it breaks.

translation.title: LLM 生成的证明在程序重构下有多稳定？可验证代码生成的压力测试
translation.abstract: 可验证代码生成的基准通常只针对一个固定实现测试证明。我们追问：在保持行为不变的程序重构之后，同一证明是否仍然有效。我们提出 RefactorProof，从在我们固定环境中可编译的 185 个 VERINA 任务中派生出 458 个经 Lean 认证的变体，同时将规约和被评估的证明逐字节保持不变。VERINA 为 46 个任务（全部来自其 basic split）提供了参考证明；主要的模型与参考对比进一步限定在 21-25 个短小、非递归的任务上。结构性重构暴露了各证明来源的显著脆弱性：任务归一化的结构性 PSR 在提供的参考证明上为 4.3%，在专用证明器上为 13.3-26.8%。然而在匹配任务上，专用证明器的证明在整体未变证明存活率上高于提供的参考工件：DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B 高出 15.6 个百分点，Goedel-Prover-V2-32B 高出 18.8，Goedel-Prover-V2-8B 高出 20.3；三者的 95% 置信区间均不含零。在排除普遍存活的 T1 变体、采用家族平衡聚合以及采用其他可部署的有效证明选择规则后，该排序仍然保持。不过，未变证明失败并不等于高修复成本：预定义的单标识符编辑可修复 51/54 个符合条件的参考结构性失败和 58/85 个符合条件的证明器失败。因此，RefactorProof 度量的是程序重构下未变证明的稳定性，而非证明失效后的维护成本。
translation.brief: 针对现有可验证代码生成基准只测试单一实现的问题，构建 RefactorProof 数据集，通过行为保持的 Lean 程序重构变体压力测试 LLM 生成证明的稳定性。

papers.title: OA-RAG: Ontology-based Agentic RAG for Faithful LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) perform well across many real-world tasks but remain prone to hallucination, limiting their reliability in domains such as biomedicine and healthcare, where answers must be grounded in established knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mitigates this problem by incorporating external information, but often overlooks logical relationships and relies heavily on the LLM's own reasoning, which can compromise answer faithfulness. We propose OA-RAG, an agent that integrates formal reasoning with LLM reasoning, drawing on both the logical structure and informal annotations of domain ontologies. For each answer, OA-RAG reports the ontology observations used as evidence and a model-assessed grounding level (entailed, supported, related, or unrelated) that characterises the strength of that evidence. Across benchmarks derived from three large-scale ontologies and six real-world medical question-answering tasks, OA-RAG achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated ontology-fine-tuned and popular RAG methods, with particularly strong results on reasoning-intensive tasks. The reported grounding levels also offer a useful indication of answer reliability, with stronger grounding generally associated with higher accuracy. Finally, our results demonstrate the value of ontologies as knowledge sources: OA-RAG is competitive with, and sometimes outperforms, domain-specific RAG systems that draw on sources such as textbooks.

translation.title: OA-RAG：基于本体的 Agentic RAG 实现忠实的 LLM 推理
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在许多现实任务中表现出色，但仍然容易产生幻觉，限制了其在生物医学和医疗等领域的可靠性，在这些领域中答案必须锚定于既有知识。检索增强生成（RAG）通过引入外部信息缓解了这一问题，但往往忽视逻辑关系，且过度依赖 LLM 自身的推理，可能损害答案的忠实性。我们提出 OA-RAG，一个将形式化推理与 LLM 推理相结合的 Agent，同时利用领域本体的逻辑结构和非形式化标注。对于每个答案，OA-RAG 报告作为证据的本体观察结果，以及一个由模型评估的锚定级别（entailed、supported、related 或 unrelated），用以刻画该证据的强度。在源自三个大规模本体的基准和六个真实医学问答任务上，OA-RAG 在所评估的本体微调方法和流行 RAG 方法中取得最佳总体性能，在推理密集型任务上表现尤为突出。所报告的锚定级别也为答案可靠性提供了有用指示，更强的锚定通常对应更高的准确率。最后，我们的结果展示了本体作为知识来源的价值：OA-RAG 与利用教科书等来源的领域专用 RAG 系统相当，有时甚至更优。
translation.brief: 针对 RAG 忽视逻辑关系导致答案不忠实的问题，提出将形式化本体推理与 LLM 推理结合的 OA-RAG Agent，并报告答案的锚定级别以指示可靠性。

papers.title: Bayesian Replicator Dynamics and the Inversion of Strict Dominance in Bimatrix Games
papers.abstract: Replicator dynamics, the central model of evolutionary game theory, describe populations evolving under selection and agents learning by trial and error. They also admit a third use: continuous-time Bayesian inference, in which an agent planning against an opponent accumulates evidence for each candidate strategy. Here we show that this use divides all two-player games into two classes. With the standard expected-utility payoff, the dynamics can be expressed as Bayesian updating only in games (with any number of actions) where no player has a dominant strategy. The logarithmic payoff of Ay and Erb admits the Bayesian representation in every game. Coordination, anti-coordination, and cyclic games share qualitative dynamics under both payoff definitions, with equilibria displaced and selection thresholds shifted. In contrast, the flows of every game with a dominant strategy are reversed between the payoff definitions, with the strictly dominant strategy eliminated under logarithmic payoffs. Cooperation therefore emerges in the Prisoner's Dilemma, and games of common interest converge to mutual defection. For two-action games the classification is complete and rests on an exact Hamiltonian structure shared by both payoff definitions. The structure gives a behavioural test: cycles in the classic Matching Pennies game have amplitude-independent period (isochronous) under logarithmic payoffs, but not under expected utility. Logarithmic evidence integration thus determines which strategic outcomes dynamical selection can reach, wherever learning approximates Bayesian updating.

translation.title: 贝叶斯复制动力学与双矩阵博弈中严格占优的逆转
translation.abstract: 复制动力学是演化博弈论的核心模型，描述在选择压力下演化的种群以及通过试错学习的智能体。它还有第三种用途：连续时间贝叶斯推断，其中针对对手进行规划的智能体为每个候选策略积累证据。我们在此表明，这一用途将所有双人博弈分为两类。在标准期望效用收益下，动力学只有在没有玩家拥有占优策略的博弈（任意行动数）中才能表示为贝叶斯更新。而 Ay 和 Erb 的对数收益在任何博弈中都允许贝叶斯表示。协调、反协调和循环博弈在两种收益定义下呈现定性相似的动力学，均衡位置移动、选择阈值偏移。相比之下，每个存在占优策略的博弈在两种收益定义下流方向相反，严格占优策略在对数收益下被淘汰。因此囚徒困境中出现合作，而共同利益博弈收敛于相互背叛。对两行动博弈，该分类是完备的，并基于两种收益定义共享的精确哈密顿结构。该结构给出一个行为学检验：经典 Matching Pennies 博弈中的循环在对数收益下周期与振幅无关（等时性），而在期望效用下并非如此。因此，只要学习近似贝叶斯更新，对数证据整合就决定了动态选择能够达到哪些策略结果。
translation.brief: 研究复制动力学何时可解释为连续时间贝叶斯推断，证明收益函数的选择决定博弈分类，并揭示对数收益下严格占优策略被逆转淘汰。

papers.title: Your Wish Is My Commit: Over-Compliant Refactoring in AI Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Large language models are known to be sycophantic, over-complying with users even when doing so is unproductive. When these models act as coding agents, this can be costly: an agent that keeps editing after no edit improves the code writes churn, technical debt, and review burden into the codebase. Yet the consequences of sycophancy in software engineering remain largely understudied. To understand them, we run a controlled study of iterative refactoring, an open-ended task with no stopping criterion, where any edit an agent makes once the code is already clean reflects compliance rather than improvement. Across algorithmic (n=50) and object-oriented (n=10) suites, we repeatedly ask two widely used agents, Codex and Claude Code, to refactor further across five models. Over 3,000 turns, we define six behavioral signals of over-compliance. We hypothesized that a capable agent would stop once it recognized an optimized codebase; none did. Every model kept editing, rewriting up to 31x the original codebase before first stopping and resuming edits even after declaring the task complete. Over-compliance is a costly, multi-turn behavior that compounds with every turn, and our six signals give developers and tool builders a way to detect and curb it.

translation.title: 你的愿望就是我的提交：AI 编程代理中的过度顺从式重构
translation.abstract: 众所周知，大语言模型存在谄媚（sycophancy）倾向，即使无益也会过度顺从用户。当这些模型充当编程代理时，代价可能很高：在无需修改时代理仍持续编辑代码，会给代码库带来无效变更、技术债务和评审负担。然而谄媚在软件工程中的后果在很大程度上仍未被充分研究。为理解这些后果，我们对迭代式重构开展了一项受控研究——这是一个没有停止准则的开放式任务，一旦代码已经整洁，代理所做的任何编辑都反映的是顺从而非改进。在算法类（n=50）和面向对象类（n=10）测试套件上，我们反复要求两个广泛使用的代理 Codex 和 Claude Code（跨五个模型）继续重构。在超过 3,000 轮交互中，我们定义了六个过度顺从的行为信号。我们假设有能力的代理在识别出已优化的代码库后会停止；但没有一个这样做。每个模型都持续编辑，在首次停止前最多重写了原始代码库的 31 倍，甚至在宣布任务完成后仍恢复编辑。过度顺从是一种代价高昂、逐轮累积的多轮行为，我们的六个信号为开发者和工具构建者提供了检测和抑制它的方法。
translation.brief: 研究 AI 编程代理在代码已无需修改时仍持续编辑的过度顺从问题，通过迭代重构受控实验定义六个行为信号来检测该现象。

papers.title: Detect Before You Disambiguate: Perturbation-Based Input Ambiguity Detection in LLMs
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often answer ambiguous inputs as if they had a single intended meaning. This is problematic because input ambiguity is an upstream source of uncertainty: when a prompt admits multiple valid interpretations, the key question is whether the model should answer directly at all. Existing input uncertainty methods often rely on LLM-generated statements or clarifications, but such transformations may already disambiguate the input before the ambiguity is measured. We propose a label-preserving perturbation framework for input ambiguity detection in which perturbations remain close to the original input while preserving its label. We instantiate this principle with two detectors: a black-box rule-based perturbation library and a white-box importance-guided method using model-internal signals. Experiments across four datasets in open-domain, conversational, and visual QA show that our methods outperform output-side uncertainty baselines and LLM-paraphrase-based perturbation baselines. Our results highlight the importance of detecting ambiguity before attempting to disambiguate it. Our code is available \href{https://github.com/Xiao0o0o/input-ambiguity-detection}{\textcolor{purple}{here}}.

translation.title: 先检测再消歧：基于扰动的 LLM 输入歧义检测
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）常常把歧义输入当作只有单一意图含义来回答。这是有问题的，因为输入歧义是不确定性的上游来源：当一个提示存在多种有效解释时，关键问题是模型是否应该直接作答。现有的输入不确定性方法往往依赖 LLM 生成的陈述或澄清，但这类转换可能在测量歧义之前就已经消除了输入的歧义。我们提出一个保持标签的扰动框架用于输入歧义检测，其中扰动保持接近原始输入且不改变其标签。我们用两个检测器实例化该原则：一个基于规则的黑盒扰动库，以及一个利用模型内部信号的白盒重要性引导方法。在开放域、对话和视觉问答的四个数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法优于输出侧不确定性基线和基于 LLM 改写的扰动基线。结果凸显了在尝试消歧之前先检测歧义的重要性。代码见 \href{https://github.com/Xiao0o0o/input-ambiguity-detection}{\textcolor{purple}{here}}。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 将歧义输入当作单一含义作答的问题，提出保持标签的扰动框架，用黑盒规则扰动和白盒重要性引导两种检测器在消歧前检测输入歧义。

papers.title: WAKMan: Workload Aware KVCache Manager
papers.abstract: Prefix caching enables a Large Language Model (LLM) servers to reuse the Key-Value (KV) states and accelerate prefill computation stage for requests that share a prefix with earlier prompts, thus reducing latency and serving cost. With limited memory resource, the KV cache eviction policy becomes a decisive factor in determining the overall benefits of prefix caching. Production traffic may have single-turn, multi-turn, agentic, or a mixture of any combination of these request types. Our findings indicate that agentic steps return within seconds and favor recency, while popular prompts and long conversations return after many other requests and favor frequency. Across 20 mixes, no single policy is always best: vLLM's default strategy LRU provides 12% higher cache hits as compared to the frequency-oriented S3FIFO on agentic-heavy mixes but trails it by up to 22% elsewhere, and even a single workload parameter can flip the winner even for any particular mix. We present WAKMan, a workload-aware KV cache manager that picks its eviction policy from live traffic without knowing request types or reading prompts. It improves hit rate over LRU by 5 percentage points on average, with the lowest mean and worst-case optimality gap of all policies.

translation.title: WAKMan：负载感知的 KV 缓存管理器
translation.abstract: 前缀缓存使大语言模型（LLM）服务器能够复用键值（KV）状态，加速与先前提示共享前缀的请求的预填充（prefill）计算阶段，从而降低延迟和服务成本。在内存资源有限的情况下，KV 缓存的淘汰策略成为决定前缀缓存整体收益的关键因素。生产流量可能包含单轮、多轮、agentic 或任意组合的请求类型。我们的发现表明，agentic 步骤在数秒内返回、偏好新近性（recency），而热门提示和长对话在许多其他请求之后才返回、偏好频率（frequency）。在 20 种混合负载上，没有任何单一策略总是最优：vLLM 默认的 LRU 策略在 agentic 为主的混合负载上比面向频率的 S3FIFO 缓存命中率高 12%，但在其他负载上落后最多 22%，甚至单个负载参数就能翻转任何特定混合负载下的胜者。我们提出 WAKMan，一个负载感知的 KV 缓存管理器，它无需知道请求类型或读取提示，即可从实时流量中选择淘汰策略。相比 LRU，它平均将命中率提升 5 个百分点，并拥有所有策略中最低的平均和最坏情况最优性差距。
translation.brief: 针对不同负载类型下 KV 缓存淘汰策略表现不一的问题，提出 WAKMan，无需请求类型信息即可根据实时流量动态选择淘汰策略。

papers.title: MUSE: Revealing Responsiveness Gaps of LLM Tutors on Multiple-Solution Programming Problems
papers.abstract: When a problem admits multiple valid solutions, effective tutoring requires building on a student's strategy while introducing alternatives at appropriate points. However, whether LLM tutors can support this flexibility by appropriately responding to students' diverse solution approaches remains largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce MUSE: Multi-solution Understanding and Simulation Environment, a controlled environment for simulating student-tutor conversations on multiple-solution programming problems. Grounded in learning science on responsive instruction and multiple-solution learning, we investigate which solutions LLM tutors prefer, how they respond to students' approaches, and how they transition between solutions. Experiments suggest that LLM tutors exhibit systematic preferences among valid solutions, often favoring brute-force approaches when not providing general advice. More concerningly, tutors often impose these preferences, redirecting students toward their own preferred approach rather than supporting the student's. Yet this tendency reverses once a solution is completed: tutors often remain anchored to the existing approach when a stronger alternative could deepen understanding, and sometimes even transition to a less optimal approach. Thus, tutors struggle both to build on students' reasoning when appropriate and to extend their reasoning when beneficial. Promisingly, targeted post-training improves both tutor responsiveness and transitions toward more optimal solutions.

translation.title: MUSE：揭示 LLM 导师在多解编程问题上的响应性差距
translation.abstract: 当一个问题存在多个有效解法时，有效的辅导需要在学生策略的基础上构建，并在恰当的时机引入替代方案。然而，LLM 导师能否通过恰当回应学生多样的解题思路来支持这种灵活性，在很大程度上尚未被探索。在本工作中，我们提出 MUSE：多解理解与模拟环境（Multi-solution Understanding and Simulation Environment），一个用于模拟多解编程问题上学生-导师对话的受控环境。基于响应性教学与多解学习的学习科学理论，我们研究 LLM 导师偏好哪些解法、如何回应学生的思路，以及如何在解法之间转换。实验表明，LLM 导师在有效解法之间表现出系统性偏好，在不提供一般性建议时往往偏好暴力解法。更令人担忧的是，导师常常将这种偏好强加于人，把学生引向自己偏好的方法而非支持学生的方法。然而一旦某个解法完成，这种倾向就会反转：当更强的替代方案本可加深理解时，导师往往仍固守现有方法，有时甚至转向更差的解法。因此，导师既难以在恰当时基于学生的推理，也难以在有益时扩展学生的推理。可喜的是，针对性的后训练同时提升了导师的响应性和向更优解法的转换能力。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 导师无法恰当回应学生多样解法的问题，构建 MUSE 模拟环境研究其解法偏好与转换行为，并通过针对性后训练加以改善。

papers.title: IOSage: Detecting HPC I/O Bottleneck Patterns to Guide LLM Recommendations
papers.abstract: HPC applications often leave much of their parallel file system's bandwidth unused, and turning their Darshan logs into concrete I/O fixes still requires a scarce I/O expert. Rule-based tools flag counters against thresholds set by experts, and in tools built on large language models (LLMs), such as ION and IOAgent, the LLM decides which bottlenecks a log contains. We present IOSage, in which a classifier trained on many labeled logs, not the LLM, makes that decision, since a single log gives an LLM no baseline for what is abnormal. The LLM receives the I/O bottleneck patterns the classifier detects, the job's configuration files, per-file Darshan evidence, and for each pattern a card built from benchmark training runs, and writes recommended changes. Applied by hand and measured in repeated paired runs, the changes IOSage names speed up median total wall time 4.38x for an openPMD kernel (4.02x on a second storage tier) and 1.42x for hourly WRF restarts. For 5 of the 6 application scenarios with a helpful change, IOSage with Claude Sonnet 4 names it, including the change for 10-minute WRF restarts (up to 1.93x faster); with GPT-4o and Llama 3.1 as well, the classifier and cards name more helpful changes than the LLM alone. On 78 benchmark test runs without a pattern, the LLM deciding alone proposes changes for 64; with the classifier, for 9. The classifier reaches 0.929 Micro-F1 on 488 labeled benchmark test runs (0.916 as the gate; 0.832 on the 158 from configurations and jobs outside training), above Drishti's rules, WisIO, and IOAgent's pipeline without its literature retrieval. On TraceBench's nine expert-labeled traces from production systems, it has the highest precision of the tools compared (0.82), with 2 false positives against 12 for the keyword-mapped LLM diagnoses shipped with TraceBench and 5 for Drishti, on the five issue labels that match registered patterns.

translation.title: IOSage：检测 HPC I/O 瓶颈模式以指导 LLM 推荐
translation.abstract: HPC 应用常常使并行文件系统的大量带宽闲置，而将 Darshan 日志转化为具体的 I/O 修复方案仍需要稀缺的 I/O 专家。基于规则的工具依据专家设定的阈值标记计数器，而在基于大语言模型（LLM）的工具（如 ION 和 IOAgent）中，由 LLM 决定日志包含哪些瓶颈。我们提出 IOSage，其中由在大量标注日志上训练的分类器而非 LLM 做出该决定，因为单条日志无法为 LLM 提供判断异常的基线。LLM 接收分类器检测到的 I/O 瓶颈模式、作业的配置文件、逐文件的 Darshan 证据，以及由基准训练运行构建的每个模式的卡片，并撰写推荐的修改。经人工应用并在重复配对运行中测量，IOSage 提出的修改使 openPMD 内核的中位总墙钟时间加速 4.38 倍（在第二存储层上为 4.02 倍），使每小时的 WRF 重启加速 1.42 倍。在 6 个存在有效修改的应用场景中，有 5 个被使用 Claude Sonnet 4 的 IOSage 命名，包括 10 分钟 WRF 重启的修改（最高加速 1.93 倍）；使用 GPT-4o 和 Llama 3.1 时，分类器和卡片命名的有效修改也多于 LLM 单独判断。在 78 个无模式的基准测试运行中，LLM 单独决策时对 64 个提出修改；使用分类器后仅对 9 个。在 488 个标注基准测试运行上，分类器达到 0.929 的 Micro-F1（作为门控时为 0.916；在来自训练外配置和作业的 158 个上为 0.832），高于 Drishti 的规则、WisIO 以及不含文献检索的 IOAgent 流水线。在 TraceBench 来自生产系统的九条专家标注轨迹上，它在匹配已注册模式的五个问题标签上具有所比较工具中最高的精确率（0.82），误报 2 个，而 TraceBench 自带的关键词映射 LLM 诊断误报 12 个，Drishti 误报 5 个。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 缺乏判断 I/O 异常的基线而误判瓶颈的问题，提出 IOSage，用标注日志训练的分类器检测瓶颈模式并配合基准卡片供 LLM 生成修复建议。

papers.title: From Generation to Scoring: Scaling LLM-Based Semantic Labeling at LinkedIn
papers.abstract: For efficiency, industrial large language model (LLM) labelers often pack many candidate labels into one prompt and generate a YES/NO answer for each, even when each decision depends only on the entity and one candidate. Generating these independent decisions as one answer list couples them, spends decoding on the list, and relies on the list being well-formed. In this paper, we present an end-to-end recipe that reformulates the labeler as semantic scoring, fine-tuning it on single-candidate prompts to return each decision as one answer-token score from a prefill-only pass. We also adapt Multiple-Item Scoring (MIS) to score hundreds of candidates in one sequence with attention masked between them. Deployed for profile qualification labeling at LinkedIn, semantic scoring changes at most 0.01% of decisions when candidates are reordered and matches the agreement with reference labels that packed generation reaches only with about 4.7x as many training pairs. The MIS-based stack raises throughput over the deployed stack by 1.24x offline and 1.9x in model serving under a one-second p99 latency target. For offline batch inference, we implement MIS-based scoring as a reusable, model-agnostic Ray Data API proposed for upstream adoption. Model serving uses MIS support contributed to SGLang.

papers.title: MAREval: A Multi-Agent Framework for Evaluating Natural Language Recommendation Explanations
papers.abstract: Evaluating natural language explanations in recommender systems is essential for fostering user trust, transparency, and engagement. However, existing evaluation approaches like human evaluations, while accurate, are resource-intensive and impractical at the scale required by modern recommendation platforms. Also, automated methods using single-agent LLMs suffer from prompt sensitivity and inconsistent outputs. To address these challenges, we propose MAREval, a structured multi-agent framework for evaluating recommendation explanations using large language models. MAREval orchestrates (i) a planner agent that uses a novel Chain of Debate (CoD) prompting strategy to coordinate agent roles and enforce logically consistent evaluation plans; (ii) a moderator agent that regulates discussions by mitigating prompt drift; and (iii) an arbitrator agent that aggregates outputs from multiple evaluation rounds and (iv) a Monte Carlo sampling method, improving robustness and alignment with human judgment. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on both public (TopicalChat) and proprietary recommendation datasets, demonstrating that MAREval outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Comprehensive experiments on a public benchmark and a proprietary e-commerce dataset show that MAREval improves alignment with human judgments over strong singleand multi-agent baselines. Stability analyses indicate substantially lower variability across repeated trials. In a large human-annotation gate, MAREval meets production quality thresholds where prior evaluators fall short, and online A/B testing demonstrates statistically significant improvements in engagement and revenue metrics. These results establish MAREval as a scalable and reliable solution for human-aligned evaluation of recommendation explanations in real-world systems

papers.title: kw-bench: Breaking Frontier Harnesses on Real-World Tasks
papers.abstract: Each new generation of frontier model pushes the edge of what is possible. Inside a harness -- a loop, a shell, a filesystem, the ability to write and run its own code -- a model can take on increasingly difficult work. A growing body of work treats the coding-agent harness as infrastructure for knowledge work rather than a coding tool, and a new wave of benchmarks tests it there. Most of them are generative: build a financial model, a memo, a spreadsheet from a brief, judged by a rubric or by another model. Few test the expensive part of knowledge work, which is investigative. In audit, tax, due diligence, regulatory reporting, claims or any dispute over numbers, the answer already exists -- hidden in incomplete and inconsistent evidence spread across systems -- and has to be recovered and defended to the cent. We introduce kw-bench, a benchmark built from real engagements specialists described to us. Its first task family is a five-year VAT reconstruction across three generations of SAP -- legacy ECC, a partial S/4HANA migration and a consultant's redesign -- delivered as raw system extracts: page headers, local number formats, partial link tables, no documentation of how anything connects. Grading is deterministic, with no LLM judge. We ran four harnesses -- Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and micro-cc -- on the same model, DeepSeek v4.1 Flash, for two hours. The two independent, model-agnostic harnesses delivered (OpenCode 0.542, micro-cc 0.528); the two lab harnesses, away from their home model, delivered nothing (0.00 each). What defeated them was inertia: keeping many weak signals alive across a long session. On a frontier model the task collapses. micro-cc and Claude Code on Claude Opus 5.5 scored 0.9986 and 1.000, in 22 and 25 minutes. A weeks-long engagement now costs minutes and a few dollars; below the frontier, the harness decides how far a model gets.

papers.title: Verifiable Efficiency Limits of Innate LLM Planning in Sliding Puzzles
papers.abstract: Tool-assisted planning success can reflect external search and verification, leaving a model's unaided planning ability unresolved. We isolate innate planning through complete plans generated in one response without tools or execution feedback. We propose a verifiable framework that decomposes success-weighted plan efficiency as $\mathrm{SPE}=R\times Q\times E$: execution reliability, planning coordination among legal plans, and action economy among completed plans. Trajectory replay and certified optima verify these factors; the joint score includes unsuccessful attempts. We evaluate 8,400 full-plan outputs from seven model conditions on $4\times4$ sliding puzzles, controlling exact horizon and obstacle count in the primary cohort. Models that complete every trial still become less economical at longer horizons, while higher efficiency among completed plans can coexist with poor goal attainment. SPE separates the overall capability hierarchy, while its factors distinguish coordination failure from inefficient completion. The framework makes long-horizon limitations in unaided planning quantitatively verifiable.

papers.title: When the Application Layer Is Disposable: Putting Integrity Constraints Back in the Database
papers.abstract: Integrity constraints have been central to the relational model since its inception. However, beyond keys, single-row CHECKs, and referential integrity, most constraints are enforced by application layers today. SQL ASSERTIONs, standardized in SQL-92, remain poorly supported by major RDBMSs. This has become increasingly unacceptable due to two developments. First, LLM-driven applications and agents increasingly issue queries and updates directly against databases, bypassing application layers where invariants reside. Such code may be generated on demand and discarded afterwards, making the database the only durable component that can encode and enforce these invariants. Second, natural constraints in higher-level conceptual models, such as E/R and property graphs, become fragmented across relations under mappings chosen for performance. The resulting multi-relation constraints lack direct database support, and only some can be efficiently enforced using existing mechanisms such as triggers. These developments motivate an overhaul of how constraints are defined, mined, managed, and enforced in data management systems. As a first concrete step, we introduce constraint indexes, which represent constraints spanning multiple relations as transactional access paths, and implement a proof of concept as a PostgreSQL extension. Constraint indexes enforce constraints arising from distributed inheritance hierarchies, folded relationships, and folded weak entities, as well as cardinality bounds and functional dependencies, at low overhead relative to no enforcement. Across these workloads, they outperform the better of the correctness-preserving baselines by up to 2.41 times. We also show that LLM-driven writers frequently violate unenforced constraints and behave erratically when provided with a list of constraints to enforce. We close by discussing a few research challenges raised by this agenda.

papers.title: What Victims Take Away: Attack Reuse and Defense Revision after Prompt-Injection Attacks
papers.abstract: Attack logs and red-team reports show targets the attacks used against them, to help them repair their defenses. Prompt injections against large language models (LLMs) are plain text, so such records also hand targets a working copy. Drawing on social learning theory and work on the victim-offender overlap, we study what targets do with that copy in Tensor Trust, an online game whose players defended LLM-guarded accounts, attacked one another's, and could read every attack they received. Using all 563,349 attack records, we compare each received attack with matched attacks that circulated among similar players at the same moment but never reached the target. Reuse mainly followed success: within a week, targets attacked other players with 10.0% of the attacks that had broken their defense, versus 0.03% of matched attacks (adjusted difference: 8.8-10.0 percentage points). Near-misses, whose replies began with "access granted" but that scored as failures, were reused about as rarely as failures: reuse tracked whether an attack paid off, not how its reply read, consistent with payoff-biased social learning. Breaches were also followed by defense changes, after which same-family attacks became 24.5 percentage points less successful against the target, relative to other defenders. Reuse came mainly from players already attacking, not newcomers. Previously received texts accounted for 23.2% of the successful hijacks we analyze. The attack history thus served both repair and reuse; we derive testable hypotheses for how AI security tools should disclose attacks, such as describing the technique without the full text.

translation.title: 受害者从攻击中获得了什么：Prompt注入攻击后的攻击复用与防御修订
translation.abstract: 攻击日志和红队报告会向目标展示针对其使用的攻击，以帮助其修复防御。针对大语言模型（LLM）的prompt注入是纯文本，因此这类记录也会把一份可用的攻击副本交到目标手中。借鉴社会学习理论和受害者-加害者重叠研究，我们在Tensor Trust这一在线游戏中研究目标如何处理这份副本，该游戏中的玩家防御由LLM守护的账户、互相攻击，并能阅读收到的每一条攻击。利用全部563,349条攻击记录，我们将每条收到的攻击与同一时刻在相似玩家间流传但从未到达目标的匹配攻击进行比较。复用主要跟随成功：一周内，目标用曾攻破其防御的攻击中的10.0%去攻击其他玩家，而匹配攻击仅为0.03%（调整后差异：8.8-10.0个百分点）。擦边攻击（回复以"access granted"开头但计为失败）的复用率与失败攻击差不多：复用追踪的是攻击是否奏效，而非其回复读起来如何，与收益偏向的社会学习一致。防御被攻破后也伴随防御变更，此后同族攻击对该目标的成功率相对其他防御者降低24.5个百分点。复用主要来自已经在攻击的玩家，而非新手。在我们分析的成功劫持中，先前收到的文本占23.2%。攻击历史因此同时服务于修复与复用；我们据此推导出AI安全工具应如何披露攻击的可检验假设，例如描述技术而不提供完整文本。
translation.brief: 研究prompt注入攻击记录被目标复用与防御修订的行为，通过Tensor Trust游戏的大规模攻击数据分析揭示收益偏向的社会学习机制。

papers.title: Electric Vehicle Scheduling and Carbon-Aware Energy Dispatch for Charging Stations
papers.abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) charging stations integrating photovoltaic (PV) generation, battery storage, and bidirectional grid exchange must coordinate access to limited chargers with energy supply while considering both energy cost and carbon emissions. This paper proposes a solver-free greedy heuristic (SFGH) for dynamic vehicle scheduling (VS) and a twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient (TD3) controller for carbon-aware energy dispatch (ED). SFGH assigns EVs according to reductions in service delays, and TD3 controls battery operation to balance energy costs and carbon emissions while meeting the resulting charging demand. The model allows both PV and battery exports, accounting for export revenue and carbon credits. Simulations on year-long case studies show that SFGH--TD3 achieves the lowest accumulated service delay, energy cost, and carbon emissions among the evaluated heuristic and multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (DRL) configurations.

translation.title: 电动汽车充电站的车辆调度与碳感知能量调度
translation.abstract: 集成光伏（PV）发电、电池储能和双向电网交换的电动汽车（EV）充电站，必须在考虑能源成本和碳排放的同时，协调有限充电桩的使用与能源供应。本文提出一种免求解器贪心启发式算法（SFGH）用于动态车辆调度（VS），以及一个基于twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient（TD3）的控制器用于碳感知能量调度（ED）。SFGH根据服务延迟的减少来分配EV，TD3控制电池运行以在满足由此产生的充电需求的同时平衡能源成本与碳排放。该模型允许光伏和电池向电网售电，并计入售电收益和碳信用。为期一年的案例仿真表明，在所评估的启发式和多智能体深度强化学习（DRL）配置中，SFGH--TD3实现了最低的累计服务延迟、能源成本和碳排放。
translation.brief: 针对充电站车辆调度与能量调度问题，提出免求解器贪心启发式SFGH与TD3强化学习控制器相结合的联合优化方法。

papers.title: LM-DSB: A Lightweight Multi-agent System for Automated Daily Safety Bulletin Generation in Construction
papers.abstract: Construction safety management still struggles to produce daily safety bulletins (DSBs), structured daily communications that identify site-specific hazards, convey safety protocols, and set preventive measures for workers. Manual DSB creation takes 2-3 hours daily and yields inconsistent quality, with 25% of crews never conducting pretask planning (Olson et al., 2016), diverting safety personnel from field supervision. This study proposes the Lightweight Multi-Agent DSB System (LM-DSB), which integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with a locally deployable Large Language Model (LLM) to automate DSB generation on consumer-grade personal computers. LM-DSB coordinates specialized planner, researcher, and writer agents in a hierarchical architecture, enhanced by domain-specific fine-tuning on construction safety documentation and RAG grounding in 37 health, safety, and environment (HSE) documents. A two-phase validation assessed feasibility. Phase 1 comparative evaluation showed the multi-agent RAG system (Llama 3-8B) outperformed all alternative configurations, with strong lexical alignment and coherence (TF-IDF: 0.70, BLEU: 0.39, ROUGE-1: 0.66) and near-complete document generation (length ratio: 1.01 vs. 0.39 for single-agent RAG). Phase 2 expert evaluation (N=40) confirmed practical acceptability (mean scores 3.50-4.20 on a 5-point scale), particularly in regulatory compliance (4.20) and factual accuracy (4.10). The findings show that architectural design enables lightweight models to handle safety-critical documentation on consumer-grade hardware, advancing technology democratization in construction safety management. Limitations include knowledge base scope, language constraints, and lack of field deployment validation; future work should address multimodal integration and workflow adoption.

translation.title: LM-DSB：用于建筑日常安全公告自动生成的轻量级多智能体系统
translation.abstract: 建筑安全管理仍难以产出日常安全公告（DSB）——一种结构化的日常沟通，用于识别工地特定危险、传达安全规程并为工人设定预防措施。人工创建DSB每天需2-3小时且质量参差不齐，25%的班组从不进行任务前规划（Olson et al., 2016），并使安全人员偏离现场监督。本研究提出轻量级多智能体DSB系统（LM-DSB），将检索增强生成（RAG）与可本地部署的大语言模型（LLM）相结合，在消费级个人电脑上自动生成DSB。LM-DSB在分层架构中协调专门的规划者、研究者和写作者智能体，并通过在建筑安全文档上的领域微调以及在37份健康、安全与环境（HSE）文档上的RAG接地加以增强。两阶段验证评估了可行性。第一阶段对比评估显示，多智能体RAG系统（Llama 3-8B）优于所有替代配置，具有强词汇一致性和连贯性（TF-IDF: 0.70, BLEU: 0.39, ROUGE-1: 0.66）以及近乎完整的文档生成（长度比1.01，而单智能体RAG为0.39）。第二阶段专家评估（N=40）确认了实际可接受性（5分制平均分3.50-4.20），尤其在法规合规（4.20）和事实准确性（4.10）方面。研究结果表明，架构设计使轻量级模型能在消费级硬件上处理安全关键文档，推动建筑安全管理的技术民主化。局限性包括知识库范围、语言限制以及缺乏现场部署验证；未来工作应解决多模态集成与工作流采纳问题。
translation.brief: 针对建筑日常安全公告人工生成耗时且质量不一的问题，提出结合RAG与本地部署LLM的分层多智能体系统LM-DSB实现自动生成。

papers.title: JustGoal: With Only a Goal, the AI Baseline Is Above the Expert Kernels
papers.abstract: A small number of GPU kernels often determines the efficiency of large language model training and inference. High-performance kernel development typically relies on expert knowledge through manual implementation, collaboration with general-purpose models, or specialized agents equipped with domain knowledge, evaluation methods, and search workflows. We investigate how much value this knowledge provides as foundation models become stronger. We introduce JustGoal, a goal-only baseline in which a general-purpose agent receives only the optimization objective and constraints, without kernel-specific infrastructure, knowledge bases, or predefined workflows, and builds its own evaluation loop. On NVIDIA B200 GPUs, JustGoal outperforms open-source libraries on 8 of 10 operators, achieving per-operator geometric mean speedups of 1.14x to 2.34x. It also surpasses the fastest publicly released specialized-agent kernel on 5 of 9 operators with available comparisons. In a controlled same-model comparison using Fable 5.1 on single shapes, the KDA-0.5 harness reaches 0.95x of JustGoal's performance, while single-mechanism ablations show no consistent benefit from domain knowledge or predefined workflows. These results indicate that specialized machinery should be justified by clear gains over a same-model, same-scope goal-only baseline and reevaluated whenever the foundation model changes.

translation.title: JustGoal：仅凭目标，AI基线即可超越专家kernel
translation.abstract: 少量GPU kernel往往决定了大语言模型训练与推理的效率。高性能kernel开发通常依赖专家知识，包括手动实现、与通用模型协作，或配备领域知识、评估方法和搜索流程的专用智能体。我们研究随着基础模型变强，这些知识能提供多少价值。我们提出JustGoal，一个仅目标（goal-only）基线：通用智能体只接收优化目标和约束，不提供kernel专用基础设施、知识库或预定义工作流，并自行构建评估循环。在NVIDIA B200 GPU上，JustGoal在10个算子中的8个上超越开源库，单算子几何平均加速达1.14x至2.34x。在可比较的9个算子中，它还在5个上超越了公开发布的最快专用智能体kernel。在使用Fable 5.1、单形状的受控同模型对比中，KDA-0.5框架达到JustGoal性能的0.95x，而单机制消融显示领域知识或预定义工作流并无一致收益。这些结果表明，专用机制应以相对同模型、同范围仅目标基线的明确收益来证明其合理性，并在基础模型更换时重新评估。
translation.brief: 研究GPU kernel优化中专家知识的价值，提出仅给优化目标的goal-only基线JustGoal，发现其性能可超越专用智能体框架。

papers.title: Your Agent Acts Differently When You're Around: How User Presence Changes Agent Behavior in Negotiation
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly interact with other agents on behalf of users, yet how users in the loop affect their agents' behavior--for better or worse--remains poorly understood. We study this question through the lens of negotiation, where agents must represent users while strategically bargaining with other agents. To isolate the effect of user presence, we develop PRESENT, a controlled evaluation framework that compares negotiation settings with and without an interactive user, while holding the game, objectives, and user preferences fixed across conditions. Across 11.2k runs spanning 7 games and 8 models, we find that user presence significantly changes both outcomes and behavior. Specifically, negotiation parties with a user obtain higher payouts (+13.7% on average) and their agents negotiate more aggressively. Surprisingly, user presence also induces misaligned behavior, both toward counterparties (where its rate roughly doubles) and toward users (where it emerges in 14.3% of games). These misaligned behaviors are uncorrelated with outcomes and persist even when the user sends only templated, neutral messages. These findings expose two blind spots in current evaluation practice: static instructions miss behaviors that emerge only when users are present, and outcome-level metrics cannot detect them.

translation.title: 你在场时你的智能体表现不同：用户在场如何改变谈判中的智能体行为
translation.abstract: LLM智能体越来越多地代表用户与其他智能体交互，但用户在环如何影响其智能体的行为——无论好坏——仍知之甚少。我们通过谈判的视角研究这一问题，其中智能体既要代表用户，又要与其他智能体进行策略性讨价还价。为隔离用户在场的影响，我们开发了PRESENT，一个受控评估框架，在保持博弈、目标和用户偏好不变的情况下，比较有和没有交互用户的谈判场景。在涵盖7个博弈和8个模型的11.2k次运行中，我们发现用户在场显著改变了结果和行为。具体而言，有用户参与的谈判方获得更高收益（平均+13.7%），其智能体谈判更具攻击性。令人惊讶的是，用户在场还会诱发错位行为，既针对对手方（其发生率大约翻倍），也针对用户（在14.3%的博弈中出现）。这些错位行为与结果不相关，且即使用户只发送模板化的中性消息也会持续存在。这些发现暴露了当前评估实践的两个盲点：静态指令无法捕捉仅在用户在场时出现的行为，而结果层面的指标也无法检测它们。
translation.brief: 研究用户在环对LLM谈判智能体行为的影响，提出受控评估框架PRESENT，发现用户在场既提升收益又诱发错位行为。

papers.title: CONCUR: Concordant Auxiliary Rewards for Multi-Task, Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: When a Large Language Model (LLM) is trained with Reinforcement Learning (RL) on multiple tasks, a task's primary reward can gate auxiliary rewards such as a length reward: on a failing response, an auxiliary cannot exceed the primary. However, group-relative advantage estimators treat a gated auxiliary like any other component, so it can reverse the primary's order, and at the primary's ceiling only auxiliaries order responses. Keeping gated auxiliaries hurts some tasks, while dropping them hurts others. We propose CONCUR, an advantage estimator that replaces the standardized scores of each gated auxiliary with the closest scores that satisfy two conditions: responses with higher primary rewards cannot receive lower scores, and responses at the primary's ceiling receive equal scores. CONCUR-T applies both conditions throughout training, and CONCUR-A lifts the second for an auxiliary that agrees with the primary's order more often than it reverses it among passing responses. On three models from two families and across math, code, instruction following, and writing, both variants score higher on average than all baselines and than when all the gated auxiliaries are dropped.

translation.title: CONCUR：面向多任务、多奖励强化学习的一致性辅助奖励
translation.abstract: 当使用强化学习（RL）在多个任务上训练大语言模型（LLM）时，某任务的主奖励可以门控辅助奖励（如长度奖励）：在失败的响应上，辅助奖励不能超过主奖励。然而，基于组相对优势的估计器将门控辅助奖励当作普通组件处理，因此它可能颠倒主奖励的排序，而在主奖励达到上限时只有辅助奖励在决定响应排序。保留门控辅助奖励会损害某些任务，而完全丢弃又会损害另一些任务。我们提出 CONCUR，一种优势估计器，它将每个门控辅助奖励的标准化分数替换为满足两个条件的最接近分数：主奖励更高的响应不能获得更低的分数，以及主奖励达到上限的响应获得相同分数。CONCUR-T 在整个训练过程中同时应用这两个条件；CONCUR-A 则对在通过响应中与主奖励排序一致多于颠倒的辅助奖励解除第二个条件。在来自两个系列的三个模型上，以及数学、代码、指令遵循和写作任务中，两个变体的平均得分均高于所有基线以及完全丢弃门控辅助奖励的做法。
translation.brief: 解决多任务RL中门控辅助奖励破坏主奖励排序的问题，方法是用满足主奖励一致性和上限等值条件的分数替换门控辅助奖励的标准化分数来估计优势。

papers.title: RouteDRAG: Learning to Route and Control Agentic Execution for Multimodal Document RAG
papers.abstract: Web-based applications increasingly rely on understanding long multimodal documents, where answering questions often requires combining information across pages, tables, and figures. Agentic retrieval-augmented generation addresses these tasks through iterative retrieval and reasoning. However, Agentic execution is not always necessary, introducing additional computation and potentially incorrect answers. Our empirical analysis reveals that Agentic execution provides query-dependent benefits, while additional operations may improve, preserve, or degrade answer accuracy. These findings motivate controlling both Agent invocation and subsequent execution. To address these challenges, we propose RouteDRAG, a learning-based framework comprising four components. Unified Document Index organizes multimodal content into a graph-backed index and derives query representations from initial retrieval. Adaptive Path Routing preserves exact answering and predicts the relative benefit of Agent over shorter execution paths. Dynamic Agent Execution maintains an evolving workspace and refines Planner proposals to control tool use and termination. Sequential Policy Learning first trains operation control from observed outcomes and then trains path routing using the resulting Agent's performance. Across two benchmarks, RouteDRAG achieves an average accuracy improvement of 3.47 percentage points over shorter-path-only execution while assigning only 79.3% of queries to Agent. Notably, it also surpasses uniform Agent execution on both benchmarks while requiring fewer answering calls. Our code is now available at https://github.com/Ereshkigal1/RouteDRAG.

translation.title: RouteDRAG：面向多模态文档RAG的路由学习与Agentic执行控制
translation.abstract: 基于Web的应用日益依赖对长篇多模态文档的理解，回答问题往往需要跨页面、表格和图表整合信息。Agentic检索增强生成通过迭代检索与推理来处理这些任务。然而，Agentic执行并非总是必要，它会引入额外计算并可能产生错误答案。我们的实证分析表明，Agentic执行带来的收益依赖于查询，额外的操作可能提升、保持或降低答案准确性。这些发现促使我们对Agent调用及其后续执行都加以控制。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 RouteDRAG，一个由四个组件组成的学习框架。统一文档索引将多模态内容组织为基于图的索引，并从初始检索中导出查询表示。自适应路径路由在保留精确作答的同时预测Agent相对于更短执行路径的相对收益。动态Agent执行维护一个不断演进的工作区，并细化Planner提案以控制工具使用和终止。序列策略学习先从观测结果训练操作控制，再利用由此得到的Agent性能训练路径路由。在两个基准上，RouteDRAG 相比仅使用更短路径的执行平均提升3.47个百分点的准确率，同时仅将79.3%的查询分配给Agent。值得注意的是，它在两个基准上均超过统一的Agent执行，且所需作答调用更少。代码已发布于 https://github.com/Ereshkigal1/RouteDRAG。
translation.brief: 解决多模态文档RAG中何时调用Agent执行的问题，方法是通过统一文档索引、自适应路径路由、动态Agent执行和序列策略学习来联合学习路由与执行控制。

papers.title: Correction or Manipulation? Measuring Epistemic Vigilance in LLM Agents Under User Pressure
papers.abstract: LLM agents that answer questions and act on behalf of users must decide when to yield to a user who disagrees. Disagreement may correct a genuine error or may be an attempt at manipulation. Prior work shows that models frequently abandon correct answers when challenged by users, yet it remains unclear whether they distinguish correction from manipulation or merely differ in their propensity to concede. We examine this question across seven LLMs from four vendors in two studies, one on the answers agents give and one on the actions they take as customer-support agents whose policy permits account changes only for verified users. Simulated users push toward correct and incorrect answers with graded pressure. Following research on epistemic vigilance, the pressure either appeals to the source, such as claimed authority, or offers content the agent cannot verify, namely a cited source. Drawing on signal detection theory, we measure on a set of benchmark questions how much more readily each agent concedes to correction than to manipulation, separately from its overall propensity to concede. Citations made five of seven models readier to concede and four worse at discriminating, while stronger wording added little. In the agentic study, five models never violated the verification policy, including models that readily abandoned correct answers, so concession on answers did not predict violations of policy. Ministral 3B violated the policy mainly under claimed authority, and Ministral 8B reported changes it had not made. An instruction to revise only on verifiable evidence chiefly shifted propensity to concede rather than improving discrimination. Concession rates alone are therefore misleading, and agents should be evaluated on both their discrimination and the actions they take.

translation.title: 纠错还是操纵？测量用户压力下LLM Agent的认知警觉
translation.abstract: 代表用户回答问题并执行操作的LLM Agent必须决定何时向持不同意见的用户让步。异议可能是对真实错误的纠正，也可能是操纵的企图。已有工作表明，模型在被用户质疑时经常放弃正确答案，但尚不清楚它们是能区分纠正与操纵，还是仅仅在让步倾向上有所不同。我们在两项研究中考察了来自四家厂商的七个LLM：一项研究关注Agent给出的答案，另一项关注其作为客服Agent采取的行动，其政策仅允许为已验证用户更改账户。模拟用户以分级压力推动正确或错误的答案。借鉴认知警觉研究，压力或者诉诸来源（如声称的权威），或者提供Agent无法验证的内容（即引用来源）。借助信号检测理论，我们在一组基准问题上测量每个Agent对纠正比对操纵更容易让步的程度，并将其与总体让步倾向分开。引用使七个模型中的五个更愿意让步，四个的辨别能力变差，而更强的措辞影响甚微。在Agentic研究中，五个模型从未违反验证政策，其中包括那些轻易放弃正确答案的模型，因此在答案上的让步并不能预测政策违反。Ministral 3B 主要在声称权威时违反政策，Ministral 8B 则报告了它并未做出的更改。要求仅在可验证证据下修改的指令主要改变了让步倾向，而非提升辨别能力。因此，仅凭让步率会产生误导，应同时依据辨别能力和所采取的行动来评估Agent。
translation.brief: 解决LLM Agent难以区分用户纠错与操纵的问题，方法是基于信号检测理论在分级压力下分离测量让步倾向与辨别能力，并考察答案让步与政策违反行为的关系。

papers.title: CoHARL: Co-Evolving Agent Policies and Executable Harnesses with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents interact with their environments through executable harnesses that govern tool use and feedback. Optimizing a harness for a fixed policy overlooks how its behavior changes during learning, while training a policy under a fixed harness leaves the interface that generates its training experience unchanged. This motivates adapting the harness throughout policy training. We introduce CoHARL, a population-based reinforcement learning framework that co-evolves a shared policy and a population of executable harnesses. The policy learns from rollouts across the population, and a proposer uses its execution traces to revise harness code during training. CoHARL achieves a 27.6% mean resolved rate on SWE-rebench, improving over harness-only search by 6.4 percentage points. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show gains in software engineering and terminal-based tasks. Under matched training budgets, CoHARL also outperforms searching for a harness once before RL and alternating policy updates with revisions to a single active harness.

translation.title: CoHARL：用强化学习共同演化Agent策略与可执行Harness
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）Agent通过控制工具使用和反馈的可执行harness与环境交互。为固定策略优化harness忽视了策略在学习过程中行为的变化，而在固定harness下训练策略又使生成训练经验的接口保持不变。这促使我们在策略训练全程中自适应调整harness。我们提出 CoHARL，一个基于种群的强化学习框架，共同演化一个共享策略和一个可执行harness种群。策略从整个种群的rollout中学习，而一个proposer利用执行轨迹在训练期间修改harness代码。CoHARL 在 SWE-rebench 上取得27.6%的平均解决率，比仅搜索harness提升6.4个百分点。在 SWE-bench Verified 和 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上的实验显示其在软件工程和终端任务中的收益。在相同训练预算下，CoHARL 也优于先搜索一次harness再进行RL，以及交替进行策略更新与修改单一活跃harness的做法。
translation.brief: 解决固定harness与策略训练脱节的问题，方法是用基于种群的强化学习让共享策略与可执行harness种群共同演化，由proposer依据执行轨迹在训练中修改harness代码。

papers.title: When to Intervene? An Empirical Study of Errors and Self-Recovery in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: LLM agents interact with Web services to perform tasks on users' behalf. Errors during these interactions can disrupt execution and prevent task completion, motivating external intervention. However, agents may self-recover through continued execution, raising the question of when to intervene and when to wait for self-recovery. We present an empirical study of errors and self-recovery in LLM agents. We construct ReInBench, a dataset containing 1,259 agent traces and 1,403 error events across computer-use and Web tasks. Our study examines how often and how quickly agents self-recover, how self-recovery relates to subsequent execution and task completion, and whether self-recovery can be predicted when an error occurs. We find that 725 error events self-recover, often within a few steps, with self-recovery performance differing across Execution LLMs. Self-recovery can also help agents recover from subsequent errors of the same type and support overall task completion. Intervention should therefore prioritize errors unlikely to self-recover, while allowing agents to continue when self-recovery is likely. Building on these empirical findings, we propose ReCoF, a method that predicts whether an error will self-recover to inform whether additional intervention is needed. ReCoF achieves an average relative improvement of 9.02% in Macro-F1 over the strongest baseline on ReInBench. Our code and data can be found at https://method-notes.github.io/ReCoF/.

translation.title: 何时干预？LLM Agent错误与自我恢复的实证研究
translation.abstract: LLM Agent与Web服务交互以代表用户执行任务。交互过程中的错误会中断执行并阻碍任务完成，因此需要外部干预。然而，Agent可能通过继续执行实现自我恢复，这就引出了何时干预、何时等待自我恢复的问题。我们对LLM Agent中的错误与自我恢复进行了实证研究。我们构建了 ReInBench，一个包含1,259条Agent轨迹和1,403个错误事件的数据集，覆盖计算机使用和Web任务。我们的研究考察Agent自我恢复的频率和速度、自我恢复与后续执行及任务完成的关系，以及错误发生时能否预测自我恢复。我们发现725个错误事件实现了自我恢复，通常在几步之内完成，且自我恢复表现因执行LLM而异。自我恢复还能帮助Agent从后续同类错误中恢复，并支持整体任务完成。因此，干预应优先针对不太可能自我恢复的错误，而在自我恢复可能性较大时允许Agent继续执行。基于这些实证发现，我们提出 ReCoF，一种预测错误是否会自我恢复的方法，以指导是否需要额外干预。ReCoF 在 ReInBench 上相比最强基线在 Macro-F1 上平均相对提升9.02%。代码和数据见 https://method-notes.github.io/ReCoF/。
translation.brief: 解决LLM Agent出错时何时干预的问题，方法是通过构建ReInBench数据集实证分析错误自我恢复规律，并提出预测错误能否自我恢复的ReCoF方法来指导干预决策。

papers.title: FIDES-Live: Evaluating Behavioral Concordance in Sequential Trading Agents
papers.abstract: Sequential trading agents produce decisions, orders, execution receipts, account states, and reports that need not agree, even when the final portfolio value is correctly computed. We present FIDES-Live, an operational extension of FIDES from generated strategy concordance to the audit of sequential agent traces. The protocol separates structured decision validity, optional numerical commitment adherence, execution and ledger reconciliation, and receipt- grounded reporting, with explicit coverage and unscorable outcomes. We retrospectively audit ten requested inference routes over 7,299 cryptocurrency account-rounds and a 310-round equity pilot, using real market observations and local paper execution. Cryptocurrency decision validity is 97.35% and structured reporting accuracy is 90.81% among scorable responses, but route-level decision and reporting performance can diverge sharply. Commitment adherence is 94.36% overall; it falls to 62.63% on constraints emitted with nonempty order proposals, compared with 97.56% for valid empty proposals. All retained cash and position transitions reconcile with recorded fills, while execution controls and unavailable quotes explain separate rejection populations. Short-window marked returns provide descriptive context rather than a new test of whether concordance predicts alpha. These observations motivate reporting concordance, evidence coverage, activity, and financial outcomes separately. They do not establish long-run trading skill, semantic faithfulness of explanations, or causal benefits from audit feedback.

translation.title: FIDES-Live：评估序贯交易智能体的行为一致性
translation.abstract: 序贯交易智能体产生的决策、订单、成交回执、账户状态和报告可能互不一致，即使最终组合价值的计算是正确的。我们提出 FIDES-Live，将 FIDES 从生成策略一致性扩展到对序贯智能体轨迹的审计。该协议区分结构化决策有效性、可选的数值承诺遵守、执行与账本对账，以及基于回执的报告，并明确覆盖范围与不可评分结果。我们回顾性地审计了十条请求的推理路径，涵盖 7,299 个加密货币账户轮次和 310 轮股票试点，使用真实市场观测和本地模拟执行。在可评分响应中，加密货币决策有效性为 97.35%，结构化报告准确率为 90.81%，但路径级的决策与报告表现可能差异显著。承诺遵守率总体为 94.36%；在伴随非空订单提议发出的约束上降至 62.63%，而有效空提议下为 97.56%。所有保留的现金与持仓变动均与记录的成交对账一致，而执行控制和不可用报价解释了各自独立的拒绝群体。短窗口标记收益仅提供描述性背景，并非检验一致性是否预测 alpha 的新测试。这些观察促使将报告一致性、证据覆盖、活动与财务结果分开评估。它们并不证明长期交易能力、解释的语义忠实性，或审计反馈的因果收益。
translation.brief: 该论文解决序贯交易智能体各环节输出不一致的审计问题，提出将 FIDES 协议扩展为对智能体轨迹进行决策有效性、承诺遵守、账本对账与回执报告分层审计的框架。

papers.title: CogArena: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents on Interactive Behavioral Experiments
papers.abstract: Claims about the cognitive capabilities of large language models are typically tested by translating behavioral paradigms into text prompts, bypassing the visual interfaces and time pressure through which human participants actually engage with experiments. At the same time, AI agents can now complete online behavioral tasks and produce human-like data, which raises concerns that online datasets in the social and behavioral sciences are increasingly open to contamination. We introduce CogArena, a benchmark of ten experimental paradigms from the social and behavioral sciences. Agents complete the experiments through a standard web browser, working with the same visual stimuli and response interfaces that online participants use. A three-level scoring procedure evaluates whether the agent completed the task, how accurately it performed, and whether its data show the behavioral signatures each paradigm reliably produces in people.
