Across four multimodal models, each run ten times per task, we find that finishing an experiment and reproducing its signatures are different things. Many sessions did not finish, and those that did reproduced some signatures reliably and others not at all. CogArena provides the tasks, scoring code, and a public leaderboard for new submissions.

translation.title: CogArena：在交互式行为实验中对多模态智能体进行基准测试
translation.abstract: 关于大语言模型认知能力的主张通常通过将行为范式转化为文本提示来测试，绕过了人类被试实际参与实验所依赖的视觉界面和时间压力。与此同时，AI 智能体现在能够完成在线行为任务并产生类人数据，这引发了对社会科学与行为科学在线数据集日益面临污染的担忧。我们提出 CogArena，一个包含十个社会科学与行为科学实验范式的基准。智能体通过标准网页浏览器完成实验，使用与在线被试相同的视觉刺激和响应界面。三级评分程序评估智能体是否完成任务、完成得有多准确，以及其数据是否呈现每个范式在人类身上稳定产生的行为特征。在四个多模态模型、每个任务各运行十次的实验中，我们发现完成实验与复现其行为特征是两回事。许多会话未能完成，而完成者中某些特征能可靠复现，另一些则完全无法复现。CogArena 提供任务、评分代码和公开排行榜供新提交。
translation.brief: 该论文解决如何让 AI 智能体在与人类相同的视觉交互条件下完成行为认知实验的问题，构建了包含十个行为范式的浏览器端基准 CogArena 并采用三级评分体系。

papers.title: Do AI Scientists Know What's New?
papers.abstract: A major challenge facing AI scientific discovery pipelines is how to determine when a generated idea is meaningfully novel. Ideally, novelty checks in these pipelines must be able to reject non-novel ideas while not rejecting too many novel ideas, and they should also be able to distinguish which parts of a proposal are non-novel, as opposed to opaquely discarding entire proposals. We design an analytical framework for evaluation of novelty checks with temporal ground truth at both the proposal- and claim-level, using four datasets of 1,060 proposals built from published papers, reviewer disputes, and generated ideas matching ones the field went on to publish. Auditing existing novelty checks with this framework, we find that checks with high rejection rates on non-novel work also tend to have high false alarms on ideas that are later realized by human researchers, and observe that checks built to evaluate proposals as a whole can point to claim-level prior art only by rejecting the whole proposal. We therefore introduce ClaimNov, a fine-grained, interpretable claim-level novelty module. ClaimNov catches 97% of disguised papers at a 1.5% false-alarm rate, and its claim-level novelty profile cuts the LLM judge's false alarms from 11.8% to 1.5%. Because its verdict rests on claim-level evidence, ClaimNov also keeps proposals that build on established contributions, rejecting only 3% of ICLR-accepted proposals with a reviewer-disputed contribution and keeping 91 of 100 novel proposals with one spliced prior contribution, against 76 for the strongest existing check. Code and data are available at https://github.com/emmatliu/claimnov.

translation.title: AI 科学家知道什么是新的吗？
translation.abstract: AI 科学发现流程面临的一个主要挑战是如何判断生成的想法是否具有实质性的新颖性。理想情况下，这些流程中的新颖性检查应能拒绝非新颖想法，同时不过度拒绝新颖想法，并且应能区分提案中哪些部分是非新颖的，而非不透明地丢弃整个提案。我们设计了一个分析框架，在提案级和主张级使用时间性真值来评估新颖性检查，基于四个共 1,060 个提案的数据集，这些数据集由已发表论文、审稿人争议以及与领域后来发表的想法相匹配的生成想法构建。用该框架审计现有新颖性检查后，我们发现对非新颖工作拒绝率高的检查，对后来被人类研究者实现的想法也往往有高误报率；并且为整体评估提案而构建的检查只能通过拒绝整个提案来指出主张级的现有技术。因此我们提出 ClaimNov，一个细粒度、可解释的主张级新颖性模块。ClaimNov 在 1.5% 误报率下捕获 97% 的伪装论文，其主张级新颖性画像将 LLM 裁判的误报率从 11.8% 降至 1.5%。由于其判断基于主张级证据，ClaimNov 也保留了在既有贡献之上构建的提案：对具有审稿人争议贡献的 ICLR 录用提案仅拒绝 3%，对 100 个含一个拼接既有贡献的新颖提案保留 91 个，而现有最强检查仅保留 76 个。代码和数据见 https://github.com/emmatliu/claimnov。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 AI 科学发现流程中新颖性检查误报高且缺乏细粒度的问题，提出基于主张级时间性真值的评估框架及可解释的模块 ClaimNov。

papers.title: MedConstBench: Benchmarking How Constitutions Steer LLMs in Medical Ethics
papers.abstract: As large language models advance rapidly, they are increasingly used to answer medical questions, and many such models are now deployed locally. Once a model is deployed, its behavior is governed mainly by the ethical policy written into its constitution. However, most existing work focuses on factual correctness rather than the trade-off between competing ethical values. Even benchmarks that do evaluate ethics treat it as a fixed property of the model rather than as a variable, so how a constitution reshapes medical-ethics behavior remains largely unexplored. We introduce MedConstBench, a medical-ethics benchmark that treats the deployment constitution as a controlled variable, is organized around Beauchamp's four principles, and is scored by human-calibrated multi-model peer review. It includes MedDilemma, our own dataset of clinical dilemmas, and supports a systematic analysis of how constitutions steer LLMs. Evaluating ten open-source LLMs under four constitutions, we find that the effect of a constitution is dimension-selective and model-dependent, and that no constitution is universally optimal. Motivated by these findings, we propose a do-no-harm adaptive selector that chooses a constitution per model, matching the per-model oracle while guaranteeing a worst-case floor and generalizing to unseen models at low cost.

translation.title: MedConstBench：基准测试宪法如何引导大语言模型的医学伦理
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型快速发展，它们越来越多地被用于回答医学问题，且许多此类模型现已本地部署。模型一旦部署，其行为主要由写入其宪法（constitution）的伦理政策决定。然而，现有工作大多关注事实正确性而非相互竞争的伦理价值之间的权衡。即使有评估伦理的基准，也将伦理视为模型的固定属性而非变量，因此宪法如何重塑医学伦理行为在很大程度上未被探索。我们提出 MedConstBench，一个将部署宪法作为受控变量的医学伦理基准，围绕 Beauchamp 的四原则组织，并由人工校准的多模型同行评审进行评分。它包含我们自建的临床困境数据集 MedDilemma，并支持对宪法如何引导 LLM 进行系统分析。在四种宪法下评估十个开源 LLM，我们发现宪法的影响是维度选择性的且依赖具体模型，没有一种宪法是普遍最优的。基于这些发现，我们提出一个不伤害原则的自适应选择器，为每个模型选择宪法，在匹配每模型最优结果的同时保证最坏情况底线，并能以低成本泛化到未见过的模型。
translation.brief: 该论文解决宪法（伦理策略）如何影响 LLM 医学伦理行为缺乏系统评估的问题，构建了以宪法为受控变量的基准 MedConstBench 并提出按模型自适应选择宪法的方法。

papers.title: Benchmarking Task Takeover Across Agent Handoffs
papers.abstract: As agents collaborate on longer tasks, responsibility may pass between models before the work is complete. The receiving model must build on prior decisions, observations, and actions while addressing the remaining requirements. Evaluating this transition requires connecting the information preserved at handoff to how the receiver continues the work, a relationship that task-success and memory-retention scores alone do not capture. We introduce the Handoff State Continuity Benchmark (HSC-Bench), comprising 1,039 tasks that evaluate two complementary aspects of task takeover: recovering relevant repository evidence and continuing from established conversational, tool, and file-work state. Comparisons across six receiving models show that structured handoff state improves repository evidence recovery for every model and continuation performance for most models. The strongest receivers differ between the two tracks, showing that evidence-recovery rankings alone do not characterize performance when continuing from inherited state. By combining these comparisons with checks of subsequent responses and actions, HSC-Bench evaluates both access to prior evidence and adherence to established commitments and completed work. This provides a basis for selecting receiving models and assessing handoff representations according to the work that must be carried forward.

translation.title: 跨智能体交接的任务接管基准测试
translation.abstract: 随着智能体在更长任务上协作，责任可能在工作完成前在不同模型之间转移。接收模型必须在既有决策、观察和动作的基础上继续工作，并处理剩余需求。评估这种转移需要将交接时保留的信息与接收方如何继续工作联系起来，这是任务成功率和记忆保留分数无法单独刻画的关系。我们提出 Handoff State Continuity Benchmark（HSC-Bench），包含 1,039 个任务，评估任务接管的两个互补方面：恢复相关仓库证据，以及从既定的对话、工具和文件工作状态继续。对六个接收模型的比较显示，结构化交接状态提升所有模型的仓库证据恢复能力和大多数模型的继续执行性能。两条赛道上的最强接收模型不同，表明仅凭证据恢复排名无法刻画从继承状态继续工作的表现。通过将这些比较与对后续响应和动作的检查相结合，HSC-Bench 同时评估对先前证据的获取和对既定承诺与已完成工作的遵循。这为根据需要承接的工作选择接收模型和评估交接表示提供了依据。
translation.brief: 该论文解决智能体交接后任务接管质量难以评估的问题，提出包含证据恢复与状态延续两条赛道的基准 HSC-Bench。

papers.title: ETC-Bench: A Multilingual Benchmark for Evaluation-Side Transcript Canonicalization
papers.abstract: Written transcripts of the same speech can differ in ways that are not uniquely determined by the speech signal. We formulate evaluation-side transcript canonicalization (ETC), which maps multiple surface forms to a single canonical form when their differences are not determined by speech. To our knowledge, ETC-Bench is the first and most comprehensive multilingual benchmark for evaluation-side transcript canonicalization, covering 181 phenomenon types across 12 languages. Each instance is a minimal pair that shares a sentence context and differs only in a target span exhibiting one phenomenon. To evaluate both canonicalization success and semantic preservation, we propose Semantic-preserving Exact-match Normalization Accuracy (SENA), which combines exact agreement between independently canonicalized pair members with a pair-relative BERTScore constraint against information loss. We further introduce the Taxonomy-guided Agent Canonicalization Skill (TACS), which provides LLM agents with phenomenon descriptions and explicit canonicalization contracts. Experiments with five baseline configurations and three TACS-based agents show that the agents outperform the baseline systems on shared languages. ETC-Bench provides a systematic testbed for evaluation-side transcript canonicalization across languages.

translation.title: ETC-Bench：面向评测侧转写规范化的多语言基准
translation.abstract: 同一语音的书面转写可能以语音信号无法唯一确定的方式存在差异。我们提出了评测侧转写规范化（ETC），即当多个表层形式之间的差异并非由语音决定时，将其映射到单一规范形式。据我们所知，ETC-Bench 是首个也是最全面的评测侧转写规范化多语言基准，覆盖 12 种语言中的 181 种现象类型。每个实例是一个最小对立对，共享相同的句子上下文，仅在展现某一现象的目标片段上不同。为同时评估规范化成功与否及语义保真度，我们提出了语义保持精确匹配归一化准确率（SENA），它将独立规范化的对立对成员之间的精确一致性与针对信息损失的相对 BERTScore 约束相结合。我们进一步引入了分类法引导的智能体规范化技能（TACS），为 LLM 智能体提供现象描述和明确的规范化契约。使用五种基线配置和三个基于 TACS 的智能体的实验表明，智能体在共享语言上优于基线系统。ETC-Bench 为跨语言的评测侧转写规范化提供了一个系统性测试平台。
translation.brief: 针对语音信号无法唯一决定的转写差异问题，提出多语言转写规范化基准 ETC-Bench，并配套 SENA 评估指标与 TACS 智能体方法进行规范化评估与增强。

papers.title: Agentic Data Sampling Framework for Multilingual ASR via Linguistic-Aware Error-Driven Optimization
papers.abstract: Multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) has achieved rapid progress with large-scale pretrained models and multilingual speech corpora. Previous studies have proved the pivotal role of data sampling in multilingual ASR performance. However, existing sampling strategies largely rely on time-consuming manual, heuristic-based designs. To address this, we propose a linguistic-aware agentic data sampling framework that introduces a data sampling LLM agent into the multilingual ASR training loop. The agent is driven by a linguistically grounded rubric that analyzes ASR errors from phonological, morphological, and syntactic perspectives, and uses the resulting feedback together with training statistics, budget constraints, and algorithm profiles to select domain-level, sample-level, and token-level sampling strategies. This design turns evaluation results into adaptive data-selection decisions rather than treating WER/CER as final endpoints only. We conduct experiments on twelve Common Voice languages using Whisper-medium as the ASR backbone. The results show that our method achieves performance better than full-data training while using less training data and lower computational resources, and substantially accelerates training convergence compared to conventional sampling strategies.

translation.title: 基于语言学感知错误驱动优化的多语言 ASR 智能体式数据采样框架
translation.abstract: 多语言自动语音识别（ASR）借助大规模预训练模型和多语言语音语料库取得了快速进展。已有研究证明了数据采样在多语言 ASR 性能中的关键作用。然而，现有的采样策略很大程度上依赖耗时的手动、启发式设计。为此，我们提出一个语言学感知的智能体式数据采样框架，将数据采样 LLM 智能体引入多语言 ASR 训练循环。该智能体由一个基于语言学的评分准则驱动，从音系、形态和句法角度分析 ASR 错误，并将所得反馈与训练统计信息、预算约束和算法特性相结合，选择域级、样本级和词元级的采样策略。这一设计将评估结果转化为自适应的数据选择决策，而非仅将 WER/CER 视为最终终点。我们以 Whisper-medium 为 ASR 骨干，在十二种 Common Voice 语言上进行了实验。结果表明，我们的方法在减少训练数据和计算资源的情况下取得了优于全量数据训练的性能，并且相比传统采样策略显著加速了训练收敛。
translation.brief: 针对多语言 ASR 中依赖人工启发式数据采样的问题，提出将具备语言学错误分析能力的 LLM 智能体嵌入训练循环以自适应选择采样策略。

papers.title: Monitor Accuracy Isn't the Answer: A Decision-Value Framework for Evaluating AI Agent Restart Monitors
papers.abstract: Classification accuracy and true-positive and false-positive rates alone do not determine whether restarting an AI agent improves success. Using an exact alarm-to-action identity for an independent clean restart with zero monitoring overhead, we show analytically that a monitor with fixed 90% accuracy can swing from a five-percentage-point loss to a 35-point gain in success rate, depending solely on the replacement attempt's residual-budget success probability. We introduce two techniques for evaluating monitors and progress signals in decision terms. First, a decision-sufficiency criterion, a binary-action specialization of Blackwell's comparison of experiments, identifies which progress representations or context compressions preserve the information needed to choose optimally between the specified actions, independent of trace reconstruction fidelity. Second, a finite-sample, model-free decision audit uses simultaneous binomial intervals over existing agent traces, without additional model calls, to certify a preference for "restart" or "continue" under stated sampling assumptions, or return "abstain" when evidence is insufficient. In a study of 194 externally evaluated model executions on 19 selected SymPy issues from SWE-bench Verified, with a retrospective audit of 130 of these traces, we find a 2.29-point apparent restart gain traced to a single surviving failed attempt, a 42.29-point loss on a second model, no positive replication of the initial gain on prospective task cohorts, and zero of 103 live comparisons meeting the specified certification bar. These results motivate evaluating agent monitors through recovery opportunity, decision value, and statistical support, rather than classification performance alone.

translation.title: 监控准确率并非答案：评估 AI 智能体重启监控器的决策价值框架
translation.abstract: 仅凭分类准确率和真/假阳性率并不能决定重启 AI 智能体是否能提升成功率。利用监控零开销下独立干净重启的精确“警报-动作”恒等式，我们解析地表明：固定 90% 准确率的监控器仅因替换尝试的剩余预算成功概率不同，就可使成功率在损失五个百分点与提升三十五个百分点之间波动。我们引入两种以决策术语评估监控器和进度信号的技术。第一，决策充分性准则——Blackwell 实验比较在二元动作上的特化——可识别哪些进度表示或上下文压缩在独立于轨迹重建保真度的情况下，仍保留了在指定动作间进行最优选择所需的信息。第二，有限样本、无模型的决策审计利用现有智能体轨迹上的同步二项区间，无需额外模型调用，即可在既定采样假设下认证“重启”或“继续”的偏好，或在证据不足时返回“弃权”。在对 SWE-bench Verified 中 19 个精选 SymPy 问题的 194 次外部评估模型执行（其中对 130 条轨迹进行了回溯审计）的研究中，我们发现表面上 2.29 个点的重启收益源自单一幸存的失败尝试，第二个模型损失达 42.29 个点，初始收益在前瞻任务队列上无正向复现，且 103 次在线比较中零次达到既定认证门槛。这些结果表明，应通过恢复机会、决策价值和统计支持来评估智能体监控器，而非仅看分类性能。
translation.brief: 针对仅以分类准确率评估智能体重启监控器失效的问题，提出以决策充分性准则和统计决策审计为核心的决策价值评估框架。

papers.title: From Ripple to Boundary: Deterministic Impact Boundaries for LLM-Based Software Evolution
papers.abstract: The landscape of software evolution is undergoing a fundamental paradigm shift in the era of Large Language Models. As industrial software engineering increasingly transitions toward design-driven code generation, the bottleneck of evolution has shifted from writing code to maintaining deterministic consistency between multi-source design assets and the generated code. When a design asset changes, LLM agents currently lack a deterministic impact boundary to identify which code must be evolved, leading to two failure modes: hallucinating missing changes or breaking unrelated code. Probabilistic approaches, such as semantic retrieval or text-based diffing, fail to capture the structural ripple effects across highly interconnected design dependencies. We propose a paradigm shift from probabilistic semantic retrieval to deterministic structural constraints. We formalize the design assets as a Knowledge Graph and organize them into a content-addressed Merkle Directed Acyclic Graph. Our key insight reveals a topological isomorphism between the logical ripple effect of a design change and the content hash propagation within the DAG. By leveraging this, we transform ambiguous impact analysis into verifiable structural operations. Through a two-phase diffing process, we extract a precise causal chain that defines the exact modification boundary. This boundary enables deterministic context injection, providing the LLM agent with strictly scoped code and design updates, thereby fundamentally guaranteeing evolution safety. As a by-product, the KG serves as an agent-queryable knowledge base for natural language design retrieval. Early deployment on a large-scale industrial payment platform demonstrates that our mechanism successfully computes the exact impact boundary and generates incremental code modifications that meet the expected design changes.

translation.title: 从涟漪到边界：面向 LLM 软件演化的确定性影响边界
translation.abstract: 在大语言模型时代，软件演化的格局正经历根本性的范式转变。随着工业软件工程日益向设计驱动的代码生成转型，演化的瓶颈已从编写代码转移到保持多源设计资产与生成代码之间的确定性一致性。当设计资产变更时，LLM 智能体目前缺乏确定性的影响边界来识别哪些代码必须演化，从而导致两种失败模式：幻觉出不存在的变更或破坏无关代码。概率性方法（如语义检索或基于文本的差异比较）无法捕捉高度互联的设计依赖之间的结构性涟漪效应。我们提出从概率性语义检索到确定性结构约束的范式转变。我们将设计资产形式化为知识图谱，并将其组织为内容寻址的 Merkle 有向无环图。我们的关键洞察揭示了设计变更的逻辑涟漪效应与 DAG 内内容哈希传播之间的拓扑同构。借助这一点，我们将模糊的影响分析转化为可验证的结构操作。通过两阶段差异比较过程，我们提取出精确的因果链，定义确切的修改边界。该边界实现了确定性的上下文注入，为 LLM 智能体提供严格限定范围的代码和设计更新，从根本上保证演化安全性。作为副产品，知识图谱还可作为智能体可查询的知识库，支持自然语言设计检索。在一个大型工业支付平台上的早期部署表明，我们的机制成功计算出精确的影响边界，并生成符合预期设计变更的增量代码修改。
translation.brief: 针对设计变更后 LLM 智能体无法确定代码修改范围的问题，提出用内容寻址的 Merkle DAG 形式化设计资产以计算确定性影响边界。

papers.title: NextEval: An Agent-Based Solver and Benchmark for Derivative-Free Optimization
papers.abstract: Derivative-free optimization (DFO) addresses problems where derivatives are unavailable or costly to obtain. This setting often arises in simulation-based and experimental applications, where evaluating the black-box objective can itself be costly. Thus, it remains a central challenge in DFO to effectively exploit accumulated observations to select informative evaluation points under a limited budget. In this light, we introduce the NextEval solver, an agent-based DFO solver, which integrates the capabilities of a large language model (LLM) to guide the sequential selection of evaluation points. Specifically, we establish a system that combines an LLM agent with a numerical environment. The environment provides tools for analyzing past evaluations and executing numerical methods, while maintaining a shared evaluation history and method-specific state to support continuation across method switches. Using observations and tool feedback, the LLM agent selects tools, configures their parameters, and allocates the evaluation budget, while numerical methods compute and evaluate candidate points. Building on this system, we also introduce NextEval Bench, a benchmark protocol for comparing agent configurations on shared DFO tasks using the same numerical tools under matched evaluation budgets and information constraints. Numerical results on low-dimensional DFO problems demonstrate that the NextEval solver outperforms the state-of-the-art DFO baselines in function-evaluation efficiency.

translation.title: NextEval：基于智能体的无导数优化求解器与基准
translation.abstract: 无导数优化（DFO）处理导数不可得或获取代价高昂的问题。这一情形常见于基于仿真和实验的应用中，其中评估黑箱目标函数本身就可能代价高昂。因此，如何在有限预算下有效利用已积累的观测来选取有信息量的评估点，仍是 DFO 的核心挑战。为此，我们提出 NextEval 求解器，一个基于智能体的 DFO 求解器，它集成大语言模型（LLM）的能力来引导评估点的序贯选择。具体而言，我们构建了一个将 LLM 智能体与数值环境相结合的系统。该环境提供分析历史评估和执行数值方法的工具，并维护共享的评估历史与方法特定的状态，以支持跨方法切换的延续。基于观测和工具反馈，LLM 智能体选择工具、配置参数并分配评估预算，而数值方法则计算和评估候选点。在此系统基础上，我们还提出 NextEval Bench，一个基准协议，用于在匹配的评估预算和信息约束下、使用相同数值工具，在共享 DFO 任务上比较不同的智能体配置。在低维 DFO 问题上的数值结果表明，NextEval 求解器在函数评估效率上优于最先进的 DFO 基线。
translation.brief: 针对无导数优化中有限预算下选取评估点的难题，提出结合 LLM 智能体与数值环境的 NextEval 求解器及配套基准协议。

papers.title: QESChunker: A Single Objective Unifies Overlapping and Non-Overlapping Chunking for RAG
papers.abstract: Chunking is a fundamental preprocessing step in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), yet most existing chunkers rely primarily on heuristics. We introduce the Question--Evidence-Supervised Chunker (QESChunker), to our knowledge the first method for constructing static chunk indices from question--evidence supervision. QESChunker constructs document-specific chunk indices by optimizing over human-annotated or LLM-generated question--evidence pairs, without access to held-out test queries. We formulate non-overlapping and overlapping index construction through a unified question--evidence utility-maximization objective, turning chunking into a supervised combinatorial optimization problem. Under the non-overlap constraint, the objective decomposes over chunks and can be optimized exactly in polynomial time by dynamic programming. When overlap is allowed, the objective becomes monotone submodular; exact optimization is NP-hard, but our greedy achieves a $(1-1/\sqrt{e})$-approximation. Across two self-constructed and three public datasets, both variants outperform existing chunking methods in complete-evidence recall in nearly all evaluated settings, under the same overlap regime and a fixed hybrid retriever. These results recast chunking as supervised, budget-aware index construction for evidence retrieval.

translation.title: QESChunker：单一目标统一RAG中的重叠与非重叠分块
translation.abstract: 分块是检索增强生成（RAG）中的基础预处理步骤，但现有分块器大多依赖启发式方法。我们提出了问题-证据监督分块器（QESChunker），据我们所知这是首个基于问题-证据监督构建静态分块索引的方法。QESChunker通过在人工标注或LLM生成的问题-证据对上进行优化来构建文档特定的分块索引，且无需访问留出的测试查询。我们通过统一的问题-证据效用最大化目标来形式化非重叠和重叠索引构建，将分块转化为有监督的组合优化问题。在非重叠约束下，该目标可按分块分解，并可通过动态规划在多项式时间内精确优化。当允许重叠时，目标变为单调次模函数；精确优化是NP难的，但我们的贪心算法可达到$(1-1/\sqrt{e})$近似。在两个自建数据集和三个公开数据集上，在相同的重叠设置和固定的混合检索器下，两种变体在几乎所有评估设置中的完整证据召回率均优于现有分块方法。这些结果将分块重新定义为面向证据检索的有监督、预算感知的索引构建。
translation.brief: 针对RAG分块依赖启发式的问题，提出以问题-证据对为监督的统一效用最大化目标，用动态规划（非重叠）和贪心次模优化（重叠）构建分块索引。

papers.title: CASEL: Consequence-Aware Selective Execution for Reliable Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents
papers.abstract: Tool-using language agents increasingly modify external systems, yet most runtime safeguards allocate scrutiny by generic uncertainty scores or coarse mutation heuristics. We introduce CASEL (Consequence-Aware Selective Execution Layer), a model-agnostic runtime allocation policy that combines calibrated failure probability, state-dependent consequence, reversibility, ambiguity, and evidence freshness to choose, for each proposed tool call, among direct execution, verification, sandboxing, clarification, approval, and abstention by minimizing a per-mode cost. We formalize direct execution as selective prediction and state and test the validity conditions of a finite-sample threshold and a trajectory risk ledger. In a controlled simulation over 20 seeds with 120,000 test actions each, in which every method has the same intervention menu and the same compute cost, CASEL reduces harmful-side-effect trajectories from 14.75 percent for an uncertainty-ranked gate to 7.02 percent and mean normalized harm from 0.184 to 0.123. A gate ranked by the product of failure probability and consequence reaches similar harm (5.82 percent, 0.120) but sends 45 percent more actions to human approval, and removing reversibility-aware routing raises the rate to 15.53 percent. A trajectory-level risk budget, in contrast, increases harm at equal cost (11.82 percent). Intervention effectiveness is assumed, not measured: the results rank allocation rules under the simulator's assumptions and do not establish deployment effectiveness.

translation.title: CASEL：面向可靠长时程工具使用代理的后果感知选择性执行
translation.abstract: 使用工具的语言代理日益会修改外部系统，但大多数运行时防护措施依据通用的不确定性分数或粗粒度变更启发式来分配审查。我们提出CASEL（后果感知选择性执行层），这是一种模型无关的运行时分配策略，它结合校准的失败概率、状态相关的后果、可逆性、模糊性和证据新鲜度，通过最小化每种模式的成本，为每个提议的工具调用在直接执行、验证、沙箱、澄清、审批和弃权之间做出选择。我们将直接执行形式化为选择性预测，并陈述和检验有限样本阈值与轨迹风险账本的有效性条件。在一个20个种子、每个12万测试动作的受控仿真中，所有方法拥有相同的干预菜单和相同的计算成本，CASEL将有害副作用轨迹比例从不确定性排序门控的14.75%降至7.02%，平均归一化伤害从0.184降至0.123。按失败概率与后果乘积排序的门控达到相近的伤害（5.82%，0.120），但向人工审批发送的动作多45%，而移除可逆性感知路由会使该比例升至15.53%。相比之下，轨迹级风险预算在相同成本下增加了伤害（11.82%）。干预有效性是假设而非测量的：这些结果仅在仿真器假设下对分配规则进行排序，并未确立部署有效性。
translation.brief: 针对工具调用运行时防护分配粗放的问题，提出CASEL策略，综合失败概率、后果、可逆性等因素按最小化成本在执行、验证、沙箱、审批等模式间做选择性分配。

papers.title: ADTGuard: Adaptive Depth-Time Safeguard for Streaming Inference in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate fluent responses to diverse user requests, yet streaming may expose users to harmful content before generation is complete. Existing guardrails face two limitations in this setting. First, post-hoc moderation at response or chunk boundaries delays intervention, risking harmful exposure when content is released before verification. Second, even with token-level detection, coarse response-level supervision does not specify when harmful content begins, while fixed-layer readouts may miss relevant safety signals at other depths. To address these limitations, we introduce ADTGuard, which checks each token before release, progressively refines token-level training targets, and adapts layer selection to the current prefix. ADTGuard models risk across depth and time through Depth-Time Safety Dynamics (DTSD), which integrates safety evidence across layers at each token and uses it to guide risk accumulation over successive tokens. To adapt the choice of observation layers to the current prefix, we propose the Causal Depth Router (CDR). With only response-level labels available, we further develop Risk-Onset Target Refinement (RTR) to progressively construct token-level training targets for both components. Through extensive experiments across multiple safety benchmarks, we demonstrate that ADTGuard consistently achieves strong streaming detection performance, matching or surpassing state-of-the-art safeguards while requiring only 16M trainable parameters and maintaining competitive per-token latency.

translation.title: ADTGuard：面向大语言模型流式推理的自适应深度-时间安全防护
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）能够对多样的用户请求生成流畅回复，但流式输出可能在生成完成前就让用户接触到有害内容。现有防护措施在此场景下存在两个局限。第一，在回复或分块边界的后置审核会延迟干预，当内容在验证前被释放时存在有害暴露风险。第二，即使有token级检测，粗粒度的回复级监督也无法指明有害内容何时开始，而固定层的读取可能错过其他深度的相关安全信号。为解决这些局限，我们提出ADTGuard，它在每个token释放前进行检查，逐步细化token级训练目标，并根据当前前缀自适应选择层。ADTGuard通过深度-时间安全动力学（DTSD）对深度和时间上的风险建模，在每个token处整合跨层的安全证据，并用其指导后续token的风险累积。为使观察层的选择适应当前前缀，我们提出因果深度路由器（CDR）。在仅有回复级标签可用的情况下，我们进一步提出风险起始目标细化（RTR），为两个组件逐步构建token级训练目标。通过在多个安全基准上的大量实验，我们证明ADTGuard在流式检测上持续取得强劲性能，匹配或超越最先进的防护措施，同时仅需16M可训练参数并保持有竞争力的每token延迟。
translation.brief: 针对流式输出有害内容暴露问题，提出ADTGuard，通过深度-时间安全动力学、因果深度路由器和风险起始目标细化实现逐token、自适应选层的实时安全检测。

papers.title: Less is more: learning what to profile for GPU kernel optimization
papers.abstract: Large language models have recently shown strong potential for automatically optimizing GPU kernels, yet their effectiveness depends critically on the hardware information available to the kernel optimization model. Existing systems typically rely on predefined profiling strategies, leaving what to profile largely outside the optimization process. We show that effective profiling is not simply about collecting more information: increasing the number of profiling metrics does not monotonically improve kernel optimization, while the most useful profiling information varies across kernels. Our theoretical analysis further shows that, under such heterogeneous profiling utility, kernel-conditioned selection can outperform any single fixed profiling configuration. Motivated by this observation, we propose AutoProfiler, a feedback-driven framework for learning a deterministic profiling tree from optimization feedback. The tree is iteratively refined through REWRITE and SPLIT operations, with an LLM generating candidate modifications and empirical evaluation determining their acceptance. Once constructed, the tree quickly gathers the required profiling information for any kernel, allowing the LLM rewriter to be invoked only once. Experiments on KernelBench show that our approach improves kernel optimization over fixed profiling configurations under constrained profiling budgets. These results suggest that hardware profiling should evolve from static metric collection toward profiling reasoning, making profiling itself a new dimension for improving kernel optimization. The codes are available at https://github.com/Satissss/AutoProfiler.

translation.title: 少即是多：学习GPU核函数优化中该分析什么
translation.abstract: 大语言模型近来在自动优化GPU核函数方面展现出强大潜力，但其效果关键取决于核函数优化模型可获得的硬件信息。现有系统通常依赖预定义的分析策略，使分析什么基本处于优化过程之外。我们表明，有效的分析并不只是收集更多信息：增加分析指标数量并不能单调提升核函数优化效果，而最有用的分析信息因核函数而异。我们的理论分析进一步表明，在这种异构分析效用下，基于核函数条件的选择可以优于任何单一固定分析配置。基于这一观察，我们提出AutoProfiler，一个从优化反馈中学习确定性分析树的反馈驱动框架。该树通过REWRITE和SPLIT操作迭代细化，由LLM生成候选修改，由实证评估决定其是否被接受。树构建完成后，可为任意核函数快速收集所需的分析信息，使LLM重写器只需调用一次。在KernelBench上的实验表明，在受限分析预算下，我们的方法优于固定分析配置的核函数优化。这些结果表明，硬件分析应从静态指标收集演进为分析推理，使分析本身成为改进核函数优化的新维度。代码见 https://github.com/Satissss/AutoProfiler。
translation.brief: 针对GPU核函数优化中分析什么指标依赖固定配置的问题，提出AutoProfiler，通过REWRITE和SPLIT操作从优化反馈中学习核函数条件化的分析树。

papers.title: Structured Maps for Landmark-Based Route Instructions with LLMs
papers.abstract: To generate landmark-based route instructions, models must understand both map geometry and human landmark preferences. Although large language models (LLMs) show great abilities in language tasks, the best way to structure map data for these models is not yet established. This paper proposes a structured text representation for landmark selection tasks in route navigation, utilizing SVG format to encode spatial features. The structured text maintains a geometric connection with rendered map images, allowing language models to directly access spatial and semantic data. Using a new dataset created from human-written route descriptions and OpenStreetMap data, we evaluate models on two tasks: landmark selection at turns and around destinations. Experiments with five LLMs show that the proposed structured text input performs as well as or better than image-based PNG inputs. In addition, task-specific fine-tuning enables smaller local LLMs to effectively leverage map layouts to achieve high selection accuracy. These results demonstrate that structured text is an efficient and lightweight interface for spatial reasoning in human-oriented navigation.

translation.title: 基于LLM的地标路线指令的结构化地图
translation.abstract: 要生成基于地标的路线指令，模型必须同时理解地图几何和人类的地标偏好。尽管大语言模型（LLM）在语言任务上能力出众，但为这些模型组织地图数据的最佳方式尚未确立。本文为路线导航中的地标选择任务提出一种结构化文本表示，利用SVG格式编码空间特征。该结构化文本与渲染的地图图像保持几何对应，使语言模型能够直接访问空间和语义数据。使用基于人类撰写的路线描述和OpenStreetMap数据创建的新数据集，我们在两个任务上评估模型：路口处和目的地附近的地标选择。五个LLM的实验表明，所提出的结构化文本输入表现与基于图像的PNG输入相当或更好。此外，任务特定微调使较小的本地LLM能够有效利用地图布局达到较高的选择准确率。这些结果表明，结构化文本是面向人类的导航中空间推理的高效轻量接口。
translation.brief: 针对LLM路线导航中地图数据表示方式未确立的问题，提出用SVG结构化文本编码地图空间特征，供地标选择任务使用。

papers.title: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Behaviorally Adequate Test Generation from Software Requirements
papers.abstract: As large language model agents increasingly compile natural-language requirements into repository-level code, requirement-to-test generation grows in importance to provide validation constraints (or harness) to guide code generation. Yet it remains unclear whether current agents can generate tests that validate the required behavior when the implementation of that behavior is withheld. Existing test-generation benchmarks mostly focus on white-box testing, whereas the requirement--test-related study usually requires evaluation on semantic alignment between the given documents and the generated tests. We introduce Req2Test-Bench, a benchmark containing 5,086 execution-validated instances recovered from developer-authored behavior-driven development (BDD) artifacts in 8 open-source projects, spanning 5 programming languages and 4 BDD frameworks. Each instance pairs a natural-language requirement in Gherkin with its developer-written Test Implementation. Given the requirement, target interfaces of the required behavior, an agent must generate a complete, potentially multi-file Test Implementation. Evaluation of 8 agent--model--reasoning configurations reveals a substantial gap between execution success and behavioral adequacy, which is measured strictly as kill-completeness: a kill-complete test kills every mutant that the ground-truth test kills. The best-performing configuration, Codex with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, produces passing tests for 82.8% of instances, yet only 33.8% are behaviorally adequate. We find that (1) scaling up agents yields sharply diminishing returns in behavioral adequacy relative to generation cost; (2) under-specified requirements cause the information gap, including ambiguous setup and implicit expected outcomes; and (3) requirement-grounded harnesses that steer agent non-determinism offer a promising direction for improvement.

translation.title: 面向行为充分测试生成的 LLM Agent 基准评测：从软件需求出发
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型 agent 越来越多地将自然语言需求编译为仓库级代码，需求到测试的生成日益重要，可为代码生成提供验证约束（或测试框架）以引导代码生成。然而，当所需行为的实现被隐藏时，现有 agent 能否生成验证该行为的测试仍不清楚。现有测试生成基准大多聚焦白盒测试，而需求—测试相关研究通常需要评估给定文档与生成测试之间的语义对齐。我们提出 Req2Test-Bench，一个包含 5,086 个经执行验证实例的基准，这些实例从 8 个开源项目中开发者编写的行为驱动开发（BDD）工件中恢复而来，涵盖 5 种编程语言和 4 个 BDD 框架。每个实例将 Gherkin 自然语言需求与开发者编写的测试实现配对。给定需求和所需行为的目标接口，agent 必须生成完整的、可能跨多文件的测试实现。对 8 种 agent—模型—推理配置的评估揭示了执行成功与行为充分性之间的巨大差距，后者严格以 kill-completeness（杀死完备性）衡量：kill-complete 测试能杀死真实测试所能杀死的所有变异体。表现最佳的配置 Codex with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 在 82.8% 的实例上生成可通过的测试，但仅 33.8% 行为充分。我们发现：(1) 扩大 agent 规模在行为充分性方面相对生成成本收益急剧递减；(2) 欠规范的需求造成信息鸿沟，包括模糊的前置设置和隐式的预期结果；(3) 以需求为依据、引导 agent 非确定性的测试框架是改进的有希望方向。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM agent 从需求生成测试时行为验证不足的问题，构建了基于真实 BDD 工件的 Req2Test-Bench 基准，并以杀死完备性严格评估测试的行为充分性。

papers.title: Efficient Quantization Training with Stochastic Rounding via Structured Subspace Randomness
papers.abstract: Low-precision training often relies on stochastic rounding (SR) to keep quantized gradients unbiased and prevent small updates from rounding to zero. Standard SR draws an independent random threshold for every gradient element. However, accelerators generate random numbers on vector units whose throughput lags far behind their matrix units. Drawing one threshold per element saturates the vector unit and can make INT8 training with SR slower than BF16 training. Sharing random thresholds across tensor elements removes this cost but forces those elements to round in the same direction and shifts their rounding errors by a common offset. We find that this offset degrades training primarily through the activation gradient, which propagates the error backward into earlier layers. Because earlier layers cannot cancel an incoming offset using their own local rounding errors, the offset must be removed at the layer where it originates. We propose Structured Subspace Stochastic Rounding (S3R), which quantizes each upstream gradient once for both the activation and weight gradient matrix multiplications and shares a single threshold per token across the hidden dimension. Its error correction, S3R-EC, subtracts the structured mean rounding error from the activation and weight gradients while leaving the optimizer unchanged. In LLM pre-training experiments, uncorrected threshold sharing degrades convergence, whereas S3R-EC eliminates this degradation and matches the validation loss of independent SR. Furthermore, S3R-EC accelerates full INT8 training steps of dense LLMs on TPU v5p by 1.24x to 1.32x over BF16 and by 1.11x over independent SR.

translation.title: 基于结构化子空间随机性的高效随机舍入量化训练
translation.abstract: 低精度训练通常依赖随机舍入（SR）来保持量化梯度无偏，并防止小更新被舍入为零。标准 SR 为每个梯度元素抽取独立的随机阈值。然而，加速器在向量单元上生成随机数，其吞吐量远落后于矩阵单元。为每个元素抽取一个阈值会饱和向量单元，可能使带 SR 的 INT8 训练比 BF16 训练更慢。在张量元素间共享随机阈值可消除这一开销，但迫使这些元素向同一方向舍入，并使其舍入误差偏移一个共同偏移量。我们发现该偏移量主要通过激活梯度降低训练效果，将误差反向传播到更早的层。由于更早的层无法用自身局部舍入误差抵消传入的偏移量，必须在偏移量产生的层将其消除。我们提出结构化子空间随机舍入（S3R），对上游梯度只量化一次即可同时用于激活和权重梯度矩阵乘法，并在隐藏维度上按 token 共享单一阈值。其误差校正方法 S3R-EC 从激活和权重梯度中减去结构化平均舍入误差，同时保持优化器不变。在 LLM 预训练实验中，未校正的阈值共享会降低收敛性，而 S3R-EC 消除了这一退化，并达到与独立 SR 相同的验证损失。此外，S3R-EC 使稠密 LLM 在 TPU v5p 上的完整 INT8 训练步骤相对 BF16 加速 1.24x 至 1.32x，相对独立 SR 加速 1.11x。
translation.brief: 为解决随机舍入中逐元素随机数生成拖慢 INT8 训练的问题，提出按 token 共享阈值并校正结构化舍入误差的 S3R-EC 方法。

papers.title: InfraDev: Can Coding Agents Develop AI Infrastructure, and How Can We Tell?
papers.abstract: Coding agents are beginning to develop the production-grade AI infrastructure that trains and serves large models, yet existing benchmarks cover only single kernels or single-GPU tasks, and grade with tests and prompts that misjudge both correct and incorrect patches. We introduce InfraDev, a benchmark of 36 tasks built from real-world pull requests to Megatron-LM, vLLM, and verl, covering infrastructure development for training, inference, and reinforcement learning. Each task asks an agent to reimplement a real change that spans many files and must run correctly across many GPUs. To grade such changes, we jointly synthesize hidden probes, which enforce the requirements the original tests leave unchecked, and a prompt that states every interface the probes call without revealing the solution. We also design a shared execution environment that reuses dependencies and artifacts across tasks, cutting storage by 52-57% and build time by 13-14% on Megatron-LM and vLLM. Across six frontier models, the best resolves only 38.9% of the tasks; the probes reject 32% of the submissions that pass every official test, and with the original pull request descriptions as prompts, no model resolves a single task. Failure analysis shows that structural and state errors dominate and that agents' own tests rarely check memory, time, or traffic. Turning these findings into an agent skill raises the resolved rate of a frontier model on the Megatron-LM tasks by 10.5%.

translation.title: InfraDev：编码 Agent 能否开发 AI 基础设施，以及如何评判？
translation.abstract: 编码 agent 正开始开发用于训练和服务大模型的生产级 AI 基础设施，但现有基准仅覆盖单 kernel 或单 GPU 任务，且使用的测试和提示会同时误判正确与错误的补丁。我们提出 InfraDev，一个包含 36 个任务的基准，构建自 Megatron-LM、vLLM 和 verl 的真实 pull request，涵盖训练、推理和强化学习的基础设施开发。每个任务要求 agent 重新实现一个跨多文件、且必须在多 GPU 上正确运行的真实变更。为评判此类变更，我们联合合成隐藏探针（hidden probes）——强制执行原始测试未检查的需求——以及一个声明探针所调用的每个接口但不泄露解法的提示。我们还设计了在任务间复用依赖和工件的共享执行环境，在 Megatron-LM 和 vLLM 上将存储减少 52-57%，构建时间减少 13-14%。在六个前沿模型上，最佳模型仅解决 38.9% 的任务；探针拒绝了 32% 通过全部官方测试的提交；而以原始 pull request 描述作为提示时，没有任何模型能解决哪怕一个任务。失败分析表明结构和状态错误占主导，且 agent 自写的测试很少检查内存、时间或流量。将这些发现转化为 agent 技能后，前沿模型在 Megatron-LM 任务上的解决率提升 10.5%。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准无法评测编码 agent 开发多文件、多 GPU AI 基础设施能力的问题，构建了基于真实 PR 的 InfraDev 基准，并用隐藏探针实现更严格的自动评判。

papers.title: Optimality and Impossibility in Multidimensional Strategyproof Facility Location
papers.abstract: We study facility location in multidimensional normed spaces with the objective of minimizing social cost, the sum of agents' distances to their nearest facility. A deterministic mechanism selects $k$ facility locations based on the reports of $n$ agents and is strategyproof (SP) if no agent can reduce her distance by misreporting her location. We establish optimal approximation ratios and impossibility results. For a single facility in the Euclidean plane, we prove that the optimal approximation ratios among deterministic SP mechanisms are exactly those obtained by Goel and Hann-Caruthers [SCW 2023] for the coordinate-wise median (CM): $\frac{\sqrt{2(n^2+1)}}{n+1}$ for odd $n\ge3$ and $\sqrt{2}$ for even $n\ge4$. We remove the anonymity assumption from their optimality result. However, CM is not always optimal in non-Euclidean spaces: we give an SP mechanism that minimizes social cost exactly in $\ell_\infty^d$, whereas CM has a tight uniform approximation ratio of $2$ already in the plane. We then consider two facilities in $\ell_p$ spaces with $1<p<\infty$ and prove two impossibility results for every $n>2$. In the plane, no deterministic SP mechanism has a finite approximation ratio. In higher dimensions, the same impossibility holds for anonymous deterministic SP mechanisms. Finally, a reduction using distant agents and a limiting argument extends both impossibility results to every $k>2$ with $n>k$.

translation.title: 多维策略防操纵设施选址中的最优性与不可能性
translation.abstract: 我们研究多维赋范空间中的设施选址问题，目标是最小化社会成本，即各 agent 到其最近设施距离之和。确定性机制基于 n 个 agent 的报告选择 k 个设施位置，若任何 agent 无法通过虚报位置来减少自身距离，则该机制是策略防操纵的（strategyproof, SP）。我们建立了最优近似比和不可能性结果。对于欧氏平面中的单个设施，我们证明确定性 SP 机制的最优近似比恰为 Goel 和 Hann-Caruthers [SCW 2023] 对坐标中位数（CM）得到的结果：奇数 n≥3 时为 \frac{\sqrt{2(n^2+1)}}{n+1}，偶数 n≥4 时为 \sqrt{2}。我们移除了其最优性结果中的匿名性假设。然而，CM 在非欧氏空间中并不总是最优：我们给出一个在 \ell_\infty^d 中精确最小化社会成本的 SP 机制，而 CM 即使在平面中也只有紧的统一近似比 2。随后我们考虑 \ell_p 空间（1<p<\infty）中的两个设施，并对每个 n>2 证明两个不可能性结果：在平面中，不存在具有有限近似比的确定性 SP 机制；在更高维中，同样的不可能性对匿名确定性 SP 机制成立。最后，利用远处 agent 的归约和极限论证，将两个不可能性结果扩展到每个 k>2 且 n>k 的情形。
translation.brief: 研究多维赋范空间中策略防操纵的 k 设施选址机制，确定了单设施情形的最优近似比并证明了两个及以上设施情形的不可能性结果。

papers.title: Dream-COP: Guiding Algorithm Discovery for Combinatorial Optimization Problems in an Experience World
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable algorithm discovery for combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) through iterative program generation and evaluation. A central challenge is how to organize search to discover better algorithms within a limited budget. Our key insight is that past search trajectories and their recorded outcomes form an experience world, which can be used to facilitate the COP solving through replay. We introduce Dream-COP, in which a \emph{policy agent} learns executable policies through \emph{dreaming} in this experience world to guide a \emph{discovery agent} in generating and refining COP programs. Specifically, policy replay provides feedback on the quality of the programs revealed and the search steps used, to guide policy selection more effectively. Across five COPs, \textsc{Dream} discovers better algorithms than fixed exploration in both heuristic component design and complete solver generation. Particularly, it matches the optimal values on KP and reduces the gap on OBPP from 2.112\% to 1.199\% while using 42.5\% fewer search requests. Moreover, the learned exploration policies transfer effectively across different COPs with the assitance of the experience world.

translation.title: Dream-COP：在经验世界中引导组合优化问题的算法发现
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）通过迭代的程序生成与评估实现组合优化问题（COP）的算法发现。一个核心挑战是如何组织搜索，以便在有限预算内发现更好的算法。我们的关键洞察是：过去的搜索轨迹及其记录的结果构成一个经验世界，可通过重放（replay）来辅助 COP 求解。我们提出 Dream-COP，其中一个策略 agent 通过在该经验世界中做梦（dreaming）学习可执行策略，以引导发现 agent 生成和改进 COP 程序。具体而言，策略重放提供关于已发现程序质量和所用搜索步骤的反馈，从而更有效地引导策略选择。在五个 COP 上，Dream 在启发式组件设计和完整求解器生成方面均比固定探索发现更好的算法。特别是，它在 KP 上达到最优值，在 OBPP 上将差距从 2.112% 降至 1.199%，同时少用 42.5% 的搜索请求。此外，借助经验世界，学到的探索策略能有效跨不同 COP 迁移。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 算法发现中搜索预算有限的问题，提出 Dream-COP，通过在经验世界中重放历史搜索轨迹学习探索策略来引导算法生成。

papers.title: God Does Not Play Dice: Enforcing Batch Invariance in Agentic Kernel Generation
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving systems dynamically batch user requests for GPU execution, so the same request may be processed alongside different requests across runs. If the GPU kernels lack batch invariance (BI), this changing batch context can alter the numerical output for an unchanged input, undermining reproducibility. Existing kernel generation agents focus on correctness and efficiency but \emph{overlook BI}. We find 19 confirmed BI violations among 83 batch-applicable released artifacts. To address this limitation, we propose \tool, which combines contract-guided static dependency analysis with dynamic validation of bitwise consistency across batch contexts. \tool is designed as a plug-in component for general kernel agents, allowing their original optimization capabilities to be reused while adding BI enforcement. We integrate it as successive acceptance gates in the optimization loop, rejecting structurally risky or dynamically non-invariant candidates before performance benchmarking and returning feedback to the agent. Experiments across three agent frameworks under baseline and BI-aware generation on real world LLM serving tasks show that \tool improves the BI pass rate from 67.6\% to 91.9\% while retaining 91.8\% of the baseline geometric mean speedup. These results demonstrate that \tool can be incorporated into kernel optimization by agents as an additional reliability objective alongside correctness and speed.

translation.title: 上帝不掷骰子：在智能体内核生成中强制实现批处理不变性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）服务系统通过动态批处理将用户请求提交给 GPU 执行，因此同一请求在不同运行中可能与其他不同请求一起被处理。如果 GPU 内核缺乏批处理不变性（BI），这种不断变化的批处理上下文可能会改变相同输入的数值输出，从而破坏可复现性。现有的内核生成智能体关注正确性和效率，但忽视了 BI。我们在 83 个适用于批处理的已发布工件中发现了 19 个已确认的 BI 违例。为解决这一局限，我们提出 \tool，它将契约引导的静态依赖分析与跨批处理上下文的位级一致性动态验证相结合。\tool 被设计为通用内核智能体的插件组件，可复用其原有的优化能力，同时增加 BI 强制机制。我们将其作为优化循环中的连续验收门，在性能基准测试之前拒绝结构上有风险或动态非不变的候选内核，并向智能体返回反馈。在三个智能体框架上、在基线与 BI 感知生成两种模式下，针对真实世界 LLM 服务任务的实验表明，\tool 将 BI 通过率从 67.6% 提升至 91.9%，同时保留了基线几何平均加速比的 91.8%。这些结果表明，\tool 可以作为正确性和速度之外的额外可靠性目标，被纳入智能体的内核优化流程。
translation.brief: 针对 GPU 内核缺乏批处理不变性导致 LLM 服务输出不可复现的问题，提出结合静态依赖分析与动态位级一致性验证的插件式框架，在内核智能体优化循环中强制执行批处理不变性。

papers.title: Measuring Users' Security and Privacy Concerns About Third-Party Community Bots on Discord
papers.abstract: Third-party community-based bots are central to how social platforms such as Discord work. They moderate content, manage roles, play music, and support AI-assisted conversations across millions of servers. Yet when a bot is installed in a server, it can access messages, user profiles, and server metadata concerning members who did not participate in the installation decision, with no standardized way to communicate the associated security and privacy implications. In this paper, we analyze 23,102 third-party Discord bots and 183,142 user reviews spanning 49 detected languages and five years of feedback (2021-2026). We employ LLM-based knowledge distillation and fine-tune a DeBERTa-based classifier to identify candidate security and privacy (S&P)-relevant reviews. After manually validating the complete classifier-positive set, we retain 8,832 reviews identified as S&P-relevant, representing an observed pipeline yield of 4.82%, and map them to a 31-theme S&P taxonomy extending prior work. Our results show that S&P-related reviews focus heavily on Data Sharing (30.5%) and Data Collection (16.2%). Confession and anonymity bots have pipeline-identified SPRRs above 50%, more than ten times the ecosystem-wide pipeline yield of 4.82%. Star ratings may obscure the frequency and valence of S&P-related discussion, while conventional metadata features, such as permission count and administrator status, show only weak associations with user-reported S&P concerns. We then build BotLens, a proof-of-concept auditing framework that combines review-derived S&P signals with bot metadata to provide on-demand decision support for the community-based bot ecosystem. BotLens exposes six tools through a Model Context Protocol server, supporting bot-level checkups, server-wide comparison, and integration with AI agents.

translation.title: 衡量用户对 Discord 第三方社区机器人的安全与隐私担忧
translation.abstract: 第三方社区机器人在 Discord 等社交平台的运作中处于核心地位。它们负责内容审核、角色管理、音乐播放，并在数百万个服务器中支持 AI 辅助对话。然而，当机器人被安装到服务器后，它可以访问未参与安装决策的成员的消息、用户资料和服务器元数据，且没有标准化的方式来传达相关的安全与隐私影响。本文分析了 23,102 个第三方 Discord 机器人和 183,142 条用户评论，涵盖 49 种检测到的语言和五年（2021-2026）的反馈。我们采用基于 LLM 的知识蒸馏并微调基于 DeBERTa 的分类器，以识别候选的安全与隐私（S&P）相关评论。在人工验证全部分类器正样本集后，我们保留了 8,832 条被认定为 S&P 相关的评论，观测到的流水线产出率为 4.82%，并将其映射到一个扩展先前工作的 31 主题 S&P 分类体系。结果表明，S&P 相关评论高度集中于数据共享（30.5%）和数据收集（16.2%）。表白与匿名机器人的流水线识别 SPRR 超过 50%，是全生态 4.82% 流水线产出率的十倍以上。星级评分可能掩盖 S&P 相关讨论的频率与倾向，而权限数量和管理员状态等常规元数据特征与用户报告的 S&P 担忧仅呈弱关联。随后我们构建了 BotLens，一个概念验证审计框架，它将评论衍生的 S&P 信号与机器人元数据相结合，为社区机器人生态提供按需决策支持。BotLens 通过 Model Context Protocol 服务器提供六种工具，支持机器人级检查、服务器级比较以及与 AI 智能体的集成。
translation.brief: 针对 Discord 第三方机器人缺乏安全与隐私风险沟通的问题，通过 LLM 知识蒸馏与 DeBERTa 分类器大规模分析用户评论，构建 S&P 分类体系及 BotLens 审计框架。

papers.title: Remembering Is Not Enough: Refining Memories and Learning When to Use Them in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Memory helps LLM-based multi-agent systems reuse experience, but stored advice can be flawed or applied in the wrong situation. Team-level success or failure alone cannot reliably show whether a memory needs correction or should not have been used. We propose DiscernMem, a training-free framework that improves both memory quality and memory use. To improve quality, Defect-Aware Memory Refinement (DMR) compares team executions with a single memory and with no memory, diagnoses rule defects, and tests repairs on current and earlier tasks to guard against losing previously useful behavior. To guide appropriate use, Boundary-Learning Meta-Memory (BLM) records each memory's past uses and effects, learning when its owner role should apply or avoid it based on task context and incoming messages. Together, these components help teams correct flawed experience while retaining useful rules that were applied incorrectly. Experiments with Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on four benchmarks show that DiscernMem achieves the highest average score on AutoGen, CAMEL, and MacNet, exceeding the strongest reported baselines by 0.51-4.32 points. It leads on code generation and symbolic planning across all three systems, including a PDDL score of 37.71 versus 28.48 on CAMEL.

translation.title: 记住还不够：在多智能体系统中精炼记忆并学习何时使用它们
translation.abstract: 记忆帮助基于 LLM 的多智能体系统复用经验，但存储的建议可能存在缺陷或在不恰当的情况下被应用。仅凭团队层面的成败无法可靠地判断某条记忆是否需要修正或本不应被使用。我们提出 DiscernMem，一个无需训练的框架，可同时提升记忆质量和记忆使用。为提升质量，缺陷感知记忆精炼（DMR）将团队在带单条记忆与不带记忆情况下的执行结果进行对比，诊断规则缺陷，并在当前和早期任务上测试修复方案，以防止丢失先前有用的行为。为引导恰当使用，边界学习元记忆（BLM）记录每条记忆的过往使用情况及其效果，基于任务上下文和传入消息学习其所属角色何时应应用或避免使用该记忆。这些组件共同帮助团队修正有缺陷的经验，同时保留那些被错误应用的有用规则。在四个基准上使用 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 的实验表明，DiscernMem 在 AutoGen、CAMEL 和 MacNet 上取得最高平均分，超过最强已报告基线 0.51-4.32 分。它在三个系统的代码生成和符号规划任务上均领先，包括在 CAMEL 上 PDDL 得分 37.71 对 28.48。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体系统记忆可能存在缺陷或被误用的问题，提出无需训练的 DiscernMem 框架，通过缺陷感知记忆精炼和边界学习元记忆同时提升记忆质量与使用时机。

papers.title: Edhivo: An AI-Native Platform for Scalable Assessment and Instant Feedback in Higher Education
papers.abstract: Scaling assessment in higher education faces two intertwined bottlenecks: the cognitive burden of authoring assessments and the inability to semantically evaluate open-ended responses, which together create a persistent feedback gap that hinders student learning outcomes. To address these challenges, we present Edhivo, an AI-native pedagogical platform that addresses both bottlenecks through a vertically integrated system for content delivery, assessment, and reporting. Edhivo employs a Dual-LLM pipeline: one model generates context-aware assessments for both multiple-choice and open-ended questions, from instructor-provided materials, while a second model performs multi-criteria, rubric-based evaluation of student responses, enabling near-instant qualitative feedback at multiple hierarchical levels. All AI interactions are source-grounded to reduce hallucination risk, and a Human-in-the-Loop review process preserves instructor authority. We demonstrate Edhivo's efficacy through a pilot deployment at Stony Brook University in a real classroom environment in 2026 spring, where it supports high-frequency assessment creation and evaluation for a cohort of 36 students throughout a full semester, significantly reducing authoring effort and feedback latency while enabling novel pedagogical designs centered on active learning.

translation.title: Edhivo：面向高等教育可扩展评估与即时反馈的 AI 原生平台
translation.abstract: 高等教育中评估的规模化面临两个相互交织的瓶颈：编写评估的认知负担，以及无法对开放式回答进行语义评估，二者共同造成了阻碍学生学习成效的持续性反馈鸿沟。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 Edhivo，一个 AI 原生教学平台，通过内容交付、评估和报告的垂直集成系统同时解决这两个瓶颈。Edhivo 采用双 LLM 流水线：一个模型根据教师提供的材料为选择题和开放式题目生成上下文感知的评估，另一个模型基于多准则量规对学生回答进行评估，从而在多个层级实现近乎即时的定性反馈。所有 AI 交互均以源材料为依据以降低幻觉风险，并通过人在回路（Human-in-the-Loop）审核流程保留教师权威。我们通过 2026 年春季在 Stony Brook University 真实课堂环境的试点部署验证了 Edhivo 的有效性，为一个 36 名学生的班级在整个学期内支持高频次的评估创建与评价，显著降低了编写工作量和反馈延迟，并支持以主动学习为中心的新型教学设计。
translation.brief: 针对高等教育评估编写负担重且开放式回答难以语义评估的问题，提出双 LLM 流水线的 AI 原生平台 Edhivo，实现可扩展的评估生成与基于量规的即时反馈。

papers.title: The View from Nowhere: Population-Centered Agent Evolution
papers.abstract: Self-improving AI systems can revise the designs that govern their own behavior. Yet existing approaches center improvement on selected parent agents and their evolutionary experience, leaving the broader population largely underused. We identify a substantial gap between population coverage (i.e., the tasks solved by at least one evolved variant) and the performance of the best individual agent. This gap shows that useful capabilities and diagnostic evidence emerge across the population without being consolidated into its leading agents. These observations motivate the view from nowhere, a principle for agent evolution: an agent should be improved by interpreting its behavior through population-wide patterns of success, failure, and prior self-modification. We instantiate this principle as Population-Centered Evolution (PCE). PCE distils task records and modification histories from the population into a population block, which captures recurring failures, complementary successes, and the effects of previously attempted modifications to guide improvements to a selected parent's harness. Under matched models, initial harnesses, and evolution schedules, PCE achieves 72.1% success on SWE-bench Verified and 96.7% on Polyglot, improving over a strong group-evolution baseline by 3.2 and 5.9 percentage points. In our evaluation, PCE reduces the gap between population coverage and best-agent performance by one-third on SWE-bench and closes it on Polyglot. These results suggest that treating the population as evidence--not merely as candidates for selection--provides a complementary principle for agent evolution.

translation.title: 无处之观：以种群为中心的智能体进化
translation.abstract: 自我改进的 AI 系统可以修改支配自身行为的设计。然而现有方法将改进聚焦于被选中的父代智能体及其进化经验，使更广泛的种群在很大程度上未被利用。我们发现了种群覆盖率（即至少一个进化变体解决的任务）与最佳个体智能体性能之间的显著差距。这一差距表明，有用的能力和诊断性证据在种群中涌现，却未被整合到其领先智能体中。这些观察启发了“无处之观”这一智能体进化原则：应通过种群范围的成功、失败和既往自我修改模式来解读智能体行为，从而对其进行改进。我们将该原则实例化为种群中心进化（PCE）。PCE 将种群的任务记录和修改历史提炼为一个种群块，捕捉反复出现的失败、互补的成功以及既往修改的效果，以指导对被选父代 harness 的改进。在匹配的模型、初始 harness 和进化调度下，PCE 在 SWE-bench Verified 上达到 72.1% 的成功率，在 Polyglot 上达到 96.7%，较强大的群体进化基线分别提升 3.2 和 5.9 个百分点。在我们的评估中，PCE 将 SWE-bench 上种群覆盖率与最佳智能体性能之间的差距缩小了三分之一，并在 Polyglot 上消除了该差距。这些结果表明，将种群视为证据——而不仅仅是待选择的候选——为智能体进化提供了一个互补原则。
translation.brief: 针对智能体自我改进仅聚焦父代而浪费种群信息的问题，提出种群中心进化（PCE），将种群的任务记录与修改历史提炼为种群块以指导父代 harness 的改进。

papers.title: Impossibility of No-Regret in Multi-Agent Bidding
papers.abstract: We consider $T$ repeated second-price auctions across $n$ pacing bidders with i.i.d. item arrivals, and show that it is computationally impossible for all bidders to achieve no-regret simultaneously while satisfying their respective budget or return-on-investment constraints. Therefore, in the prominent internet auction systems where buyers simultaneously deploy pacing algorithms or automated bidding agents, we cannot hope to achieve joint no-regret guarantees in general. We establish a deterministic relationship that high variance in online bidding systems implies high regret. By showing that one can extract a pacing equilibrium from a low-variance system, we prove PPAD-hardness of attaining joint no-regret. For several widely used bidding algorithms, we also show evidence from dynamical systems and numerical simulations that they can indeed display high-variance behavior through cycling, even on simple market instances.

translation.title: 多智能体竞价中无遗憾的不可能性
translation.abstract: 我们研究了 $n$ 个采用 pacing 策略的竞价者在物品独立同分布到达下参与的 $T$ 轮重复二价拍卖，并证明在满足各自预算或投资回报率约束的同时，让所有竞价者同时实现无遗憾在计算上是不可行的。因此，在买家同时部署 pacing 算法或自动竞价智能体的主流互联网拍卖系统中，我们无法期望在一般情况下获得联合无遗憾保证。我们建立了一个确定性关系：在线竞价系统中的高方差意味着高遗憾。通过证明可以从低方差系统中提取 pacing 均衡，我们证明了实现联合无遗憾是 PPAD-困难的。对于几种广泛使用的竞价算法，我们还通过动力系统和数值模拟的证据表明，即使在简单的市场实例上，它们也确实会通过循环表现出高方差行为。
translation.brief: 证明在预算或ROI约束下多竞价者同时实现无遗憾是PPAD-困难的，核心方法是通过高方差与高遗憾的确定性关系及从低方差系统提取pacing均衡来建立归约。

papers.title: Japanese Discourse Structure Analysis Based on Segmented Discourse Representation Theory Using LLMs
papers.abstract: Discourse parsing based on Segmented Discourse Representation Theory (SDRT) is crucial for capturing the structural dynamics of dialogues. However, most prior research focuses on English, and its effectiveness for Japanese remains unclear owing to the lack of Japanese SDRT corpora. To address this issue, we construct Japanese SDRT corpora by translating existing English SDRT corpora using an LLM. Through a comparative evaluation of prompt-based and fine-tuned LLMs, we show that the models achieve comparable performance between English and Japanese, suggesting the cross-lingual applicability of SDRT-based discourse parsing. In order to investigate why the English and Japanese parsers achieve similar performance, we conduct ablation analyses on discourse markers and contextual inputs. Our results reveal that most of the Japanese discourse markers we examined have little impact, and the models' predictions depend heavily on contextual discourse relations rather than on the content of the context clauses. This structural reliance might explain the comparable performance despite the substantial typological differences between English and Japanese.

translation.title: 基于SDRT并使用大语言模型的日语篇章结构分析
translation.abstract: 基于分段篇章表示理论（SDRT）的篇章解析对于捕捉对话的结构动态至关重要。然而，以往研究大多聚焦于英语，由于缺乏日语SDRT语料库，其在日语上的有效性尚不清楚。为解决这一问题，我们利用大语言模型翻译现有英语SDRT语料库来构建日语SDRT语料库。通过对基于提示的和微调的LLM进行对比评估，我们发现模型在英语和日语上取得了相当的性能，表明基于SDRT的篇章解析具有跨语言适用性。为探究英语和日语解析器性能相近的原因，我们对篇章标记和上下文输入进行了消融分析。结果表明，我们考察的大多数日语篇章标记影响甚微，模型的预测严重依赖于上下文中的篇章关系而非上下文从句的内容。这种对结构的依赖或许可以解释为何尽管英语和日语存在显著的类型学差异，性能却相当。
translation.brief: 针对日语缺乏SDRT语料库的问题，用LLM翻译英语语料构建日语SDRT语料并评估LLM篇章解析器，通过消融分析揭示模型主要依赖篇章关系而非篇章标记。

papers.title: A Quantitative Approach to Asch Conformity in Frontier Large Language Models
papers.abstract: The Asch conformity experiment has recently gained considerable attention as a way of measuring conformity in large language models (LLMs). While previous studies have focused on demonstrating conformity in LLMs, our work adds a further quantitative layer to this approach. Instead of sampling a frontier LLM on a suite of questions, our approach samples a single question repeatedly, leveraging the probabilistic nature of LLMs to produce a distribution of answers. In doing so, we can compare the distributions of answers before and after the model is presented with the manufactured consensus. Our experiments confirm that frontier LLMs do conform, reinforcing prior literature, and, through our distribution-to-distribution comparisons, provide additional quantitative data on the conditions that lead to conformity and the degree to which it occurs.

translation.title: 前沿大语言模型中Asch从众效应的定量研究
translation.abstract: Asch从众实验近来作为衡量大语言模型（LLM）从众性的方法受到广泛关注。以往研究侧重于证明LLM存在从众性，而我们的工作为这一方法增加了进一步的定量层面。我们的方法不是让前沿LLM回答一组问题，而是对单个问题重复采样，利用LLM的概率性产生答案分布。由此，我们可以比较模型在被呈现人为制造的共识前后的答案分布。实验证实前沿LLM确实存在从众性，印证了已有文献，并通过分布到分布的比较，提供了关于导致从众的条件及从众程度的额外定量数据。
translation.brief: 针对LLM从众性缺乏定量刻画的问题，通过对单题重复采样构建答案分布并比较呈现人为共识前后的分布差异来量化从众程度。

papers.title: From Voiceprints to User Entities: Online Speaker-Memory Construction for Multi-User Spoken Agents
papers.abstract: Personalized spoken agents must identify speakers before accessing user-specific memory, yet memory benchmarks typically assume correctly attributed histories. We argue that voiceprints are observations of identity, not identities themselves, and formulate online speaker-memory construction to maintain persistent user entities as acoustic evidence evolves. We introduce EvoSpeakerMem, a training-free layer for causal speaker routing, selective acoustic-state updates, and identity-partitioned memory writes and retrieval through a replaceable text-memory backend. We also construct LoCoMo-ID, a spoken-memory benchmark with hidden speaker identities, speaker-sensitive queries, simulated recording-condition shifts, and four-speaker identity-confusion tests. On longitudinal SMIIP-TV, genuine-probe rejection under a frozen near-enrollment threshold rises from 29.8% to 55.6% over approximately one year. On LoCoMo-ID speaker-sensitive queries, gated updating improves identity-gated QA over fixed representations by 3.86 and 11.62 percentage points under clean and shifted conditions, respectively, with no wrong-user authorizations. The advantage persists in the four-speaker test. Yet reducing fragmentation and improving QA can coexist with incorrect cross-user links, revealing a fragmentation--contamination trade-off that QA alone cannot capture.

translation.title: 从声纹到用户实体：面向多用户语音智能体的在线说话人记忆构建
translation.abstract: 个性化的语音智能体必须在访问用户特定记忆之前识别说话人，然而记忆基准通常假设历史记录已被正确归属。我们认为声纹是身份的观测而非身份本身，并提出在线说话人记忆构建问题，即在声学证据不断演化时维护持久的用户实体。我们提出 EvoSpeakerMem，一个免训练的层，用于因果说话人路由、选择性声学状态更新，以及通过可替换的文本记忆后端进行按身份分区的记忆写入与检索。我们还构建了 LoCoMo-ID，一个包含隐藏说话人身份、说话人敏感查询、模拟录音条件变化和四人身份混淆测试的语音记忆基准。在纵向 SMIIP-TV 上，在冻结的近似注册阈值下，真实探针拒绝率在约一年内从 29.8% 上升到 55.6%。在 LoCoMo-ID 的说话人敏感查询上，门控更新在干净和漂移条件下分别比固定表示提升身份门控问答 3.86 和 11.62 个百分点，且没有错误用户的授权。该优势在四人测试中依然存在。然而，减少碎片化和提升问答可能与错误的跨用户链接并存，揭示了一种仅靠问答无法捕捉的碎片化—污染权衡。
translation.brief: 针对多用户语音智能体中声纹误归属导致记忆错配的问题，提出免训练的EvoSpeakerMem层进行因果说话人路由和按身份分区的记忆读写，并构建LoCoMo-ID基准进行评估。

papers.title: A Harness Reducing over-Defensive Writing in Agents by Isolating Objections
papers.abstract: When expanding a report, writing with agents may introduce a stronger claim than the article makes and then disclaim it. This is called over-defensive writing. We assume that this is because the agent is writing for responding to an adversarial AI reviewer, instead of a human reader. The defensive context may also influnce the consequent when we simply ban defensive writing in the output through prompts. In order to reduce over-defensive writing, we produce a harness that separates the reviewer, filter, and writer. The writer agent receives only the problems choosen by the filter, which is an independent context. We evaluate this harness on 25 business-project drafts expanded into formal reports, the result shows that the defensive propositions decreased from 59 to 2, which is a 96.61\% reduction, no unsupported factual additions were identified while the source-claim retention rises from 80.35% to 93.12%.

translation.title: 通过隔离异议来减少智能体过度防御性写作的框架
translation.abstract: 在扩写报告时，智能体写作可能会提出比原文更强的论断然后加以否认，这被称为过度防御性写作。我们假设这是因为智能体是在为应对一个对抗性的AI审稿人而非人类读者而写作。当我们仅通过提示词在输出中禁止防御性写作时，防御性上下文也可能影响结果。为了减少过度防御性写作，我们构建了一个将审稿人、过滤器和写作者分离的框架。写作者智能体只接收由过滤器选出的、处于独立上下文中的问题。我们在25份被扩写为正式报告的商业项目草稿上评估了该框架，结果显示防御性命题从59个降至2个，减少了96.61%，未发现无依据的事实添加，同时源论断保留率从80.35%升至93.12%。
translation.brief: 针对智能体扩写报告时的过度防御性写作问题，提出将审稿人、过滤器和写作者分离为独立上下文的框架，使写作者只接收过滤后的问题。

papers.title: When do token systems stabilize? Compatibility constraints and community structure
papers.abstract: Token systems support repeated service exchange without monetary transfers, but their viability depends on the stability of token balances. We study token systems with compatibility constraints among agents. A requester is randomly sampled in each period, and only a few randomly sampled agents are available to provide service. We establish a necessary and sufficient condition for stability and show that the minimum-token rule, which selects the available provider with the lowest token balance, achieves the optimal stability region. We then apply this stability criterion to a random token system generated from stochastic block models with uniformly sampled requesters. We tightly characterize the stability regime by identifying two obstructions to stability: insufficient service opportunities for a group of communities or for an individual agent.

translation.title: 代币系统何时稳定？兼容性约束与社区结构
translation.abstract: 代币系统支持无需货币转移的重复服务交换，但其可行性取决于代币余额的稳定性。我们研究了智能体之间存在兼容性约束的代币系统。每个周期随机抽取一个请求者，且只有少数随机抽取的智能体可以提供服务。我们建立了稳定性的充要条件，并证明最小代币规则（即选择代币余额最低的可用服务提供者）能够达到最优稳定区域。随后，我们将该稳定性准则应用于由随机块模型生成、请求者均匀采样的随机代币系统，通过识别两类稳定性障碍——某组社区或某个体的服务机会不足——对稳定区域进行了紧致刻画。
translation.brief: 研究带兼容性约束的代币系统稳定性问题，通过建立稳定性的充要条件并证明最小代币规则的最优性，刻画了随机块模型下代币系统的稳定区域。

papers.title: Robust LLM Data Selection via Content-Invariant Gradient Attribution
papers.abstract: Gradient-based data attribution has become an important tool for high-quality data selection in the instruction fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), as it estimates the contribution of training examples through their influence on model optimization. However, we find that existing global gradient attribution methods suffer from surface-form bias: minor changes to semantically irrelevant details, such as wording or formatting, can produce highly inconsistent attribution scores even when the underlying content remains unchanged. To address this issue, we propose Content-Invariant Gradient Attribution (CIGA), a robust framework for instruction data selection. CIGA first identifies layers whose gradients are both influential for attribution and stable under semantics-preserving surface-form perturbations, thereby reducing formatting noise in gradient features. It then dynamically fuses these attribution signals with semantic representations of the input, combining optimization-level influence with content-level information. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks show that CIGA produces more stable rankings under surface-form perturbations while preserving downstream capabilities and improving average performance. CIGA also reduces attribution cost, offering a robust and efficient approach to data selection for LLM instruction tuning.

translation.title: 基于内容不变梯度归因的鲁棒 LLM 数据选择
translation.abstract: 基于梯度的数据归因已成为大语言模型（LLM）指令微调中高质量数据选择的重要工具，它通过训练样本对模型优化的影响来估计其贡献。然而，我们发现现有的全局梯度归因方法存在表层形式偏差：即使底层内容不变，对措辞或格式等语义无关细节的微小改动也会产生高度不一致的归因分数。为解决这一问题，我们提出了内容不变梯度归因（CIGA），一个鲁棒的指令数据选择框架。CIGA 首先识别那些对归因有影响力且在保持语义的表层形式扰动下梯度稳定的层，从而降低梯度特征中的格式噪声；然后将这些归因信号与输入的语义表示动态融合，将优化层面的影响力与内容层面的信息相结合。在多个基准上的大量实验表明，CIGA 在表层形式扰动下产生更稳定的排序，同时保持下游能力并提升平均性能。CIGA 还降低了归因成本，为 LLM 指令微调的数据选择提供了一种鲁棒且高效的方法。
translation.brief: 针对梯度数据归因方法受措辞格式等表层形式变化干扰的问题，提出 CIGA 框架，通过筛选扰动稳定的梯度层并与语义表示动态融合实现鲁棒的指令数据选择。

papers.title: DocSkill: Skill-Integrated Agentic Reasoning for Multilingual Multi-Hop Document Question Answering
papers.abstract: Multilingual multi-hop document question answering (MMHop-DocQA) requires locating and integrating evidence across complex layouts, document pages, and diverse languages. Existing approaches include single-pass processing and adaptive tool use, but learning to coordinate evidence acquisition, cross-page integration, and answer verification remains challenging. To address this challenge, we present DocSkill, an agentic framework with a learned skill-orchestration policy for adaptive evidence acquisition and reasoning. The policy selects, revisits, or skips skills according to the evolving evidence state. To construct supervision for skill orchestration, bounded Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) explores alternative skill trajectories offline. These trajectories provide demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference pairs for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). We further introduce MMHop-DocBench, a multilingual multi-hop document QA dataset with training and test splits, containing 60K QA pairs across 10 languages and eight document domains. Its HopGen pipeline builds hierarchical page-element graphs to derive traceable cross-page evidence paths and generate grounded QA pairs with page- and element-level evidence annotations. Experiments show that DocSkill with Qwen3-VL-8B achieves 41.0 accuracy and 49.2 F1 on MMHop-DocBench, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 5.5 and 6.3 points, respectively, and achieving competitive performance on MMLongBench-Doc and DocBench.

translation.title: DocSkill：面向多语言多跳文档问答的技能集成智能体推理
translation.abstract: 多语言多跳文档问答（MMHop-DocQA）需要在复杂版面、文档页面和多种语言之间定位并整合证据。现有方法包括单次处理和自适应工具使用，但学习协调证据获取、跨页整合与答案验证仍具挑战性。为此，我们提出 DocSkill，一个具备可学习技能编排策略的智能体框架，用于自适应的证据获取与推理。该策略根据不断演化的证据状态选择、重访或跳过技能。为构建技能编排的监督信号，有界蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）离线探索备选技能轨迹，这些轨迹为监督微调（SFT）提供示范，为直接偏好优化（DPO）提供偏好对。我们还进一步构建了 MMHop-DocBench，一个含训练与测试划分的多语言多跳文档问答数据集，涵盖 10 种语言、8 个文档领域的 6 万个问答对。其 HopGen 流水线构建层次化页面元素图，推导可追溯的跨页证据路径，并生成带有页面级和元素级证据标注的接地问答对。实验表明，DocSkill 配合 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 MMHop-DocBench 上达到 41.0 的准确率和 49.2 的 F1，分别超过最强基线 5.5 和 6.3 分，并在 MMLongBench-Doc 和 DocBench 上取得有竞争力的表现。
translation.brief: 针对多语言多跳文档问答中证据获取与整合协调困难的问题，提出 DocSkill 智能体框架，利用 MCTS 生成技能轨迹监督训练可学习的技能编排策略。

papers.title: Beyond the Evidence Coherence Trap: Agent-Driven Evidence Selection for Temporally Disordered Fake News Detection
papers.abstract: Fake news undermines public trust and the integrity of online information ecosystems. Temporally disordered fake news is especially elusive because it rearranges factual events into a false chronology. Individual events may remain factually valid even when their temporal relations are misrepresented. When similar events involving the same entity recur, retrieval may return semantically plausible evidence from the wrong period. Consequently, independent event verification may rely on locally coherent but temporally mismatched evidence and incorrectly validate the article. We call this the \textit{evidence coherence trap}. Because existing benchmarks rarely isolate this setting, we construct ChronoFake, a source-disjoint benchmark of 30,706 articles derived from temporally anchored real events. It distinguishes temporal manipulation from valid narration, including flashbacks. To address this, we propose DelSA, a \underline{D}ocument S\underline{el}ection \underline{S}elf-Updating \underline{A}gent that iteratively refines evidence selection during training and applies a frozen rulebook for one-pass evidence selection at inference. DelSA uses an LLM to characterize candidate evidence, while a verifier-trained reranker balances local relevance against timeline consistency. Finally, the classifier compares the article-implied chronology extracted by the LLM with the evidence-derived chronology to reveal global temporal conflicts. DelSA outperforms existing methods on ChronoFake, while remaining competitive on PolitiFact and GossipCop.

translation.title: 超越证据连贯性陷阱：面向时序错乱假新闻检测的智能体驱动证据选择
translation.abstract: 假新闻损害公众信任和在线信息生态的完整性。时序错乱的假新闻尤其难以识别，因为它将真实事件重排为虚假的时间顺序。即使时间关系被歪曲，单个事件在事实上可能仍然成立。当涉及同一实体的相似事件反复出现时，检索可能返回来自错误时期的语义上看似合理的证据。因此，独立的事件验证可能依赖局部连贯但时间错配的证据，从而错误地认可该文章。我们将其称为“证据连贯性陷阱”。由于现有基准很少隔离这一场景，我们构建了 ChronoFake，一个源自带时间锚定的真实事件、包含 30,706 篇文章的源不相交基准，用于区分时间操纵与合法叙述（包括倒叙）。为此，我们提出 DelSA，一个文档选择自更新智能体，在训练中迭代精化证据选择，并在推理时应用冻结的规则手册进行一次性证据选择。DelSA 使用 LLM 刻画候选证据，同时由验证器训练的重排序器在局部相关性与时间线一致性之间进行权衡。最后，分类器将 LLM 提取的文章隐含时间线与证据推导的时间线进行对比，以揭示全局时间冲突。DelSA 在 ChronoFake 上优于现有方法，同时在 PolitiFact 和 GossipCop 上保持竞争力。
translation.brief: 针对时序错乱假新闻因局部连贯但时间错配证据而难以检测的问题，构建 ChronoFake 基准并提出 DelSA 智能体，通过迭代证据选择与时间线冲突对比实现检测。

papers.title: Can LLMs Reliably Grade Olympiad Proofs? A Study of Mathematical Verification with LLMs
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made remarkable progress on solving competition-level mathematics, yet their ability to verify natural-language mathematical proofs remains relatively underexplored. This gap is especially pronounced for Olympiad-level proofs, which require meticulous assessment of each claim in a long reasoning chain. Current proof verification thus primarily relies on expert inspection, which is costly to scale. In this paper, we present a systematic study of LLM-based verification in this setting. Specifically, we introduce a human-curated dataset of USAMO 2025 candidate solutions with expert grading, and conduct a broad evaluation of existing LLM verifiers across frontier models. We also propose TROJAN, an iterative self-critique pipeline for generating high-fidelity adversarial proofs at scale. Our comprehensive evaluation covers 20 models spanning seven metrics, two prompt styles, three inference methods, and three prompt templates, showing that state-of-the-art models still leave considerable room for improvement. To narrow this gap, we propose MABGrader, a Multi-Armed Bandit framework that reframes grading as arm selection over the discrete score space. MABGrader outperforms the SOTA ProofGrader by 26.4% in Quadratic Weighted Kappa and reduces grading error by 14%. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/aziksh-ospanov/TROJAN.

translation.title: LLM 能可靠地批改奥数证明吗？基于 LLM 的数学验证研究
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在解决竞赛级数学问题上取得了显著进展，但其验证自然语言数学证明的能力仍相对缺乏研究。这一差距在奥数级证明上尤为突出，因为此类证明需要对长推理链中的每个论断进行细致评估。目前的证明验证因此主要依赖专家检查，难以规模化。本文对这一场景下基于 LLM 的验证进行了系统研究。具体而言，我们引入了一个由人工整理的 USAMO 2025 候选解答数据集（含专家评分），并对现有 LLM 验证器在多个前沿模型上进行了广泛评估。我们还提出 TROJAN，一个用于大规模生成高保真对抗性证明的迭代自我批评流水线。我们的全面评估涵盖 20 个模型、7 项指标、2 种提示风格、3 种推理方法和 3 种提示模板，表明最先进的模型仍有相当大的提升空间。为缩小这一差距，我们提出 MABGrader，一个多臂老虎机框架，将评分重新表述为在离散分数空间上的臂选择问题。MABGrader 在二次加权 Kappa 上超过 SOTA 的 ProofGrader 26.4%，并将评分误差降低 14%。代码和数据集见 https://github.com/aziksh-ospanov/TROJAN。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 难以可靠验证奥数级自然语言证明的问题，构建 USAMO 2025 专家评分数据集并提出基于多臂老虎机的 MABGrader 评分框架。

papers.title: Batching the Reflective Optimization Loop: Parallel Proposals Make GEPA Faster and Better
papers.abstract: Reflective text optimization makes agentic systems better, but the optimization loop is itself a resource-hungry workload whose sequential structure leaves parallel evaluation capacity idle. We extend the open-source GEPA optimizer to propose and evaluate a batch of candidates on each optimization step instead of one candidate at a time. In our sweep on two tasks, most batched runs finished in half the wall-clock time or less, and the fastest in about a quarter to a third. Batched settings also achieved higher held-out test scores, from 68.9% to 72.1% on LiveBench-Math (with $2\times2$) and from 49.0% to 60.0% on HoVer (with $8\times1$). A simple runtime model explains the measured speedups under a finite worker pool, and batched settings also spend their metric-call and dollar budgets more efficiently. We frame the axes along which a reflective optimization step can scale in parallel, a first look at allocating a fixed optimization budget across them.

translation.title: 批量化反思优化循环：并行提议使 GEPA 更快更好
translation.abstract: 反思式文本优化能提升智能体系统的性能，但优化循环本身是资源密集型工作负载，其串行结构使并行评估能力闲置。我们扩展了开源的 GEPA 优化器，使其在每个优化步骤中提议并评估一批候选方案，而非一次只处理一个候选。在两个任务的扫描实验中，大多数批量化运行的墙钟时间缩短至一半或更少，最快的约为原来的四分之一到三分之一。批量化设置还取得了更高的留出测试分数：LiveBench-Math 上从 68.9% 提升至 72.1%（2×2 配置），HoVer 上从 49.0% 提升至 60.0%（8×1 配置）。一个简单的运行时模型解释了在有限 worker 池下测得的加速比，且批量化设置也更高效地利用了指标调用和美元预算。我们梳理了反思优化步骤可以并行扩展的各个维度，并首次探讨了如何在它们之间分配固定的优化预算。
translation.brief: 解决反思优化循环串行执行导致并行资源闲置的问题，方法是扩展 GEPA 使其每步并行提议和评估一批候选方案。

papers.title: Does LLM Pre-Training Typically Occur at the Edge of Stability?
papers.abstract: Quadratic approximations provide a common lens for studying neural network optimization, but recent evidence challenges their predictive validity. In full-batch gradient descent with learning rate (LR) $\eta$, Cohen et al. (2021) observed the Edge of Stability (EoS), where the largest Hessian eigenvalue concentrates near $2/\eta$, seemingly at odds with classical stability conditions predicted by quadratic approximations. In this work, we revisit the fidelity of quadratic approximations as a model of neural network training dynamics, with a particular focus on their failure modes in LLM training. We first highlight a distinct failure mode of the quadratic approximation, where persistent negative curvature causes the quadratic dynamics to diverge regardless of the LR, even though the real dynamics remain stable. We term this phenomenon the Edge of Convexity (EoC). After removing the effect of this LR-independent instability, we then propose a generalized definition of Edge of Stability (EoS) for stochastic training with adaptive optimizers, based on whether increasing the LR induces significant divergence in the quadratic dynamics while leaving the real dynamics largely unchanged. Across different LLM pretraining runs with various model sizes up to 787M, we find that (1) EoC is always observed across LLM pretraining, and (2) EoS is also prevalent but not universal: it disappears when the LR becomes sufficiently small (e.g., after decay) or when the batch size falls below a critical threshold that has a positive correlation with the critical batch size. Together, these findings characterize when and how quadratic approximations fail and provide a foundation for future work on understanding training dynamics.

translation.title: LLM 预训练通常发生在稳定边缘吗？
translation.abstract: 二次近似是研究神经网络优化的常用视角，但近期证据对其预测有效性提出了挑战。在学习率为 $\eta$ 的全批量梯度下降中，Cohen 等人（2021）观察到了稳定边缘（Edge of Stability, EoS）现象，即最大 Hessian 特征值集中在 $2/\eta$ 附近，这似乎与二次近似预测的经典稳定性条件相矛盾。本文重新审视二次近似作为神经网络训练动力学模型的保真度，特别关注其在 LLM 训练中的失效模式。我们首先指出二次近似的一种独特失效模式：持续的负曲率导致二次动力学无论学习率如何都会发散，而真实动力学仍保持稳定。我们将这一现象命名为凸边缘（Edge of Convexity, EoC）。在去除这种与学习率无关的不稳定性影响后，我们基于“提高学习率是否会引起二次动力学的显著发散而真实动力学基本不变”，为使用自适应优化器的随机训练提出了广义的稳定边缘（EoS）定义。在多个不同规模（最大 787M）的 LLM 预训练运行中，我们发现：(1) EoC 在 LLM 预训练中始终存在；(2) EoS 也普遍存在但并非普适：当学习率足够小（如衰减后）或批量大小低于某个与临界批量大小正相关的阈值时，EoS 会消失。这些发现刻画了二次近似何时以及如何失效，为未来理解训练动力学的工作奠定了基础。
translation.brief: 研究二次近似在 LLM 训练中的失效模式，提出凸边缘（EoC）现象和广义稳定边缘（EoS）定义来刻画其何时失效。

papers.title: Select-TTT: Query-Conditioned Selective Fast Weight Updates for In-Place Test-Time Training
papers.abstract: Test-time training (TTT) enables a deployed language model to internalize incoming context on-the-fly into a small set of fast-weight parameters, rather than merely treating it as transient context for attention. In-Place TTT recently made this idea practical for large language models by repurposing the down-projection of standard MLP blocks as fast weights. However, we find that its benefit largely disappears on realistic web long-context question answering. We attribute this to In-Place TTT's uniform write schedule: every chunk is written with equal strength, so irrelevant content dilutes query-relevant information in fast-weight memory. Building on this insight, we propose Select-TTT, a model-agnostic, query-conditioned rule for In-Place TTT that scales each chunk's write strength by its relevance to the user query. This relevance signal requires no supervision and no new parameters: it is read directly from the model's frozen output head, as the probability mass that a chunk's hidden states assign to the query tokens. A temperature-scaled softmax turns these scores into learning-rate multipliers, leaving the chunk-wise, context-parallel computation of In-Place TTT intact. Select-TTT consistently improves long-context question answering on two benchmarks and two backbones. These findings highlight the value of query-conditioned fast weight writes for practical test-time training on long-context question answering, which is also potentially promising for long-horizon agent tasks involving multiple user queries over evolving contexts.

translation.title: Select-TTT：面向原位测试时训练的查询条件选择性快速权重更新
translation.abstract: 测试时训练（TTT）使部署后的语言模型能够将 incoming context 即时内化到一小组快速权重参数中，而不仅仅是将其视为注意力机制的瞬态上下文。In-Place TTT 最近通过将标准 MLP 块的下投影重用为快速权重，使这一想法在大语言模型上变得实用。然而，我们发现其收益在真实的网页长上下文问答中基本消失。我们将其归因于 In-Place TTT 的均匀写入调度：每个 chunk 以相同强度写入，导致无关内容稀释了快速权重记忆中与查询相关的信息。基于这一洞察，我们提出 Select-TTT，一种模型无关的、查询条件的 In-Place TTT 规则，根据每个 chunk 与用户查询的相关性来缩放其写入强度。该相关性信号无需监督也无需新参数：它直接从模型冻结的输出头读取，即 chunk 的隐藏状态分配给查询 token 的概率质量。经温度缩放的 softmax 将这些分数转换为学习率乘数，同时保持 In-Place TTT 的 chunk 级、上下文并行计算不变。Select-TTT 在两个基准和两个骨干模型上持续提升长上下文问答性能。这些发现凸显了查询条件快速权重写入对长上下文问答实际测试时训练的价值，对涉及在演化上下文中处理多个用户查询的长程智能体任务也具有潜在前景。
translation.brief: 解决 In-Place TTT 均匀写入导致无关内容稀释查询相关信息的问题，方法是根据 chunk 与查询的相关性（从冻结输出头读取）缩放写入强度。

papers.title: API-TAIL: Detecting Model Substitution in LLM APIs through Temperature-Aligned Likelihood Tails
papers.abstract: Commercial language model APIs return only text, allowing a provider to cut costs by quietly routing a fraction of user requests to a cheaper substitute model while billing for the advertised one. Detecting such partial substitution is challenging because honest providers also alter the output distribution through undocumented decoding and serving choices, such as temperature scaling, sampling truncation, repetition and presence penalties, and default system prompts, forcing an audit to test against a composite null of legitimate configurations rather than a single reference. Our key insight is that these legitimate variations primarily shift response typicality across the entire batch, whereas partial substitution injects individual responses that remain anomalous under the claimed model. Building on this, we introduce API-TAIL, a typicality audit that first absorbs batch-level shifts by aligning a single effective temperature to center standardized surprisal scores across the audited batch, and then flags the endpoint if the number of remaining tail responses exceeds a threshold calibrated across legitimate configurations. Evaluated on real-world commercial APIs, API-TAIL reliably controls false alarms across diverse honest providers while detecting even low-rate partial substitution with a small query budget, substantially outperforming existing rank- and MMD-based audits that lose detection power under the same composite calibration.

translation.title: API-TAIL：通过温度对齐的似然尾部检测 LLM API 中的模型替换
translation.abstract: 商业语言模型 API 只返回文本，这使得提供商可以通过将部分用户请求悄悄路由到更便宜的替代模型、却按宣传的模型计费来削减成本。检测这种部分替换颇具挑战，因为诚实的提供商也会通过未记录的解码和服务选择（如温度缩放、采样截断、重复惩罚与存在惩罚、默认系统提示词）改变输出分布，迫使审计必须在合法配置构成的复合零假设而非单一参考下进行检验。我们的关键洞察是：这些合法变化主要使整批响应的典型性发生整体偏移，而部分替换会注入在声称模型下仍然异常的个别响应。基于此，我们提出 API-TAIL，一种典型性审计方法：它首先通过将单一有效温度对齐以居中整批标准化 surprisal 分数来吸收批次级偏移，然后在剩余尾部响应数量超过跨合法配置校准的阈值时标记该端点。在真实商业 API 上的评估表明，API-TAIL 能在多样化诚实提供商下可靠控制误报，同时以较小的查询预算检测出低比例的部分替换，大幅优于在相同复合校准下失去检测能力的基于排名和 MMD 的现有审计方法。
