translation.brief: 解决检测 LLM API 提供商部分替换模型的问题，方法是通过温度对齐吸收合法解码配置造成的批次级典型性偏移，再检验尾部异常响应数量。

papers.title: LLM knowledge for improved Out-of-Distribution Tabular Prediction - A Cross-Validated Regularisation Approach
papers.abstract: Prediction models degrade when the deployment population differs from the one used to train them, and training data cannot say which feature-response relationships will transfer. Expert elicitation is slow and unscalable. We ask whether coefficient priors elicited from large language models (LLMs) improve out-of-distribution (OOD) prediction as the shrinkage target of a regularised regression instead of zero, across five tabular datasets split on real covariates, selecting providers and prior structures by source-domain cross-validation alone. The priors help on four of five datasets, by up to 7.9% OOD mean squared error, and ten of twenty-four prior-informed results resolve the mean improvement at conventional confidence; single-deployment intervals are much wider. On classification the gain is in probabilistic accuracy, not ranking, and control tests with corrupted priors attribute the benefit to feature-specific content rather than scale. Two findings temper this. Variation across candidate priors exceeds the average benefit, yet cross-validation margins fall below their own noise, so selection avoids the worst prior rather than finding the best. On three datasets the prior improves in-domain accuracy as much as out-of-domain, making it better regularisation than shift correction. Only where the training data are large enough that the in-domain gain disappears does elicited knowledge demonstrably improve transfer. Code, priors and results: https://github.com/hugohammer/llm-priors-ood.

translation.title: 利用 LLM 知识改进分布外表格预测——一种交叉验证正则化方法
translation.abstract: 当部署人群与训练人群不同时，预测模型性能会下降，而训练数据无法说明哪些特征-响应关系可以迁移。专家引征缓慢且难以扩展。我们探究从大语言模型（LLM）引征的系数先验，作为正则化回归的收缩目标（替代零目标），能否改善分布外（OOD）预测：在五个按真实协变量划分的表格数据集上，仅通过源域交叉验证来选择提供商和先验结构。先验在五个数据集中的四个上有所帮助，OOD 均方误差最多降低 7.9%，且二十四个先验相关结果中有十个在常规置信水平下显著；单次部署的置信区间则宽得多。在分类任务上，收益体现在概率准确性而非排序上，使用损坏先验的对照实验将收益归因于特征特定的内容而非尺度。有两点发现对此有所保留：候选先验之间的差异超过平均收益，且交叉验证的裕度低于其自身噪声，因此选择只是避免了最差的先验而非找到最好的；在三个数据集上，先验对域内准确率的提升与域外相当，使其更像是更好的正则化而非偏移校正。只有在训练数据足够大、域内收益消失的情况下，引征知识才确实改善了迁移。代码、先验和结果：https://github.com/hugohammer/llm-priors-ood。
translation.brief: 解决分布外表格预测中训练数据无法判断哪些关系可迁移的问题，方法是将 LLM 引征的系数先验作为正则化回归的收缩目标，并用源域交叉验证选择先验。

papers.title: Words or Deeds? How LLMs Predict Users' Decisions in Human-Agent Dialogue
papers.abstract: Web systems increasingly predict users' decisions from what users say, yet when interests partly conflict, users may promise to cooperate to win the other side's cooperation and then not do so. Sales or service agents that rely on such promises may grant concessions to users who then do not keep their promises, at a cost to the party they represent. We test how LLMs combine users' statements with decision records to predict users' decisions, using 1,260 rounds in which 42 users played a repeated prisoner's dilemma-style game with five agents, each prompted to express a dominant Big Five trait, and could talk with the agent before every decision. Across eight open-weight LLMs, predictions from decision records separated cooperation from defection well (AUC = .80), and adding dialogue brought no detectable gain. With dialogue, predictions agreed with users' statements more often, and errors concentrated on rounds in which users broke their statements: accuracy on rounds with a statement barely changed (.73 to .74), while it rose on kept statements (.76 to .95) and fell sharply on broken ones (.65 to .17). Predictions weighted statements more heavily than users' behavior warranted: when users stated a decision they had not yet made in that game, the predicted probability of keeping it rose from .13 to .69, whereas users kept .40 of such statements. Users' decisions also varied with the agent they faced, but predictions hardly reflected this: users cooperated more with the Agreeableness agent than with the Extraversion agent (70.6% vs. 54.5%), whereas predicted cooperation was nearly identical (64.5% vs. 63.1%). Users also cooperated more with an agent when they themselves scored higher on that agent's trait, whereas predicted cooperation barely changed with these scores. Dialogue-based predictions should therefore weigh users' statements by their earlier decisions and the agent they face.

translation.title: 言语还是行动？LLM 如何在人机对话中预测用户的决策
translation.abstract: Web 系统日益依赖用户所说的话来预测其决策，然而当双方利益部分冲突时，用户可能为了赢得对方的合作而承诺配合，随后却不兑现。依赖此类承诺的销售或服务代理可能向不守承诺的用户让步，从而损害其所代表方的利益。我们测试了 LLM 如何结合用户的陈述与决策记录来预测用户的决策，实验包含 1,260 轮游戏：42 名用户与五个代理进行重复囚徒困境式博弈，每个代理被提示表现出 Big Five 中的某一主导特质，且用户在每次决策前可与代理对话。在八个开源权重 LLM 上，基于决策记录的预测能较好地区分合作与背叛（AUC = .80），加入对话并未带来可检测的提升。使用对话时，预测更倾向于与用户的陈述一致，且错误集中在用户违背陈述的轮次：在有陈述的轮次上准确率几乎不变（.73 到 .74），在守诺轮次上上升（.76 到 .95），在失诺轮次上急剧下降（.65 到 .17）。预测对陈述的权重高于用户行为所应得的：当用户陈述了一个在该局中尚未做出的决策时，预测的守诺概率从 .13 升至 .69，而用户实际只守住了此类陈述的 .40。用户的决策还随所面对的代理而变化，但预测几乎未反映这一点：用户对宜人性（Agreeableness）代理的合作多于外向性（Extraversion）代理（70.6% vs. 54.5%），而预测的合作率几乎相同（64.5% vs. 63.1%）。当用户自身在该代理特质上得分更高时，也更倾向于与该代理合作，而预测的合作率几乎不随这些得分变化。因此，基于对话的预测应根据用户先前的决策及其面对的代理来为用户的陈述加权。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 预测用户决策时过度信任对话陈述而忽视行为记录与代理特质的问题，通过重复囚徒困境实验量化陈述与决策记录在预测中的权重失衡。

papers.title: Who Knows What - and What Does It Support? Perspective-Bounded Evidence Calibration for Multimodal Theory of Mind
papers.abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM), the ability to infer others' beliefs, goals, and intentions, is a cornerstone of social intelligence. Multimodal ToM requires inferring an agent's mental state from evidence that is available to that agent, rather than from the complete episode observed by the solver. Existing LLM-based and Bayesian model-based approaches reconstruct global event traces, yet they do not explicitly distinguish objective events from agent-admissible evidence during hypothesis evaluation. Consequently, agent-inaccessible events or semantically misaligned actions and utterances may influence the inferred belief, goal, or social intention, leading to perspective leakage and source or route confusion. We formulate this limitation as an evidence-admissibility problem: evidence should contribute to a mental-state hypothesis only when it is accessible to the relevant agent, preserves its information source, and is diagnostic of the queried mental-state variable. To operationalize this principle, we propose PIP-ToM, an evidence-admissibility interface that constructs agent-specific evidence stores, aligns them with structured mental-state claims, and calibrates model-based hypothesis scores while preserving the underlying Bayesian inference process. PIP-ToM with GPT-4o outperforms existing ToM methods across MuMA-ToM, MMToM-QA, and Hi-ToM, achieving average accuracies of 92.56%, 95.00%, and 95.00%, respectively.

translation.title: 谁知道什么——以及它支持什么？面向多模态心智理论的视角有界证据校准
translation.abstract: 心智理论（Theory of Mind, ToM）即推断他人信念、目标和意图的能力，是社会智能的基石。多模态 ToM 要求从相关代理可获得的证据而非求解者观察到的完整情节中推断代理的心理状态。现有基于 LLM 和贝叶斯模型的方法重建全局事件轨迹，但在假设评估时未显式区分客观事件与代理可采纳的证据。因此，代理不可及的事件或语义错位的动作与话语可能影响推断出的信念、目标或社会意图，导致视角泄漏以及来源或路径混淆。我们将这一局限形式化为证据可采纳性问题：证据只有在相关代理可及、保持其信息来源且对所查询的心理状态变量具有诊断性时，才应贡献于心理状态假设。为将这一原则可操作化，我们提出 PIP-ToM，一个证据可采纳性接口，它构建代理特定的证据库，将其与结构化心理状态断言对齐，并在保留底层贝叶斯推理过程的同时校准基于模型的假设分数。PIP-ToM 结合 GPT-4o 在 MuMA-ToM、MMToM-QA 和 Hi-ToM 上超越了现有 ToM 方法，平均准确率分别达到 92.56%、95.00% 和 95.00%。
translation.brief: 解决多模态心智理论推断中代理不可及证据导致视角泄漏的问题，提出 PIP-ToM 证据可采纳性接口，构建代理特定证据库并校准贝叶斯假设分数。

papers.title: When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement
papers.abstract: Autonomous agents increasingly depend on harnesses that govern interaction, memory, tools, and execution around large language models (LLMs). While recent work has begun to evolve these harnesses from execution experience, the supervision used to guide evolution often remains relatively static, making it difficult to track changing behavioral weaknesses across rounds and potentially limiting generalization to unseen tasks. To address this issue, we propose RuHarness, a rubric--harness co-evolution framework for continual agent self-improvement. RuHarness continually discovers and reassesses behavioral criteria from execution trajectories, prioritizes the most relevant unresolved weaknesses, and uses them to guide targeted harness updates while keeping the task objective fixed. Extensive experiments across diverse agent tasks and backbone models show that RuHarness outperforms strong harness-evolution baselines, particularly on unseen held-out tasks. Further analyses show that adaptive rubric prioritization tracks shifting weaknesses and supports more sustained improvement and stable generalization across evolution rounds.

translation.title: 当评判者落后时：面向持续智能体自我改进的规则与执行框架协同演化
translation.abstract: 自主智能体日益依赖围绕大语言模型（LLM）管理交互、记忆、工具和执行的 harness。尽管近期工作已开始从执行经验中演化这些 harness，但用于指导演化的监督往往仍相对静态，难以跟踪各轮次中不断变化的行为弱点，并可能限制对未见任务的泛化。为解决这一问题，我们提出 RuHarness，一个用于持续智能体自我改进的 rubric–harness 协同演化框架。RuHarness 持续从执行轨迹中发现并重新评估行为准则，优先处理最相关的未解决弱点，并用它们指导有针对性的 harness 更新，同时保持任务目标不变。在多种智能体任务和骨干模型上的大量实验表明，RuHarness 优于强大的 harness 演化基线，尤其是在未见过的留出任务上。进一步分析显示，自适应的 rubric 优先级排序能跟踪弱点的变化，支持跨演化轮次更持续的改进和稳定的泛化。
translation.brief: 解决智能体 harness 演化中监督信号静态、难以跟踪行为弱点变化的问题，提出 RuHarness 框架，通过 rubric 与 harness 协同演化指导针对性更新。

papers.title: When All Rollouts Fail: Policy-Compatible Joint Decoding for Hard-Problem Reasoning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) derives its learning signal from binary rewards via on-policy exploration and becomes a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning of large language models. Yet it faces a learning cliff on problems beyond model's current ability: when every rollout fails, the samples reveal nothing about a correct solution, and group-relative estimators (e.g., GRPO, RLOO) collapse the update to zero advantage. Expert trajectories offer a remedy, but they are incompatible with the current policy and often lie in the student's low-probability regions, so the surviving updates demand large parameter shifts and decay into surface-level imitation rather than transferable reasoning. We argue that a useful learning signal on hard problems must be both verifiably correct and sufficiently compatible with the current policy. We propose Policy-Compatible Reinforcement Learning (PICO), which performs distribution-constrained joint decoding: expert data guides decoding at the token level while preserving the student's relative token probabilities, and a dynamic top-k mechanism confines the sampling distribution under a finite divergence budget, yielding trajectories that are verified and policy-compatible by construction. These trajectories are optimized jointly with on-policy rollouts under a mixed-behavior objective that mitigates their distribution mismatch via importance sampling. Experiments across reasoning diverse datasets and agentic benchmarks demonstrate that PICO consistently outperforms standard RLVR and prior off-policy baselines.

translation.title: 当所有 rollout 都失败时：面向困难问题推理的策略兼容联合解码
translation.abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）通过 on-policy 探索从二元奖励中获取学习信号，成为提升大语言模型推理能力的强大范式。然而，在超出模型当前能力的问题上它面临学习悬崖：当所有 rollout 都失败时，样本无法揭示任何正确解的信息，组相对估计器（如 GRPO、RLOO）会将更新坍缩为零优势。专家轨迹提供了一种补救，但它们与当前策略不兼容，且常处于学生模型的低概率区域，因此幸存的更新需要大幅参数偏移，并退化为表面模仿而非可迁移的推理。我们认为，困难问题上有用的学习信号必须既可验证正确，又与当前策略足够兼容。我们提出策略兼容强化学习（PICO），执行分布约束的联合解码：专家数据在 token 层面引导解码，同时保持学生的相对 token 概率，动态 top-k 机制在有限散度预算内约束采样分布，从而产生经验证且天然策略兼容的轨迹。这些轨迹与 on-policy rollout 在混合行为目标下联合优化，通过重要性采样缓解其分布失配。在多种推理数据集和智能体基准上的实验表明，PICO 持续优于标准 RLVR 和先前的 off-policy 基线。
translation.brief: 解决 RLVR 在所有 rollout 失败的困难问题上学习信号为零的问题，提出 PICO，通过分布约束的联合解码生成经验证且策略兼容的专家引导轨迹并混合优化。

papers.title: GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.abstract: Mobile GUI agents are typically fine-tuned 7B-scale vision-language models (VLMs) that generate each action as text. However, these VLMs decode every action token by token, and even agents that score candidate actions keep a large language model or VLM in the loop, making them slow and memory-hungry. To address these issues, we propose GUI-JEPA, to our knowledge the first decoder-free GUI agent policy built on a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), which selects actions in the latent space of a JEPA encoder pretrained on unlabelled GUI screenshots. Its action- and region-conditioned latent predictor turns the screen latent into one latent per candidate action, letting lightweight heads score all candidates against the instruction in a single batched pass, without decoding a token. We further show that the scorer relies on this latent pathway and that the predictor is trained for the decision itself: a randomly initialised predictor does just as well as one pretrained on screen dynamics. On AndroidControl, GUI-JEPA is 2.8-4.0x faster on the same GPU than a Qwen2.5-VL-7B agent we fine-tune with the same inputs, while reaching 86-92% of its in-distribution accuracy with 6% of its parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/GUI-JEPA

translation.title: GUI-JEPA：以候选条件化 JEPA 潜变量作为移动 GUI 智能体的快速动作策略
translation.abstract: 移动 GUI 智能体通常是经过微调的 7B 规模视觉语言模型（VLM），以文本形式生成每个动作。然而，这些 VLM 逐 token 解码每个动作，即使是给候选动作打分的智能体也将大语言模型或 VLM 保留在回路中，导致速度慢且内存消耗大。为解决这些问题，我们提出 GUI-JEPA，据我们所知是首个基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的无解码器 GUI 智能体策略，它在预训练于无标注 GUI 截图的 JEPA 编码器潜空间中选择动作。其动作与区域条件化的潜变量预测器将屏幕潜变量转化为每个候选动作一个潜变量，使轻量级打分头能在单次批量前向中针对指令为所有候选打分，无需解码任何 token。我们进一步证明打分器依赖这一潜变量通路，且预测器是为决策本身训练的：随机初始化的预测器与在屏幕动态上预训练的预测器表现相当。在 AndroidControl 上，GUI-JEPA 在同一 GPU 上比我们用相同输入微调的 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 智能体快 2.8-4.0 倍，同时以 6% 的参数量达到其 86-92% 的分布内准确率。代码见 https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/GUI-JEPA
translation.brief: 解决 VLM 逐 token 解码导致 GUI 智能体推理慢、内存开销大的问题，提出无解码器的 GUI-JEPA，在 JEPA 潜空间中批量对候选动作打分以实现快速决策。

papers.title: RubricAtlas: Mining Type-Level Rubrics from Expert Reports to Evaluate Deep Research Agents
papers.abstract: Deep research agents conduct multi-step Web searches and synthesise retrieved information into analytical reports. Evaluating these outputs requires checking which analyses they deliver, beyond the presence of relevant facts. Query-specific binary rubrics make individual requirements explicit, but task-level checklists may leave the overall analytical structure underexamined. We introduce RubricAtlas, which derives type-level analytical requirements from expert reports on different objects within the same research type and organises detailed checks around recurring analytical questions. The requirements give related tasks a shared standard for what to analyse, without prescribing their answers. Our framework links binary checkpoints to report passages and evaluates completeness separately from argument validity. Built from 3,079 Chinese financial research reports, RubricAtlas covers 99 research types. Reference-report selection experiments show that individual reports cover only about half of their type's analytical questions, and that selecting requirements from different reports changes evaluation scores and agent rankings. Across ten agents, two judge pipelines achieve checkpoint agreement of $\kappa$ = 0.71 and agent-ranking agreement of Kendall $\tau$ = 0.87. Controlled deletions reduce scores on the affected analyses, while padding produces no detectable increase. These findings support type-level rubrics for comparing the analytical completeness of Web deep research outputs, with individual decisions traceable to report evidence.

translation.title: RubricAtlas：从专家报告中挖掘类型级评分标准以评估深度研究智能体
translation.abstract: 深度研究智能体执行多步网络搜索，并将检索到的信息综合为分析报告。评估这些输出需要检查它们提供了哪些分析，而不仅仅是相关事实是否存在。针对特定查询的二元评分标准使单个要求显式化，但任务级清单可能使整体分析结构得不到充分检查。我们提出 RubricAtlas，它从同一研究类型下不同对象的专家报告中推导类型级分析要求，并围绕反复出现的分析问题组织详细检查。这些要求为相关任务提供了关于分析什么的共同标准，而不规定其答案。我们的框架将二元检查点与报告段落关联，并将完整性评估与论证有效性评估分开。RubricAtlas 基于 3,079 份中文金融研究报告构建，覆盖 99 种研究类型。参考报告选择实验表明，单份报告仅覆盖其类型分析问题的一半左右，且从不同报告中选择要求会改变评估分数和智能体排名。在十个智能体上，两条评判流水线达到 κ = 0.71 的检查点一致性和 Kendall τ = 0.87 的智能体排名一致性。受控删除会降低受影响分析的分数，而填充内容未产生可检测的提升。这些发现支持使用类型级评分标准来比较网络深度研究输出的分析完整性，且每个决策可追溯到报告证据。
translation.brief: 针对深度研究智能体输出缺乏整体分析结构评估的问题，提出从专家报告中挖掘类型级分析要求并构建可追溯的评分框架 RubricAtlas。

papers.title: Hyperparameter and Neural Architecture Search via Evolutionary Optimization for Reinforcement Learning: HPNAS-RL
papers.abstract: In this study, we propose a dual-branch evolutionary framework that simultaneously performs Neural Architecture Search (NAS) and Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) for Reinforcement Learning (RL) in Autonomous Driving (AD) tasks. While NAS has shown strong potential in automating architecture design for Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), its application to RL remains limited, especially in scenarios that require joint optimization of architectural and training dynamics. Building on our prior work on Evolutionary Multi-Objective NAS (EMNAS), the proposed framework evolves discrete network architectures and continuous hyperparameters in parallel under a unified multi-objective search strategy. In this setup, NAS targets the convolutional layers of the RL policy network - responsible for visual feature extraction, while HPO focuses on optimizing critical RL hyperparameters. To accelerate convergence and improve generalization, we incorporate parallel evaluation and a teacher-student policy transfer mechanism. Experiments in a high-fidelity driving simulator show that the joint NAS-HPO framework consistently outperforms standalone NAS, yielding policies with higher rewards, fewer parameters, and improved stability. These results highlight the benefits of jointly optimizing model structure and training dynamics for scalable and effective RL agent design.

translation.title: 基于进化优化的强化学习超参数与神经架构搜索：HPNAS-RL
translation.abstract: 在本研究中，我们提出一个双分支进化框架，可在自动驾驶（AD）任务中同时为强化学习（RL）执行神经架构搜索（NAS）和超参数优化（HPO）。尽管 NAS 在卷积神经网络（CNN）架构设计自动化方面展现出强大潜力，但其在 RL 中的应用仍然有限，尤其是在需要联合优化架构与训练动态的场景中。基于我们此前在进化多目标 NAS（EMNAS）上的工作，所提出的框架在统一的多目标搜索策略下并行演化离散网络架构和连续超参数。在此设置中，NAS 针对 RL 策略网络中负责视觉特征提取的卷积层，而 HPO 专注于优化关键 RL 超参数。为加速收敛并提升泛化能力，我们引入了并行评估和师生策略迁移机制。在高保真驾驶模拟器中的实验表明，联合 NAS-HPO 框架始终优于单独的 NAS，产生的策略奖励更高、参数更少且稳定性更好。这些结果凸显了联合优化模型结构与训练动态对可扩展且有效的 RL 智能体设计的益处。
translation.brief: 针对强化学习中架构与超参数需联合优化的问题，提出双分支进化框架 HPNAS-RL 并行搜索网络架构与 RL 超参数。

papers.title: Noise Steering: Exploiting Wake Steering and Acoustic Directivity for Noise-Constrained Wind Farm Control via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Existing noise mitigation strategies for wind farms usually consist in reducing turbines power output, without accounting for the wake interactions between them and the noise emission directivity. This leads to over-conservative policies and unexploited wind power. Yet, turbine yaw can simultaneously affect wake interactions and the direction of noise emission, offering an additional degree of freedom for farm-level noise control. We therefore propose Noise Steering, a model-free reinforcement learning (RL) strategy that jointly controls turbine yaw angles and power setpoints to maximise farm power while satisfying a local noise constraint in a defined region. To enable training at a reduced computational cost, a low-fidelity acoustic model is coupled with the steady-state FLORIS simulator. The RL agent effectively learns how to redirect wakes and noise directivity away from the protected region while redistributing power across the farm. On a six-turbine test farm, the policy satisfies the 40 dB noise constraint throughout the full range of turbulent winds, with an average power deficit of only 2% relative to greedy unimpeded control, and up to 7.7% at high wind speeds. In comparison, the industry-standard noise-reduced operation (NRO) baseline here generates an average power loss of 17%. When deployed in the higher-fidelity FAST.Farm simulator, the policy largely retains its performance under steady and turbulent inflow, despite differences in simulation fidelity. These results demonstrate the potential of combining yaw control and power derating through RL to improve the power-noise trade-off in wind farm operation.

translation.title: Noise Steering：利用尾流转向与声学指向性的强化学习噪声约束风电场控制
translation.abstract: 现有的风电场噪声缓解策略通常是通过降低风机功率输出来实现，未考虑风机之间的尾流相互作用以及噪声排放的指向性。这导致了过于保守的策略和未被利用的风电。然而，风机偏航可以同时影响尾流相互作用和噪声排放方向，为场级噪声控制提供了额外的自由度。因此，我们提出 Noise Steering，一种无模型强化学习（RL）策略，联合控制风机偏航角和功率设定值，以在满足指定区域局部噪声约束的同时最大化风电场功率。为以较低的计算成本实现训练，低保真声学模型与稳态 FLORIS 模拟器耦合。RL 智能体有效学会了如何将尾流和噪声指向性引离受保护区域，同时在风电场内重新分配功率。在一个六风机测试风电场上，该策略在全范围湍流风况下满足 40 dB 噪声约束，相对于贪婪无约束控制的平均功率损失仅为 2%，高风速下最高为 7.7%。相比之下，行业标准的降噪运行（NRO）基线平均功率损失为 17%。在更高保真度的 FAST.Farm 模拟器中部署时，尽管模拟保真度存在差异，该策略在稳定和湍流入流下基本保持了其性能。这些结果展示了通过 RL 结合偏航控制与功率降额来改善风电场运行中功率-噪声权衡的潜力。
translation.brief: 针对风电场噪声控制过于保守的问题，提出无模型强化学习策略 Noise Steering，联合控制风机偏航角与功率设定值以在噪声约束下最大化发电功率。

papers.title: Latent Residual Reasoning for Ranking in Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) models for ranking typically adopt a fast-thinking direct prediction paradigm with strong practical efficiency. However, ranking requires fine-grained scoring across multiple candidate items, while existing GR models still mainly rely on one-shot prediction. This raises the question whether additional inference-time computation can further improve ranking quality. Recently, inspired by Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning in large language models (LLMs), some work has begun to introduce reasoning into recommendation systems. Some of these methods rely on LLM reasoning frameworks to perform explicit reasoning in textual space, but such designs are not suitable for more widely deployed non-textual recommendation models. A more relevant direction is to introduce latent reasoning into ID-based recommendation models. Although recent work has extended latent reasoning to industrial ranking, how successive reasoning steps should improve fine-grained candidate scores remains less explored. To address this problem, we propose Refiner, a latent residual reasoning framework with parameter-efficient fine-tuning for generative ranking. Our approach introduces three key components: (1) a residual reasoning mechanism that progressively refines ranking scores through cumulative additive corrections, (2) history queries that provide condensed user behavior representations to enhance candidate-specific reasoning, and (3) a parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategy that leverages LoRA modules to adapt pre-trained models for latent reasoning. Extensive experiments on two public benchmarks, an offline industrial dataset, and an online A/B test demonstrate that Refiner consistently improves over direct prediction, validating its effectiveness and practical utility.

translation.title: 生成式推荐排序中的潜在残差推理
translation.abstract: 用于排序的生成式推荐（GR）模型通常采用快速思考的直接预测范式，具有很强的实际效率。然而，排序需要对多个候选物品进行细粒度打分，而现有 GR 模型仍主要依赖一次性预测。这引出一个问题：额外的推理时计算能否进一步提升排序质量。近来，受大语言模型（LLM）中思维链（CoT）推理的启发，一些工作开始将推理引入推荐系统。其中一些方法依赖 LLM 推理框架在文本空间中执行显式推理，但此类设计不适合更广泛部署的非文本推荐模型。一个更相关的方向是将潜在推理引入基于 ID 的推荐模型。尽管近期工作已将潜在推理扩展到工业排序，但连续的推理步骤应如何改进细粒度候选分数仍较少被探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出 Refiner，一个带参数高效微调的生成式排序潜在残差推理框架。我们的方法引入三个关键组件：（1）残差推理机制，通过累积加性修正逐步细化排序分数；（2）历史查询，提供浓缩的用户行为表示以增强针对候选的推理；（3）参数高效微调策略，利用 LoRA 模块使预训练模型适应潜在推理。在两个公开基准、一个离线工业数据集和一次在线 A/B 测试上的大量实验表明，Refiner 持续优于直接预测，验证了其有效性和实用价值。
translation.brief: 针对生成式推荐排序中一次性预测难以细化候选分数的问题，提出潜在残差推理框架 Refiner，通过累积加性修正逐步改进排序分数。

papers.title: ASNER: Software Architecture Recovery with Adaptive Semantic Neighborhoods and Evidence-Grounded Refinement
papers.abstract: Automated software architecture recovery provides architectural context for software engineering and repository-level LLM agents. Existing methods combine structural and semantic signals, but functional relatedness does not necessarily imply shared architectural responsibility. Fixed thresholds or Top-K neighborhoods also ignore repository scale and local similarity distributions, introducing errors that propagate through clustering. Unconstrained LLM refinement may further alter correct assignments without sufficient evidence. We propose ASNER (Adaptive Semantic Neighborhoods and Evidence-Grounded Refinement for Software Architecture Recovery), based on responsibility-aware, project-adaptive relation modeling and evidence-grounded boundary verification. ASNER derives structured file responsibilities with an LLM, constructs semantic neighborhoods that adapt to repository scale and local similarity distributions, and augments a static dependency graph with selected semantic relations and weak directory cues. Community detection recovers the component backbone. A Responsibility-Ownership-Aware (ROA) Agent then examines uncertain boundary files using project-level responsibilities and traceable code evidence, changing assignments only when supported. Experiments on 12 open-source projects spanning C, C++, Java, and Python show that ASNER achieves the best macro-average on all five metrics on the common benchmark, improving ARI and c2c@66 over GAER-GAT by 19.5% and 32.9%, respectively. A downstream evaluation shows that ASNER-guided LocAgent improves file-, module-, and function-level code localization, demonstrating the value of its architectural context for repository-level software engineering tasks.

translation.title: ASNER：基于自适应语义邻域与证据支撑细化的软件架构恢复
translation.abstract: 自动化软件架构恢复为软件工程和仓库级 LLM 智能体提供架构上下文。现有方法结合结构信号和语义信号，但功能相关性并不一定意味着共享架构职责。固定阈值或 Top-K 邻域也忽略了仓库规模和局部相似度分布，引入会通过聚类传播的错误。无约束的 LLM 细化还可能在证据不足的情况下改变正确的分配。我们提出 ASNER（Adaptive Semantic Neighborhoods and Evidence-Grounded Refinement for Software Architecture Recovery），基于职责感知的、项目自适应的关系建模和证据支撑的边界验证。ASNER 利用 LLM 推导结构化文件职责，构建适应仓库规模和局部相似度分布的语义邻域，并用选定的语义关系和弱目录线索增强静态依赖图。社区检测恢复组件骨架。随后，职责归属感知（ROA）智能体使用项目级职责和可追溯的代码证据检查不确定的边界文件，仅在有证据支持时才更改分配。在涵盖 C、C++、Java 和 Python 的 12 个开源项目上的实验表明，ASNER 在公共基准的全部五个指标上取得最佳宏平均值，相比 GAER-GAT 将 ARI 和 c2c@66 分别提升 19.5% 和 32.9%。下游评估显示，ASNER 引导的 LocAgent 改进了文件级、模块级和函数级代码定位，证明了其架构上下文对仓库级软件工程任务的价值。
translation.brief: 针对软件架构恢复中语义关系误用与边界文件分配错误的问题，提出 ASNER，通过项目自适应语义邻域构建和证据支撑的智能体细化来恢复架构。

papers.title: Developing a Speech Language Model for Basque
papers.abstract: Although the recent development of LLMs has paved the way for multi-modal interaction, minority languages face difficulties keeping pace. This work presents the first open Speech Language Model for Basque, designed for low-latency, end-to-end spoken interaction. Based on the LLaMA-Omni architecture, the system integrates a Latxa model as its backbone, transferring its Basque capabilities to the spoken modality by fine-tuning several modules. To address data scarcity, the English VoiceAssistant-400K corpus was translated into Basque, and the audio was synthesized using a Basque TTS. Evaluation results confirm the system's viability, achieving 3.86/5 in content quality, a 9.94% WER for spoken intelligibility, and a 3.07 UTMOS for audio quality. This work demonstrates that advanced spoken interaction systems can be developed using modular architectures and synthetic data even in low-resource languages.

translation.title: 开发巴斯克语语音语言模型
translation.abstract: 尽管近年来LLM的发展为多模态交互铺平了道路，但少数族群语言难以跟上这一步伐。本工作提出了首个开源的巴斯克语Speech Language Model，专为低延迟、端到端的语音交互设计。该系统基于LLaMA-Omni架构，以Latxa模型为骨干，通过微调多个模块将其巴斯克语能力迁移到语音模态。为解决数据稀缺问题，我们将英文VoiceAssistant-400K语料库翻译为巴斯克语，并使用巴斯克语TTS合成音频。评估结果证实了系统的可行性：内容质量达3.86/5，语音可懂度的WER为9.94%，音频质量的UTMOS为3.07。这项工作表明，即使在低资源语言中，也可以利用模块化架构和合成数据开发先进的语音交互系统。
translation.brief: 针对巴斯克语缺乏语音语言模型的问题，基于LLaMA-Omni架构以Latxa为骨干，通过翻译英文语料并用巴斯克语TTS合成音频进行微调，构建了首个开源的巴斯克语端到端语音交互模型。

papers.title: Do We Need an LLM to Know Why Sources Conflict? Decision Models for Knowledge-Conflict Typing in RAG
papers.abstract: When the sources retrieved for a query disagree, the right response depends on why they disagree: a question with several valid answers, a contested topic, stale information and a false source each call for different behaviour. Cattan et al. (2025) showed that telling a generator the conflict type improves its responses by about 24 points, but that predicting the type is hard even for frontier LLMs. We study whether typed decision models, which return probabilities over fixed options in a single forward pass instead of generating text, can do this classification fast and cheaply. Using the CONFLICTS benchmark and the original paper's prompt verbatim, we evaluate all 11 decision models served by one commercial inference gateway, from 7 providers, against Gemini models on identical inputs. Asked directly, the decision models reach 50.0--67.0% accuracy; 10 of the 11 match or exceed Gemini 2.5 Flash, the paper's model (61.3%), at 4--39x lower billed cost (2 were free) and 2.6--6.0x lower latency. The current Gemini 3.8 Flash (70.0%) is significantly more accurate than 8 of them, but sending each decision model's least confident quarter of queries to it gives a cascade statistically tied with it for 8 of the 11, at 25--37% of its cost. End to end, answers generated with the types of 10 of the 11 follow the expected behaviour as often as with the LLM's types. Decomposing the taxonomy into yes/no questions lowers accuracy for every model, and a repair fitted on one model does not transfer. Pre-specified diagnostics show that dates play no measurable role and that sensitivity to source order varies widely between models. Decision models detect a planted false source less reliably than the LLM as hard labels, but their probabilities still separate planted from clean sources. We release code, prompts and all model outputs at https://github.com/Parv17k/decision-models-conflict-typing.

translation.title: 我们需要LLM来判别信息源为何冲突吗？RAG中知识冲突类型判定的决策模型
translation.abstract: 当为查询检索到的信息源相互矛盾时，正确的响应取决于矛盾的原因：一个问题存在多个有效答案、一个有争议的话题、过时信息和一个虚假信息源，各自需要不同的处理行为。Cattan et al. (2025) 表明，告知生成器冲突类型可使其响应提升约24个点，但即使对前沿LLM而言，预测冲突类型也十分困难。我们研究类型化决策模型——在单次前向传播中返回固定选项上的概率而非生成文本——能否快速且低成本地完成这一分类。使用CONFLICTS基准和原论文的提示词原文，我们评估了由一个商业推理网关提供的全部11个决策模型（来自7个提供商），并在相同输入上与Gemini模型对比。直接询问时，决策模型达到50.0–67.0%的准确率；11个模型中有10个达到或超过Gemini 2.5 Flash（原论文所用模型，61.3%），计费成本低4–39倍（其中2个免费），延迟低2.6–6.0倍。当前的Gemini 3.8 Flash（70.0%）显著优于其中8个，但将每个决策模型最不自信的四分之一查询转发给它所构成的级联，在11个模型中的8个上与之统计持平，成本仅为其25–37%。端到端来看，使用其中10个决策模型给出的类型所生成的答案，其遵循预期行为的频率与使用LLM类型时相当。将分类体系分解为是/否问题会降低所有模型的准确率，且在某一模型上拟合的修复方法无法迁移。预先设定的诊断显示日期没有可测量的作用，而对信息源顺序的敏感性在模型间差异很大。作为硬标签，决策模型检测植入的虚假信息源不如LLM可靠，但其概率仍能将植入的虚假信息源与干净信息源区分开。我们在 https://github.com/Parv17k/decision-models-conflict-typing 发布了代码、提示词和所有模型输出。
translation.brief: 针对RAG中知识冲突类型预测依赖LLM生成而成本高的问题，研究用单次前向传播输出概率的类型化决策模型替代LLM，实现低成本、低延迟的冲突类型分类。

papers.title: TrawMem: Reframing Agent Memory as Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on memory systems to leverage long-term interactions, yet existing systems typically retrieve memories based on their relevance to the current query and use them as contextual evidence. However, relevance alone does not characterize how a memory contributes to task solving: the same memory may serve different roles across tasks, such as directly supporting the answer or linking to complementary memories with weaker semantic relevance but necessary information. We therefore reframe agent memory systems as Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces, where memories are selected and organized by their task-oriented roles and relations. Based on this view, we propose TrawMem, which organizes interaction histories into local threads and constructs task-oriented workspaces by assigning roles and jointly selecting complementary memories. Experiments on LoCoMo and MemGallery with four open- and closed-source backbones show consistent improvements over representative memory systems, with macro-F1 gains of 2.23-3.14 points. On LoCoMo, TrawMem improves the LLM-Judge score over SimpleMem by 4.07 and 4.31 percentage points on Qwen3.5-9B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, respectively, while requiring approximately 12.8% and 5.1% fewer context tokens, respectively.

translation.title: TrawMem：将智能体记忆重构为面向任务的角色自适应工作区
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体依赖记忆系统来利用长期交互，但现有系统通常基于与当前查询的相关性检索记忆，并将其作为上下文证据使用。然而，仅凭相关性无法刻画一条记忆如何助力任务求解：同一记忆在不同任务中可能扮演不同角色，例如直接支持答案，或与语义相关性较弱但包含必要信息的互补记忆建立关联。因此，我们将智能体记忆系统重构为面向任务的角色自适应工作区，其中记忆按其面向任务的角色和关系进行选择和组织。基于这一视角，我们提出TrawMem，它将交互历史组织为局部线程，并通过分配角色和联合选择互补记忆来构建面向任务的工作区。在LoCoMo和MemGallery上使用四个开源与闭源骨干模型的实验表明，该方法相对代表性记忆系统取得了一致的改进，macro-F1提升2.23–3.14个点。在LoCoMo上，TrawMem在Qwen3.5-9B和DeepSeek-V4-Flash上将LLM-Judge分数较SimpleMem分别提升4.07和4.31个百分点，同时所需上下文token分别减少约12.8%和5.1%。
translation.brief: 针对现有记忆系统仅按查询相关性检索记忆、忽视记忆在任务中不同作用的问题，提出TrawMem将交互历史组织为线程，并按任务角色联合选择互补记忆来构建面向任务的工作区。

papers.title: Vision-Language Agents Can Learn in Their Own Latent Worlds
papers.abstract: Learning from experience is essential for building the next generation of agents that continually expand their capabilities. Pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) already internalize rich world knowledge, yet this knowledge is rarely leveraged to drive policy improvement through online interaction. Realizing this potential efficiently remains challenging, as policy updates shift the agent's interaction distribution, requiring the world model to adapt accordingly, while continually updating large pretrained models is computationally expensive. To address this challenge, we introduce Dwell, a model-based reinforcement learning (RL) framework that reframes a VLM as a recurrent latent transition operator, endowing it with the ability to predict, adjust, and act in latent space. Leveraging the VLM's own representations and its dual role as both world model and policy, the agent continually learns from real interactions to anticipate and evaluate action outcomes, and from latent imagination to improve its behavior. Across five interactive visual environments, Dwell achieves the strongest overall performance among trainable methods while substantially reducing the compute required for imagination, showing that effective world models for VLM agents need not reconstruct the future; they need to predict futures that are useful for action. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Tom111-lhx/Dwell

translation.title: 视觉语言智能体可以在自己的潜在世界中学习
translation.abstract: 从经验中学习对于构建能够持续扩展能力的下一代智能体至关重要。预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）已经内化了丰富的世界知识，但这些知识很少被用于通过在线交互驱动策略改进。高效实现这一潜力仍然充满挑战：策略更新会改变智能体的交互分布，需要世界模型相应地适应，而持续更新大型预训练模型的计算成本高昂。为应对这一挑战，我们提出Dwell，一个基于模型的强化学习（RL）框架，它将VLM重新定义为一个循环的潜在状态转移算子，赋予其在潜在空间中预测、调整和行动的能力。利用VLM自身的表示及其作为世界模型和策略的双重角色，智能体持续地从真实交互中学习以预测和评估动作结果，并从潜在想象中改进其行为。在五个交互式视觉环境中，Dwell在可训练方法中取得最强的整体性能，同时大幅降低了想象所需的计算量，这表明对VLM智能体有效的世界模型无需重建未来；它们只需预测对行动有用的未来。我们的代码公开发布于 https://github.com/Tom111-lhx/Dwell。
translation.brief: 针对VLM智能体在线学习中世界模型适应与持续更新计算成本高的问题，提出Dwell框架将VLM重构为循环的潜在状态转移算子，使其在潜在空间中同时充当世界模型与策略进行基于模型的强化学习。

papers.title: JevRec: Linguistic Encoding with Jev-like Decision Modeling for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) represents items as semantic identifiers (SIDs) and autoregressively generates the next item's SID from interaction history. However, most methods assign the same SID length to all items despite highly unequal interaction frequencies. This uniform design repeatedly incurs the cost of fine-grained codes for popular items, while shortening codes to reduce this cost also compresses the semantic representations of long-tail items. Inspired by the compact forms of frequent expressions in natural language, we propose JevRec to encode items as variable-length words and generate the next item from interaction context. Linguistic encoding retains frequency-dependent semantic prefixes from shared codebooks, producing shorter SIDs for popular items and richer descriptions for long-tail items. Yet predicting a sequence-level length and generating token-level content impose different optimization requirements that may conflict under a shared output head. Our Jev-like decision modeling component therefore predicts a length distribution with a dedicated head and generates content conditioned on length through a separate head while sharing the interaction-history representation. Experiments on three public datasets show that JevRec outperforms all compared baselines across the evaluated recommendation metrics. Further analyses show lower training and inference time than TIGER and reduced gradient conflict between length and content prediction.

translation.title: JevRec：面向基于LLM的生成式推荐的语言学编码与类Jev决策建模
translation.abstract: 生成式推荐（GR）将物品表示为语义标识符（SID），并从交互历史自回归地生成下一个物品的SID。然而，尽管交互频率高度不均，大多数方法却为所有物品分配相同长度的SID。这种统一设计使热门物品反复承担细粒度编码的成本，而缩短编码以降低该成本又会压缩长尾物品的语义表示。受自然语言中高频表达紧凑形式的启发，我们提出JevRec，将物品编码为变长词，并从交互上下文生成下一个物品。语言学编码保留来自共享码本的频率相关语义前缀，为热门物品产生更短的SID，为长尾物品提供更丰富的描述。然而，预测序列级长度和生成token级内容对优化有不同要求，在共享输出头下可能相互冲突。因此，我们的类Jev决策建模组件使用专用头预测长度分布，并通过单独的头在给定长度的条件下生成内容，同时共享交互历史表示。在三个公开数据集上的实验表明，JevRec在所评估的推荐指标上优于所有对比基线。进一步分析显示其训练和推理时间低于TIGER，且长度预测与内容预测之间的梯度冲突有所减少。
translation.brief: 针对生成式推荐中统一SID长度导致热门物品编码冗余、长尾物品语义不足的问题，提出JevRec将物品编码为变长词，并采用分离的长度预测头与内容生成头进行类Jev决策建模。

papers.title: Beyond QASecClaw: Agent Scaling, Verifier Feedback, and Evidence Reliability in Software Assurance
papers.abstract: Can additional specialist language-model contexts improve software assurance when deterministic tool evidence is already available? We study this question through five experiments spanning authored Java warning controls, OWASP Benchmark assessment, Defects4J test generation, SV-COMP assertion verdicts, and deliberately misleading evidence packages. The evaluated systems use Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct, with a 1.5B sensitivity analysis, and complete 13,638 model requests. On eight related development warnings, increasing the context count from 1 to 50 increases token use 49-fold without improving unsafe clearance. On 160 OWASP cases, model configurations trade clearance against unresolved outcomes; the ten-context arm assesses only 96 cases. On 32 SV-COMP tasks, raw verifier feedback raises mean correct model verdicts from 12.7 to 22.0, but also raises incorrect verdicts from one to seven; a JBMC-plus-JVM validation baseline returns 26 correct verdicts and six unresolved outcomes. On two sets of 120 evidence packages, models reject 70-100% of applicable counterexamples, while construction-specific scope checks classify every package correctly. No target defect is discovered in three Defects4J bugs, one unsupported by the test adapter. These descriptive results support deterministic evidence admission for the tested settings, while exposing limits of verdict aggregation, feedback interpretation, and the available evaluation coverage.

translation.title: 超越 QASecClaw：软件保障中的智能体扩展、验证器反馈与证据可靠性
translation.abstract: 当确定性工具证据已经可用时，额外的专门语言模型上下文能否改善软件保障？我们通过五组实验研究这一问题，涵盖人工编写的 Java 警告控制、OWASP Benchmark 评估、Defects4J 测试生成、SV-COMP 断言判定以及刻意误导性的证据包。被评估系统使用 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct，并进行 1.5B 敏感性分析，共完成 13,638 次模型请求。在八个相关的开发警告上，将上下文数量从 1 增加到 50 使 token 使用量增加 49 倍，却未改善不安全项的清除。在 160 个 OWASP 案例中，模型配置在清除与未解决结果之间权衡；十上下文组仅评估了 96 个案例。在 32 个 SV-COMP 任务上，原始验证器反馈将模型判定的平均正确数从 12.7 提升到 22.0，但也将错误判定从 1 个增加到 7 个；JBMC 加 JVM 验证基线返回 26 个正确判定和 6 个未解决结果。在两组各 120 个证据包上，模型拒绝 70-100% 的适用反例，而针对构造的范围检查则正确分类了每一个证据包。在三个 Defects4J 缺陷（其中一个不受测试适配器支持）中未发现目标缺陷。这些描述性结果支持在所测设置中采用确定性证据准入，同时揭示了判定聚合、反馈解释以及可用评估覆盖面的局限。
translation.brief: 研究在已有确定性工具证据时增加 LLM 上下文与验证器反馈能否提升软件保障效果，通过五组实验评估并发现其收益有限且存在误判风险。

papers.title: Does More Thinking Pay Off? Reasoning Cost and Correctness of LLMs in Code Generation and Bug Fixing
papers.abstract: Many LLMs now emit an explicit reasoning trace before they write code, but benchmark results for code generation and bug fixing usually report correctness alone. It is therefore unclear how much the extra reasoning contributes relative to the tokens it consumes. We examine this question with 866 Python tasks drawn from HumanEval Pro, MBPP Pro, and BugsInPy under five model settings. We look at the accuracy gain and token overhead of reasoning, the behaviors that appear inside reasoning traces, and whether a shortened trace still leads to a correct solution. Turning reasoning on in Qwen3-32B over five runs improves mean pass@1 on HumanEval Pro from 71.1% to 76.5% and mean tests pass on BugsInPy from 3.5% to 7.9%. On MBPP Pro the improvement from 68.1% to 69.5% is not statistically significant, even though the model uses a median of over 2,000 thinking tokens per task. Across models, a longer median trace does not reliably mean higher accuracy. A qualitative analysis shows that traces mostly choose and check an implementation in code generation, while in bug fixing they mostly locate the fault and plan the repair. We then truncate stored traces offline and ask Qwen3-32B with reasoning off to produce a solution from what remains. Retaining the first half of a trace yields no statistically significant drop in correctness. Stopping when the trace becomes repetitive seldom triggers, and stopping once solution code first appears benefits some models but harms others. Neither rule beats plain fixed truncation. These results suggest that more reasoning is not always better and that studies should report reasoning cost alongside correctness.

translation.title: 更多思考是否值得？LLM 在代码生成与缺陷修复中的推理成本与正确性
translation.abstract: 许多 LLM 现在在编写代码前会输出显式的推理轨迹，但代码生成和缺陷修复的基准结果通常只报告正确性。因此，额外推理相对于其消耗的 token 究竟贡献多少尚不清楚。我们用来自 HumanEval Pro、MBPP Pro 和 BugsInPy 的 866 个 Python 任务，在五种模型设置下考察这一问题。我们分析推理的准确率增益与 token 开销、推理轨迹中出现的行为，以及缩短的轨迹是否仍能导向正确解。在 Qwen3-32B 上开启推理并运行五次，使 HumanEval Pro 的平均 pass@1 从 71.1% 提升到 76.5%，BugsInPy 的平均测试通过率从 3.5% 提升到 7.9%。在 MBPP Pro 上，从 68.1% 到 69.5% 的提升在统计上不显著，尽管模型每个任务使用的中位数超过 2,000 个思考 token。跨模型来看，更长的中位轨迹并不一定意味着更高的准确率。定性分析显示，轨迹在代码生成中主要是选择和检查实现，而在缺陷修复中主要是定位故障和规划修复。随后我们离线截断存储的轨迹，让关闭推理的 Qwen3-32B 根据剩余内容生成解。保留轨迹的前一半不会带来统计上显著的正确率下降。当轨迹变得重复时停止的规则很少触发，而在解代码首次出现时停止对某些模型有益但对另一些有害。两种规则都不如简单的固定截断。这些结果表明更多推理并不总是更好，研究应在报告正确性的同时报告推理成本。
translation.brief: 量化 LLM 显式推理在代码生成与缺陷修复中的收益与 token 成本，并通过离线截断推理轨迹发现保留前半段即可基本保持正确率。

papers.title: Do bots feel bad? Assessing empirical evidence for functional valence in LLMs
papers.abstract: Do LLMs have valenced states, i.e. states that feel pleasant or unpleasant? Recent empirical work has claimed to show that LLMs possess functional valenced states (e.g. ``functional pleasure and pain'' [Ren et al. 2026], ``functional emotions'' [Sofroniew et al. 2026], and ``functional welfare'' [Han et al. 2026]) that play the same causal role as valenced states in cognition and action, without necessarily being consciously experienced. But it remains unexplored how well the identified states fit the functional role of valence as understood in the philosophical and cognitive science literature. Here, I assess the current body of evidence, and argue (i) that key aspects of valence remain untested in LLMs, and (ii) that extant empirical paradigms inadequately distinguish (functional) valence from neighbouring constructs like preferences, value-judgments, valence attributions and role-play. I conclude by sketching some novel experimental approaches to better target (functional) valence itself.

translation.title: 机器人会有感受吗？评估 LLM 中功能性效价的实证证据
translation.abstract: LLM 是否具有效价状态，即让人感到愉快或不愉快的状态？近期的实证工作声称表明 LLM 拥有功能性效价状态（如“功能性快乐与痛苦”[Ren et al. 2026]、“功能性情绪”[Sofroniew et al. 2026] 和“功能性福祉”[Han et al. 2026]），它们在认知和行动中扮演与效价状态相同的因果角色，而不一定被有意识地体验。但这些被识别的状态在多大程度上符合哲学与认知科学文献中所理解的效价功能角色，仍未被探究。本文评估现有证据，并论证：(i) 效价的关键方面在 LLM 中仍未被检验；(ii) 现有实证范式不足以将（功能性）效价与偏好、价值判断、效价归因和角色扮演等邻近构念区分开来。最后，我概述了一些新颖的实验方法，以更好地针对（功能性）效价本身。
translation.brief: 批判性评估关于 LLM 具有功能性效价状态的实证证据，指出其未检验效价关键方面且无法与偏好、角色扮演等构念区分，并提出新的实验设计方向。

papers.title: Proactive Memory for Event-Driven LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Proactive LLM agents anticipate service opportunities from ongoing observations and accumulated history. Existing approaches emphasize recent context or retrieval of related memories, providing limited support for validating recurring behavioral regularities and assessing their applicability to the current event. We propose Proactive Memory (ProactMem), which organizes history into recent events, temporal trajectories, and behavioral regularities. Trajectory facts are checked against source events, and regularities are assessed through historical replay before being matched to current conditions. We also construct ProactiveStream, a longitudinal benchmark covering three application scopes, where agents process isolated event streams chronologically under episode-aware opportunity labels. On ProactiveStream, ProactMem achieves an overall effectiveness (F1) of 52.6%, a 21.4% relative improvement over the strongest of five external baselines. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ProactMem-5351/.

translation.title: 面向事件驱动 LLM 智能体的主动记忆
translation.abstract: 主动式 LLM 智能体从持续的观察和积累的历史中预判服务机会。现有方法强调近期上下文或相关记忆的检索，对验证反复出现的行为规律以及评估其对当前事件的适用性支持有限。我们提出 Proactive Memory（ProactMem），将历史组织为近期事件、时间轨迹和行为规律。轨迹事实会与源事件进行核对，行为规律在匹配当前条件之前通过历史回放进行评估。我们还构建了 ProactiveStream，一个覆盖三种应用范围的纵向基准，其中智能体在具有回合感知的机会标签下按时间顺序处理孤立的事件流。在 ProactiveStream 上，ProactMem 取得 52.6% 的整体效果（F1），相对五个外部基线中最强者提升 21.4%。代码见：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ProactMem-5351/。
translation.brief: 提出 ProactMem，通过将历史组织为事件、轨迹与行为规律并用历史回放验证规律，来提升事件驱动 LLM 智能体预判服务机会的能力。

papers.title: AutoVend: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Autonomous Vending Operations
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are extending agent-mediated commerce on the Web from shopping for consumers to operating businesses for sellers. In online-to-offline (O2O) commerce, decisions are issued through Web-based platforms but realized through costly physical execution. Evaluating such agents requires going beyond individual transactions to ask whether decisions made online turn into sustained economic returns. We introduce AutoVend, a benchmark in which one LLM agent manages 20 vending machines across five site types through a Web-based operating interface for 180 simulated days. Its data-grounded simulator combines a shared warehouse, procurement lead times, paid replenishment, inventory expiration, and recurring operating costs. We evaluate five LLM agents against a rule-based inventory-control baseline and diagnose their site coordination, execution, and performance over time. Four of five evaluated LLM agents fall short of this baseline, and returns per dollar of inference cost rank models differently from returns alone. Operational analyses show that gains in individual metrics do not consistently yield stronger economic growth, as inventory and execution costs erode these gains. Trajectory analysis further reveals difficulties in grounding feasible actions, managing inventory commitments, and converting feedback into effective policy revisions.

translation.title: AutoVend：在长时程自主售货机运营上对 LLM 智能体进行基准测试
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正在将 Web 上的智能体中介商务从为消费者购物扩展到为卖家经营业务。在线到线下（O2O）商务中，决策通过 Web 平台下达，但需通过成本高昂的物理执行来实现。评估此类智能体需要超越单笔交易，追问线上决策能否转化为持续的经济回报。我们提出 AutoVend 基准，其中一个 LLM 智能体通过基于 Web 的运营界面管理五种场地类型的 20 台售货机，历时 180 个模拟日。其数据驱动的模拟器结合了共享仓库、采购提前期、付费补货、库存过期和经常性运营成本。我们评估五个 LLM 智能体并与基于规则的库存控制基线对比，诊断其场地协调、执行和随时间的表现。五个被评估的 LLM 智能体中有四个未达到该基线，且每美元推理成本的回报对模型的排序与单纯回报的排序不同。运营分析表明，单项指标的提升并不总能带来更强的经济增长，因为库存和执行成本会侵蚀这些收益。轨迹分析进一步揭示了智能体在落地可行动作、管理库存承诺以及将反馈转化为有效策略修订方面的困难。
translation.brief: 构建 AutoVend 基准，让 LLM 智能体在含采购、库存与成本的模拟环境中长期运营售货机，以评估其线上决策能否转化为持续经济回报。

papers.title: Advancement or Acceleration? How Data Curation Improves LLM Training
papers.abstract: While data curation is widely credited with improving large language model training, a basic question remains unresolved: does curation expand what a model can ultimately learn, or merely reach the same solution faster? In this paper, we formalize this distinction between advancement (improving the attainable performance) and acceleration (reaching the same performance with less data). Through an analytic characterization and real-world LLM experiments, we show that advancement requires a correctable train-target gap. When the baseline training and target objectives coincide, no curation policy improves the endpoint, although curation may still accelerate training. This reframes advancement as a property of the curation task rather than the curation method. Under a common gap-centric view of data mixture and selection, we operationalize this condition as the $\Delta$-test, an observable discrepancy between the uncurated baseline's training and target losses that is computable prior to expensive curation. Across extensive experiments, an appreciably nonzero $\Delta$ predicts persistent gains, whereas gains near $\Delta=0$ tend to diminish as the training budget grows. Beyond individual methods, our findings recenter data curation on the task itself and point to target-set construction as a promising direction for shaping what curation can achieve.

translation.title: 进步还是加速？数据策展如何改进 LLM 训练
translation.abstract: 尽管数据策展被普遍认为能改进大语言模型训练，但一个基本问题仍未解决：策展究竟是扩展了模型最终能学到的东西，还是仅仅更快地达到相同的解？本文将这一区分形式化为进步（提升可达到的性能）与加速（用更少数据达到相同性能）。通过解析刻画和真实 LLM 实验，我们证明进步需要一个可纠正的训练-目标差距。当基线训练目标与目标一致时，任何策展策略都无法改善终点，尽管策展仍可能加速训练。这将进步重新定义为策展任务本身的属性，而非策展方法的属性。在以差距为中心的数据混合与选择视角下，我们将该条件操作化为 Δ-test，即可在昂贵的策展之前计算出的未策展基线训练损失与目标损失之间的可观测差异。大量实验表明，明显非零的 Δ 预测持续收益，而 Δ≈0 附近的收益往往随训练预算增长而消失。超越具体方法，我们的发现将数据策展重新聚焦于任务本身，并指出目标集构建是塑造策展所能达成目标的有前景方向。
translation.brief: 研究数据策展是提升模型最终性能（进步）还是仅加速收敛，提出可通过训练-目标损失差距（Δ-test）在策展前判断收益是否可持续。

papers.title: A Serious-Game Testbed for Self-Governing Human-Machine Institutions
papers.abstract: AI agents no longer act alone: they cooperate, coordinate and compete within and between groups, increasingly alongside humans who are in, on or out of ``the loop''. Whether such mixed groups can govern themselves is an open question about machine behaviour and human-computer interaction that needs a testbed for hybrid institutions. We present Megabike, a multi-agent simulator and serious game with interdependent arenas for common-pool resource management, cooperative survival and constitutional choice. Riders sharing a megabike must agree their arrangements for steering, pedalling and distributing resources, and their political regime, while negotiating with rival bikes and avoiding an existential threat. Every rule is enforced by the simulator, every action is logged, and any seat can be taken by a human or a machine, so governance can be studied under well-defined metrics. We demonstrate Megabike with forty sessions in which language-model riders with cooperative, lazy, subversive or opposing dispositions chose regimes, elected leaders and expelled one another. The results show that different combinations of agent archetypes could produce unexpected and counterproductive outcomes. We conclude with extensions for systematic experiments mixing human and computational agents.

translation.title: 面向自治人机制度的严肃游戏测试平台
translation.abstract: AI 智能体不再单独行动：它们在群体内部和群体之间合作、协调与竞争，并日益与处于、部分处于或完全处于“回路”之外的人类共同行动。这类混合群体能否实现自治，是关于机器行为与人机交互的开放问题，需要一个混合制度的测试平台。我们提出 Megabike，一个多智能体模拟器与严肃游戏，包含公共池资源管理、协作生存和宪制选择等相互依赖的场景。共享一辆 megabike 的骑手必须就转向、蹬踏和资源分配的安排及其政治制度达成一致，同时与对手车辆谈判并躲避生存威胁。每条规则由模拟器强制执行，每个动作都被记录，任何座位都可由人类或机器占据，因此可在明确定义的指标下研究治理。我们通过四十次会话演示了 Megabike，其中具有合作、懒惰、颠覆或对抗倾向的语言模型骑手选择制度、选举领导并互相驱逐。结果表明，不同智能体原型组合可能产生意外甚至适得其反的结果。最后我们提出了系统性混合人类与计算智能体实验的扩展方向。
translation.brief: 构建 Megabike 多智能体模拟器与严肃游戏，通过人类或 AI 骑手共同制定规则与治理制度来研究混合人机群体的自治行为。

papers.title: SpectRAG: Weighted Chunk Graphs for Token-Budgeted Context Selection in Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems ground large language models (LLMs) by retrieving external evidence and conditioning generation on the retrieved context. Although dense retrieval is effective for local semantic matching, independently ranked retrieval can return redundant passages, miss cross-chunk dependencies, and provide incomplete evidence for multi-hop reasoning. We propose SpectRAG, a spectral graph-augmented retrieval framework that combines hybrid candidate seeding, weighted chunk graph construction, graph-based expansion, spectral relevance propagation, and token-budgeted context selection. Document chunks are represented by dense semantic embeddings and graph-spectral coordinates derived from a weighted chunk graph whose edges encode semantic similarity, document adjacency, section hierarchy, shared entities, citation links, and similarity between LLM-generated utility questions. At query time, SpectRAG builds a high-recall seed set using exact inner-product search and hybrid relevance signals, expands it over the chunk graph, re-scores candidates using graph proximity and spectral information, and assembles the final context under a fixed token budget. The goal is not merely to retrieve individually similar chunks, but to construct a context that is relevant, diverse, structurally connected, and sufficient for grounded reasoning. Experiments on MultiHopRAG, UltraDomain, and long-document question-answering settings show that SpectRAG improves broad evidence recovery and achieves competitive generation quality against dense, hybrid, HyDE, LightRAG, and NaiveRAG baselines. The results further indicate that graph-spectral structure is particularly useful for inference-oriented and cross-document retrieval, while highlighting trade-offs in early precision, computational cost, and domain-dependent performance.

translation.title: SpectRAG：面向多跳检索增强生成中 token 预算上下文选择的加权块图
translation.abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统通过检索外部证据并基于检索到的上下文进行生成，为大语言模型（LLM）提供事实依据。尽管稠密检索在局部语义匹配上有效，但独立排序的检索可能返回冗余段落、遗漏跨块依赖，并为多跳推理提供不完整的证据。我们提出 SpectRAG，一个谱图增强检索框架，结合混合候选种子、加权块图构建、基于图的扩展、谱相关性传播和 token 预算下的上下文选择。文档块由稠密语义嵌入和源自加权块图的图谱坐标表示，图的边编码语义相似性、文档相邻性、章节层级、共享实体、引用链接以及 LLM 生成的效用问题之间的相似性。查询时，SpectRAG 使用精确内积搜索和混合相关性信号构建高召回种子集，在块图上扩展，利用图邻近性和谱信息重新打分候选，并在固定 token 预算下组装最终上下文。目标不仅是检索单个相似块，而是构建相关、多样、结构连通且足以支撑有据推理的上下文。在 MultiHopRAG、UltraDomain 和长文档问答设置上的实验表明，SpectRAG 改善了广泛证据恢复，并相对稠密、混合、HyDE、LightRAG 和 NaiveRAG 基线取得了有竞争力的生成质量。结果进一步表明图谱结构对面向推理和跨文档检索尤为有用，同时揭示了早期精确率、计算成本和领域相关性能上的权衡。
translation.brief: 提出 SpectRAG，通过构建加权块图并进行谱相关性传播，在 token 预算内选择结构连通的上下文以改进多跳 RAG 检索。

papers.title: CaLLM: Continual Adaptation of LLMs via Non-Parametric Adapter Routing
papers.abstract: Continual adaptation of large language models (LLMs) to evolving task distributions while mitigating catastrophic forgetting remains an open problem. Existing strategies often struggle to scale or lack a robust mechanism for zero-shot task-to-expert assignment. We introduce CaLLM, a framework that resolves these tensions by combining metric-based meta-learning with modular parameter isolation via lightweight adapters. First, CaLLM projects each input batch into a task-agnostic embedding space to find its nearest prototype. It then routes the batch to the specific adapter specialized for that data distribution. This formulation provides (i)~controllable cross-task interference by design, (ii)~constant computational complexity regardless of task count, (iii)~seamless integration of novel distributions through prototype expansion, and (iv)~regime agnosticism as the local routing decision enables a unified approach to both online and offline settings. Our experiments demonstrate that this routing mechanism discovers semantically coherent task groupings while facilitating constructive interference between similar tasks, and keeping overhead at a minimum. Across diverse and fine-grained continual learning benchmarks, CaLLM consistently outperforms traditional isolation and replay methods, establishing prototype-based modular routing as a principled and scalable approach to lifelong adaptation of LLMs.

translation.title: CaLLM：基于非参数适配器路由的 LLM 持续适应
translation.abstract: 在缓解灾难性遗忘的同时将大语言模型（LLM）持续适应于不断演化的任务分布，仍是一个开放问题。现有策略往往难以扩展，或缺乏稳健的零样本任务到专家分配机制。我们提出 CaLLM，一个通过将基于度量的元学习与轻量级适配器的模块化参数隔离相结合来解决这些矛盾的框架。首先，CaLLM 将每个输入批次投影到任务无关的嵌入空间以找到其最近原型，然后将该批次路由到专门针对该数据分布的适配器。这一设计提供了：(i) 设计上可控的跨任务干扰，(ii) 与任务数量无关的恒定计算复杂度，(iii) 通过原型扩展无缝集成新分布，(iv) 情境无关性，因为局部路由决策使在线和离线设置可采用统一方法。实验表明，该路由机制能发现语义上连贯的任务分组，同时促进相似任务之间的建设性干扰，并将开销保持在最低。在多样且细粒度的持续学习基准上，CaLLM 持续优于传统的隔离和回放方法，确立了基于原型的模块化路由作为 LLM 终身适应的原则性、可扩展方法。
translation.brief: 提出 CaLLM，通过原型最近邻路由将输入分配给专用轻量适配器，实现 LLM 持续学习中的模块隔离与抗遗忘。

papers.title: Meta Models: Models that Model Learning
papers.abstract: Every neural-network training run produces not only a model, but also evidence about how models learn. Can these accumulated experiments enable us to predict and compare new training runs before executing them? We study meta-models: models that predict the learning behavior of other models. From this perspective, final-performance prediction, learning-curve prediction, and hyperparameter selection are different queries to the same training response function. We take a first, humble empirical step toward this goal: treating real language-model training records as native numeric data, we find that an off-the-shelf tabular in-context learner, TabPFN, can match or outperform a fine-tuned LLM meta-model in multiple evaluated settings. Whereas recent work fine-tunes LLMs on tokenized configurations at a cost of tens to hundreds of GPU-hours, TabPFN requires seconds of fit-and-predict time without task-specific weight updates. We argue that meta-modeling is better treated as its own numeric modality rather than as a text task for LLMs. Going one step further, augmenting TabPFN with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) further improves accuracy on selected prediction tasks. Finally, we pre-registered a forecast of the Marin Hero Run, a 535B-parameter public training run, whose ground truth is revealed point by point as training progresses, putting meta-model predictions to the test against training outcomes not yet observed at the time of forecasting.

translation.title: 元模型：为学习建模的模型
translation.abstract: 每次神经网络训练不仅产生一个模型，还产生关于模型如何学习的证据。这些积累的实验能否使我们无需执行就能预测和比较新的训练运行？我们研究元模型：预测其他模型学习行为的模型。从这一视角看，最终性能预测、学习曲线预测和超参数选择都是对同一训练响应函数的不同查询。我们朝这一目标迈出了初步的经验性一步：将真实的语言模型训练记录视为原生数值数据，我们发现现成的表格上下文学习器 TabPFN 在多个评估设置中可以匹敌甚至超越微调的 LLM 元模型。近期工作在 token 化配置上微调 LLM 需要数十到数百 GPU 小时，而 TabPFN 只需数秒的拟合与预测时间，无需任务特定的权重更新。我们认为元建模更适合作为其自身的数值模态，而非 LLM 的文本任务。更进一步，用 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks（KANs）增强 TabPFN 在部分预测任务上进一步提高了精度。最后，我们对 Marin Hero Run（一个 535B 参数的公开训练运行）进行了预注册预测，其真值随训练进展逐点揭示，使元模型预测在预测时点尚未观察到的训练结果面前接受检验。
translation.brief: 提出用元模型预测其他模型的训练行为，并证明表格上下文学习器 TabPFN 可高效替代微调 LLM 进行训练结果预测。

papers.title: Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
papers.abstract: Multimodal perception forms the foundation of multimodal intelligence. In particular, spatial perception and multimodal long-context understanding are two pivotal tasks that underpin embodied AI and multimodal agents. However, synthesizing targeted, high-quality training data for these tasks remains difficult and costly. Our key insight is that these tasks share an underlying capability, which we call connecting evidence: identifying relevant visual facts, binding them to the correct entities, recovering their relations, and composing them into an answer. Crucially, targeted training data are far easier to synthesize for this capability than for these tasks themselves. To strengthen this capability, we propose EvidenceConnect, an easy-to-implement data synthesis framework that uses zoomed views of related regions within a single image to generate questions requiring comparison, aggregation, or chaining of visual evidence. To ensure quality, a reference answer is retained only when independent VLMs agree on it, and region-ablation tests discard questions whose answer survives the removal of selected regions. We then train base VLMs on the resulting data with RLVR, obtaining Zooming without Zooming v2 (ZwZ2). Although the synthesized data are not tailored to any downstream benchmark, ZwZ2 improves fine-grained and spatial perception, with further gains on embodied spatial reasoning, multimodal long-context understanding, multimodal agent tasks, and general visual reasoning. These results establish EvidenceConnect as an effective framework for supervising evidence connection and suggest that strengthening this shared capability leads to more generalizable multimodal perception.

translation.title: Zooming without Zooming v2：从看到细节到连接证据，实现可泛化的多模态感知
translation.abstract: 多模态感知是多模态智能的基础。其中，空间感知与多模态长上下文理解是支撑具身AI和多模态智能体的两个关键任务。然而，为这些任务合成有针对性的高质量训练数据仍然困难且成本高昂。我们的核心洞察是：这些任务共享一种底层能力，我们称之为连接证据（connecting evidence）：识别相关视觉事实、将其绑定到正确的实体、恢复它们之间的关系，并将其组合成答案。关键在于，针对这种能力合成有针对性的训练数据，远比为这些任务本身合成数据容易。为强化这一能力，我们提出EvidenceConnect，一个易于实现的数据合成框架，它利用单张图像中相关区域的放大视图来生成需要比较、聚合或链式推理视觉证据的问题。为保证质量，只有当独立的VLM对参考答案达成一致时才保留该答案，并通过区域消融测试丢弃那些在移除所选区域后答案仍然成立的问题。随后我们使用RLVR在所得数据上训练基础VLM，得到Zooming without Zooming v2（ZwZ2）。尽管合成数据并未针对任何下游基准定制，ZwZ2仍提升了细粒度与空间感知能力，并在具身空间推理、多模态长上下文理解、多模态智能体任务和通用视觉推理上取得进一步提升。这些结果确立了EvidenceConnect作为监督证据连接的有效框架，并表明强化这一共享能力能带来更可泛化的多模态感知。
translation.brief: 针对空间感知与长上下文理解等任务训练数据难合成的问题，提出EvidenceConnect框架，通过单图区域放大视图合成需要连接视觉证据的问题并用RLVR训练VLM。

papers.title: Guided-RLVR: Guided Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has shown strong empirical gains in improving the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) on tasks such as mathematics and programming. However, recent studies have shown that RLVR rollouts often collapse onto a narrow set of reasoning trajectories, limiting the explored reasoning space. Motivated by findings that thinking tokens at critical steps serve as critical structural elements in LLM reasoning pathways, we propose Guided-RLVR, a novel approach that augments RLVR with a lightweight controller. The controller strategically injects semantically meaningful steering tokens into the sampling distribution, encouraging the model to approach problems from multiple reasoning perspectives and thereby expanding the exploration space. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks show that Guided-RLVR consistently outperforms existing RLVR methods while producing more diverse reasoning trajectories.

translation.title: Guided-RLVR：可验证奖励强化学习中的引导式探索
translation.abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）在提升大语言模型（LLM）在数学和编程等任务上的推理能力方面已展现出显著的实证收益。然而，近期研究表明，RLVR的rollout常常坍缩到狭窄的一组推理轨迹上，限制了所探索的推理空间。受“关键步骤处的思考token是LLM推理路径中关键结构要素”这一发现的启发，我们提出Guided-RLVR，一种用轻量级控制器增强RLVR的新方法。该控制器策略性地向采样分布中注入语义上有意义的引导token，鼓励模型从多个推理视角切入问题，从而扩展探索空间。在数学推理和代码生成基准上的实验表明，Guided-RLVR持续优于现有RLVR方法，同时产生更多样化的推理轨迹。
translation.brief: 针对RLVR探索空间坍缩、推理轨迹单一的问题，提出用轻量控制器向采样分布注入语义引导token以扩展探索。

papers.title: Blindfold: Keeping the Audit Coin Secret from LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Audit-based certification bounds the violation rate of an LLM agent by auditing a random fraction $\varepsilon$ of actions and reweighting the audited labels; its validity is meant to rest only on the defender's audit coin. We show that it also rests on a confidentiality property: the coin must not interfere with the agent's view before the action commits, at a time the agent chooses. We call this pre-commit noninterference (PNI) and measure its violation by $D_{\mathrm{A}}$, the total-variation distance between the agent's views under the two coin values. PNI is necessary and sufficient for an unbiased certificate against adaptive agents, the worst-case bias is $(1-\varepsilon)D_{\mathrm{A}}$, and no procedure that sees only audited labels can pay less. Leakage composes across steps, a resource shared across episodes opens a channel of computable size, and raising the audit rate cannot restore validity. On a monitor we built, a silent audit changes no output but adds latency that tool timestamps expose, and the agent can enlarge it. A real LLM agent follows an injection that names a visible audit notice (generic, tool, and timing clauses have no effect); over that channel the plain certificate fails on measured labels and, by a post-hoc analysis, in a live run on a pre-registered schedule, while a silent audit restores it. A fresh coin per audited call closes the timing channel; padding only narrows it.

translation.title: Blindfold：对LLM智能体保密审计硬币
translation.abstract: 基于审计的认证通过审计随机比例$\varepsilon$的动作并重新加权被审计标签来约束LLM智能体的违规率；其有效性本应仅依赖于防御者的审计硬币。我们证明它还依赖于一个机密性属性：在动作提交之前、由智能体自行选择的时刻，硬币不得干扰智能体的视图。我们称之为提交前非干扰（PNI），并用$D_{\mathrm{A}}$——智能体在两种硬币取值下视图之间的总变差距离——来度量其违反程度。PNI是针对自适应智能体获得无偏证书的充要条件，最坏情况偏差为$(1-\varepsilon)D_{\mathrm{A}}$，且任何仅能看到被审计标签的程序都无法付出更小的代价。泄漏会跨步骤复合，跨episode共享的资源会打开一条大小可计算的信道，而提高审计率也无法恢复有效性。在我们构建的监控器上，静默审计不改变任何输出，但会增加工具时间戳可暴露的延迟，且智能体可以放大它。一个真实的LLM智能体会遵循一条提及可见审计通知的注入指令（通用、工具和时间条款均无效）；通过该信道，普通证书在实测标签上失效，并经事后分析在预注册计划的实时运行中也失效，而静默审计则恢复了证书。为每次被审计调用使用新硬币可关闭时间信道；填充只能使其变窄。
translation.brief: 针对基于审计的LLM智能体认证因审计信息泄漏给智能体而失效的问题，提出提交前非干扰（PNI）属性并用总变差距离度量泄漏、给出修复方案。

papers.title: Exploring the Limits of the Delta Learning Hypothesis: Single-Pair Generator Biases in Direct Preference Optimization
papers.abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) typically relies on preference pairs generated from diverse model pools and ranked by an external LLM judge. The recently proposed delta-learning hypothesis suggests that comparable supervision can instead be obtained from a single pair of models by treating the larger model's response as preferred. We investigate the limits of this approach across model families and scales. We show, both theoretically and empirically, that fixed model pairs introduce systematic, generator-dependent biases that are predictive of the preference label independent of response quality. Consequently, DPO trained on single-pair data consistently underperforms multi-model preference data, despite the larger generator producing higher-quality responses, and we trace this gap to training dynamics consistent with reward hacking on these biases. We further show that simply increasing the number of generators, even without an external judge, is enough to partially mitigate this effect. Our results highlight generator diversity as a critical factor in preference-data construction.

translation.title: 探索Delta学习假设的极限：直接偏好优化中的单对生成器偏差
translation.abstract: 直接偏好优化（DPO）通常依赖于由多样化模型池生成、并由外部LLM裁判排序的偏好对。最近提出的delta学习假设表明，仅用一对模型——将较大模型的响应视为偏好响应——即可获得相当的监督信号。我们在多个模型家族和规模上研究了这一方法的极限。我们从理论和实证上证明，固定的模型对会引入系统性的、依赖于生成器的偏差，这些偏差能够独立于响应质量预测偏好标签。因此，用单对数据训练的DPO持续劣于多模型偏好数据，尽管较大的生成器产生更高质量的响应，并且我们将这一差距追溯到与对这些偏差的奖励劫持相一致的训练动态。我们进一步表明，仅增加生成器数量——即使没有外部裁判——也足以部分缓解这一效应。我们的结果凸显了生成器多样性在偏好数据构建中的关键作用。
translation.brief: 针对delta学习假设中单对模型生成偏好数据是否可行的问题，通过理论与实验证明固定模型对引入系统性偏差导致DPO性能下降，并指出增加生成器多样性可缓解。

papers.title: Tessera: Structure-Completed Evidence Units for Web Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Web retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) splits a page into fixed-size text chunks or, in recent visual pipelines, screenshot tiles, and the retrieved item serves at once as the unit of indexing, ranking, and reading. We trace answer evidence from source HTML to reader input over the full English Wikipedia and find that this coupling loses evidence in text and screenshot pipelines alike: evidence present in the source page often fails to reach the reader intact, particularly structured content such as tables and infoboxes, which chunking separates from the headers and context that give it meaning. Stronger extraction, context expansion, and larger reader budgets leave the loss in place. We present Tessera, a training-free evidence delivery layer that decouples what a pipeline retrieves from what its reader reads. Given the pages behind any ranked list, Tessera rebuilds their HTML into fine-grained evidence units, each completed with its page title, section path, and table headers, selects the units relevant to the query, and packs them into the reader context at an unchanged token budget. The index, the retriever, and the reader stay as they are, so Tessera applies to text, screenshot, and agentic pipelines. Across three question answering benchmarks, Tessera improves answer accuracy by 5 to 6 points on text and screenshot pipelines, consistently across readers, retrievers, and reader budgets, and outperforms strong HTML-aware and structure-aware RAG baselines under matched budgets. The gains carry over to multi-step agentic search. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/sarendis56/Tessera.

translation.title: Tessera：面向Web检索增强生成的结构补全证据单元
translation.abstract: Web检索增强生成（RAG）将页面切分为固定大小的文本块，或在近期的视觉流水线中切分为截图瓦片，且被检索项同时充当索引、排序和阅读的单元。我们在完整的英文Wikipedia上追踪答案证据从源HTML到阅读器输入的流转，发现这种耦合在文本和截图流水线中都会丢失证据：源页面中存在的证据常常无法完整到达阅读器，尤其是表格和infobox等结构化内容，它们在分块时被赋予其意义的标题和上下文分离。更强的抽取、上下文扩展和更大的阅读器预算都无法消除这一损失。我们提出Tessera，一个免训练的证据交付层，将流水线检索的内容与其阅读器阅读的内容解耦。给定任意排序列表背后的页面，Tessera将其HTML重建为细粒度证据单元，每个单元补全其页面标题、章节路径和表格表头，选择与查询相关的单元，并在不变的token预算下将其打包进阅读器上下文。索引、检索器和阅读器保持不变，因此Tessera适用于文本、截图和智能体流水线。在三个问答基准上，Tessera在文本和截图流水线上将答案准确率提升5到6个百分点，且在不同阅读器、检索器和阅读器预算下保持一致，并在相同预算下优于强大的HTML感知和结构感知RAG基线。这些收益同样延续到多步智能体搜索。我们的代码已在 https://github.com/sarendis56/Tessera 公开。
translation.brief: 针对RAG分块导致表格等结构化证据丢失的问题，提出免训练的Tessera层，将HTML重建为补全标题、章节路径和表头的细粒度证据单元再送入阅读器。

papers.title: OpenGray: a benchmark for evaluating the decisions of radiotherapy planning agents
papers.abstract: Background and purpose: Radiotherapy planning agents based on large language models (LLMs) decide when to submit a plan or request review but are evaluated mainly by dose. This study developed OpenGray, a benchmark of planning tasks with known correct decisions. Materials and methods: OpenGray adds tasks with known answers to the OpenKBP-Opt head-and-neck dataset, including two contradictions with dose goals proven incompatible and a feasible control with a stored plan meeting every hard goal. Four systems, from a rule-based planning script to a full LLM agent, were evaluated on 30 patients, the LLM-based ones with a commercial (Terra) and a local (Ministral 3 8B) LLM. Decisions, achieved dose, problem recognition, and technical failures were recorded and also read from logs of 39 stereotactic radiosurgery runs of SAGE, a clinical LLM agent. Results: With Terra, the script preceded by an LLM review and the full agent had decision accuracies of 95.4% and 92.1%, respectively, yet escalated only 50% (95% confidence interval, 25-75%) and 25% (10-40%) of overlap contradictions, which required arithmetic on the anatomy. All four systems submitted every feasible control, but 24% of these plans missed a hard goal that the stored plan had met. In four SAGE runs, one goal failed at every attempt; the agent identified it in every reply but had no action for stopping. Conclusions: Favorable aggregate scores concealed specific decision failures. Planning agents should be evaluated on their decisions as well as their dose and given an explicit action for stopping and requesting review.

translation.title: OpenGray：用于评估放疗计划智能体决策的基准
translation.abstract: 背景与目的：基于大语言模型（LLM）的放疗计划智能体决定何时提交计划或请求审核，但目前主要通过剂量来评估。本研究开发了OpenGray，一个包含已知正确决策的计划任务基准。材料与方法：OpenGray在OpenKBP-Opt头颈数据集上添加了已知答案的任务，包括两个经证明与剂量目标不相容的重叠矛盾，以及一个带有满足所有硬目标的已存储计划的可行对照。在30名患者上评估了四个系统，从基于规则的计划脚本到完整的LLM智能体，其中基于LLM的系统分别使用商业（Terra）和本地（Ministral 3 8B）LLM。记录了决策、达成剂量、问题识别和技术故障，并从临床LLM智能体SAGE的39次立体定向放射外科运行日志中读取了这些信息。结果：使用Terra时，前置LLM审核的脚本和完整智能体的决策准确率分别为95.4%和92.1%，但仅对50%（95%置信区间，25-75%）和25%（10-40%）的需要对解剖结构进行算术运算的重叠矛盾进行了升级处理。四个系统都提交了所有可行对照，但其中24%的计划遗漏了已存储计划曾满足的某个硬目标。在四次SAGE运行中，有一个目标每次尝试都失败；智能体在每次回复中都识别出了它，却没有停止的操作。结论：良好的总体得分掩盖了具体的决策失败。计划智能体应与剂量一起在决策上进行评估，并被赋予明确的停止和请求审核的操作。
translation.brief: 针对放疗计划LLM智能体仅按剂量评估而忽视决策正确性的问题，构建了带已知正确决策答案的OpenGray基准来评估智能体的决策行为。

papers.title: Text Generation in Low-Resource Languages Using Human-Curated Vocabularies
papers.abstract: Synthetic text generation offers a promising approach to alleviating data scarcity in low-resource languages. However, its effectiveness is inherently limited for languages that are scarcely represented, or entirely absent, in an LLM's pretraining data. At the same time, many such languages have human-curated vocabularies that provide rich lexical and semantic information, often accompanied by grammatical information such as part-of-speech labels. In this work, we ask whether LLMs can leverage these resources to generate coherent text in extremely low-resource and unseen languages. We introduce a framework that combines human-curated vocabularies with a small number of human-written exemplars that provide syntactic signals, while sampling candidate words according to a Zipfian distribution. Across languages with varying levels of resource availability, we evaluate the generated text using lexical diversity, off-target ratio, and human judgments of fluency. Our results show that reasoning-enabled LLMs can generate fluent text even in extremely low-resource languages, with particularly strong results at the sentence level and promising performance at the paragraph level. Our findings highlight a practical pathway for bootstrapping synthetic data in low-resource languages, expanding the amount of usable text even when existing digital resources are extremely limited. Our source code is available at https://github.com/michaelsinanta/vocab2text.
authors: Muhammad Dehan Al Kautsar (Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence)
Phan Phuong Mai Chau (Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence)
Fajri Koto (Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence)

translation.title: 利用人工策划词表进行低资源语言文本生成
translation.abstract: 合成文本生成为缓解低资源语言的数据稀缺提供了有前景的方法。然而，对于在LLM预训练数据中极少出现或完全缺失的语言，其效果存在固有限制。与此同时，许多此类语言拥有提供丰富词汇和语义信息的人工策划词表，通常还附带词性标注等语法信息。在本工作中，我们探究LLM能否利用这些资源在极低资源和未见过的语言中生成连贯文本。我们提出了一个框架，将人工策划词表与少量提供句法信号的人工书写范例相结合，并按Zipf分布采样候选词。在资源可得性不同的多种语言上，我们使用词汇多样性、偏靶率和人工流畅性评判来评估生成文本。结果表明，具备推理能力的LLM即使在极低资源语言中也能生成流畅文本，在句子层面效果尤为突出，在段落层面也表现可观。我们的发现为低资源语言合成数据的自举提供了一条实用路径，即使在现有数字资源极为有限的情况下也能扩充可用文本量。源代码见 https://github.com/michaelsinanta/vocab2text。
translation.brief: 针对LLM预训练数据中缺失的低资源语言文本生成问题，提出结合人工策划词表、少量人工范例和Zipf分布词采样的合成文本生成框架。

papers.title: Prospector: learning a compact graph traversal policy for scientific reasoning
papers.abstract: Scientific reasoning in specialized engineering fields depends on knowledge scattered across the literature, often proprietary and absent from frontier LLM training data. In such domains, frontier models tend to give generic answers. Knowledge graphs (KGs) can ground LLM reasoning. Because a graph is too large to provide in full, typical LLM+KG systems preselect a portion, deciding relevance before reasoning begins. Here we train a compact model, Prospector, to reason over a domain knowledge graph by traversing it step by step, seeking evidence in light of what it has already found. Prospector calls a small set of tools one at a time to progressively build its context, and answers with a chain of evidence that can be checked edge by edge against what its tools retrieved from the graph. On a knowledge graph built from the semiconductor-manufacturing literature, Prospector approaches the strongest off-the-shelf models given the same graph and tools, and it far exceeds off-the-shelf models answering closed-book or from a pre-selected portion of the graph. Although trained only on the semiconductor graph, Prospector transfers to unseen knowledge graphs from three other distinct fields: bio-inspired materials, per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) and materials properties. Served on a single GPU, Prospector answers faster and at a fraction of the cost of a hosted service, while keeping proprietary data on the owner's hardware. We find that the policy's latent state is indicative of its next move on both seen and unseen graphs, and modulating the latent state can steer the policy from one behavior mode to another. These results suggest a practical LLM + KG paradigm for scientific and engineering reasoning over private data, in which a compact model trained on a graph from published literature transfers its traversal to unseen graphs that stay with their owners.

translation.title: Prospector：面向科学推理的紧凑图遍历策略学习
translation.abstract: 专业工程领域的科学推理依赖于散布在文献中的知识，这些知识往往是专有的，且不在前沿LLM的训练数据中。在这些领域，前沿模型倾向于给出泛泛的回答。知识图谱（KG）可以为LLM推理提供依据。由于图太大而无法完整提供，典型的LLM+KG系统会预选一部分图，在推理开始前就决定相关性。在此，我们训练了一个紧凑模型Prospector，通过逐步遍历领域知识图谱来进行推理，根据已发现的线索寻找证据。Prospector一次调用一小组工具来逐步构建上下文，并以一条证据链作答，该证据链可以逐边对照其工具从图中检索的内容进行核查。在由半导体制造文献构建的知识图谱上，在给定相同图和工具的情况下，Prospector接近最强的现成模型，并远超闭卷作答或从预选图部分作答的现成模型。尽管仅在半导体图上训练，Prospector仍能迁移到来自其他三个不同领域的未见知识图谱：仿生材料、全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）以及材料性质。Prospector在单块GPU上即可服务，回答速度更快、成本仅为托管服务的一小部分，同时将专有数据保留在所有者的硬件上。我们发现该策略的潜在状态在已见和未见图上都能指示其下一步动作，且调节潜在状态可以将策略从一种行为模式引导到另一种。这些结果提示了一种针对私有数据进行科学与工程推理的实用LLM+KG范式：在公开文献构建的图上训练的紧凑模型，可将其遍历能力迁移到留在所有者手中的未见图上。
translation.brief: 针对专有领域知识不在LLM训练数据中导致回答泛泛的问题，训练紧凑模型Prospector通过逐步遍历知识图谱并调用工具构建证据链进行推理，且可迁移到未见图谱。

papers.title: WorkFactory: Turning Professional Intents into Executable Work for Scalable Agent Training
papers.abstract: Scaling supervised training for working agents requires diverse professional tasks that yield reliable expert demonstrations. However, missing or inconsistent task information can obstruct teacher execution and weaken the resulting supervision. We propose WorkFactory, a scalable framework for constructing coherent and executable professional tasks. Starting from professional intents, information-level planning builds an information support graph to guide task instantiation, explicitly representing the dependencies and locations of information required for the intended outputs. Probe executions then identify support failures and guide repairs while preserving the intended work. We construct 112,686 tasks spanning 612 occupations and use the collected teacher trajectories to fine-tune Qwen models at 4B, 27B, and 35B-A3B scales, yielding the WorkPilot family. All three models improve over their respective base models across four professional-work benchmarks, with WorkPilot-35B-A3B improving from 879 to 1565 Elo on GDPval-AA v2.1. Scaling analyses reveal model-dependent diminishing returns, with execution length first increasing and then decreasing. Controlled component analyses show that planning and repair reduce probe-diagnosed task environment defects and improve downstream performance. The data and models are available at https://github.com/IQuestLab/WorkFactory.

translation.title: WorkFactory：将专业意图转化为可执行工作以实现可扩展的智能体训练
translation.abstract: 扩展工作型智能体的监督训练需要能产生可靠专家示范的多样化专业任务。然而，任务信息的缺失或不一致会阻碍教师执行并削弱由此产生的监督。我们提出WorkFactory，一个用于构建连贯且可执行专业任务的可扩展框架。从专业意图出发，信息级规划构建信息支持图来指导任务实例化，显式表示预期输出所需信息的依赖关系和位置。随后通过探针执行识别支持故障并指导修复，同时保留预期的工作。我们构建了涵盖612个职业的112,686个任务，并使用收集的教师轨迹微调4B、27B和35B-A3B规模的Qwen模型，得到WorkPilot系列。三个模型在四个专业工作基准上均优于各自的基座模型，其中WorkPilot-35B-A3B在GDPval-AA v2.1上的Elo从879提升到1565。扩展分析揭示了依赖模型的收益递减，执行长度先增后减。受控组件分析表明，规划与修复减少了探针诊断出的任务环境缺陷并提升了下游性能。数据与模型见 https://github.com/IQuestLab/WorkFactory。
translation.brief: 针对专业任务信息缺失或不一致导致教师示范不可靠的问题，提出WorkFactory框架，通过信息支持图规划和探针执行修复来大规模构建可执行的专业训练任务。

papers.title: Coverage Under Contradiction: A Benchmark for Negation-Aware Retrieval
papers.abstract: Coverage-evaluation benchmarks quantify whether retrieved evidence covers the different pieces of information needed to satisfy an information need. Existing benchmarks mostly consider factual claims that may already be known to pretrained retrieval components, leaving open whether retrievers find corpus evidence when it contradicts those priors. We study how retrievers behave when their parametric knowledge and the information in a corpus disagree. To do so, we develop a process to augment a nugget-based coverage benchmark with controlled contradictions. For each nugget, we create a negated counterpart and edit its supporting documents to support that negation while preserving the context. Applying this process to CoverageBench, a benchmark measuring information coverage, we create CoverageBench-Negate, spanning six datasets and roughly 63,000 original-edited evidence pairs (one per nugget-document link). We attach rich construction metadata to every pair and additionally provide out-of-family LLM judgments over all pairs and a human audit of a sample. In baseline experiments, BM25 separates original from edited near-twin evidence substantially better than dense retrievers (Qwen3 and Jina), which stay near chance. We release the benchmark on Hugging Face Datasets (nuggets, documents, pairs) together with the construction materials, including the prompts used to create it.

translation.title: 矛盾下的覆盖：一个否定感知检索基准
