translation.abstract: 覆盖评估基准用于量化检索到的证据是否覆盖了满足信息需求所需的不同信息片段。现有基准大多考虑预训练检索组件可能已知的事实性陈述，这留下了一个悬而未决的问题：当语料证据与这些先验矛盾时，检索器能否找到它。我们研究检索器在其参数化知识与语料信息不一致时的行为。为此，我们开发了一个流程，用受控矛盾来增强基于nugget的覆盖基准。对每个nugget，我们创建其否定对应项，并编辑其支持文档使其支持该否定，同时保留上下文。将该流程应用于衡量信息覆盖的基准CoverageBench，我们创建了CoverageBench-Negate，涵盖六个数据集和约63,000个原始-编辑证据对（每个nugget-文档链接一个）。我们为每个证据对附加了丰富的构建元数据，并额外提供了对所有证据对的跨家族LLM判断以及抽样的人工审计。在基线实验中，BM25区分原始与编辑后近似孪生证据的能力显著优于稠密检索器（Qwen3和Jina），后者接近随机水平。我们在Hugging Face Datasets上发布了该基准（nugget、文档、证据对）及构建材料，包括用于创建它的提示词。
translation.brief: 针对检索器在语料证据与其参数化知识矛盾时能否找到证据的问题，构建了通过否定改写和文档编辑生成受控矛盾的CoverageBench-Negate基准。

papers.title: LiveSearch: Questions as Executable Verifier Code for a Live Benchmark of Professional-Source Financial Search Agents
papers.abstract: In finance, the answer that matters is usually the current one: prices, rates, and disclosures hold only as of a given day, so retrieving up-to-date facts is a core capability of a financial agent. Yet most financial benchmarks overlook timeliness. They fix each answer at annotation time, so the gold goes stale as markets move and, once leaked into training data, rewards recall rather than search and analysis. We introduce LiveSearch, a live benchmark that stores each question as executable verifier code: a typed program of calls to a professional financial data service, followed by a declarative extractor. The question is frozen, while its gold answer is determined by executing the program against professional financial data at evaluation time, and a daily job re-executes it with no human or language model in the loop. A memorized answer is thus likely outdated, and a model must reach the current one through tools and analysis. Construction is equally automatic: a language model only verbalizes programs enumerated from real tool responses and never chooses an answer. Under general web search, six contemporary tool-calling models reach 70.9% to 76.7% answer accuracy. Over three consecutive days, 70% of served questions change their gold value, and even under tolerance-aware matching, a literally reused earlier snapshot fails on a majority of questions within a single day. Per-question tracking uncovers dynamic shifts in correctness masked by aggregate accuracy.

translation.title: LiveSearch：以可执行验证代码作为问题的专业来源金融搜索智能体动态基准
translation.abstract: 在金融领域，重要的答案通常是当前的答案：价格、利率和披露信息仅在特定日期有效，因此检索最新事实是金融智能体的核心能力。然而大多数金融基准忽视了时效性。它们在标注时固定每个答案，导致标准答案随市场变动而过时，且一旦泄露到训练数据中，奖励的是记忆而非搜索与分析。我们提出 LiveSearch，一个动态基准，它将每个问题存储为可执行的验证代码：一个调用专业金融数据服务的类型化程序，后接声明式提取器。问题被冻结，而其标准答案在评估时通过针对专业金融数据执行程序来确定，并且每日任务会重新执行该程序，全程无需人工或语言模型介入。因此记忆的答案很可能过时，模型必须通过工具和分析获得当前答案。构建过程同样自动化：语言模型仅将从真实工具响应中枚举出的程序转化为自然语言，从不选择答案。在通用网络搜索下，六个当代工具调用模型的答案准确率为 70.9% 至 76.7%。在连续三天内，70% 的已服务问题其标准答案发生变化，即使在容错感知匹配下，直接复用较早快照也会在一天内在多数问题上失败。逐题追踪揭示了被总体准确率掩盖的正确性动态变化。
translation.brief: 针对金融基准答案过时导致奖励记忆的问题，提出将问题存储为可执行验证代码、在评估时动态计算标准答案的 LiveSearch 动态基准。

papers.title: MLE-World: Predicting Machine Learning Experiment Outcomes with a Learned World Model
papers.abstract: AI research agents can propose, execute, and improve programs that solve machine learning tasks. However, executing each candidate program requires training and evaluating ML models, limiting how many candidates an agent can explore at each step. We introduce MLE-World, a world model finetuned from Qwen3.5-4B that predicts a program's terminal output (error traces, training logs, and validation scores) from its code and data description without executing it, together with a confidence score estimating the prediction's correctness. Because a prediction costs one inference call rather than a training run, MLE-World makes test time scaling (TTS) affordable for these agents. We build five TTS policies, guided by MLE-World, that compare several candidates per step by their predicted outputs: Sequential revision, Best-of-N, Pairwise judging, Fusion, and a UCB style rule that also adds an exploration bonus from this confidence score. Since predictions can be wrong, we run a candidate for real only when its confidence score is low. On 17 MLE-bench Lite tasks, MLE-World matches the real terminal output on 77.9% of held out programs, versus 41.1% for much larger prompted models. MLE-World guided TTS achieves up to 22.1% higher observed mean performance than the agent without a world model, with less real execution. Project webpage: https://mle-world.github.io/.

translation.title: MLE-World：用学习到的世界模型预测机器学习实验结果
translation.abstract: AI 研究智能体可以提出、执行和改进解决机器学习任务的程序。然而，执行每个候选程序都需要训练和评估 ML 模型，限制了智能体每一步能探索的候选数量。我们提出 MLE-World，一个从 Qwen3.5-4B 微调而来的世界模型，它无需执行即可从程序代码和数据描述预测程序的最终输出（错误轨迹、训练日志和验证分数），并附带一个估计预测正确性的置信度分数。由于一次预测只需一次推理调用而非一次训练运行，MLE-World 使测试时扩展（TTS）对这些智能体变得可行。我们构建了五种由 MLE-World 引导的 TTS 策略，通过预测输出在每步比较多个候选：顺序修订、Best-of-N、成对评判、Fusion，以及一种 UCB 风格的规则，后者还利用置信度分数添加探索奖励。由于预测可能出错，我们仅在置信度分数较低时才真正运行候选程序。在 17 个 MLE-bench Lite 任务上，MLE-World 在 77.9% 的留出程序上与真实最终输出匹配，而大得多的提示模型仅为 41.1%。MLE-World 引导的 TTS 相比无世界模型的智能体，观测到的平均性能提升高达 22.1%，且真实执行次数更少。项目网页：https://mle-world.github.io/。
translation.brief: 针对 ML 智能体执行候选程序成本高的问题，训练世界模型 MLE-World 无需实际执行即可预测程序输出并引导测试时扩展策略。

papers.title: Action-Value Calibration via Continuation Sharing for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents relies on feedback from sequences of interactions, making credit assignment to individual actions difficult. Existing methods such as GiGPO compare actions at shared states to compute relative advantages, but estimate each action's value from a single sampled continuation. The resulting local credit remains sensitive to decisions made later in the trajectory. To address this problem, we propose ConCal (Continuation Calibration), a recursive continuation-value estimator that incorporates continuation evidence already present in a rollout batch. ConCal matches visits from the same task by their incoming state-action-state transitions, combines shared continuation evidence with each visit's own transition estimate, and propagates calibrated values backward to refine earlier action-value estimates. This reduces dependence on individual sampled continuations and mitigates local credit distortions without additional rollouts. Held-out return diagnostics show lower error in within-group value differences and higher agreement with reference action orderings than estimates based on individual continuations. With Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, ConCal improves success rates over GiGPO by 3.39 and 5.86 percentage points on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/Yingjian-Chen/ConCal.

translation.title: 基于延续共享的动作价值校准用于长程智能体强化学习
translation.abstract: 长程智能体的强化学习依赖交互序列的反馈，使得对单个动作的信用分配十分困难。现有方法如 GiGPO 在共享状态处比较动作以计算相对优势，但从单个采样延续估计每个动作的价值。由此得到的局部信用对轨迹后期的决策仍然敏感。为解决这一问题，我们提出 ConCal（Continuation Calibration），一种递归的延续价值估计器，它利用 rollout 批次中已存在的延续证据。ConCal 通过入边状态-动作-状态转移匹配同一任务的访问，将共享的延续证据与每次访问自身的转移估计相结合，并将校准后的价值向后传播以细化更早的动作价值估计。这减少了对单个采样延续的依赖，并在无需额外 rollout 的情况下缓解了局部信用失真。留出回报诊断显示，与基于单个延续的估计相比，其组内价值差异误差更低，与参考动作排序的一致性更高。使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct，ConCal 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上分别比 GiGPO 提升成功率 3.39 和 5.86 个百分点。代码见 https://github.com/Yingjian-Chen/ConCal。
translation.brief: 针对长程智能体强化学习中单次采样延续导致信用分配失真的问题，提出 ConCal 递归估计器，通过共享 rollout 批次中的延续证据校准动作价值。

papers.title: Does Your Generalist Skill Optimizer Really Incentivize Agentic Tasks? Rethinking Skill Optimization via Bipartite Attribution
papers.abstract: Skill optimizers adapt an agent to long-horizon tasks, such as repairing a terminal environment, by rewriting its skill, a natural-language procedure in its context, and keeping the edits that raise success on a small dev set. On such tasks success is noisy, so a gain on a small dev set does not show that an edit helps, and a success score does not show what the edit costs. We introduce BiPA, which replays an optimizer's acceptance rule on candidates identical to its seed to measure what selection alone reports, and records each episode as a bipartite graph of turns and the text they read to trace extra input tokens to the behavior behind them. Across three optimizers, three agentic benchmarks and two models, the learned skills succeed about as often as their hand-written seed, 0.1 points higher on average. Their dev gains vanish on test: keeping the best of several candidates on at most 30 tasks reports gains this large even when none changed. They read about 16% more input tokens: the optimizers almost always add rules, half to re-check work and some to act one call at a time, and the agent follows them as extra turns, each re-sending the whole conversation. Four principles follow: accept an edit only if its gain exceeds what selection alone reports; charge it for the turns it adds, not for its length; let the editor delete and merge rules; show it what earlier rules cost. Code is available at https://github.com/valleysprings/BiPA.git.

translation.title: 你的通用技能优化器真的能激励智能体任务吗？基于二部归因的技能优化再思考
translation.abstract: 技能优化器通过重写智能体的技能（其上下文中的自然语言流程）并保留在小开发集上提升成功率的修改，使智能体适应长程任务，例如修复终端环境。在这类任务上成功具有噪声，因此小开发集上的提升并不能证明修改有效，而成功分数也无法体现修改的代价。我们提出 BiPA，它在与其种子完全相同的候选上重放优化器的接受规则，以测量仅凭选择所能报告的效果，并将每个回合记录为回合与所读文本的二部图，以追踪额外输入 token 背后的行为。在三个优化器、三个智能体基准和两个模型上，学到的技能的成功率与手写种子大致相当，平均仅高 0.1 分。它们的开发集增益在测试集上消失：在至多 30 个任务上保留多个候选中的最优者，即使没有任何改变也能报告如此大的增益。它们多读取约 16% 的输入 token：优化器几乎总是添加规则，一半用于复查工作，一些用于一次只执行一次调用，而智能体将其作为额外回合遵循，每个回合重发整个对话。由此得出四条原则：仅当修改的增益超过仅凭选择所报告的效果时才接受它；按其增加的回合而非长度计费；让编辑器删除和合并规则；向它展示先前规则的代价。代码见 https://github.com/valleysprings/BiPA.git。
translation.brief: 针对技能优化器在小开发集上的增益不可靠且忽视代价的问题，提出 BiPA 通过重放接受规则和二部图归因来评估技能编辑的真实收益与成本。

papers.title: Spine: Compiling Subtask Trees into Structured Context for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Long-horizon coding tasks contain nested subtasks. Typically, agents record interactions sequentially into a growing history, causing context inflation and performance degradation. Compressing or trimming the history without explicit subtask boundaries can discard information needed by unfinished subtasks. Conversely, recursive subagent delegation isolates completed subtasks through child agents by assigning every subtask boundary to delegation, which conflates subtask granularity with executing agent choice, adding execution and coordination overhead. We introduce Spine, an interface and runtime that align model context with subtask nesting and completion. An agent declares explicit subtask boundaries through work scopes, allowing the same agent to execute nested subtasks inline while reserving delegation for independent parallel tasks. The runtime organizes execution in SpineTree, a persistent tree recording subtask relations, local interactions, completion states, and returned results. Before each model call, it compiles the tree into model context just in time, retaining unfinished subtasks' interactions and replacing completed subtasks' details with their results, while preserving prefix-cache reuse. We integrate Spine into Codex to build SpineCodex. With GPT-5.6 Sol, compared with native Codex, SpineCodex improves SWE-Milestone Score by 11.8% while reducing total cost by 32.4%, improves the average ProgramBench test-pass rate by 17.3%, and improves Mean@5 on eight of the ten evaluated FrontierSWE tasks. On SWE-Milestone, it also achieves a comparable Score to Recursive Subagent at 73.7% lower total cost. We also integrate Spine into Pi through a reusable software package: with Gemini 3.8 Flash and Qwen 3.8 27B, it improves SWE-Milestone Score by 9.5-17.5% and the average ProgramBench test-pass rate by 4.3-8.7% compared with native Pi.

translation.title: Spine：将子任务树编译为结构化上下文用于长程编码智能体
translation.abstract: 长程编码任务包含嵌套子任务。通常，智能体将交互按顺序记录到不断增长的历史中，导致上下文膨胀和性能下降。在没有显式子任务边界的情况下压缩或裁剪历史，可能丢弃未完成子任务所需的信息。相反，递归子智能体委托通过子智能体隔离已完成的子任务，将每个子任务边界都交给委托处理，混淆了子任务粒度与执行智能体的选择，增加了执行和协调开销。我们提出 Spine，一个使模型上下文与子任务嵌套和完成状态对齐的接口与运行时。智能体通过工作范围（work scopes）声明显式的子任务边界，允许同一智能体内联执行嵌套子任务，同时将委托保留给独立的并行任务。运行时将执行组织在 SpineTree 中，这是一棵持久树，记录子任务关系、局部交互、完成状态和返回结果。在每次模型调用前，它即时将树编译为模型上下文，保留未完成子任务的交互，并用结果替换已完成子任务的细节，同时保持前缀缓存复用。我们将 Spine 集成到 Codex 中构建 SpineCodex。使用 GPT-5.6 Sol，与原生 Codex 相比，SpineCodex 将 SWE-Milestone Score 提升 11.8%，同时将总成本降低 32.4%，将 ProgramBench 平均测试通过率提升 17.3%，并在十个评估的 FrontierSWE 任务中的八个上提升 Mean@5。在 SWE-Milestone 上，它还以低 73.7% 的总成本达到与递归子智能体相当的分数。我们还通过可复用软件包将 Spine 集成到 Pi 中：使用 Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 Qwen 3.8 27B，与原生 Pi 相比，它将 SWE-Milestone Score 提升 9.5-17.5%，ProgramBench 平均测试通过率提升 4.3-8.7%。
translation.brief: 针对长程编码任务中历史上下文膨胀与子任务边界缺失的问题，提出 Spine 通过显式工作范围和 SpineTree 运行时将上下文与子任务嵌套结构对齐并即时编译。

papers.title: AutoRSE: Evaluating LLM Agents as Recommendation Engineers for Self-Evolving Recommender Systems
papers.abstract: Recommender Systems Engineer Agents (RSE-Agents), which use LLM-based agents to autonomously improve recommendation algorithms, are emerging as a promising paradigm. However, their capabilities and limitations remain poorly understood due to the lack of a unified, standardized evaluation framework and systematic trajectory-level analysis. To address this gap, we introduce AutoRSE, an evaluation framework spanning six representative industrial-grade recommendation tasks, and conduct a large-scale empirical study of three frontier LLMs across three widely used agent harnesses. Our results show that RSE-Agents consistently enhance the performance of backbones on five of the six tasks, with an average relative improvement of 16.1%, indicating that they can already autonomously improve recommendation performance. However, trajectory-level analysis also reveals that current RSE-Agents function primarily as engineering optimizers rather than algorithmic improvers: their gains are largely driven by hyperparameter tuning, training strategies, and model ensembling, while genuine algorithmic innovations are rare. Since the largest gains in recommender systems often stem from algorithmic advances, this behavior underscores a fundamental limitation of current RSE-Agents. To probe this limitation, we perform idea-injection experiments and show that agents equipped with innovative ideas from frontier research or human experts achieve substantially larger improvements than those relying on self-generated ideas. These results suggest that idea generation is a central bottleneck of current RSE-Agents, highlights a key direction for the future recommendation system research. Our implementation is publicly available on GitHub: https://github.com/Ray-Tiann/AutoRSE.

translation.title: AutoRSE：将LLM智能体评估为推荐工程师以实现自演化推荐系统
translation.abstract: 推荐系统工程师智能体（RSE-Agents）利用基于LLM的智能体自主改进推荐算法，正在成为一种有前景的范式。然而，由于缺乏统一、标准化的评估框架和系统的轨迹级分析，其能力与局限仍鲜为人知。为填补这一空白，我们提出了AutoRSE，一个涵盖六项代表性工业级推荐任务的评估框架，并对三个前沿LLM在三种广泛使用的智能体框架下进行了大规模实证研究。结果表明，RSE-Agents在六项任务中的五项上持续提升骨干模型性能，平均相对提升16.1%，说明它们已能自主改进推荐性能。然而，轨迹级分析也揭示，当前的RSE-Agents主要充当工程优化器而非算法改进者：其收益主要来自超参数调优、训练策略和模型集成，而真正的算法创新非常罕见。由于推荐系统的最大收益往往来自算法进步，这一行为凸显了当前RSE-Agents的根本局限。为探究这一局限，我们进行了思想注入实验，结果表明配备前沿研究或人类专家创新思想的智能体比依赖自我生成思想的智能体取得显著更大的提升。这些结果表明，思想生成是当前RSE-Agents的核心瓶颈，并指明了未来推荐系统研究的关键方向。我们的实现已在GitHub上公开：https://github.com/Ray-Tiann/AutoRSE。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体自主改进推荐算法缺乏统一评估的问题，提出AutoRSE评估框架并进行大规模实证分析。

papers.title: Decision Models as Judges for Hallucination Detection
papers.abstract: Large language models are widely used as judges of model outputs (LLM-as-a-Judge), but they are costly and can hallucinate or be overconfident. Decision models are a potential alternative. They return a predefined verdict with a probability for each label instead of free-form text and are much cheaper and faster. We test this promise on hallucination detection. We build binary benchmarks for five hallucination types (9,852 items from six datasets) and compare five decision models with the generative judge gpt-6-sol. Performance depends strongly on the type: the best decision model matches gpt-6-sol in balanced accuracy on context inconsistency and comes within 3 percentage points on factual errors, but trails it by 4-8 points on logical and instruction inconsistency. Decision-model probabilities are overconfident, though less so than the GPT-6 models, and separate correct from incorrect decisions only moderately. We also find that a confidence cascade of decision models improves on the best single model by 1.9-3.3 points on three types and matches or exceeds gpt-6-sol at 1-3% of its cost. Overall, decision models are a practical low-cost judge for some hallucination types but need to be validated before use.

translation.title: 决策模型作为幻觉检测的裁判
translation.abstract: 大语言模型被广泛用作模型输出的裁判（LLM-as-a-Judge），但其成本高且可能产生幻觉或过度自信。决策模型是一种潜在替代方案。它们返回带有每个标签概率的预定义判定，而非自由文本，且更便宜、更快速。我们在幻觉检测上检验这一承诺。我们构建了涵盖五种幻觉类型的二分类基准（来自六个数据集的9,852条数据），并将五个决策模型与生成式裁判gpt-6-sol进行比较。性能在很大程度上取决于类型：最佳决策模型在上下文不一致上的平衡准确率与gpt-6-sol持平，在事实错误上仅落后3个百分点，但在逻辑不一致和指令不一致上落后4-8个百分点。决策模型的概率过度自信，尽管程度低于GPT-6模型，且只能中等程度地区分正确与错误的判定。我们还发现，决策模型的置信度级联在三种类型上比最佳单一模型提升1.9-3.3个百分点，并以1-3%的成本达到或超过gpt-6-sol。总体而言，决策模型是某些幻觉类型的实用低成本裁判，但使用前需要验证。
translation.brief: 针对LLM裁判成本高且易幻觉的问题，评估决策模型作为幻觉检测裁判的可行性与局限。

papers.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
papers.abstract: Agentic services alternate between model inference on clustered GPUs and external tools on distributed CPUs. In this scenario, existing systems (1) overlook tool-return readiness in service evaluation, wasting limited resources, and (2) use heuristic strategies to decide admission and placement on GPUs, resulting in suboptimal scheduling decisions. To bridge this gap, we present TAO, a tool-aware joint scheduling framework for LLM-based agentic serving. Its value interface combines near-term tool readiness, node-specific cache credit with time-aware decay, and token footprint; a dynamic program jointly selects and places waiting sessions under capacity constraints. Across the 12 reported model-workload-concurrency settings, TAO reduces latency by up to 26.8%, reduces mean time to first token (TTFT) by up to 36.3%, and increases decode throughput by up to 29.5% relative to the best evaluated state-of-the-art baseline for each metric.

translation.title: TAO：面向LLM智能体服务的工具感知联合调度
translation.abstract: 智能体服务在集群GPU上的模型推理与分布式CPU上的外部工具之间交替进行。在这一场景下，现有系统（1）在服务评估中忽视工具返回就绪情况，浪费了有限资源；（2）使用启发式策略决定GPU上的准入与放置，导致次优的调度决策。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了TAO，一个面向LLM智能体服务的工具感知联合调度框架。其价值接口结合了近期的工具就绪性、具有时间感知衰减的节点特定缓存信用以及token占用；一个动态规划在容量约束下联合选择并放置等待中的会话。在报告的12种模型-工作负载-并发设置中，相对于每个指标下评估的最佳先进基线，TAO将延迟最多降低26.8%，将首token时间（TTFT）均值最多降低36.3%，并将解码吞吐量最多提升29.5%。
translation.brief: 针对智能体服务中忽视工具就绪性导致GPU调度次优的问题，提出结合工具就绪性、缓存信用与token占用的联合调度框架TAO。

papers.title: GraphRAGProv: GraphRAG Meets How-Provenance
papers.abstract: GraphRAG systems often use knowledge graphs to retrieve relevant context for an LLM that produces the final answer. That makes answers more inscrutable and therefore less appealing for domains where transparency is paramount. We present GraphRAGProv, an architecture that executes SPARQL queries over source-grounded RDF graphs to compute answers and their how-provenance polynomials. These polynomials record which statement occurrences were used and how they were combined. Because each occurrence is linked to its source text, users can follow these links to check whether the extracted statements reflect the text and whether the query combines them to answer the question. Querying thereby becomes a way to inspect and evaluate the text-to-graph transformation. Our interactive demo examines 400 cases from two multi-hop QA benchmarks, revealing extraction and query errors even when the final answer is correct.

translation.title: GraphRAGProv：GraphRAG与How-Provenance的结合
translation.abstract: GraphRAG系统通常使用知识图谱为LLM检索相关上下文以生成最终答案。这使答案更加难以解读，因此在透明度至关重要的领域吸引力下降。我们提出GraphRAGProv，一种在基于源文本的RDF图上执行SPARQL查询的架构，用于计算答案及其how-provenance多项式。这些多项式记录了使用了哪些语句出现实例以及它们如何被组合。由于每个出现实例都链接到其源文本，用户可以沿着这些链接检查提取的语句是否反映文本，以及查询是否将它们组合起来回答问题。查询由此成为检查和评估文本到图转换的一种方式。我们的交互式演示检查了来自两个多跳问答基准的400个案例，即使在最终答案正确的情况下也揭示了提取和查询错误。
translation.brief: 针对GraphRAG答案缺乏可解释性的问题，提出在源文本RDF图上执行SPARQL查询并计算how-provenance多项式的架构。

papers.title: Peers4U: Designing Learner-Centered Virtual Peers for Children's Multimodal Mathematics Learning
papers.abstract: In early mathematics, children learn abstract concepts through concrete representations, such as manipulating objects, drawing, and speaking. Learning with peers can enrich this process by exposing children to diverse strategies and enabling them to exchange ideas through interaction. We realized this potential with virtual peers in Peers4U, a multimodal learning system to enhance children's mathematical conceptual understanding. Virtual peers driven by LLMs are personalized to the learner's cognitive level and assigned multimodal solutions with inspectable processes. During learning, peers engage in mixed-initiative interactions by responding, initiating topics, and advancing discussions along a pedagogical progression. A user study with 22 children and two experts showed our learner-centered topic orchestration significantly outperformed a persona-centered baseline, and children spontaneously authored new artifacts to demonstrate inspired ideas or share their own strategies, producing significantly more solutions when grouped with more Leading Peers. We contribute design insights for multimodal, learner-centered virtual peer systems.

translation.title: Peers4U：为儿童多模态数学学习设计以学习者为中心的虚拟同伴
translation.abstract: 在早期数学学习中，儿童通过具体表征学习抽象概念，如操作物体、绘画和说话。与同伴学习可以通过让儿童接触多样化策略并通过互动交流想法来丰富这一过程。我们通过Peers4U中的虚拟同伴实现了这一潜力，Peers4U是一个增强儿童数学概念理解的多模态学习系统。由LLM驱动的虚拟同伴根据学习者的认知水平进行个性化，并被分配具有可检查过程的多模态解法。在学习过程中，同伴通过回应、发起话题以及沿着教学进程推进讨论来参与混合主动式互动。一项包含22名儿童和两名专家的用户研究表明，我们以学习者为中心的话题编排显著优于以人设为中心的基线，且儿童会自发创作新作品来展示受启发的想法或分享自己的策略，当与更多Leading Peers分组时产生显著更多的解法。我们贡献了多模态、以学习者为中心的虚拟同伴系统的设计见解。
translation.brief: 针对儿童数学学习中同伴互动缺失的问题，设计由LLM驱动、按学习者认知水平个性化的多模态虚拟同伴系统。

papers.title: Grounding LLM Agents in Business Processes: Process-Aware Knowledge Graphs for Reliable Multi-Step Service Invocation
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents that call enterprise APIs must select the correct endpoints, follow process order, use valid payload keys, and choose coded values from predefined lists. However, current retrieval-augmented service discovery treats endpoints independently and therefore misses process and schema constraints. We address this limitation by integrating Open Data Protocol (OData) metadata and Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) reference processes in a typed property graph. A hybrid retriever identifies candidate endpoints using dense embeddings and follows process edges to retrieve subsequent endpoints. We evaluate the method on 42 enterprise services with process-chain ground truth. For queries with low lexical overlap between the query and downstream entities, it improves Recall@3 by 5.7 points (n=74), with consistent gains across embedding models and cut-offs. It matches dense retrieval on other queries and provides no improvement on OpenAPI services without a process layer, indicating that the gains arise from process structure. We also evaluate an LLM agent on 81 multi-step queries. It completes 38.7% of tasks, compared with 10.3% for a chunk-based baseline. In an elicitation probe, providing valid code lists eliminates invented codes but leaves invalid keys in 46% of write runs. Full typed context reduces invalid calls to 3% (3 of 101 runs), with no invented codes. These results show that exposing process and schema constraints during retrieval improves the reliability of agent-driven API calls.

papers.title: Aligning Large Language Models for Safety in African Languages: A Case Study of Hausa
papers.abstract: Safety alignment research for large language models (LLMs) remains concentrated on high-resource languages, leaving open how existing alignment methods perform in low-resource, culturally distinct settings. We study this question for Hausa, a language spoken by more than 200 million people across West Africa. We introduce HausaSafeLM, one of the first Hausa safety preference dataset, built from 10,000 prompts derived from PKU-SafeRLHF: 3,000 human-corrected (gold) and 7,000 machine-translated (silver) examples spanning six harm macro-categories. Using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, we compare supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and SFT followed by Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) under both data regimes, evaluating on 500 harmful and 200 benign Hausa prompts.We find that the untuned base model appears highly safe by refusal-rate metrics alone, but this reflects limited Hausa generation ability rather than genuine alignment: its refusals are almost uniformly low quality. SFT improves both refusal fluency and precision and benefits substantially from the larger, noisier silver-tier data, while DPO sharpens refusal precision but comes at a steep, largely data-invariant cost to linguistic quality. No single configuration jointly maximizes safety, helpfulness, and fluency. Our results suggest that current alignment techniques teach models when to refuse more readily than how to do so fluently in underrepresented languages, and that refusal-rate metrics alone are an unreliable signal of safety in low-resource settings.

papers.title: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: The Decision Geometry of Agent Interfaces
papers.abstract: Language model agents are post-trained and deployed through a harness, the prompts, tools, and control logic that present a task to the model and execute its outputs. Harnesses are often revised and judged by how an already trained model performs under them, which assumes that what the model learned under one harness carries over to the next. We ask what a policy learns from its harness and what survives when the harness changes. Under KL-regularized control, we show that the log odds of an optimal policy recover how strongly its harness favors each action over the others, so a trained policy carries the preferences of its harness. Deployed return then equals the ceiling of the harness, the best return it offers, minus the mismatch of the policy, the return lost to its own suboptimal decisions. Training changes only the mismatch, while changing the harness moves both terms. Comparing harnesses with a fixed model therefore mixes what each harness offers with how well that model uses it. In MiniWoB++, post-training makes a model's preferences specific to its training harness. Reversing the order of the observation fields leaves every optimal decision unchanged yet lowers a trained model's success from 85.0% to 19.2%. Conversely, every new harness that a fixed-model comparison rejects but that raises the ceiling outperforms the original agent after further training under it, and ceiling and mismatch measured beforehand predict these gains. For coding-agent harnesses on Terminal-Bench Lite, ceiling minus mismatch estimated with a stronger model as a stand-in for the optimum reproduces the accuracy ranking, while either term alone does not. Code is available at https://github.com/2020-qqtcg/HRP.

papers.title: Watermark Basins: Black-Box Detection of Distilled LLMs
papers.abstract: Proprietary language models and their reasoning traces are vulnerable to API-based distillation, where an adversary trains a student model on the teacher model's outputs. To obtain evidence of distillation, model providers can watermark the teacher's outputs, aiming to leave a radioactive signal in the student's outputs. Existing black-box detectors search for such radioactivity using token-level statistics of the suspect model's outputs. However, token-level signals are not always detectable, for instance when the distillation traces are sampled at a low temperature. In this work, we discover the watermark basin, a persistent signal that enables more reliable watermark detection: during fine-tuning, watermarked teacher traces embed a distinct, key-specific geometric signal in parameter space that lies orthogonal to the ordinary task-specific fine-tuning subspace. Building on this, we introduce Watermark Basin Alignment (WM-Basin), a black-box watermark detector that queries the suspect model through its API, without access to its weights or logits. WM-Basin maps generated text to gradient representations using a fixed clean probe model, projects out the ordinary fine-tuning task directions, and tests whether the residual gradient aligns with the watermark basin induced by the watermark key. We evaluate WM-Basin extensively across diverse teacher models and student architectures (from 135M to 8.2B parameters) distilled on mathematical reasoning. At a strict 0.1% false-positive rate, WM-Basin detects 79% of distilled models at n-gram=1 and 45% at n-gram=3, substantially improving over the state-of-the-art token-level baseline (29% and 1.3%, respectively). Because the watermark signal resides in a persistent basin, it survives post-distillation modifications including quantization, pruning, and reinforcement-learning post-training.

translation.abstract: Proprietary language models and their reasoning traces are vulnerable to API-based distillation, where an adversary trains a student model on the teacher model's outputs. To obtain evidence of distillation, model providers can watermark the teacher's outputs, aiming to leave a radioactive signal in the student's outputs. Existing black-box detectors search for such radioactivity using token-level statistics of the suspect model's outputs. However, token-level signals are not always detectable, for instance when the distillation traces are sampled at a low temperature. In this work, we discover the watermark basin, a persistent signal that enables more reliable watermark detection: during fine-tuning, watermarked teacher traces embed a distinct, key-specific geometric signal in parameter space that lies orthogonal to the ordinary task-specific fine-tuning subspace. Building on this, we introduce Watermark Basin Alignment (WM-Basin), a black-box watermark detector that queries the suspect model through its API, without access to its weights or logits. WM-Basin maps generated text to gradient representations using a fixed clean probe model, projects out the ordinary fine-tuning task directions, and tests whether the residual gradient aligns with the watermark basin induced by the watermark key. We evaluate WM-Basin extensively across diverse teacher models and student architectures (from 135M to 8.2B parameters) distilled on mathematical reasoning. At a strict 0.1% false-positive rate, WM-Basin detects 79% of distilled models at n-gram=1 and 45% at n-gram=3, substantially improving over the state-of-the-art token-level baseline (29% and 1.3%, respectively). Because the watermark signal resides in a persistent basin, it survives post-distillation modifications including quantization, pruning, and reinforcement-learning post-training.

papers.title: Where Should the Evaluation Budget Go in LLM-Driven Agent Scaffold Evolution?
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-driven agent scaffold evolution improves agent workflows through iterative candidate generation and evaluation. Evaluation both guides subsequent search and determines the final scaffold, but evaluating every candidate on the full task set incurs substantial execution costs. We investigate how evaluation budgets can be allocated across these two roles. Our experiments show that sparse feedback can sustain productive evolution, while additional targeted evaluation improves final selection. Replay analyses further show that shared informative items and a common scoring reference support comparisons among closely matched candidates. Motivated by these findings, we propose \method, an evaluation allocation framework that combines sparse search-time feedback with targeted final confirmation. A short fully evaluated warm-up establishes a shared informative core and calibrates a response model whose item parameters remain fixed during search. After search, \method refits the model and applies paired successive halving, reusing accumulated observations and executing only missing evaluations. Across four benchmarks and two evolution frameworks, \method achieves higher mean performance than full evaluation in most settings while using approximately half as many evaluation cells.

translation.title: Where Should the Evaluation Budget Go in LLM-Driven Agent Scaffold Evolution?
translation.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-driven agent scaffold evolution improves agent workflows through iterative candidate generation and evaluation. Evaluation both guides subsequent search and determines the final scaffold, but evaluating every candidate on the full task set incurs substantial execution costs. We investigate how evaluation budgets can be allocated across these two roles. Our experiments show that sparse feedback can sustain productive evolution, while additional targeted evaluation improves final selection. Replay analyses further show that shared informative items and a common scoring reference support comparisons among closely matched candidates. Motivated by these findings, we propose \method, an evaluation allocation framework that combines sparse search-time feedback with targeted final confirmation. A short fully evaluated warm-up establishes a shared informative core and calibrates a response model whose item parameters remain fixed during search. papers.title: Modeling Preference Dependencies with Directed Acyclic Graphs for Narrative-Driven Recommendation
papers.abstract: Narrative-driven recommendation allows users to express multifaceted needs through free-form text where stated preferences naturally qualify and condition one another. Existing methods typically treat narratives as flat keyword combinations or unconstrained generative queries, failing to capture how complex preferences hierarchically refine and contextualize each other. We propose the Preference Dependency Graph Framework (PDG-F), a narrative-driven recommendation framework centered on explicit preference dependencies. Specifically, PDG-A (PDG-Agent) first parses unstructured requests to organize user preferences and their mutual qualifications into a directed acyclic Preference Dependency Graph (PDG). Through this graph, candidate evidence from the open Web is acquired via directed path retrieval, and final recommendations are determined by topological path ranking. Comprehensive experiments across three diverse domains spanning English and Chinese contexts confirm that PDG-F consistently achieves superior recommendation performance over competitive baselines, open-domain retrieval agents, and frontier language models. Further diagnostic analyses show that our dependency-guided retrieval markedly raises the attainable candidate-pool ceiling, demonstrating the fundamental value of modeling preference dependencies in narrative-driven recommendation.

translation.title: 基于有向无环图的偏好依赖建模用于叙事驱动推荐
translation.abstract: 叙事驱动推荐允许用户通过自由文本表达多方面需求，其中所述偏好之间会自然地相互限定和制约。现有方法通常将叙事视为扁平的关键词组合或无约束的生成式查询，未能捕捉复杂偏好如何分层地相互细化和情境化。我们提出偏好依赖图框架（PDG-F），一个以显式偏好依赖为核心的叙事驱动推荐框架。具体而言，PDG-A（PDG-Agent）首先解析非结构化请求，将用户偏好及其相互限定关系组织为有向无环的偏好依赖图（PDG）。基于该图，通过有向路径检索从开放Web获取候选证据，并通过拓扑路径排序确定最终推荐。在涵盖英语和中文语境的三个不同领域上的全面实验表明，PDG-F持续取得优于竞争基线、开放域检索智能体和前沿语言模型的推荐性能。进一步诊断分析显示，依赖引导的检索显著提升了可达到的候选池上限，证明了在叙事驱动推荐中建模偏好依赖的根本价值。
translation.brief: 针对叙事推荐中复杂偏好相互限定无法被现有方法捕捉的问题，提出以有向无环偏好依赖图为核心的框架，结合有向路径检索与拓扑路径排序进行推荐。

papers.title: RPSD: Retrieval-Privileged On-Policy Self-Distillation with Optimal Transport
papers.abstract: Sequential recommendation predicts a user's next interaction from historical behavior. Recent LLM-based methods recast this task as generative recommendation and increasingly adopt reinforcement learning such as GRPO for post-training. However, these methods suffer from two limitations, namely credit-blind optimization, where a sequence-level reward is shared across all generated tokens, and collaborative-blind supervision, where each training signal is derived from a single user and ignores behavioral patterns shared across similar users. To address both issues, we propose Retrieval-Privileged on-policy Self-Distillation (RPSD). For credit-blind optimization, we introduce on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), in which a teacher with privileged knowledge re-evaluates the student's on-policy response, and the token-level confidence difference between the student and teacher reshapes the shared sequence-level advantage into token-specific credit. However, the privileged knowledge in vanilla OPSD is still derived from a single user, leaving collaborative-blind supervision unresolved. We therefore ground the teacher in collaborative behavioral evidence from similar users. Specifically, we use temporally aware optimal transport (OT) to compare interaction trajectories across users by jointly considering item similarity and temporal structure, and further apply diversity-aware selection to retain complementary trajectories as privileged evidence. In this way, on-policy self-distillation provides fine-grained token-level credit, while OT enriches the teacher with structured cross-user evidence. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to bring on-policy self-distillation to sequential recommendation and to use cross-user behavior as its privileged signal. Extensive experiments across multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that RPSD achieves state-of-the-art performance.

translation.title: RPSD：基于最优传输的检索特权在线自蒸馏
translation.abstract: 序列推荐从历史行为预测用户的下一次交互。近期基于LLM的方法将该任务重构为生成式推荐，并日益采用GRPO等强化学习进行后训练。然而这些方法存在两个局限：信用盲优化，即序列级奖励被所有生成token共享；以及协同盲监督，即每个训练信号仅来自单个用户而忽略相似用户间共享的行为模式。为解决这两个问题，我们提出检索特权在线自蒸馏（RPSD）。针对信用盲优化，我们引入在线自蒸馏（OPSD），其中拥有特权知识的教师重新评估学生的在线策略响应，学生与教师之间的token级置信度差异将共享的序列级优势重塑为token级信用。然而原始OPSD中的特权知识仍来自单个用户，未解决协同盲监督问题。因此我们以相似用户的协同行为证据来支撑教师。具体地，我们使用时间感知的最优传输（OT），通过联合考虑物品相似性和时间结构来比较跨用户的交互轨迹，并进一步应用多样性感知选择保留互补轨迹作为特权证据。由此，在线自蒸馏提供细粒度的token级信用，而OT以结构化的跨用户证据丰富教师。据我们所知，这是首个将在线自蒸馏引入序列推荐并将跨用户行为作为特权信号的工作。在多个真实数据集上的大量实验表明，RPSD取得了最先进的性能。
translation.brief: 针对LLM序列推荐中序列级奖励共享和单用户监督两大缺陷，提出在线自蒸馏结合时间感知最优传输选取跨用户协同证据作为教师特权信号，实现token级信用分配。

papers.title: BenchMeUp: Building Software Engineering Benchmarks from Natural-Language Specifications
papers.abstract: Software-engineering research relies on benchmarks that evaluate new techniques on a set of problem instances. Unfortunately, manually constructing benchmarks is labor-intensive, as researchers must find suitable instances, prepare execution environments, establish expected outcomes, and validate correctness. This paper presents BenchMeUp, an approach for automatically creating software-engineering benchmarks from natural-language specifications. Given a specification defining the desired instances, data sources, and evaluation procedures, BenchMeUp generates search rules and a construction plan, invokes parallel LLM agents that identify candidate instances and construct executable instances, validates the results in fresh execution environments, and packages the instances behind a unified command-line interface. We evaluate the approach on four tasks: program repair, issue reproduction, compiler autotuning, and fixing static-analysis warnings. Targeting 50 instances per task (200 in total), BenchMeUp constructs 198 instances, of which 196 (99\%) are successfully packaged. Search and construction take 36 minutes and \$0.79 per instance, on average. Evaluating eight existing techniques on the generated benchmarks, we find that 189 of 196 packaged instances (96\%) support end-to-end evaluation, allowing users to study the effectiveness of the techniques. Checking every constructed instance against its source, the specification, and its expected outcome, we find that 180 of 198 (91\%) meet all criteria, compared with 10 of 200 instances delivered by Codex (general-purpose coding agent). Overall, we show that LLM-based agents can automate benchmark construction across diverse software-engineering tasks and produce executable instances that existing techniques can use, while validity beyond execution still needs to be checked.

translation.title: BenchMeUp：从自然语言规格说明构建软件工程基准
translation.abstract: 软件工程研究依赖于在一组问题实例上评估新技术的基准。不幸的是，手工构建基准非常费力，研究人员必须找到合适的实例、准备执行环境、建立预期结果并验证正确性。本文提出BenchMeUp，一种从自然语言规格说明自动创建软件工程基准的方法。给定定义所需实例、数据源和评估流程的规格说明，BenchMeUp生成搜索规则和构建计划，调用并行的LLM智能体识别候选实例并构建可执行实例，在全新执行环境中验证结果，并将实例封装在统一的命令行接口之后。我们在四个任务上评估该方法：程序修复、issue复现、编译器自动调优和修复静态分析警告。以每任务50个实例（共200个）为目标，BenchMeUp构建了198个实例，其中196个（99%）成功打包。搜索和构建平均每个实例耗时36分钟、花费0.79美元。在生成的基准上评估八种现有技术，我们发现196个打包实例中的189个（96%）支持端到端评估，使用户能够研究这些技术的有效性。将每个构建实例与其来源、规格说明和预期结果核对，我们发现198个中的180个（91%）满足所有标准，而Codex（通用编程智能体）交付的200个实例中仅10个达标。总体而言，我们表明基于LLM的智能体可以跨多种软件工程任务自动化基准构建，并生成现有技术可用的可执行实例，但执行之外的有效性仍需检查。
translation.brief: 针对软件工程基准手工构建费时费力的问题，提出利用并行LLM智能体从自然语言规格说明自动搜索、构建、验证并打包可执行基准实例的方法。

papers.title: Probabilistic Sequential Safety for Stochastic Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract: In this letter, we investigate a notion of probabilistic safety for a stochastic dynamical system. Standard safety notions are based on the idea that an unsafe region of the state-space must be avoided at each instant. In contrast, we study a sequential safety notion which is based on avoiding a tuple of target regions of the state-space. The proposed safety notion is inspired by many practical systems, ranging from modeling jailbreak attacks in large language models (LLMs) to predicting hazardous chemical reactions. In solving the sequential safety problem, we solve a sequential reachability problem for a stochastic dynamical system.

translation.title: 随机动力系统的概率序贯安全性
translation.abstract: 在这篇快报中，我们研究了随机动力系统的一种概率安全性概念。标准安全性概念基于在每一时刻避开状态空间中不安全区域的思想。相比之下，我们研究一种序贯安全性概念，其基于避开状态空间中一组目标区域。所提出的安全性概念受许多实际系统启发，从建模大语言模型（LLM）的越狱攻击到预测危险化学反应。在求解序贯安全性问题时，我们求解了随机动力系统的序贯可达性问题。
translation.brief: 研究避开状态空间中一组目标区域的序贯安全性概念，并将其求解转化为随机动力系统的序贯可达性问题。

papers.title: ReForest: Interpretability Meets Reasoning in Isolation Forest
papers.abstract: Statistical anomaly detection methods like Isolation Forest are efficient but suffer from a critical semantic gap. They identify numerical rarities but fail to understand the contextual meaning of data, often missing subtle, context-dependent anomalies. Conversely, Large Language Models possess strong semantic reasoning capabilities but are prohibitively expensive and slow for large-scale deployment. To bridge this gap, we propose ReForest, a novel framework that synergizes the statistical efficiency of Isolation Forest with the reasoning power of LLMs. ReForest transforms the latent decision paths of Isolation Forest into natural-language explanations, enabling an LLM to refine anomaly detection through an uncertainty-aware dynamic ensemble. This approach allows the model to adaptively weigh statistical and semantic signals based on uncertainty-driven instance-level confidence. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets (Healthcare, Finance) demonstrate that ReForest significantly outperforms baselines, achieving an average 21% improvement in Recall and a 10% gain in F1-score. Our framework not only improves detection performance but also enhances model transparency by grounding semantic narratives in statistical evidence, providing interpretable rationales essential for high-stakes decision-making.

translation.title: ReForest：可解释性与推理在孤立森林中的融合
translation.abstract: 孤立森林等统计异常检测方法高效，但存在关键的语义鸿沟。它们识别数值上的稀有性却无法理解数据的上下文含义，常常遗漏细微的、依赖上下文的异常。相反，大语言模型具备强大的语义推理能力，但对于大规模部署而言成本过高且速度缓慢。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出ReForest，一个将孤立森林的统计效率与LLM推理能力相协同的新框架。ReForest将孤立森林的潜在决策路径转化为自然语言解释，使LLM能够通过不确定性感知的动态集成来改进异常检测。该方法使模型能够基于不确定性驱动的实例级置信度自适应地权衡统计信号与语义信号。在四个真实数据集（医疗、金融）上的大量实验表明，ReForest显著优于基线，Recall平均提升21%，F1分数提升10%。我们的框架不仅提升检测性能，还通过将语义叙述建立在统计证据之上增强了模型透明度，为高风险决策提供了可解释的依据。
translation.brief: 针对孤立森林缺乏语义理解和LLM成本过高的问题，提出将孤立森林决策路径转化为自然语言解释、由LLM通过不确定性感知动态集成为异常检测融合统计与语义信号的方法。

papers.title: AnalogScout: Simulation-Efficient PVT-Aware Analog Sizing with LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Analog device sizing must satisfy all specifications across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners to ensure tape-out success, but simulating every candidate at all corners dominates the sizing time and slows design iteration. Conventional surrogate-based optimizers search the sizing space directly, while recent large language model (LLM) agents add circuit knowledge to designs but still delegate the sizes to global optimizers. Both learn the circuit response from repeated multi-corner SPICE simulations and optimize on top of it, which becomes expensive under a limited simulation budget. Providing an agent with reusable verified designs and sizing sub-blocks analytically could save most of this budget. We propose AnalogScout, a simulation-efficient PVT-aware sizing framework driven by an LLM agent. Combining elite-design reuse, analytic gm/Id local sizing and global refinement under full-corner verification, AnalogScout reduces power by 43.3% relative to the evolution strategy CMA-ES at an equal budget of 16k simulations on three SKY130 OTAs of increasing complexity, and reaches the final CMA-ES power after 7.0% of that budget. It also attains lower power than Bayesian optimization on all three OTAs and than two re-implemented LLM-driven flows on the two OTAs where they were tested.

translation.title: AnalogScout：基于LLM智能体的仿真高效PVT感知模拟电路尺寸优化
translation.abstract: 模拟器件尺寸优化必须在所有工艺、电压和温度（PVT）角下满足全部规格以确保流片成功，但对每个候选设计在所有角下进行仿真主导了优化时间并拖慢设计迭代。传统的基于代理模型的优化器直接搜索尺寸空间，而近期的大语言模型（LLM）智能体为设计引入电路知识，但仍将尺寸交给全局优化器。两者都通过反复的多角SPICE仿真学习电路响应并在此基础上优化，在有限仿真预算下代价高昂。为智能体提供可复用的已验证设计和解析式的子模块尺寸计算可以节省大部分预算。我们提出AnalogScout，一个由LLM智能体驱动的仿真高效PVT感知尺寸优化框架。通过结合精英设计复用、解析式gm/Id局部尺寸计算以及全角验证下的全局精调，AnalogScout在三个复杂度递增的SKY130 OTA上，以相同的16k仿真预算相比进化策略CMA-ES降低43.3%的功耗，并仅用CMA-ES预算的7.0%即达到其最终功耗。它还在全部三个OTA上取得低于贝叶斯优化的功耗，并在两个OTA上优于两个重新实现的LLM驱动流程。
translation.brief: 针对多PVT角下模拟电路尺寸优化仿真开销过大的问题，提出结合精英设计复用、解析式gm/Id局部定尺寸与全局精调的LLM智能体框架AnalogScout。

papers.title: WCC: A Learning-Based Framework for Deciding When to Apply Cooperative Coevolution in Large-Scale Optimization
papers.abstract: Cooperative Coevolution (CC) and Non-Decomposition Algorithms (NDAs) are two primary approaches for large-scale global optimization (LSGO). Although both have achieved success, they exhibit markedly different performance across problem types and each faces approach-specific limitations, leaving the question of "when to use CC" unresolved. We address this gap with WCC, a novel learning-based framework that dynamically decides when to deploy CC in LSGO. WCC employs a streamlined design for efficient adaptive learning. We formulate the decision as a Markov decision process, designing a targeted feature set, a robust reward, and a tailored network architecture to provide the agent with rich information about the problem state and optimization progress. Our auto-regressive policy enables WCC to perform fine-grained, dynamic switching between CC and NDAs while conditionally allocating the computational budget without expert specifications. WCC shows strong competitiveness and superior generalization across problems, optimization horizons, and baseline optimizers. It realizes a "train-once and reuse" paradigm under a low budget, significantly curbing LSGO cost. Additionally, in-depth analyses yield insights not captured by existing theory, offering practical guidance on when and how to effectively deploy CC.

translation.title: WCC：一个决定何时在大规模优化中应用协作协同进化的学习型框架
translation.abstract: 协作协同进化（CC）与非分解算法（NDA）是大规模全局优化（LSGO）的两种主要方法。尽管两者都取得了成功，但它们在不同问题类型上的表现差异显著，且各自存在方法特有的局限，使得“何时使用CC”这一问题悬而未决。我们用WCC填补这一空白，这是一个新颖的基于学习的框架，可动态决定在LSGO中何时部署CC。WCC采用精简设计以实现高效的自适应学习。我们将该决策建模为马尔可夫决策过程，设计了针对性的特征集、稳健的奖励和定制的网络架构，为智能体提供关于问题状态和优化进度的丰富信息。我们的自回归策略使WCC能够在CC与NDA之间进行细粒度的动态切换，并有条件地分配计算预算而无需专家指定。WCC在不同问题、优化时域和基线优化器上展现出强大的竞争力和出色的泛化能力。它在低预算下实现了“一次训练、多次复用”的范式，显著降低了LSGO成本。此外，深入分析提供了现有理论未能捕捉的洞见，为何时以及如何有效部署CC提供了实用指导。
translation.brief: 针对大规模优化中何时使用协作协同进化（CC）难以判断的问题，将其建模为马尔可夫决策过程，用学习型框架WCC在CC与非分解算法间动态切换并分配预算。

papers.title: Hidden in Plain Sight: an Empirical Study about The Instruction Stacks of Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents send their models more than the user's prompt: they add instructions, tool definitions, and environmental context that form an instruction stack. This stack guides execution and changes across releases, yet remains largely unexposed to users and insufficiently characterized in research. We present a longitudinal, cross-agent study of the instruction stacks captured in the first model requests of 1,886 releases of Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, and OpenCode. Under controlled conditions, we analyze their composition and evolution and trace changes in the four open-source agents to documented motivations. Our findings show why examining the system prompt or reporting the model alone provides an incomplete account of agent inputs. Tool definitions dominate three agents' latest requests, while occasional concentrated revisions alter instructions governing tool use, attribution, and coding style. Such revisions can complicate how researchers identify agent-authored contributions and interpret generated code. We also found that only 48% of examined change units directly explain the motivation for stack revisions. Across agents, shared capabilities emerge despite increasingly distinct wording. These findings expose an evolving, incompletely documented layer of agent design. The findings motivate documenting captured instruction stacks alongside agent releases, models, and user prompts, and preserving the rationale behind their revisions.

translation.title: Hidden in Plain Sight：关于编码智能体指令栈的实证研究
translation.abstract: 编码智能体发送给模型的远不止用户的提示词：它们还会添加指令、工具定义和环境上下文，构成一个指令栈。该栈指导执行过程并随版本发布而变化，但对用户基本不可见，在研究中也缺乏充分刻画。我们对Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Qwen Code和OpenCode共1,886个版本首次模型请求中捕获的指令栈进行了纵向、跨智能体的研究。在受控条件下，我们分析其组成与演化，并将四个开源智能体的变更追溯到已记录的动机。我们的发现表明，仅检查系统提示词或只报告模型名称无法完整刻画智能体的输入。工具定义在三个智能体的最新请求中占主导地位，而偶发的集中式修订会改变 governing 工具使用、署名和编码风格的指令。此类修订可能使研究者难以识别智能体撰写的贡献并解读生成的代码。我们还发现，所考察的变更单元中只有48%直接说明了栈修订的动机。尽管措辞日益不同，各智能体间仍涌现出共享的能力。这些发现揭示了一个不断演化、文档不完整的智能体设计层面。这些发现促使我们将捕获的指令栈与智能体版本、模型和用户提示词一同记录，并保留其修订背后的理由。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体隐藏的指令栈缺乏系统刻画的问题，对五个主流编码智能体1,886个版本的指令栈进行纵向实证分析，揭示其组成、演化及对研究的影响。

papers.title: CoS-VQ: Coordinated Shared-Scale Vector Quantization for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) require substantial memory, motivating low-bit weight quantization for efficient deployment. Existing vector quantization (VQ) methods often improve accuracy by increasing the effective coding dimension, which can complicate independent lookup and local codeword updates. We propose CoS-VQ (Coordinated Shared-Scale Vector Quantization), which preserves low-dimensional codewords while jointly optimizing hard indices and their shared scale across positions. The key challenge is scale-induced coupling: the optimal scale depends on the entire codeword combination and, in turn, changes candidate rankings across positions, so pointwise updates can stall even after scale re-optimization. CoS-VQ collects candidates at multiple probe scales and constructs a tangent separable upper bound for the residual-aware quadratic objective. By reducing candidate comparisons to lower envelopes of lines over positive scales, it identifies finitely many representative intervals for joint index--scale updates without exhaustively enumerating codeword combinations. On Qwen3.8-27B, CoS-VQ outperforms QTIP and LLVQ on the evaluated language modeling, coding, and reasoning benchmarks. Ablations from the same initialization further show larger gains from joint updates than from scale-only refinement, highlighting joint selection as an alternative to increasing codeword dimensionality. The code is available at https://github.com/xzktx003/Cos_VQ.

translation.title: CoS-VQ：面向大语言模型的协同共享尺度向量量化
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）需要大量内存，推动了低比特权重量化以实现高效部署。现有的向量量化（VQ）方法常通过增大有效编码维度来提升精度，这会使独立查表和局部码字更新变得复杂。我们提出CoS-VQ（协同共享尺度向量量化），在保持低维码字的同时，联合优化硬索引及其跨位置的共享尺度。关键挑战在于尺度引起的耦合：最优尺度取决于整个码字组合，进而改变各位置的候选排序，因此即使在尺度重新优化后，逐点更新也可能停滞。CoS-VQ在多个探测尺度下收集候选，并为残差感知的二次目标构造切向可分的上界。通过将候选比较化为正尺度上直线的下包络，它识别出有限个代表性区间用于联合索引-尺度更新，而无需穷举码字组合。在Qwen3.8-27B上，CoS-VQ在所评估的语言建模、编码和推理基准上优于QTIP和LLVQ。来自相同初始化的消融实验进一步表明，联合更新带来的收益大于仅尺度精调，凸显了联合选择作为增大码字维度之外的一种替代方案。代码见 https://github.com/xzktx003/Cos_VQ。
translation.brief: 针对向量量化中增大编码维度导致查表和更新复杂的问题，提出CoS-VQ，通过构造切向可分上界在低维码字下联合优化索引与共享尺度。

papers.title: Mind the Intent Gap: A Methodology for Collaborative Agent-Driven Software Engineering
papers.abstract: AI agents have entered software teams, first as tools and now as team members. They produce in minutes what used to take days, yet the expected gain in delivery often fails to appear. We argue that they are entering processes designed for people, which quietly relied on people to cover three of their weaknesses. The team's intent was never fully written down, because colleagues filled the gaps. An AI agent fills them too, though by guessing, and drifts from what the team had in mind. The reasoning behind each deliverable was already lost from one step to the next, and AI agents now inflate and deflate the documents passed along. The reasoning people did alone was partly private and now moves into AI tools that keep it private by nature. We present CAIA, for Collaborative Agentic Intent Alignment, a methodology for software teams that brings agents into the way they work. A knowledge base describes the product that a project maintains. For each Change, a micro-team aligns on its intent before agents evolve the product and propose updates to the Knowledge Base. The proposed CAIA methodology emerged from an industrial need and is already in use at Ni2, with a platform built to support it. We present the methodology and outline our plans to evaluate it further.

translation.title: Mind the Intent Gap：协作式智能体驱动软件工程方法论
translation.abstract: AI智能体已进入软件团队，最初作为工具，如今作为团队成员。它们能在几分钟内完成过去需要数天的工作，然而预期的交付收益却常常未能实现。我们认为，它们正在进入为人设计的流程，而这些流程悄然依赖人来弥补智能体的三个弱点。团队的意图从未被完整写下，因为同事会填补空白。AI智能体也会填补这些空白，但靠的是猜测，从而偏离团队的本意。每个交付物背后的推理在步骤之间本已丢失，而AI智能体现在会放大或压缩传递的文档。人们独自进行的推理部分是私有的，如今则转移到天然保持私有的AI工具中。我们提出CAIA（Collaborative Agentic Intent Alignment），一套让智能体融入软件团队工作方式的方法论。知识库描述项目所维护的产品。对于每次变更（Change），微团队在智能体演进产品并提议更新知识库之前先对齐其意图。CAIA方法论源于工业需求，已在Ni2投入使用，并构建了支持它的平台。我们介绍该方法论并概述进一步评估的计划。
translation.brief: 针对AI智能体进入软件团队后因团队意图未被显式记录而偏离本意的问题，提出CAIA方法论，通过知识库与变更前微团队意图对齐来协作驱动软件工程。

papers.title: Aligning Institutional Power and Operational Ability
papers.abstract: To be socially sustainable, Agentic AI systems require normative designs that align responsibilities with the ability to fulfil them. Identifying incongruences such as unsatisfiable expectations or privilege escalation is crucial in avoiding normative pitfalls. In this study, we discuss design dimensions suitable for describing multi-agent systems in light of this norm-ability alignment requirement. We propose a formal framework centred on process-oriented modelling and institutional power for the analysis of a given normatively relevant process, discuss strategies for repairing it, and elaborate on how the symmetrical relation between operational process and institutional state affects the lifecycle of normative positions.

papers.title: HIDE: Hierarchical Isolation via Documentation and Evidence for Rustc Bugs
papers.abstract: Rustc bugs can prevent valid programs from compiling or cause incorrect compilation results, making the identification of responsible source files essential for repair. Using large language models (LLMs) for rustc bug isolation raises three challenges. First, distributed compiler functionality requires understanding both what individual files do and how they work together. Second, a large source file search space makes exhaustive analysis of all files costly. Third, including documentation and source code for many candidate files in LLM prompts leads to context overload, which can reduce bug isolation accuracy. We propose HIDE, a hierarchical LLM-based approach that combines compiler documentation with bug evidence to rank suspicious rustc source files. Given a rustc revision and a bug context, HIDE consists of two stages that generate compiler documentation and narrow the search space. To understand distributed compiler functionality, the Layered Documentation Aggregation stage summarizes what individual files do and how files with similar functions work together. To reduce the large source file search space, the Hierarchical Bug Isolation stage uses hierarchical candidate selection to reduce the number of files requiring detailed analysis. To mitigate context overload, this stage uses Scoped Candidate Competition and Evidence-Guided Code Slicing to limit the number of candidates and the amount of source code included in each prompt, respectively. We evaluate HIDE on 160 reproducible rustc bugs and compare it with Agentless, SoapFL, and GraphLocator. With GPT-5.4, HIDE achieves 42.08% Accuracy@1 and 80.42% Accuracy@10, exceeding the strongest baseline results by 5.83% and 6.04%, respectively. These results demonstrate that generating compiler documentation, narrowing candidates hierarchically, and limiting analysis context enable effective rustc bug isolation.

papers.title: Uncovering Why LLMs Fail: From Internal Mechanisms to Adversarial Reasoning Trajectories
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are usually evaluated by final-output correctness or safety, yet an endpoint label does not reveal how a failure develops throughout the reasoning process. We therefore ask whether ordinary reasoning failures and adversarially induced failures can be characterized using the same internal coordinates. Towards this end, we in this paper study a white-box diagnostic framework CauTrace to disclose the root-cause of why LLM fails from three fundamental inspections: Functional States, Propagation of Representation, Temporal-State Coordination and Reasoning Trajectory. First, seven functional states are creatively defined to represent the support and constraint processing in LLMs. Second, the propagation of representation change measures how the changes among the seven states persist across subsequent Transformer blocks. Third, temporal-state coordination and trajectory topology characterize when the commitment and verification occur relative to the support, and how the dominant state sequence evolves over the full inference process. Finally, we evaluate CauTrace on both clean reasoning failures and paired adversarial perturbations. Across Qwen and LLaMA-family models, the failed traces show weaker Attention-MLP agreement on support-state updates and less verification activity relative to commitment, while the exact representation-level signatures and timing shifts vary by architecture. Held-out repair and steering tests demonstrate consistent operational signals that were in line with our claims for certain models and specific settings, with aligned steering producing the predicted directional changes in process measures. Overall, CauTrace provides a unified diagnostic framework for analyzing failure dynamics through changes in support, commitment, and verification, which would shed light on the in-depth research on LLM security.

papers.title: Agent-Conditioned Routing: Diverse Reasoning Paths Within One Frozen Model
papers.abstract: Generating several solutions can expose alternative methods, but additional trajectories often paraphrase one dominant approach. We investigate whether the conditional capacity of a frozen sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) model can provide such diversity from one problem prompt, without user-assigned roles, prescribed methods, fine-tuning, or model copies. Agent-Conditioned Routing (ACR) assigns $m$ parallel trajectories persistent, untrained shared/private expert-eligibility masks while preserving the learned, input-dependent token router. On a screened 126-question multi-mode mathematics and physics benchmark, with model judges reading the reported derivations in full, we count the number of problems yielding at least two distinct primary methods among soft-correct solutions in four trajectories. ACR reaches approximately twice as many such problems as the strongest temperature setting under GLM 5.3 (37.3 versus 18.7), and 1.67 times as many under GPT-5.6 Sol (45.00 versus 27.00), at matched output budgets. A blinded four-expert audit on a stratified sample of 30 problems also finds more multi-method solutions with ACR on both backbones, with lower correctness. Matched-eligibility ablations show modest multi-method count advantages for ACR, while token-resampled masks attain higher correctness. An informed sequential prompt elicits more diversity still, using previous solutions and explicit requests for alternative methods. ACR adds about 160 KiB of mask state. In a three-problem microbenchmark capped at 1,024 tokens, its latency and peak VRAM usage remain within 3% of batched temperature sampling.

papers.title: Same Verdict, Different Readers: Personalizing Fact-Checking Explanations from Relative Preferences
papers.abstract: Fact-checking explanations help Web users understand why a claim receives its verdict, yet the same explanation may not satisfy readers with different backgrounds and preferences. We formulate Faithful Personalized Fact-Checking Explanation Rewriting, which adapts an existing explanation to individual readers while preserving factual fidelity. Rather than relying on reader-written reference explanations, we learn personalized rewriting from the relative preferences of LLM-simulated readers. However, this presents two challenges: distinguishing persona-specific preferences from general explanation quality and learning beyond a limited set of predefined explanation styles. To address these challenges, we propose Personalized Explanation Rewriting via Preference Learning (PERPL), a framework consisting of two components. Simulated Preference Construction derives persona-specific supervision from simulated reader preferences through cross-persona reciprocal pairing. Progressive Preference Learning first trains a lightweight rewriter on the constructed supervision and then refines it through exploration-guided preference optimization, enabling it to discover preferred explanations beyond the predefined styles. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PERPL outperforms much larger general-purpose LLMs in personalized preference alignment while maintaining high factual fidelity.

papers.title: Game-Theoretic Solvers with Bayesian Opponent Modeling and Moral Rhetoric Framing for GLEE
papers.abstract: We describe the agent we submitted to the GLEE Competition, which plays bargaining, negotiation, and persuasion games against a shared pool of human and AI opponents. The agent is built around three central components: a classical game-theoretic solver to compute numeric moves, an online Bayesian layer to estimate opponent archetypes, and a language model to write accompanying messages. We utilize Rubinstein bargaining for bargaining, Faratin concession for negotiation, and Kamenica--Gentzkow disclosure for persuasion, and adapt those models to live opponents using two separate layers: a Bayesian estimate of the opponent's hidden discount factor, reservation value, or signaling reliability, and a Thompson sampling bandit over five moral-foundation framings coupled with an evidence-intuition spectrum to establish message register. Most of the development effort went into the recurring problem that theoretically optimal policies perform poorly in certain live settings; we report associated failure modes, guardrails we built, and our hypotheses. We additionally evaluate our model over 13,200 Monte Carlo games against 11 synthetic opponent archetypes, an ablation of the opponent-modeling layer, and an extensive analysis of 9,337 live-game messages in which moral rhetoric framing in the persuasion setting is strongly correlated with whether the buyer purchased ($\chi^2=616.7$, $p \approx 3.7\times10^{-132}$), surviving controls for quality, round, and configuration.

papers.title: Clearing the FoG: Training KG Agents to Retrieve the Evidence Behind Their Answers
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can answer many factual questions correctly, but a correct answer is not necessarily a supported one. For an LLM agent, a knowledge graph (KG) plays two roles: as a source of answers, it supplies facts that the model lacks; as a source of evidence, it supplies the supporting triples that make an answer traceable and auditable. However, existing KG agents treat the KG only as a source of answers: their training data carries answers but not evidence, and their training rewards check the answer but not the retrieved evidence, so agents often answer correctly without retrieving the supporting triples. We propose FoG, a framework that trains KG agents to retrieve the evidence behind their answers. FoG consists of evidence-grounded synthesis, a KG interaction agent, and an evidence-coverage process reward (ECPR): the synthesis recursively hides explicit entities behind verifiable sub-questions, so that every question carries its supporting triples by construction; the agent records the triples returned by the KG; and ECPR credits each supporting triple to the turn that first retrieves it. Experiments on three KGQA benchmarks demonstrate that FoG enables 3B--4B open-source agents to outperform substantially larger baselines in answer accuracy and evidence coverage, with zero-shot cross-KG transfer.

papers.title: Constraining the Commit Boundary: A DIO/ODI-Informed Authorization Guardrail for Agentic Entity Resolution
papers.abstract: Agentic Entity Resolution (ER) systems iteratively plan actions, retrieve evidence, revise hypotheses, and propose graph mutations. An erroneous identity hypothesis may condition later retrieval and produce apparent confirmation. This paper proposes a Digital Identity Optimization (DIO) and Ontology of Digital Identity (ODI)-informed authorization boundary between evidence available for agent reasoning and evidence eligible to authorize persistent identity-changing mutations. A domain-governed constraint-binding function maps selected reconstruction-failure distinctions to explicit identity-preserving constraints. An abstract two-phase supervisor permits a commit only when claim-specific authorization-eligible evidence supports every required proposition, relevant conflicts are resolved, the operation remains within its authorized scope, and relevant state and policy versions remain valid. Admission as UNVERIFIED does not confer authorization eligibility. Separate claim-specific promotion governs evidentiary use; insufficient support or unresolved material conflict leads to deferral. The contribution is a specification connecting diagnostic-to-constraint mapping, evidence promotion, proposition coverage, conflict handling, scope binding, and commit-time version integrity. A proposed evaluation protocol is designed to assess the mapping's incremental value beyond generic authorization and conventional identifier rules. This is a conceptual architecture without implementation or empirical validation, not a theorem of semantic correctness. Its property depends on domain-policy adequacy, evidence promotion, and enforcement. It does not prevent erroneous hypotheses or hypothesis-conditioned retrieval; dependency-aware evidence flow remains future research.

papers.title: Bayes-Adaptive MDPs for Rollout Allocation to Enhance GRPO Training
papers.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has demonstrated strong performance in LLM post-training. However, it allocates a uniform rollout budget to every training question, ignoring variations in question difficulty. As a result, highly difficult questions may receive too few rollouts to generate informative positive reward signals, limiting their contribution to training, while moderately difficult questions often receive more rollouts than necessary. In this work, we formulate the problem of difficulty-aware rollout budget allocation to maximize training utility under the same total rollout budget as standard GRPO. We propose AdaRoll-GRPO, which reformulates rollout allocation as a sequential decision-making problem and leverages a Bayes-adaptive Markov decision process (MDP) to learn an adaptive allocation policy. The learned policy is computed offline and applied during GRPO training without introducing additional online optimization overhead. Extensive experiments on multiple reasoning datasets and LLM architectures demonstrate that AdaRoll-GRPO consistently improves GRPO training performance under a fixed rollout budget, highlighting the effectiveness of adaptive rollout allocation for GRPO in LLM post-training.

translation.title: Bayes-Adaptive MDPs for Rollout Allocation to Enhance GRPO Training
translation.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has demonstrated strong performance in LLM post-training. However, it allocates a uniform rollout budget to every training question, ignoring variations in question difficulty. As a result, highly difficult questions may receive too few rollouts to generate informative positive reward signals, limiting their contribution to training, while moderately difficult questions often receive more rollouts than necessary. In this work, we formulate the problem of difficulty-aware rollout budget allocation to maximize training utility under the same total rollout budget as standard GRPO. We propose AdaRoll-GRPO, which reformulates rollout allocation as a sequential decision-making problem and leverages a Bayes-adaptive Markov decision process (MDP) to learn an adaptive allocation policy. The learned policy is computed offline and applied during GRPO training without introducing additional online optimization overhead. Extensive experiments on multiple reasoning datasets and LLM architectures demonstrate that AdaRoll-GRPO consistently improves GRPO training performance under a fixed rollout budget, highlighting the effectiveness of adaptive rollout allocation for GRPO in LLM post-training.

papers.title: Request-Adaptive Execution for Efficient Hybrid LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Hybrid large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising way to combine the modeling capability of the Attention mechanism with the efficiency of state space models (SSMs). However, most existing hybrid LLMs still inherit a static design philosophy: once the Attention-to-SSM layout is chosen, every request must follow the same hybrid execution. This one-layout-fits-all design is inefficient for real-world serving workloads, where different requests rely on contextual information in different ways. This paper presents Morph, a serving system that co-designs the model architecture and runtime for request-adaptive hybrid LLM inference. Its model architecture pairs Attention and SSM layers within each block and uses prefill-oriented gating to select a request-specific layout that remains fixed throughout decoding. Its serving runtime preserves batching efficiency under divergent layer choices through selective batching and enables correct prefix reuse through hybrid-aware context caching. Experiments on six datasets show that Morph achieves a better quality-efficiency trade-off than existing static hybrid baselines. System-level evaluation further shows that Morph improves the serving throughput by up to 3.87x over baselines while substantially reducing inference latency.

translation.title: Request-Adaptive Execution for Efficient Hybrid LLM Inference
translation.abstract: Hybrid large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising way to combine the modeling capability of the Attention mechanism with the efficiency of state space models (SSMs). However, most existing hybrid LLMs still inherit a static design philosophy: once the Attention-to-SSM layout is chosen, every request must follow the same hybrid execution.
